    Circuit Distillation

    电路蒸馏

    Somin Wadhwa, Silvio Amir, Byron C. Wallace

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Circuit distillation aligns internal representations of corresponding teacher and student circuit components to transfer algorithmic capabilities, directly advancing mechanistic understanding and control of internal mechanisms. Entity tracking and theory-of-mind tasks provide evidence about capability transfer, but the abstract does not make compositional generalization or broader system design a central contribution.

    电路蒸馏对齐教师模型和学生模型中对应电路组件的内部表征，以迁移算法能力，直接推动了对内部机制的机理性理解和控制。实体跟踪和心智理论任务为能力迁移提供了证据，但摘要并未将组合泛化或更广泛的系统设计作为核心贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Model distillation typically focuses on behavioral mimicry, where a student model is trained to replicate a teacher's output while treating its internal computations as a black box. In this work we propose an alternative approach: Distilling the underlying computational mechanisms implemented by a teacher model. Specifically, we propose circuit distillation, which introduces an objective to align internal representations between analogous circuit components in teacher and student models. We propose a method to match ``functionally correspondent'' circuit components and introduce a loss reflecting similarities between the representations that these induce. We evaluate circuit distillation on entity tracking and theory of mind (ToM) tasks using models from the Llama3 family. Our results demonstrate that circuit distillation outperforms standard distillation, successfully transferring algorithmic capabilities by adjusting only a small, targeted subset of student model parameters. This work establishes the feasibility of transferring mechanisms, which may in turn allow for efficient distillation of targeted teacher capabilities via interpretable and controllable internal student mechanisms.

    中文

    模型蒸馏通常侧重于行为模仿：训练学生模型复现教师模型的输出，同时将其内部计算视为黑箱。在本研究中，我们提出另一种方法：蒸馏教师模型实现的底层计算机制。具体而言，我们提出电路蒸馏，通过一个目标函数对齐教师模型与学生模型中相应电路组件的内部表征。我们提出一种匹配“功能对应”电路组件的方法，并引入一个反映这些组件所产生表征之间相似性的损失函数。我们使用 Llama3 系列模型，在实体跟踪和心智理论（ToM）任务上评估电路蒸馏。结果表明，电路蒸馏优于标准蒸馏；它仅需调整学生模型中少量经过针对性选取的参数，就能成功迁移算法能力。本研究证实了迁移机制的可行性，这或许能通过可解释且可控的学生模型内部机制，高效蒸馏教师模型的特定能力。

    Advancing the Pareto Frontier of Test-Time Scaling with Multi-Path Plan Aggregation

    通过多路径计划聚合推进测试时扩展的帕累托前沿

    Siheng Xiong, Ali Payani, Faramarz Fekri

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    MPPA uses jointly generated plans and learned answer selection to improve test-time reasoning accuracy per token, with supervised and reinforcement learning optimization. Its central contribution directly advances multi-step reasoning; plan composition is a secondary contribution, while adapters and inference-time computation alone provide only incidental Systems relevance and no interpretability insight.

    MPPA 通过联合生成计划和学习答案选择来提升测试时推理的每 token 准确率，并采用监督学习和强化学习进行优化。其核心贡献直接推动了多步推理；计划组合是次要贡献，而适配器和推理时计算仅与系统领域略有关系，也没有带来可解释性方面的洞见。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Test-time scaling seeks to improve reasoning through additional inference-time computation, commonly using solution sampling with majority voting to select the final answer. However, repeated sampling can reproduce correlated errors, limiting the accuracy gains from additional computation. We introduce Multi-Path Plan Aggregation (MPPA), which learns planning and answer selection using separate LoRA adapters on a shared frozen backbone. The planner jointly generates $K$ short plans, each guiding a separate solution generated by the frozen executor; the aggregator then scores the resulting solutions and selects the final answer. Joint planning encourages complementary approaches suited to the executor's capabilities, while learned selection uses reasoning evidence to identify correct candidates. Alternating optimization improves planning and aggregation through supervised finetuning and reinforcement learning. Across five mathematics and science benchmarks and three backbones, MPPA improves accuracy--token trade-offs compared with training-free and training-based baselines. With three plans, it achieves higher average accuracy than eight directly sampled solutions with majority voting or the same learned aggregator, while reducing output tokens by 47--54%. Evaluation with task-provided subtasks further demonstrates higher final-task accuracy than direct sampling with majority voting or learned aggregation at either the task or subtask level.

    中文

    测试时扩展旨在通过增加推理时计算来提升推理能力，通常使用解答采样和多数投票来选出最终答案。然而，重复采样可能会重现相关错误，从而限制增加计算所带来的准确率提升。我们提出多路径计划聚合（MPPA），通过共享的冻结骨干网络上的独立 LoRA 适配器来学习规划和答案选择。规划器联合生成 $K$ 个简短计划，每个计划引导冻结执行器生成一个单独的解答；随后，聚合器为得到的解答评分并选出最终答案。联合规划鼓励采用适合执行器能力的互补方法，而学习得到的选择机制利用推理证据识别正确候选项。交替优化通过监督微调和强化学习改进规划与聚合。在五个数学和科学基准以及三个骨干网络上，与无需训练和基于训练的基线相比，MPPA 改善了准确率与 token 数之间的权衡。使用三个计划时，其平均准确率高于直接采样八个解答并采用多数投票，或使用相同的学习型聚合器，同时输出 token 数减少 47--54%。使用任务提供的子任务进行评估进一步表明，与在任务级或子任务级采用多数投票或学习型聚合的直接采样相比，MPPA 的最终任务准确率更高。

    Generative Anchored Fields: Endpoint Learning for Generative Modeling

    生成式锚定场：生成建模的端点学习

    Deressa Wodajo Deressa, Hannes Mareen, Peter Lambert, Glenn Van Wallendael

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper’s main contribution is an endpoint-prediction architecture for generative modeling that makes algebraic composition and controllable multi-class sampling explicit capabilities. This directly advances compositional generation; its feature bank is an architectural design, but the abstract gives no evidence about interpreting learned representations or model-system organization beyond that.

    该论文的主要贡献是用于生成建模的端点预测架构，它将代数组合和可控的多类别采样明确地作为模型能力。这直接推动了组合生成的发展；其特征库是一种架构设计，但摘要没有提供关于理解所学表征或超出此范围的模型系统组织的证据。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    We present Generative Anchored Fields (GAF), a generative model that learns independent endpoint predictors, \(J\) (noise) and \(K\) (data), from any point on a linear bridge. Instead of learning the local path along a trajectory, as in diffusion or flow-based models, GAF is trained to identify the endpoint coordinates of a bridge state directly via an endpoint regression objective. Central to our approach is the decoupling of time-dependent feature learning from endpoint prediction. Unlike the transport-based models that learn a monolithic time-conditioned predictor that maps noise to data via a unified field, GAF uses a shared trunk, \(\Phi\), which produces a time-conditioned feature bank and a pair of linear predictors, \(J\) and \(K\). This separation of feature learning from prediction enables \textit{Transport Algebra}: algebraic operations on multiple \(J\) and \(K\) heads for compositional sampling. Additionally, with class-specific \(K_n\) heads, where \(n\in\{1,...,N\}\) for \(N\) classes, GAF defines directed transport maps between a shared base noise distribution and multiple data domains, allowing controllable interpolation, multi-class composition, and semantic editing. This is achieved either directly on the predicted data coordinates (\(K\)) using (i) Iterative Endpoint Refinement (IER), a novel sampler that achieves high-quality generation in \(5-8\) forward steps, or (ii) on the derived velocity field \(v=K-J\). GAF achieves strong sample quality with an FID of 2.25 on ImageNet \(256\times256\) while treating compositional generation as an architectural primitive. Code available at https://github.com/IDLabMedia/GAF

    中文

    我们提出生成式锚定场（GAF），这是一种生成模型，能够从线性桥上的任意点学习独立的端点预测器，\(J\)（噪声）和\(K\)（数据）。与扩散模型或基于流的模型学习轨迹上的局部路径不同，GAF 通过端点回归目标进行训练，直接识别桥状态的端点坐标。我们方法的核心是将时变特征学习与端点预测解耦。不同于基于传输的模型学习单一的时间条件预测器、通过统一场将噪声映射到数据，GAF 使用一个共享主干网络，\(\Phi\)，其生成一个时间条件特征库和一对线性预测器，\(J\)和\(K\)。这种将特征学习与预测分离的做法促成了 \textit{传输代数}：对多个\(J\)和\(K\)头进行代数运算，以实现组合采样。此外，通过使用类别专属的\(K_n\)头，其中对于\(n\in\{1,...,N\}\)个类别，\(N\)，GAF 在共享基础噪声分布与多个数据域之间定义有向传输映射，从而实现可控插值、多类别组合和语义编辑。这可以通过以下方式实现：直接在预测的数据坐标（\(K\)）上使用（i）迭代端点精化（IER）——一种新颖的采样器，只需\(5-8\)个前向步骤即可实现高质量生成；或（ii）在推导出的速度场\(v=K-J\)上实现。GAF 在 ImageNet\(256\times256\)上取得了 2.25 的 FID，生成质量表现出色，同时将组合生成作为一种架构原语。代码见 https://github.com/IDLabMedia/GAF

    Do Latent Tokens Think? A Causal and Adversarial Analysis of Chain-of-Continuous-Thought

    潜在 token 会思考吗？对连续思维链的因果与对抗性分析

    Yuyi Zhang, Boyu Tang, Tianjie Ju, Sufeng Duan, Gongshen Liu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Using token steering and shortcut-focused evaluations, the paper argues that COCONUT latent tokens do not carry reasoning-critical information and that benchmark gains rely on dataset artifacts. This directly investigates reasoning mechanisms and provides mechanistic evidence about latent representations, while offering no substantive contribution to composition or model systems.

    通过 token 定向干预和聚焦捷径的评估，该论文指出 COCONUT 潜在 token 不包含推理所必需的信息，且基准测试表现的提升依赖于数据集伪迹。该研究直接考察推理机制，并提供了有关潜在表征的机制性证据，但没有对组合能力或模型系统作出实质贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Latent tokens are gaining attention for enhancing reasoning in large language models (LLMs), yet their internal mechanisms remain unclear. This paper examines the problem from a reliability perspective, uncovering fundamental weaknesses: latent tokens function as uninterpretable placeholders rather than encoding faithful reasoning. While resistant to perturbation, they promote shortcut usage over genuine reasoning. We focus on Chain-of-Continuous-Thought (COCONUT), which claims better efficiency and stability than explicit Chain-of-Thought (CoT) while maintaining performance. We investigate this through two complementary approaches. First, steering experiments perturb specific token subsets, namely COCONUT and explicit CoT. Unlike CoT tokens, COCONUT tokens show minimal sensitivity to steering and lack reasoning-critical information. Second, shortcut experiments evaluate models under biased and out-of-distribution settings. Results on MMLU and HotpotQA demonstrate that COCONUT consistently exploits dataset artifacts, inflating benchmark performance without true reasoning. These findings reposition COCONUT as a pseudo-reasoning mechanism: it generates plausible traces that conceal shortcut dependence rather than faithfully representing reasoning processes.

    中文

    潜在 token 正受到关注，被认为能够增强大型语言模型（LLM）的推理能力，但其内部机制仍不清楚。本文从可靠性角度考察这一问题，揭示了其根本弱点：潜在 token 充当无法解释的占位符，而非编码忠实的推理。尽管它们能抵抗扰动，却会助长捷径使用，而非真正的推理。我们聚焦于连续思维链（COCONUT）；该方法声称在保持性能的同时，比显式思维链（CoT）具有更高的效率和稳定性。我们通过两种互补的方法进行研究。首先，定向干预实验对特定 token 子集，即 COCONUT token 和显式 CoT token，进行扰动。与 CoT token 不同，COCONUT token 对定向干预几乎不敏感，也不包含推理所必需的信息。其次，捷径实验在有偏和分布外设置下评估模型。在 MMLU 和 HotpotQA 上的结果表明，COCONUT 会持续利用数据集伪迹，在缺乏真正推理的情况下虚增基准测试表现。这些发现将 COCONUT 重新定位为一种伪推理机制：它生成看似合理的轨迹，以掩盖对捷径的依赖，而非忠实地表征推理过程。

    The Straight and Narrow: Do LLMs Possess an Internal Moral Path?

    正道与窄路：LLM 是否具有内在的道德路径？

    Luoming Hu, Jingjie Zeng, Liang Yang, Hongfei Lin

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper maps cross-lingual moral representations to a shared subspace and tests steerable moral vectors through internal and behavioral interventions, directly advancing representation geometry and model mechanisms. Its adaptive inference-time intervention has a systems connection, but the abstract gives no substantial contribution to computation, memory, or agent organization.

    该论文将跨语言道德表征映射到一个共有子空间，并通过内部和行为干预检验可控的道德向量，直接推动了表征几何和模型机制研究。其自适应推理时干预与系统有关，但摘要没有对计算、记忆或智能体组织作出实质贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Enhancing the moral alignment of Large Language Models (LLMs) is a critical challenge in AI safety. Current alignment techniques often act as superficial guardrails, leaving the intrinsic moral representations of LLMs largely untouched. In this paper, we bridge this gap by leveraging Moral Foundations Theory (MFT) to map and manipulate the fine-grained moral landscape of LLMs. Through cross-lingual linear probing, we validate the shared nature of moral representations in middle layers and uncover a shared yet different moral subspace between English and Chinese. Building upon this, we extract steerable Moral Vectors and successfully validate their efficacy at both internal and behavioral levels. Leveraging the high generalizability of morality, we propose Adaptive Moral Fusion (AMF), a dynamic inference-time intervention that synergizes probe detection with vector injection to tackle the safety-helpfulness trade-off. Empirical results confirm that our approach acts as a targeted intrinsic defense, effectively reducing incorrect refusals on benign queries while minimizing jailbreak success rates compared to standard baselines.

    中文

    提升大型语言模型（LLM）的道德对齐是 AI 安全领域的一项关键挑战。当前的对齐技术往往只是表面的护栏，几乎没有触及 LLM 的内在道德表征。在本文中，我们借助道德基础理论（MFT）绘制并操控 LLM 的细粒度道德图景，以弥合这一差距。通过跨语言线性探测，我们验证了中间层道德表征具有共通性，并发现英语和中文之间存在共有但有差异的道德子空间。在此基础上，我们提取可控的道德向量，并在内部和行为层面成功验证了其效果。利用道德的高度泛化能力，我们提出自适应道德融合（AMF），这是一种推理时动态干预方法，将探针检测与向量注入相结合，以应对安全性与有用性之间的权衡。实证结果证实，我们的方法是一种有针对性的内在防御：与标准基线相比，它能有效减少对良性查询的错误拒绝，同时降低越狱成功率。

    FlexMARL: Graph-Driven Rollout-Training Co-Design for LLM-Based Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning

    FlexMARL：面向基于 LLM 的多智能体强化学习的图驱动展开—训练协同设计

    Zhida Jiang, Zhaolong Xing, Jiawei Lu, Yipei Niu, Qingyuan Sang, Liangxu Zhang, Wenquan Dai, Junhua Shu, Jiaxing Wang, Qiangyu Pei, Qiong Chen, Xinyu Liu, Fangming Liu, Ai Han, Zhen Chen, Ke Zhang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    FlexMARL’s main contribution is a graph-driven infrastructure for LLM-based multi-agent RL, with coordinated rollout, orchestration, storage, and resource allocation that substantially improves throughput and utilization. The RL and multi-agent setting alone does not establish a contribution to reasoning mechanisms or compositional generalization.

    FlexMARL 的主要贡献是为基于 LLM 的多智能体 RL 提供图驱动基础设施，通过协调展开、编排、存储和资源分配，显著提升吞吐量和资源利用率。RL 和多智能体场景本身不足以证明其对推理机制或组合泛化有所贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Despite algorithm-level innovations for multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL), the underlying infrastructure for large-scale MARL remains underexplored. Existing training frameworks primarily optimize for single-agent scenarios and fail to capture the graph-structured nature of MARL. This fundamental mismatch leads to three MARL-specific challenges: topology-induced rollout skew, critical path synchronization barriers, and dynamic training demand. To bridge this gap, we propose FlexMARL, a graph-driven rollout-training co-designed framework for large-scale LLM-based MARL. FlexMARL introduces the multi-agent execution graph (MEG) and materializes the intermediate representation as the MEG Store, which provides decentralized multi-table storage and serves as the data hub for system components. Built around the MEG Store, the Rollout Engine develops dependency parallel sampling with hierarchical load balancing, which reduces inference latency and balances intra-agent/inter-agent loads. The Joint Orchestrator exploits an agent-level asynchronous pipeline to mitigate the critical path synchronization barriers while maintaining consistency. The Training Engine achieves on-demand resource allocation by collectively managing training processes for individual agents. The training states of different agents are swapped via location-agnostic communication APIs. Empirical results on a production cluster demonstrate that FlexMARL achieves up to 7.3x speedup and improves hardware utilization by up to 5.6x compared to existing frameworks.

    中文

    尽管多智能体强化学习（MARL）的算法层面不断创新，大规模 MARL 的底层基础设施仍未得到充分研究。现有训练框架主要针对单智能体场景进行优化，未能体现 MARL 的图结构特性。这一根本不匹配带来了 MARL 特有的三项挑战：拓扑导致的展开偏斜、关键路径同步屏障，以及动态变化的训练需求。为弥补这一差距，我们提出 FlexMARL，这是一种面向大规模、基于 LLM 的 MARL 的图驱动展开与训练协同设计框架。FlexMARL 引入多智能体执行图（MEG），并将其中间表示具体实现为 MEG Store；它提供去中心化多表存储，并作为系统组件的数据枢纽。围绕 MEG Store 构建的展开引擎采用依赖关系并行采样和分层负载均衡，从而降低推理延迟并平衡智能体内和智能体间负载。联合编排器利用智能体级异步流水线，在保持一致性的同时缓解关键路径同步屏障。训练引擎通过集中管理各个智能体的训练进程，实现按需资源分配。不同智能体的训练状态通过与位置无关的通信 API 交换。在生产集群上的实证结果表明，与现有框架相比，FlexMARL 的加速比最高可达 7.3 倍，硬件利用率最高可提升 5.6 倍。

    Prompt Injection as Role Confusion

    将提示注入视为角色混淆

    Charles Ye, Jasmine Cui, Dylan Hadfield-Menell

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper measures role perception in LLM representations and links role confusion to prompt-injection success, identifying a predictive mechanism behind attacks. Its reasoning connection is limited to forged CoT, while agent security is an application of the mechanism rather than a main systems contribution.

    本文测量了 LLM 表征中的角色感知，并将角色混淆与提示注入成功联系起来，识别出攻击背后一种具有预测性的机制。其与推理的联系仅限于伪造的 CoT；智能体安全是该机制的一种应用，而非主要的系统贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    LLMs see the world as a single stream of text, partitioned into roles like <user> or <tool>. We trace prompt injection to role confusion: models perceive the source of text from how it sounds, not its labeled role. A command hidden in a webpage hijacks an agent simply because it sounds like <user> text, despite its <tool> label. We design role probes to measure how LLMs internally perceive "who is speaking," and find that injected text occupies the same representational space as the trusted role it imitates. We demonstrate this with CoT Forgery, a zero-shot attack that injects fabricated reasoning into user prompts and tool outputs. Models mistake the forgery for their own thoughts, yielding 60% attack success against frontier models with near-zero baselines. Strikingly, the degree of role confusion predicts attack success before a single token is generated. This mechanism generalizes beyond CoT Forgery to standard agent prompt injections, revealing prompt injection as a measurable consequence of role perception. To the model, sounding like a role is indistinguishable from being one. Project page and writeup: https://role-confusion.github.io

    中文

    LLM 将世界视为单一文本流，并将其划分为 <user> 或 <tool> 这样的角色。我们将提示注入归因于角色混淆：模型根据文本听起来像什么来感知其来源，而不是依据它被标记的角色。网页中隐藏的一条指令会劫持智能体，仅仅因为它听起来像 <user> 文本，尽管其标签是 <tool>。我们设计了角色探针，用于测量 LLM 在内部如何感知“谁在说话”，并发现注入文本占据了与其所模仿的可信角色相同的表征空间。我们通过 CoT Forgery 展示这一点：这是一种零样本攻击，会将伪造的推理注入用户提示和工具输出中。模型会把伪造内容误认为自己的想法，使得针对前沿模型的攻击成功率达到 60%，而基线成功率接近零。值得注意的是，角色混淆程度在生成任何 token 之前就能预测攻击成功率。这一机制也适用于 CoT Forgery 之外的标准智能体提示注入，表明提示注入是角色感知的一种可测量后果。对模型而言，听起来像某个角色与实际属于该角色无法区分。项目页面和说明：https://role-confusion.github.io

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Vision foundation models (FMs) achieve state-of-the-art performance in medical imaging. However, they encode information in abstract latent representations that clinicians cannot interrogate or verify. The goal of this study is to investigate Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) for replacing opaque FM image representations with human-interpretable, sparse features. We train SAEs on embeddings from BiomedParse (biomedical) and DINOv3 (general-purpose) using 909,873 CT and MRI 2D image slices from the TotalSegmentator dataset. We find that learned sparse features: (a) reconstruct original embeddings with high fidelity (R2 up to 0.941) and recover up to 87.8% of downstream performance using only 10 features (99.4% dimensionality reduction), (b) preserve semantic fidelity in image retrieval tasks, (c) correspond to specific concepts that can be expressed in language using large language model (LLM)-based auto-interpretation.     视觉基础模型（FM）在医学影像领域取得了最先进的性能。然而，它们将信息编码为临床医生无法审查或验证的抽象潜在表征。本研究旨在探索稀疏自编码器（SAE）能否用人类可解释的稀疏特征替代不透明的 FM 图像表征。我们使用 TotalSegmentator 数据集中的 909,873 张 CT 和 MRI 二维图像切片，在 BiomedParse（生物医学领域）和 DINOv3（通用领域）的嵌入上训练 SAE。我们发现，学习得到的稀疏特征能够：(a) 高保真地重建原始嵌入（R2 最高达 0.941），并且仅用 10 个特征即可恢复高达 87.8% 的下游性能（降维 99.4%）；(b) 在图像检索任务中保持语义保真度；(c) 对应于可使用基于大语言模型（LLM）的自动解释以语言表达的特定概念；(d) 在零样本、语言驱动的图像检索中，连接临床语言与抽象潜在表征。我们的工作表明，SAE 是构建可解释、概念驱动的医学视觉系统的一条有前景的途径。代码仓库：https://github.com/pwesp/sail。

    Bangzhao Shu, Arinjay Singh, Mai ElSherief

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper uses causal interventions on sparse autoencoder features to explain emotion-specific failures in LLM inference and test targeted steering, directly advancing mechanistic interpretability. Emotion co-activation touches feature relationships, but the abstract does not focus on compositional generalization; emotion recognition is a reasoning-adjacent task, while no system design contribution is described.

    本文对稀疏自编码器特征进行因果干预，以解释 LLM 推断中特定情绪的识别失败，并测试定向引导，直接推动了机制可解释性的发展。情绪共激活涉及特征之间的关系，但摘要并未聚焦于组合泛化；情绪识别是与推理相关的任务，而文中没有描述系统设计方面的贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in emotionally sensitive human-AI applications, where reliable emotion detection is essential. However, their emotion recognition abilities remain uneven: models often perform well on some emotions while consistently struggling with others. Although recent work has explored emotion mechanisms in LLMs, little is known about why models are weaker on some emotions than others from a mechanistic interpretability perspective. In this work, we investigate emotion-specific biases through the causal mechanisms of emotion inference using sparse autoencoders (SAEs). We systematically identify causal sparse emotion features that drive emotion inference and analyze their sparse causal organization within and across emotions. We show that some emotions, such as surprise and fear, rely on highly concentrated feature sets, whereas disgust exhibits a more distributed sparse causal organization: its causal features are generally weaker, frequently co-activate with features for other emotions, and are often overshadowed by causal features for anger. These representational differences provide a mechanistic explanation for why LLMs struggle more with certain emotions. Finally, we conduct two intervention experiments: targeted steering of weaker causal features to mitigate emotion-specific failures, and global optimization of a steering vector over the identified causal features to improve overall emotion recognition performance.

    中文

    大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地应用于情绪敏感的人机交互场景，在这些场景中，可靠的情绪检测至关重要。然而，它们的情绪识别能力并不均衡：模型往往能很好地识别某些情绪，却持续难以识别其他情绪。尽管近期研究已探索 LLM 中的情绪机制，但从机制可解释性的角度来看，人们对模型为何在某些情绪上的表现弱于其他情绪知之甚少。在这项工作中，我们利用稀疏自编码器（SAE），通过情绪推断的因果机制研究特定情绪偏差。我们系统地识别驱动情绪推断的因果稀疏情绪特征，并分析它们在同一情绪内部及不同情绪之间的稀疏因果组织。我们发现，惊讶和恐惧等某些情绪依赖高度集中的特征集合，而厌恶则呈现出分布更广的稀疏因果组织：其因果特征通常较弱，经常与其他情绪的特征共同激活，并且常被愤怒的因果特征所掩盖。这些表征差异为 LLM 为何更难识别某些情绪提供了机制层面的解释。最后，我们进行了两项干预实验：定向引导较弱的因果特征，以缓解特定情绪识别失败；并针对已识别的因果特征全局优化引导向量，以提升整体情绪识别性能。

    LatentRAG: Latent Reasoning and Retrieval for Efficient Agentic RAG

    LatentRAG：面向高效智能体 RAG 的潜在推理与检索

    Yijia Zheng, Marcel Worring

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    LatentRAG moves multi-step reasoning and retrieval into continuous latent tokens, jointly aligning generation and retrieval while reducing latency. This directly advances reasoning mechanisms and agentic retrieval systems; latent representations are designed for efficient operation and transparency, but the abstract does not investigate internal mechanisms or compositional generalization.

    LatentRAG 将多步推理和检索转移到连续潜在 token 中，联合对齐生成与检索，同时降低延迟。这直接推动了推理机制和智能体检索系统的发展；潜在表征旨在提升运行效率和透明度，但摘要没有考察内部机制或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Single-step retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) provides an efficient way to incorporate external information for simple question answering tasks but struggles with complex questions. Agentic RAG extends this paradigm by replacing single-step retrieval with a multi-step process, in which the large language model (LLM) acts as a search agent that generates intermediate thoughts and subqueries to iteratively interact with the retrieval system. This iterative process incurs substantial latency due to the autoregressive generation of lengthy thoughts and subqueries. To address this limitation, we propose LatentRAG, a novel framework that shifts both reasoning and retrieval from discrete language space to continuous latent space. Unlike existing explicit methods that generate natural language thoughts or subqueries token-by-token, LatentRAG produces latent tokens for thoughts and subqueries directly from the hidden states in a single forward pass. We align LLMs with dense retrieval models in the latent space, enabling retrieval over latent subquery tokens and supporting end-to-end joint optimization. To improve transparency and encourage semantically meaningful latent representations, we incorporate a parallel latent decoding mechanism that translates latent tokens back into natural language. Extensive experiments on seven benchmark datasets show that LatentRAG achieves performance comparable to explicit agentic RAG methods while reducing inference latency by approximately 90%, substantially narrowing the latency gap with traditional single-step RAG.

    中文

    单步检索增强生成（RAG）为简单问答任务引入外部信息提供了一种高效方式，但难以处理复杂问题。智能体 RAG 将单步检索替换为多步流程，扩展了这一范式；在该流程中，大型语言模型（LLM）充当搜索智能体，生成中间思考和子查询，与检索系统反复交互。由于需要自回归生成冗长的思考内容和子查询，这一迭代过程会产生显著延迟。为解决这一局限，我们提出 LatentRAG，这是一种新框架，将推理和检索都从离散语言空间转移到连续潜在空间。与逐 token 生成自然语言思考或子查询的现有显式方法不同，LatentRAG 在一次前向传播中直接根据隐藏状态生成用于思考和子查询的潜在 token。我们在潜在空间中对齐 LLM 与稠密检索模型，从而能够基于潜在子查询 token 进行检索，并支持端到端联合优化。为提升透明度并促进具有语义意义的潜在表征，我们加入并行潜在解码机制，将潜在 token 转换回自然语言。在七个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，LatentRAG 的性能与显式智能体 RAG 方法相当，同时将推理延迟降低约 90%，大幅缩小了它与传统单步 RAG 之间的延迟差距。

    马尔可夫电路追踪：对 Transformer 状态抽象的真实标签检验

    Abdullah X

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The central contribution is a controlled benchmark testing whether transformer activations encode causally useful state abstractions, with interventions and controls that assess when circuit interpretations are supported. Its HMM setting is an interpretability test, not a contribution to compositional generalization, reasoning capabilities, or model systems.

    核心贡献是一项受控基准，用于检验 Transformer 激活是否编码了具有因果效用的状态抽象，并通过干预和控制来评估电路解释何时得到支持。其 HMM 场景属于可解释性检验，并非对组合泛化、推理能力或模型系统的贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Mechanistic interpretability needs tests that separate accessible information from a causally useful internal abstraction. We introduce Markovian Circuit Tracing (MCT), a controlled benchmark for testing whether transformer activations support a compact state abstraction with recoverable transition structure. We train small causal transformers on sequences from four-state hidden Markov models. The experiment fixes the latent transition law and varies emission observability. The canonical artifact contains 15 runs across five fixed seeds. Every model reaches validation loss within 0.02 nats per token of the exact Bayes predictor. Under easy observability, held-out mean rowwise Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence from the true transition matrix is 0.114. The easy shuffled control gives 0.379. Under medium observability, recovered transition KL is 0.221. The medium shuffled control gives 0.355. Recovery collapses to control performance under hard observability. Natural activation swaps and state forcing show the same decline in causal specificity. New transition-specific controls refine this result. Untrained activations yield similar transition recovery in the easy regime. In medium, trained activations improve over the untrained control by 0.049 KL on average. Probabilistic Markov-order tests show a clear first-order gain in easy. Medium shows a smaller gain. Hard shows no meaningful gain. A second latent transition law reproduces the same observability-dependent pattern. The belief-probe control fails to support learned specificity. The fixed sparse autoencoder fails to improve transition recovery. MCT therefore tests when a state-machine interpretation earns support and when the evidence rejects it.

    中文

    机制可解释性需要能够区分可访问信息与具有因果效用的内部抽象的检验。我们提出马尔可夫电路追踪（MCT），这是一项受控基准，用于检验 Transformer 激活是否支持一种紧凑的状态抽象，且其转移结构可以恢复。我们在四状态隐马尔可夫模型生成的序列上训练小型因果 Transformer。实验固定潜在转移规律，并改变发射的可观测性。标准实验产物包含 15 次运行，使用五个固定随机种子。每个模型的验证损失都达到与精确贝叶斯预测器相差不超过每 token 0.02 纳特的水平。在可观测性较容易的条件下，留出数据上相对于真实转移矩阵的逐行平均 Kullback-Leibler（KL）散度为 0.114。容易条件下的打乱控制组结果为 0.379。在中等可观测性条件下，恢复出的转移 KL 散度为 0.221。中等条件下的打乱控制组结果为 0.355。在困难可观测性条件下，恢复效果降至控制组水平。自然激活交换和状态强制干预也显示出因果特异性的相同下降。新的转移特异性控制实验进一步细化了这一结果。在容易条件下，未训练激活也能取得相似的转移恢复效果。在中等条件下，训练后的激活平均比未训练控制组的 KL 散度低 0.049。概率马尔可夫阶数检验显示，容易条件下有明显的一阶增益；中等条件下的增益较小；困难条件下则没有有意义的增益。第二种潜在转移规律也复现了相同的、依赖于可观测性的模式。信念探针控制组无法支持已学习到特异性的结论。固定稀疏自编码器未能改善转移恢复。因此，MCT 用于检验何时有证据支持状态机解释，以及何时证据会否定这种解释。

    Ishita Darade and Sushrut Thorat

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper causally tests whether a Transformer uses decoded arithmetic intermediates, finding that its localized route does not transmit them to the output despite strong task accuracy; this directly advances mechanistic analysis of computation and representation. The structured arithmetic task and held-out number-base intersections offer limited compositional-generalization evidence, while the circuit routes are not a main contribution to system design.

    论文通过因果检验考察 Transformer 是否使用已解码的算术中间量，发现尽管任务准确率很高，其局部化路径并未将这些中间量传递到输出；这直接推进了对计算与表征机制的分析。结构化算术任务和留出的数基交叉组合提供了有限的组合泛化证据，而电路路径并非系统设计方面的主要贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Structured prompts require integrating components according to task-relevant relations. How a network implements this integration is often hard to judge in language or vision, where those relations are rarely specified precisely enough to define a candidate internal algorithm. Arithmetic offers a cleaner setting. We study a Transformer trained on base-digit extraction: given $N$, $B$, and $D$, it must report the coefficient of $B^D$ in the base-$B$ expansion of $N$. The closed-form solution, $\lfloor N/B^D \rfloor \bmod B$, provides explicit candidate algorithmic intermediates. Across three seeds, the model reaches 99.83% exact-answer accuracy on held-out number-base intersections, establishing reliable task competence. Linear probes decode the intermediates, making staged arithmetic computation plausible. Causal tests then separate representation from use: within the localized route from the stream with $D$ as input to the output positions, behavior depends on early $D$-selective communication, independent of $N$ and $B$. Relatedly, a sparse circuit search finds mostly separate $N$, $B$, and $D$ routes that combine late rather than the staged route suggested by the probes. Thus, the model represents the intermediates that make the closed-form solution plausible, but the identified localized causal route does not transmit them to the output stream. This case shows that probe-based conclusions can diverge sharply from causal observations, even when explicit algorithmic hypotheses are available.

    中文

    结构化提示要求根据与任务相关的关系整合各个组成部分。在语言或视觉任务中，由于这些关系很少被精确规定到足以定义候选内部算法的程度，因此往往很难判断网络如何实现这种整合。算术提供了一个更清晰的研究场景。我们研究了一个经过基数位提取训练的 Transformer：给定 $N$、$B$和$D$，它必须报告$B^D$在以$B$为底的$N$展开中的系数。闭式解 $\lfloor N/B^D \rfloor \bmod B$ 提供了明确的候选算法中间量。在三个随机种子上，模型在留出的数基交叉组合上取得了 99.83% 的精确答案准确率，表明其具备可靠的任务能力。线性探针能够解码这些中间量，使分阶段算术计算看起来具有可能性。随后，因果检验将表征与使用区分开来：在从以$D$为输入的流到输出位置的局部化路径中，模型行为取决于早期对$D$的选择性通信，而与$N$和$B$无关。类似地，稀疏电路搜索发现，$N$、$B$和$D$的路径大多彼此分离，直到后期才汇合，而非采用探针所暗示的分阶段路径。因此，模型确实表征了使闭式解看起来合理的中间量，但已识别出的局部化因果路径并未将它们传递到输出流。这个案例表明，即使存在明确的算法假设，基于探针得出的结论也可能与因果观察大相径庭。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    GeoFaith uses latent uncertainty and its dynamics to regularize reinforcement learning of faithful chain-of-thought trajectories, directly targeting reasoning quality and capability. Its use of latent geometry is in service of training rather than a substantive investigation of internal representations, and no compositional or systems contribution is described.

    GeoFaith 使用潜在不确定性及其动态来正则化针对忠实思维链轨迹的强化学习，直接以推理质量和能力为目标。潜在几何在此用于训练，并非对内部表征的实质性研究；摘要也未描述组合性或系统方面的贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning has significantly enhanced the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs). However, existing reinforcement learning methods primarily optimize outcome-level rewards, providing limited supervision over the reasoning process. As a result, models may produce shortcut-prone or unstable reasoning trajectories even when the final answer is correct. We propose GeoFaith, a spatio-temporal latent dynamics framework for learning faithful reasoning processes without process reward models. GeoFaith combines final-state latent uncertainty, which measures whether a completed trajectory lies in a well-supported manifold region, with predictive-entropy dynamics, which penalize abnormal uncertainty patterns such as premature collapse, oscillation, and prolonged uncertainty. These signals are incorporated as process regularization into GRPO, jointly optimizing answer correctness and reasoning quality without step-level process annotations. Experiments show that GeoFaith consistently improves reasoning accuracy, produces more efficient reasoning trajectories, and outperforms both outcome-only reinforcement learning and process-supervision baselines.

    思维链（CoT）推理显著增强了大型语言模型（LLM）的推理能力。然而，现有强化学习方法主要优化结果层面的奖励，对推理过程提供的监督有限。因此，即使最终答案正确，模型也可能产生倾向于走捷径或不稳定的推理轨迹。我们提出 GeoFaith，这是一种时空潜在动态框架，无需过程奖励模型即可学习忠实的推理过程。GeoFaith 将最终状态潜在不确定性与预测熵动态结合起来：前者衡量已完成的轨迹是否位于支持充分的流形区域中；后者惩罚异常的不确定性模式，例如过早坍缩、振荡和长时间不确定。我们将这些信号作为过程正则项纳入 GRPO，在无需逐步过程标注的情况下联合优化答案正确性与推理质量。实验表明，GeoFaith 能稳定提高推理准确率，生成更高效的推理轨迹，并优于仅基于结果的强化学习和过程监督基线。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    UCE’s main contribution is an agent architecture that builds, retrieves, evaluates, prunes, and schedules typed experience units across tasks, improving interactive task performance without retraining. It supports multi-step agent problem-solving, but offers limited evidence about reasoning mechanisms or compositional generalization, and does not study model internals.

    UCE 的主要贡献是一种智能体架构，能够跨任务构建、检索、评估、清除并调度分类后的经验单元，在不重新训练的情况下提升交互任务表现。它支持多步智能体问题求解，但关于推理机制或组合泛化的证据有限，也没有研究模型内部机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    LLM-based agents can solve multi-step interactive tasks by combining reasoning with environment feedback, yet each episode starts from the same fixed context and any useful strategy discovered along the way is lost once the task ends. Existing approaches either limit learning to the current task or pool all experience into a single untyped store, without distinguishing knowledge types, tracking quality through use, or balancing what the library still lacks. We introduce Unified Context Evolution (UCE), a gradient-free framework that externalizes agent experience into an evolving library of typed Evolvable Context Units (ECUs). UCE decomposes experience into four complementary types (Memory, Strategy, Workflow, and Skill), each generated from trajectories under type-specific conditions, retrieved at decision time, scored through repeated usage outcomes, and pruned when no longer valuable. A scheduling module allocates each cycle's generation budget toward the types where the library is weakest. Across two interactive benchmarks, UCE raises ALFWorld success from 75.4% to 96.3% and WebShop task score from 45.1% to 61.3%, and remains effective across alternative actor reasoning backbones without model retraining.

    中文

    基于 LLM 的智能体可以通过结合推理与环境反馈来解决多步交互任务，但每个回合都从相同的固定上下文开始，过程中发现的有用策略会在任务结束后丢失。现有方法要么将学习限制在当前任务内，要么把所有经验汇总到一个未分类的存储库中，无法区分知识类型、跟踪知识在使用中的质量，也无法根据知识库的不足来平衡资源分配。我们提出统一上下文演化（UCE），一种无梯度框架，将智能体经验外化为不断演化的、由多种类型构成的可演化上下文单元（ECU）库。UCE 将经验分解为四种互补类型（记忆、策略、工作流和技能）；每种类型都根据特定条件从轨迹中生成，在决策时检索，通过反复使用的结果评分，并在不再有价值时清除。调度模块会将每轮的生成预算分配给知识库最薄弱的类型。在两个交互式基准上，UCE 将 ALFWorld 成功率从 75.4% 提高到 96.3%，并将 WebShop 任务得分从 45.1% 提高到 61.3%；无需重新训练模型，它在不同的智能体推理骨干模型上也保持有效。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper tests whether latent-state patterns explain reasoning, using matched controls, causal interventions, and geometric analysis to show that behaviorally influential thoughts occupy more structured low-dimensional subspaces. Its focus directly advances interpretability of reasoning mechanisms; model computation is incidental to the Systems direction.

    本文通过匹配对照组、因果干预和几何分析，检验潜在状态模式能否解释推理，并表明对行为影响较大的思维位于结构更有序的低维子空间中。其研究重点直接推进了对推理机制的可解释性研究；模型计算与 Systems 方向的关联则是附带的。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Latent reasoning models (LRMs) replace explicit chain-of-thought with continuous thoughts. Recent work treats observable latent-state patterns, such as BFS-like frontiers and decodable arithmetic computation, as evidence for internal reasoning mechanisms. Evaluating two LRMs (Coconut and CODI) against controls lacking the proposed recurrence or curriculum, we find these patterns also appear in the controls and do not consistently affect behavior. Causal interventions reveal that latent-thought utilization is not binary but graded, scaling with a thought's causal effect on model behavior. Geometric analyses reveal this effect concentrates in low-dimensional subspaces whose step-wise geometry grows more structured as their behavioral influence increases. Latent thoughts should therefore be treated as hidden computation, not hidden explanation: decodability, attention, or static structure alone cannot establish LRM reasoning mechanisms; that requires matched controls and causal tests.

    中文

    潜在推理模型（LRM）用连续思维取代显式思维链。近期研究将可观察到的潜在状态模式，例如类似 BFS 的前沿和可解码的算术计算，视为内部推理机制的证据。我们将两个 LRM（Coconut 和 CODI）与缺少所提出递归机制或课程安排的对照组进行评估，发现这些模式也会出现在对照组中，而且并不总是影响行为。因果干预表明，潜在思维的利用并非二元的，而是有程度差异，其程度随某个思维对模型行为的因果影响而变化。几何分析表明，这种影响集中在低维子空间中；随着其行为影响增强，这些子空间逐步呈现出更有结构的几何形态。因此，潜在思维应被视为隐藏计算，而非隐藏解释：仅凭可解码性、注意力或静态结构，无法确立 LRM 的推理机制；这需要匹配的对照组和因果检验。

    Tianyuan Shi, Canbin Huang, Bei Li, Xin Chen, Xiaojun Quan, Jingang Wang, Qifan Wang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    SGPO distills reusable strategies through guided and autonomous trajectories, aiming to transfer problem-solving skills that generalize beyond specific solutions. This directly advances compositional strategy reuse and reasoning development; model distillation alone gives only an incidental systems connection, and the abstract does not study internal representations.

    SGPO 通过引导轨迹和自主轨迹蒸馏可复用策略，旨在迁移能够超越特定解法并泛化的问题解决技能。这直接推进了组合式策略复用和推理能力发展；模型蒸馏本身只带来附带的系统层面关联，而且摘要没有研究内部表征。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Distilling reasoning capabilities from strong to weak language models typically involves imitating specific solution trajectories, effectively transferring what to answer rather than how to reason. This trajectory-level imitation encourages memorization of instance-specific steps rather than acquisition of transferable problem-solving skills, limiting generalization to novel problems. We propose Strategy-Guided Policy Optimization (SGPO), which replaces instance-level trajectory imitation with reusable strategy distillation. SGPO extracts structured strategy descriptions from strong-model responses and, for each problem, constructs both autonomous and strategy-guided trajectories to enable direct comparison of the model's behavior with and without strategic guidance. The framework then addresses two key questions. For how to distill, a token-level forward-KL objective selectively transfers the distributional shift induced by strategy conditioning into the unguided policy, with proximal constraints ensuring stability. For when to distill, adaptive instance-level weighting strengthens guidance when autonomous exploration falls short and reduces it as the model's own competence grows. Experiments on four mathematical benchmarks across two model families show that SGPO consistently outperforms SFT, on-policy RL, and hybrid-policy baselines, improving the average score by 2.2 points over the strongest baseline on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct. Analysis reveals that the forward-KL objective provides an inherently selective distillation signal that outperforms direct trajectory imitation, and that strategy distillation exhibits complementary scaling with base model capability.

    中文

    将推理能力从强语言模型蒸馏到弱语言模型，通常需要模仿特定的解题轨迹，这实际上转移的是“回答什么”，而非“如何推理”。这种轨迹层面的模仿会促使模型记忆特定实例的步骤，而不是掌握可迁移的问题解决技能，从而限制其对新问题的泛化能力。我们提出策略引导策略优化（SGPO），以可复用的策略蒸馏取代实例层面的轨迹模仿。SGPO 从强模型的响应中提取结构化策略描述，并针对每个问题构造自主轨迹和策略引导轨迹，以便直接比较模型在有无策略指导时的行为。该框架进而回答两个关键问题。关于如何蒸馏：token 级前向 KL 目标有选择地将策略条件化引起的分布偏移转移到无引导策略中，并通过近端约束确保稳定性。关于何时蒸馏：实例级自适应加权会在自主探索效果不足时加强指导，并随着模型自身能力提升而减弱指导。在涵盖两个模型系列的四个数学基准上的实验表明，SGPO 持续优于 SFT、on-policy RL 和混合策略基线；在 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 上，其平均分比最强基线高 2.2 分。分析显示，前向 KL 目标提供了内在具有选择性的蒸馏信号，优于直接轨迹模仿；策略蒸馏还表现出与基础模型能力互补的扩展性。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Artificial intelligence has advanced scientific discovery, but most AI4Science systems remain fragmented tools that rely on humans to coordinate problem formulation, literature grounding, model use, simulation, validation, and knowledge reuse. This paper presents \textbf{SCION (Scientific Collaborative Innovation with Agentic Organizational Nexus)}, an agentic scientific operating system that acts as an \textbf{organizational nexus}. Through a Science Agent serving as a \textbf{Meta-Harness}, SCION connects scientific tasks, tools, agents, artifacts, and memory, transforming research into an executable, auditable, and reusable operational process. At its core is the \textbf{Research Execution Plan (REP)}, which compiles high-level scientific intent into staged objectives, dependencies, verification checkpoints, tool requirements, expected artifacts, and fallback conditions. SCION further integrates hierarchical multi-agent execution, profile-driven specialization, selective context construction, governed delegation, and layered epistemic memory to support long-horizon scientific work. We formulate discovery under SCION as \textbf{Target-conditioned Inverse Search} and extend it to hidden-target settings through batch active search under finite experimental budgets. Applications in materials analysis, molecule design, and protein or antibody screening, together with experiments on scientific reading, idea generation, molecule generation, and antibody screening, show that SCION outperforms existing autonomous research-agent baselines, especially in decomposition, verification, refinement, and memory reuse. Overall, SCION shifts AI from isolated tools toward a coordinated operational layer for traceable and reusable scientific innovation.

    Broken Symmetry in LLM Refusal: Answer Release Is More Local Than Refusal Restoration

    Yiqi Liu, Yang Wang, Songxin Wang, Chenghao Xiao, Chenghua Lin

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper uses matched causal interventions to show that answer release is more local than refusal restoration, while refusal-related directions do not reliably control behavior reversibly. Its causal analysis of hidden-state recoverability and representation geometry directly addresses mechanistic interpretability; refusal behavior is the application context, not a substantive contribution to reasoning mechanisms.

    论文通过匹配的因果干预表明，释放答案比恢复拒答更局部，而与拒答相关的方向无法可靠地可逆控制行为。其对隐藏状态可恢复性和表征几何的因果分析直接涉及机制可解释性；拒答行为是应用背景，不构成对推理机制的实质性贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    When a language model refuses to answer a prompt, it is unclear whether the correct answer is erased from its internal representations, or merely suppressed at the output layer. We investigate this mechanism using a controlled withhold setting, which yields perfectly matched answering and refusal trajectories for bidirectional activation patching. We uncover a causal asymmetry in intervention locality under matched causal interventions, which we term broken symmetry. Even when a model generates a clean refusal, the correct answer remains linearly recoverable from its hidden states. Furthermore, releasing this withheld answer is a highly local operation, requiring only a single-position patch. Conversely, the reverse operation is not equally local: reimposing suppression requires broader interventions across multiple positions, and assembling a coherent refusal sequence is more difficult still. We further demonstrate that while an average answer-to-refusal displacement vector marks the geometric difference between these states, it fails to act as a reliable, reversible linear control toggle between behaviours. Taken together, our findings show that refusal does not function as a simple symmetric switch. For safety and auditing, this implies that probe recoverability can overestimate true behavioural control, and locating refusal-relevant directions does not reliably grant the ability to steer a model from answering to coherent refusal.

    中文

    当语言模型拒绝回答某个提示时，正确答案究竟已从其内部表征中被抹除，还是仅在输出层受到抑制，这一点尚不清楚。我们利用受控的答案保留设置研究这一机制；该设置为双向激活修补提供完全匹配的回答和拒答轨迹。我们在匹配的因果干预下发现了干预局部性的因果不对称，并将其称为对称性破缺。即使模型生成了明确的拒答，其隐藏状态中仍可线性恢复正确答案。此外，释放这一被保留的答案是高度局部的操作，只需在单一位置进行修补。相反，反向操作并非同样局部：重新施加抑制需要在多个位置进行范围更广的干预，而拼接出连贯的拒答序列则更加困难。我们进一步证明，尽管平均的答案到拒答位移向量标示了这两种状态之间的几何差异，但它无法作为可靠、可逆的线性控制开关来切换行为。总而言之，我们的发现表明，拒答并非简单的对称开关。对于安全和审计而言，这意味着探针可恢复性可能会高估对行为的实际控制能力；找到与拒答相关的方向，并不能可靠地赋予我们引导模型从回答转向连贯拒答的能力。

    HARTS 开发了前缀共享、状态传递和分布式执行方法，在保留轨迹目标的同时加速混合注意力模型上的智能体 RL 训练。这是对模型系统的核心贡献；其 RL 场景与能力发展有一定联系，但摘要没有研究推理机制或组合泛化。

    ENGLISH

    Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) generates irregular rollout trees, but trajectory-by-trajectory training recomputes their shared interaction histories. Existing training-time prefix-reuse systems do not jointly address state recovery, dense execution, and distributed training for hybrid-attention models. We present HARTS (Hybrid-Attention RL over Tree Structures), to our knowledge the first system to demonstrate training acceleration from arbitrary rollout-tree prefix sharing on real hybrid-attention models. A two-level planner constructs compression-oriented microbatches, then jointly refines their membership, cross-microbatch sharing, placement, and execution order. Within each sharing window, gradients from dependent microbatches accumulate before one backward pass through the shared prefix computation. Differentiable boundary-state handoff and bounded replay preserve the per-trajectory chunkwise numerical path, while a linear-time planner attains the global minimum number of sequential linear-attention calls under our packed chunkwise-call model. The runtime uses a common compact layout across attention and dense or mixture-of-experts (MoE) layers, with support for distributed parallelism and activation recomputation. Recovering log-probabilities for each original trajectory position preserves RL objectives; for deterministic top-k routing without token dropping, occurrence counts restore MoE objective weights and expert-load statistics. On SWE-bench, HARTS delivers 4.77-10.45x the update throughput of trajectory-expanded training across two sampling schemes on 7.9B- and 124B-parameter hybrid-attention MoE models using 8-64 GPUs. On the 7.9B model, full-model logit differences are comparable to baseline self-rerun variation. The 124B model shows stable online learning trends through step 150 on SWE-bench and $\tau^3$-Bench.

Yet this recognition direction is nearly orthogonal to the canonical safety-refusal direction that mediates trained harmful-content refusal. An in-domain behavior-defined invalidity-aware direction is closer to recognition, but only partially aligned with it, and remains near-orthogonal to safety refusal. Generation-time steering along the recognition direction changes invalidity-aware behavior bidirectionally and dose-responsively on structural math and code cells, while random directions do not. Base/instruct comparisons further show that the low-cosine geometry is already present at the pretraining endpoint. The confident-on-impossible failure is therefore better explained as a routing failure than as an encoding failure: the model has a usable "no admissible answer" signal, but the safety-refusal pathway is not aligned to use it.

    大型语言模型经常回答结构上无法作答的问题，例如计算 cot(-540{\deg}) 或评估 (1).startswith("1")，而不是弃答。我们探究这种失败究竟源于缺乏识别能力，还是识别信号未能被路由至弃答行为。在参数量从 1.7B 到 70B 的指令微调模型中，隐藏状态中的一个线性方向能够区分可回答的提示与结构上不可能的数学和代码提示，这表明模型在生成之前就表示了不可能性。然而，这个识别方向与在训练后有害内容拒答中起中介作用的经典安全拒答方向近乎正交。一个由领域内行为定义的无效性感知方向与识别方向更接近，但只与其部分对齐，并且仍与安全拒答方向近乎正交。沿识别方向进行生成时引导，可使模型在结构性数学和代码任务上的无效性感知行为双向、随引导强度变化，而随机方向则不会。基础模型与指令模型的比较进一步表明，这种低余弦相似度的几何关系在预训练结束时就已存在。因此，自信地回答不可能问题这一失败更适合解释为路由失败，而不是编码失败：模型拥有可用的“没有可接受答案”信号，但安全拒答路径未与之对齐，因而无法利用它。

    Todd Y. Zhou and Daniel Zhang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    CLWM’s counterfactual objective separates action-induced futures and improves planning under partial observability, directly advancing embodied reasoning and agent world-model design. Its intervention-sensitive representations offer partial representation insight, but the abstract does not investigate internal mechanisms or systematic composition.

    CLWM 的反事实目标能够区分由动作引发的未来，并提升部分可观测环境中的规划效果，直接推进了具身推理和智能体世界模型设计。其对干预敏感的表征提供了一定的表征层面洞见，但摘要并未研究内部机制或系统性组合。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    World models promise a general route to embodied intelligence: learn predictive dynamics once, then reason, plan, and act with them. Increasingly, the representations beneath such models are pretrained on large-scale video, interaction, and multimodal corpora, which raises a question prediction quality alone cannot answer: when is a learned representation actually actionable? We identify a failure mode we call counterfactual collapse: a model predicts visually plausible futures while failing to distinguish interventions with different behavioral consequences. This arises whenever a representation is optimized for perceptual similarity rather than intervention structure, which is precisely the objective under which most large-scale pretrained encoders are learned. We introduce Counterfactual Latent World Models (CLWM), which combine a recurrent belief-state encoder, action-conditioned latent dynamics, and a contrastive counterfactual objective that separates futures induced by distinct interventions even when their observations look alike. Across occluded manipulation, aliased navigation, and long-horizon manipulation, CLWM improves planning success over the strongest baseline (65.1% $\to$ 74.6% on Occluded Push and 67.3% $\to$ 78.9% on Aliased Maze) and reduces exploitative planning failures (18.4% $\to$ 9.7% on Deferred Kitchen), with ablations attributing the gains to hard counterfactual negatives, especially perceptual-alias negatives. Finally, our counterfactual separability metric, which tracks planning success across the five baseline model classes ($r \ge 0.94$), is representation-agnostic: given intervention-outcome labels, it can audit any encoder, pretrained or trained from scratch, before a planner trusts it. We do not yet measure it on large-scale pretrained encoders. Here we establish the metric and its relationship to planning success for world models trained from scratch.

    中文

    世界模型为具身智能提供了一条通用路径：学习一次预测动态，然后利用它们进行推理、规划和行动。越来越多的此类模型底层表征是在大规模视频、交互和多模态语料上预训练的，这引出了一个仅凭预测质量无法回答的问题：学习到的表征何时才真正可用于行动？我们识别出一种称为反事实坍缩的失败模式：模型能够预测视觉上合理的未来，却无法区分会带来不同行为后果的干预。当表征针对感知相似性而非干预结构进行优化时，就会出现这一问题，而这正是大多数大规模预训练编码器所采用的优化目标。我们提出反事实潜在世界模型（CLWM），将循环信念状态编码器、动作条件化潜在动态，以及对比式反事实目标结合起来；即使不同干预所产生的观测看起来相似，该目标仍能区分它们诱导的未来。在受遮挡操作、混叠导航和长时程操作任务中，CLWM 的规划成功率优于最强基线（Occluded Push 上从 65.1% $\to$ 提升至 74.6%，Aliased Maze 上从 67.3% $\to$ 提升至 78.9%），并减少了利用漏洞进行规划导致的失败（Deferred Kitchen 上从 18.4% $\to$ 降至 9.7%）；消融实验表明，这些提升来自困难反事实负样本，尤其是感知混叠负样本。最后，我们提出的反事实可分性指标能够跟踪五类基线模型的规划成功率（$r \ge 0.94$），且与表征类型无关：给定干预结果标签，该指标可以在规划器信任编码器之前，对任何编码器进行审计，无论其经过预训练还是从头训练。我们尚未在大规模预训练编码器上测量该指标。本文建立了这一指标，并揭示了它与从头训练的世界模型规划成功率之间的关系。

    Rong He

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper develops a hierarchy-based theory and algorithms for ordering reusable prompt chunks to reduce KV-cache prefill cost, with serving-trace evidence. Chunk reuse has a compositional connection, but the central contribution is cache and serving optimization rather than compositional generalization.

    本文提出基于层次结构的理论和算法，用于排列可复用的提示片段以降低 KV 缓存 prefill 成本，并提供服务轨迹上的证据。片段复用与组合有一定联系，但核心贡献是缓存和服务优化，而非组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    LLM serving reuses KV cache by exact prefix match, so when a prompt is assembled from a set of reusable pieces -- retrieved passages, tool definitions, few-shot exemplars -- the order chosen for those pieces determines how much computation can be shared. Every deployed system fixes that order by a single global convention. We prove this is optimal only when requests contain at most two pieces, and asymptotically wrong in general. Our main result is a structure theorem: the minimum prefix-trie cost equals min_H sum_x w(x) t_x(H) over binary hierarchies H on the requests, where t_x(H) is the canonical decomposition size of the set of requests needing chunk x. Choosing chunk orders is therefore equivalent to choosing one hierarchy over requests. The identity yields an O(3^m) exact algorithm, identifies the two-chunk case as minimum vertex cover, and shows that on the leave-one-out family the optimum is the minimum external path length of a binary tree -- the merge-sort recursion -- so a global order pays Theta(n^2) against a true cost of Theta(n log n). Agglomerative clustering by common intersection is a tight 1/2-approximation for the achievable saving. On BM25 retrieval traces over three BEIR corpora the resulting layout reduces prefill by 17-36% against production RAG ordering, and the margin widens with retrieval depth as the theory predicts. Serving requests in the hierarchy's DFS order finally lets a cache holding one request's context attain the unbounded-cache optimum exactly, so cache capacity and reorder window act as substitutes.

    中文

    LLM 服务通过精确前缀匹配复用 KV 缓存，因此，当提示由一组可复用片段——检索段落、工具定义、少样本示例——组成时，这些片段的顺序决定了可以共享多少计算。每个已部署系统都通过单一的全局规则固定这一顺序。我们证明，只有当请求最多包含两个片段时，这种做法才是最优的；一般情况下，其渐近表现并不正确。我们的主要结果是一个结构定理：最小前缀 trie 成本等于在请求上的二叉层次结构 H 中，对 sum_x w(x) t_x(H) 取最小值；其中，t_x(H) 是需要片段 x 的请求集合的规范分解大小。因此，选择片段顺序等价于选择一个请求层次结构。该等式给出一个 O(3^m) 的精确算法，揭示了双片段情形等价于最小顶点覆盖，并表明在留一族中，最优值等于二叉树的最小外部路径长度——也就是归并排序的递归结构——因此，全局排序的成本为 Theta(n^2)，而真正的成本为 Theta(n log n)。基于公共交集的凝聚式聚类，对于可实现的节省而言，是一个紧确的 1/2 近似算法。在三个 BEIR 语料库的 BM25 检索轨迹上，与生产环境中的 RAG 排序相比，由此得到的布局使 prefill 减少了 17-36%；随着检索深度增加，优势也如理论预测般扩大。最后，按照层次结构的 DFS 顺序服务请求，使只容纳一个请求上下文的缓存也能精确达到无限缓存的最优值，因此缓存容量和重排窗口可以相互替代。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has shown remarkable success in improving the mathematical reasoning of large language models. Yet problems beyond the model's current capability, where rollouts uniformly fail and no learning signal is produced, are structurally wasted despite marking the most informative training frontier. We show that these otherwise-inert problems can be unlocked via teacher-guided curriculum learning: partial reasoning traces from a stronger model create a graded difficulty landscape, and a backward-chaining curriculum progressively withdraws guidance until the model solves problems unaided. Training on only 128 unsolvable problems matches or exceeds GRPO trained on a full 2,000-problem corpus (~16x data efficiency) on the nine-benchmark average for both base models, while substantially expanding the reasoning boundary measured by pass@k at large k. Furthermore, we identify a distribution-shift cost that is particularly acute in the unsolvable-only regime and propose Monotone Frontier Curriculum (MFC), a method that monotonically drives training toward unguided solving, consistently outperforming existing curriculum methods.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    An agentic society is a collection of AI agents that coordinate autonomously across trust boundaries on behalf of different principals. We show experimentally that in such societies even honest, competent agents often fail to reach satisfactory outcomes when using current harnesses and messaging primitives; and faulty or malicious agents can completely stall progress, influence outcomes, and pursue harmful goals by exploiting communication vulnerabilities. We argue that agentic societies need a \emph{social harness}. Unlike a \emph{personal harness}, which manages private context and communication with the principal, a social harness manages interactions with other agents. We propose a layered architecture for social harnesses which (i) prevents classes of communication failures outright, (ii) enables agents to detect invalid messages, and (iii) supports post-facto investigation and consequences.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Recent agentic symbolic regression approaches increasingly rely on large language models to analyze data, select scientific operations, and refine hypotheses over long search trajectories. In such systems, performance depends not only on the underlying model and search strategy, but also on the runtime infrastructure that supports scientific search. We introduce SRHarness, a domain-specific harness for agentic symbolic regression built around three mechanisms: composable scientific actions that provide a common interface over raw, transformed, and candidate-derived quantities; persistent scientific state that retains evaluated hypotheses and exposes compact model-facing views; and trajectory lifecycle management that coordinates continuation, branching, restart, and termination. On LLM-SRBench, SRHarness consistently improves both numerical generalization and symbolic recovery under matched LLM backbones. With DeepSeek-v4-flash-0731, it achieves 93.69% symbolic accuracy on LSR-Transform, compared with 62.16% for SR-Scientist, and retains 72.97% accuracy on an anonymized variant that removes scientific descriptions and variable semantics, versus 39.64% for SR-Scientist. Under the same DeepSeek-v4-flash-0731 backbone, SRHarness also substantially outperforms Codex (72.97% vs. 20.72%) and reaches performance comparable to Codex with GPT-5.5, while simply providing Codex with the same scientific tools does not reproduce this advantage. These results show that effective agentic symbolic regression depends not only on models or tools, but also on structured runtime support for organizing scientific actions, accumulated hypotheses, and long-horizon search.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper uses controlled layer and attention interventions to identify the late-layer mechanisms and context-token dependencies that enable entity copying, directly advancing mechanistic understanding of model behavior.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language models (LLMs) reliably perform entity copying, in which a model copies tokens referring to an entity, termed entity tokens, from the prompt into its output to answer a question. Although entity copying is straightforward for most LLMs, existing research does not provide a systematic account of which layers specialize in this fundamental task or how other tokens in the same sequence, termed context tokens, influence the model's ability to copy the entity tokens. To address these questions, we conduct experiments on Qwen3-8B using two novel methods: genie-in-a-bottle, which controls exactly which layers can participate in an entity-copying task, and attention lobotomy, which cuts off specific tokens' attention to entity tokens without affecting the remaining attention distribution. We find that two distinct groups of layers in the second half of the model are both necessary and sufficient for entity copying. Moreover, in addition to the decoding position's attention to entity tokens, context tokens' attention to entity tokens also proves necessary for copying the exact tokens, even though context tokens do not store entity information themselves unless they satisfy particular semantic properties. Our findings establish the critical role of late layers in entity copying under the guidance of context tokens, calling for future work on how models propagate and consume entity information.

    大语言模型（LLM）能够可靠地执行实体复制：模型会将提示中指代某个实体的 token（称为实体 token）复制到输出中，以回答问题。尽管大多数 LLM 都能轻松完成实体复制，现有研究却尚未系统说明哪些层专门负责这一基础任务，也未说明同一序列中的其他 token（称为上下文 token）如何影响模型复制实体 token 的能力。为回答这些问题，我们在 Qwen3-8B 上使用两种新方法开展实验：genie-in-a-bottle，可精确控制哪些层能够参与实体复制任务；以及 attention lobotomy，可切断特定 token 对实体 token 的注意力，同时不影响其余注意力分布。我们发现，模型后半部分中两组不同的层对于实体复制既是必要的，也是充分的。此外，除了解码位置对实体 token 的注意力之外，上下文 token 对实体 token 的注意力也被证明是复制精确 token 所必需的；不过，除非上下文 token 满足特定语义属性，否则它们本身并不存储实体信息。我们的发现确立了后期层在上下文 token 引导下进行实体复制的关键作用，也呼吁未来研究模型如何传播和利用实体信息。

    Junming Lin, Yuxuan Wang, Zhenxin Lei, Yuxin Liu, Ruixun Liu, Yinsong Yan, Ling Wang, Minghao Han, Yunfei Chu, Shun Lei, Xueyao Zhang, Qize Yang, Jin Xu, Yiwu Zhong

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    OmniReasoning builds a benchmark and training method for audio-visual joint reasoning, with modality-specific clue evaluation used for token-level credit assignment. Its central contribution directly advances multimodal reasoning; cross-modal composition is relevant but secondary, and the paper does not study model internals or system organization.

    OmniReasoning 构建了音视频联合推理基准和训练方法，并使用模态特定的线索评估进行词元级信用分配。其核心贡献直接推动了多模态推理；跨模态组合能力也有关联，但属于次要内容，而且论文未研究模型内部机制或系统组织。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Recent advances have enabled unified omni-modal models in understanding audio, vision, and language. However, existing benchmarks, training data, and learning methods largely treat the modalities independently, leaving the capability of audio-visual joint reasoning poorly evaluated and insufficiently elicited. We address this gap with a benchmark, data engine, and learning method. First, we introduce OmniReasoningBench, a benchmark where both audio and visual evidence are indispensable. It comprises 1,150 multiple-choice and open-ended questions across two tasks, reasoning over video and reasoning beyond video. Second, we develop a data engine OmniQA. It automatically constructs evidence-grounded QA pairs that explicitly necessitate audio-visual joint reasoning, together with time-stamped clue chains that guide the annotation of thinking process. Besides our benchmark, this engine produces training data OmniReasoning-SFT-112K and OmniReasoning-RL-19K. Finally, we propose an on-policy self-distillation method Modality-Factored Self-Distillation (MFSD). It evaluates each sampled response under modality-specific clue contexts, disentangling the contributions of individual clues and their cross-modal interactions for token-level credit assignment. With our training data and learning method, our model OmniReasoning-30B-A3B achieves 50.0% on OmniVideoBench and 42.5% on OmniReasoningBench, improving the base model Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Thinking by 12.8 and 9.3 percentage points, respectively. Moreover, it delivers substantial gains on general and long-video benchmarks, including Video-MME-v2. We hope our work offers a solid step for facilitating future research in omni-modal joint reasoning.

    中文

    近期进展使统一的全模态模型能够理解音频、视觉和语言。然而，现有基准、训练数据和学习方法大多将各模态独立处理，因此音视频联合推理能力尚未得到充分评估，也未被充分激发。我们通过基准、数据引擎和学习方法来弥补这一不足。首先，我们推出 OmniReasoningBench，这是一个音频和视觉证据缺一不可的基准。它包含 1,150 道选择题和开放式问题，涉及两项任务：视频内推理和超越视频的推理。其次，我们开发了数据引擎 OmniQA。它会自动构建以证据为依据、明确要求音视频联合推理的问答对，并生成带时间戳的线索链，以指导思维过程的标注。除构建基准外，该引擎还生成训练数据 OmniReasoning-SFT-112K 和 OmniReasoning-RL-19K。最后，我们提出一种在线策略自蒸馏方法——模态因子化自蒸馏（MFSD）。该方法在特定模态线索的上下文中评估每个采样回答，从而解耦各条线索及其跨模态交互的贡献，以进行词元级信用分配。利用我们的训练数据和学习方法，模型 OmniReasoning-30B-A3B 在 OmniVideoBench 上取得 50.0%，在 OmniReasoningBench 上取得 42.5%，分别比基础模型 Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Thinking 提高 12.8 和 9.3 个百分点。此外，该模型在通用和长视频基准上也取得显著提升，包括 Video-MME-v2。我们希望这项工作能为推动未来全模态联合推理研究打下坚实基础。

    Where Do LLMs Retrieve Network Information? Identifying the Responsible Heads and Neurons

    LLM 从何处检索网络信息？识别负责的注意力头和神经元

    Md Abdul Kadir (1 and 2), Md Mohasin Hossain (1 and 3), Omair Shahzad Bhatti (1), Abdulrahman Mohamed Selim (1 and 2), Daniel Sonntag (1 and 2) ((1) German Research Center for Artificial Intelligence (DFKI), Saarbr\"ucken, Germany, (2) University of Oldenburg, Oldenburg, Germany, (3) Saarland University, Saarbr\"ucken, Germany)

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper causally localizes retrieval of structured network facts to specific attention heads and neurons, directly advancing the study of internal mechanisms and knowledge retrieval; its findings on localization granularity are supported across multiple models. Detector performance is a use of those findings, while the abstract offers no substantive contribution to composition, general reasoning, or system organization.

    论文通过因果方法将结构化网络事实的检索定位到特定注意力头和神经元，直接推动了对内部机制和知识检索的研究；其关于定位粒度的发现得到了多个模型的支持。检测器性能是这些发现的一种应用，而摘要并未对组合能力、一般推理或系统组织作出实质性贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language models (LLMs) used for Web information processing rely on retrieving relationships between network entities, such as domain names and IP addresses, but the internal components that causally enable this retrieval remain unclear, hindering targeted safeguards against unsafe actions. Therefore, we investigate whether their retrieval capabilities can be localized to specific attention heads or individual neurons within these LLMs. Across five LLMs from three architecture families, we identify heads through causal ablation screening, test their selectivity against matched negative and context-free controls, rank neurons within these heads using causal ablation and correlational measures, and leverage features from both causally validated heads and individual neurons to build network information retrieval detectors, which we evaluate without retraining on an independent reverse-DNS dataset. In every model, a small set of causally validated heads (1--9 out of 128--1152 candidates) builds a detector with 99.5--100\% held-out accuracy. At the neuron level, the results are model-specific, e.g., in one model, causal and correlational rankings identify the same neuron, matching full-head performance (AUC = 1.000), while in another, the best causally ranked neuron achieves only AUC = 0.665 despite the full head reaching 1.000. On independent CAIDA data, head detectors maintain AUC $\geq 0.971$, while single-neuron detectors fall below chance in three of five models. Overall, these findings highlight the importance of choosing an appropriate level of granularity when causally localizing how LLMs retrieve structured network information from context.

    中文

    用于 Web 信息处理的大型语言模型（LLM）依赖于检索网络实体之间的关系，例如域名和 IP 地址，但因果性地促成这种检索的内部组件仍不清楚，这妨碍了针对不安全操作制定有针对性的防护措施。因此，我们研究这些 LLM 的检索能力能否定位到特定注意力头或单个神经元。在来自三个架构系列的五个 LLM 上，我们通过因果消融筛查识别注意力头，使用匹配的负例和无上下文对照检验其选择性，运用因果消融和相关性度量对这些注意力头中的神经元进行排序，并利用通过因果验证的注意力头和单个神经元的特征构建网络信息检索检测器；我们在独立的反向 DNS 数据集上对这些检测器进行评估，且不重新训练。在每个模型中，少量通过因果验证的注意力头（128--1152 个候选项中的 1--9 个）就能构建出留出集准确率为 99.5--100\% 的检测器。在神经元层面，结果因模型而异。例如，在一个模型中，因果排序和相关性排序识别出同一个神经元，其表现与整个注意力头相当（AUC = 1.000）；而在另一个模型中，因果排序得分最高的神经元仅达到 AUC = 0.665，尽管整个注意力头达到 1.000。在独立的 CAIDA 数据上，注意力头检测器保持 AUC $\geq 0.971$，而在五个模型中的三个模型上，单神经元检测器的表现低于随机水平。总体而言，这些发现凸显了在因果定位 LLM 如何从上下文中检索结构化网络信息时，选择合适粒度的重要性。

    SLVR: Structured Latent Visual Reasoning via Human-like Reasoning Flows

    SLVR：通过类人推理流程实现结构化潜在视觉推理

    Albert Gao, Bing Xue, Andrea Zanette

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    SLVR trains typed latent stages for planning, grounding, evidence selection, and integration to improve visual reasoning without textual CoT at inference. Its reasoning contribution is central; the staged composition and inference efficiency are relevant but secondary, and it does not analyze internal mechanisms.

    SLVR 训练具有类型的潜在阶段，用于规划、定位、证据选择和整合，从而在推理时不使用文本 CoT 的情况下提升视觉推理能力。推理是其核心贡献；分阶段组合和推理效率具有相关性，但属于次要方面，且该工作并未分析内部机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often answer visual reasoning questions by relying on linguistic priors rather than task-relevant visual evidence. Textual chain-of-thought reasoning can partially mitigate this issue by encouraging models to decompose visual questions into intermediate evidence-seeking steps, but generating these steps autoregressively increases inference cost. Latent reasoning avoids explicit rationale generation, but existing approaches provide limited control over what intermediate states encode, making it difficult to impose separate supervision for planning, grounding, and evidence selection. We propose Structured Latent Visual Reasoning (SLVR), a training framework that bridges explicit chain-of-thought and latent reasoning by organizing multimodal reasoning into typed latent stages for planning, grounding, evidence selection, and reasoning integration. SLVR first trains the model to rely on the image by masking answer-revealing text and contrasting the correct answer with visually plausible distractors. It then organizes reasoning into latent stages for planning, grounding, evidence selection, and integration, supervising each stage with the corresponding signal: plans, boxes, visual evidence, and final rationales. This gives latent reasoning an explicit functional structure while avoiding generated textual chains at inference time. Built on Qwen2.5-VL-7B, SLVR improves consistently across multimodal reasoning benchmarks, with absolute gains of +9.4 on MMVP and +14.2 on BLINK Relation, as well as improvements on V*, MathVista, and ChartQA. These results suggest that structured latent supervision can improve fine-grained visual reasoning without the decoding overhead of textual CoT. Project page is available \href{https://bogao-code.github.io/SLVR/}{here}.

    中文

    多模态大型语言模型（MLLM）回答视觉推理问题时，往往依赖语言先验，而非与任务相关的视觉证据。文本思维链推理可以通过鼓励模型将视觉问题分解为寻找中间证据的步骤，在一定程度上缓解这一问题，但自回归生成这些步骤会增加推理成本。潜在推理无需显式生成理由，但现有方法对中间状态所编码内容的控制有限，因此难以分别对规划、定位和证据选择施加监督。我们提出结构化潜在视觉推理（SLVR），这是一种连接显式思维链与潜在推理的训练框架，它将多模态推理组织为具有类型的潜在阶段，分别用于规划、定位、证据选择和推理整合。 SLVR 首先通过屏蔽揭示答案的文本，并将正确答案与视觉上似是而非的干扰项进行对比，训练模型依赖图像。随后，它将推理组织为规划、定位、证据选择和整合等潜在阶段，并使用相应信号监督各阶段：计划、框、视觉证据和最终理由。这样一来，潜在推理具有明确的功能结构，同时避免在推理时生成文本链。 基于 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 构建的 SLVR 在多模态推理基准上均取得稳定提升，在 MMVP 上绝对提升 +9.4，在 BLINK Relation 上绝对提升 +14.2，并且在 V*、MathVista 和 ChartQA 上也有所提升。这些结果表明，结构化潜在监督能够改善细粒度视觉推理，同时避免文本 CoT 的解码开销。项目页面见 \href{https://bogao-code.github.io/SLVR/}{此处}。

    Resample the Answer: Where to Spend Test-Time Compute in Recursive Reasoning

    重新采样答案：递归推理中如何分配测试时计算资源

    Maxime Illouz

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper studies where recursive reasoning models carry failures and finds that answer-state resampling improves test-time recovery, a substantial mechanistic and algorithmic contribution to reasoning. Puzzle solving and compute allocation are relevant contexts, but the abstract does not establish compositional generalization or a broader systems contribution.

    本文研究递归推理模型在何处保留失败，并发现对答案状态重新采样可以改善测试时恢复能力，这是对推理的重要机制性和算法性贡献。谜题求解和计算资源分配是相关背景，但摘要并未确立组合泛化或更广泛的系统贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Recursive reasoning models such as the Tiny Recursive Model (TRM) iteratively refine two latent states: an answer state y, decoded into the output, and a reasoning state z, which is never decoded. Many of their failures have been attributed to bad basins, regions of latent space that trap the recursion on wrong answers. Recent test-time approaches perturb y, z or both to recover these failures, but the impact of this choice on performance, test-time compute efficiency and scaling properties remains unclear. Through controlled experiments on TRM, we find that a failed trajectory carries its failure in its answer state. At equal compute, whether retries continue a failed trajectory (depth scaling) or draw multiple trajectories from the initial states (width scaling), resampling y recovers more failures than any perturbation of z we tested, and the performance gap widens as the test-time compute budget grows. Our approach, Gated Answer Resampling (GAR), pairs this resampling of the answer state with the model's own halting head and restarts only the puzzles that the head rejects. With at most 64 restarts per puzzle and no training or hyperparameter search, GAR takes TRM from 85.9% to 99.4% on Sudoku-Extreme and from 68.8% to 85.6% on Pencil Puzzle Bench validation. On the same checkpoints, GAR also outperforms Probabilistic TRM (PTRM), which perturbs z at each step, even when PTRM uses 42 to 197 times as much compute. Our code is available at https://github.com/MaximeILL/GAR.

    中文

    递归推理模型（如 Tiny Recursive Model（TRM））会迭代细化两个潜在状态：解码为输出的答案状态 y，以及从不解码的推理状态 z。许多模型失败被归因于不良吸引盆地，即会将递归过程困在错误答案上的潜在空间区域。近期的测试时方法会扰动 y、z 或两者，以纠正这些失败，但这种选择对性能、测试时计算效率和扩展特性的影响仍不清楚。通过在 TRM 上进行受控实验，我们发现失败轨迹将失败保留在其答案状态中。在计算量相同的情况下，无论重试是继续一条失败轨迹（深度扩展），还是从初始状态采样多条轨迹（宽度扩展），重新采样 y 所恢复的失败都多于我们测试过的任何 z 扰动；并且随着测试时计算预算增加，性能差距会扩大。我们的方法门控答案重采样（GAR）将答案状态重采样与模型自身的停止头结合起来，只重新启动停止头判定为不通过的谜题。每道谜题最多重启 64 次，且无需训练或搜索超参数，GAR 将 TRM 在 Sudoku-Extreme 上的成绩从 85.9% 提升至 99.4%，在 Pencil Puzzle Bench 验证集上的成绩从 68.8% 提升至 85.6%。在相同检查点上，即使 Probabilistic TRM（PTRM）使用的计算量多出 42 至 197 倍，GAR 的表现仍优于它；PTRM 会在每一步扰动 z。我们的代码见 https://github.com/MaximeILL/GAR。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    MemComposer learns to select, size, and order agent memories using task-success feedback, with transfer across domains and executors. Memory use and agent organization are central; composition is limited to assembling retrieved memories, and the abstract does not study internal mechanisms or reasoning capabilities.

    MemComposer 利用任务成功反馈学习选择智能体记忆、确定记忆数量并排序，且能够迁移到不同领域和执行器。其核心是记忆使用和智能体组织；组合仅限于组装检索到的记忆，摘要没有研究内部机制或推理能力。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Agent memory enables large language model (LLM) agents to reuse past experiences without updating their parameters. However, semantic similarity alone does not guarantee memory usefulness: downstream performance depends on how memories are selected and presented to the agent. We propose MemComposer, a memory composer that jointly examines the current query and retrieved candidates to decide which experiences to include, how many to select, and how to order them. We train the composer using Experience Policy Optimization (ExPO), a GRPO-based framework that evaluates assembled memory contexts through complete agent interactions and uses task-success feedback to optimize the assembly policy. Across three $\tau^2$-bench domains with two frozen executors, MemComposer outperforms the strongest baseline for each executor while reducing average memory-token usage by 16.9% and 4.9%, respectively. The learned policy also transfers to unseen domains, executors, and memory banks, and benefits from memories generated by stronger models without further training. These results demonstrate the value of learning query-specific memory assembly using downstream task feedback.

    中文

    智能体记忆使大型语言模型（LLM）智能体能够复用过往经验，而无需更新其参数。然而，语义相似性本身并不能保证记忆有用：下游表现取决于如何选择记忆并将其呈现给智能体。我们提出 MemComposer，这是一种记忆组装器，它会联合考察当前查询和检索到的候选项，以决定纳入哪些经验、选择多少条，以及如何排序。我们使用经验策略优化（ExPO）训练该组装器；这是一个基于 GRPO 的框架，通过完整的智能体交互评估组装后的记忆上下文，并利用任务成功反馈优化组装策略。在三个 $\tau^2$-bench 领域、使用两个冻结执行器的实验中，MemComposer 的表现优于每个执行器所对应的最强基线，同时分别将平均记忆 token 用量降低了 16.9% 和 4.9%。学到的策略还可迁移到未见过的领域、执行器和记忆库；无需进一步训练，也能从更强模型生成的记忆中获益。这些结果表明，利用下游任务反馈学习针对查询组装记忆具有重要价值。

    ClawMMU: Protection-Coherent Virtual Memory for Stateful LLM Agents

    ClawMMU：面向有状态 LLM 智能体的保护一致型虚拟内存

    Jinhao Hu, Bardia Mohammadi, Mofasshara Binte Rafique, Lars Henning Klein, Akhil Arora, Ashvin Goel, Laurent Bindschaedler

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    ClawMMU proposes a memory-protection layer that tracks provenance and authority and checks content as it enters context, storage, or tool use, preventing untrusted instructions from gaining authority. This directly advances agent memory and harness architecture, while its focus is not model-internal mechanisms, composition, or reasoning capability.

    ClawMMU 提出一种内存保护层，用于追踪来源和权限，并在内容进入上下文、存储或工具调用时进行检查，防止不可信指令获得更高权限。这项工作直接推动了智能体内存和运行框架架构的发展；其重点并非模型内部机制、组合能力或推理能力。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    AI agents keep long-term memory, much of which comes from web pages and tool results. Agent harnesses, the software that runs the model, do not record who may act on this memory, so an instruction hidden in a fetched page can be treated as the user's own instruction. We propose ClawMMU, a protection layer that labels every piece of memory with its owner, scope, origins, and authority. ClawMMU checks these labels whenever content enters the model's context, is written to storage, returns from storage, or drives a tool call. Its central rule is that information may rise in authority, but authority never lifts itself. Because the checks depend on where content came from, not on what it says, memory attacks become classical protection faults that the harness stops even when the model is fooled.

    中文

    AI 智能体会保留长期记忆，其中许多内容来自网页和工具结果。运行模型的软件，即智能体运行框架，并不会记录谁有权对这些记忆采取行动，因此，从抓取的网页中隐藏的指令可能会被当作用户本人的指令。我们提出 ClawMMU，这是一种保护层，为每条记忆标注其所有者、适用范围、来源和权限。每当内容进入模型上下文、写入存储、从存储中返回或触发工具调用时，ClawMMU 都会检查这些标签。其核心规则是：信息的权限可以提升，但权限本身绝不会自行提升。由于检查依据的是内容来源而非内容本身，记忆攻击会成为传统的保护故障，即使模型受到了欺骗，运行框架也能将其拦截。

    Memory enables language agents to carry useful distinctions from past experience into future decisions. Its value depends on which distinctions survive, whether a bounded agent can use them, and what can be recovered or revised as demands evolve. We develop a decision-theoretic framework that follows this value from raw history through persistent state, operational use, and costly recovery and revision. Original and retained value are expressed in units of avoided task loss; risk-cost frontiers describe attainable recovery and preservation across uses. Unknown demand yields value profiles, while interactive feedback changes the distribution of future work. A cost-aware simulation condition and five minimal counterexamples expose the roles of information timing, retrieval access, component interaction, feedback and demand uncertainty. In particular, a pointer with zero mutual information about the answer can still reduce the cost of exact recovery. Diagnostics on LoCoMo, a two-project update task and longitudinal cases exhibit failures of preservation, use and measurement. At fixed retrieved evidence, a saved ledger changes subsequent answers; at fixed agent outputs, an evaluator revision changes scores. The framework connects these distinctions to operational risk bounds and testable principles for allocating memory, preserving recovery options and revising evidence dependencies.

    Scientific discovery does not follow a single fixed methodology: research methods vary across domains and evolve through experimentation as investigations unfold. Although LLM-guided evolutionary search has advanced automated discovery, existing frameworks typically rely on fixed search procedures or restrict adaptation to predefined components, limiting their ability to address diverse research problems and adapt to challenges that emerge at runtime. We introduce Organon, a recursively self-improving agent for scientific discovery. During execution, a single persistent agent analyzes its accumulated experience and autonomously revises its own search strategies, population management, diagnostic tools, memory, and worker coordination. These revisions take effect at runtime, allowing the agent to continuously adapt its approach as research progresses. Importantly, the agent can also diagnose and correct flaws in its own adaptation procedures, enabling recursive improvement of the mechanisms that guide its future self-improvement. We evaluate Organon across 21 computational discovery tasks spanning algorithm design, GPU kernel optimization, mathematical construction, and systems optimization. On ALE-Bench Lite, Organon achieves the best performance among competing search frameworks on all 10 tasks, improving mean held-out performance by 20.5% over EvoX. On KernelBench, it achieves the best results on three of four workloads, with speedups of up to 1.67x over the strongest competing method. Analysis of the search trajectories further reveals how the agent develops task-specific search strategies, builds new diagnostic capabilities, and corrects or reverses its own earlier revisions. The rendered memory is a compact timeline of records plus detail that a fixed rule fits into the remaining room without an LLM call. On AppWorld challenge tasks at 4k, it outperforms the second-best method by 11.5%, and on 147 unused tasks with predictions fixed in advance it outperforms A-Mem with a summary by 12.2%. On LongMemEval and LoCoMo, it matches a dedicated keyword retriever that writes no memory, while memories built on text written by an LLM fall far behind at tight budgets. We validate the test first by showing it yields no temporal features for the DINOv2 image-encoder. Then, using a synthetic representation space, we show that detection rate increases with a direction's projection onto the temporal subspace, and that Sparse Autoencoder features test-flagged as temporal project much more of their norm onto the temporal subspace than unflagged features.
