    Markus Gross, Hans-Martin Rieser

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper develops an interpretable PTM-based account of QELM features, their decodability, and how dynamics and symmetries affect performance, offering substantial insight into internal representations and mechanisms. Forecasting is an application, and the abstract does not establish contributions to compositional generalization, reasoning, or model-system organization.

    本文基于 PTM 构建了可解释的分析框架，阐明 QELM 特征及其可解码性，以及动力学和对称性如何影响性能，从而深入揭示其内部表征和机制。预测任务是应用场景；摘要没有证明其对组合泛化、推理或模型系统组织有所贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Quantum reservoir computers (QRCs) have emerged as a promising approach to quantum machine learning, since they utilize the natural dynamics of quantum systems for data processing and are simple to train. Here, we consider $n$-qubit quantum extreme learning machines (QELMs) with initial-state encoding and continuous-time reservoir dynamics. Applying the Pauli transfer matrix (PTM) formalism reveals the encoding-generated features and their linear transformation by quantum channels, and thereby provides a nonlinear vector autoregression model as an interpretable classical representation of a QELM. We show that the nonlinear information processing capacity of a QELM factorizes into the ability of the encoding to represent a given target function and the decodability of the relevant Pauli features after the effective PTM. Comparing geometric and statistical decodability reveals features that are algebraically hidden yet recoverable through data correlations. We relate the decodability of Pauli features to the spreading of measurement operators under Heisenberg evolution (Krylov growth). Focusing on the unitary channel, we discuss how structured Hamiltonians, when paired with certain observables, can impair model performance, as reflected in a low rank of the readout and the effective PTMs. We trace this effect to Hamiltonian symmetries and derive asymptotic rank estimates for symmetry-resolved observable families. Our decodability analysis disentangles the contributions of encoding, reservoir dynamics, and measurement observables, and thus provides interpretable diagnostics that can inform the design of QELMs and reduce reliance on exhaustive hyperparameter search. As a specific application, we consider forecasting nonlinear dynamical systems and show that the readout of a trained QELM closely matches the expression of the underlying flow map at leading orders.

    中文

    量子储层计算机（QRC）利用量子系统的自然动力学处理数据，而且易于训练，因此已成为量子机器学习的一种很有前景的方法。在此，我们研究采用初态编码和连续时间储层动力学的$n$量子比特量子极限学习机（QELM）。应用 Pauli 传递矩阵（PTM）形式体系，可以揭示编码生成的特征及其经过量子通道后的线性变换，从而将 QELM 表示为一个非线性向量自回归模型，作为其可解释的经典表征。我们证明，QELM 的非线性信息处理能力可分解为两部分：编码表示给定目标函数的能力，以及有效 PTM 作用后相关 Pauli 特征的可解码性。比较几何可解码性和统计可解码性后，可以发现一些代数上隐藏、却能通过数据相关性恢复的特征。我们将 Pauli 特征的可解码性与海森堡演化下测量算子的扩散（Krylov 增长）联系起来。聚焦于幺正通道，我们讨论结构化哈密顿量与某些观测量配对时如何损害模型性能，其表现为读出矩阵和有效 PTM 的秩较低。我们将这一效应追溯到哈密顿量对称性，并推导对称性分辨观测量族的渐近秩估计。我们的可解码性分析区分了编码、储层动力学和测量观测量各自的贡献，由此提供可解释的诊断方法，可用于指导 QELM 设计，并减少对穷举式超参数搜索的依赖。作为一项具体应用，我们研究非线性动力系统的预测，并表明训练后的 QELM 读出在低阶项上与底层流映射的表达式高度吻合。

    Pre-training Large Language Models requires immense computational resources, making optimizer efficiency essential. The optimization landscape is highly anisotropic, with loss reduction driven predominantly by progress along flat directions. While matrix-based optimizers such as Muon and SOAP use fine-grained curvature information to outperform AdamW, their updates tend toward isotropy, which is relatively conservative along flat directions yet potentially aggressive along sharp ones. To address this limitation, we first develop a unified Riemannian Ordinary Differential Equation (ODE) framework that offers a continuous-time interpretation of adaptive algorithms: the preconditioner induces a Riemannian geometry that mitigates ill-conditioning, while momentum serves as a Riemannian damping term that promotes convergence. Guided by these insights, we propose LITE, a generalized acceleration strategy that enhances training dynamics by applying larger Hessian damping coefficients and learning rates along flat trajectories. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LITE significantly accelerates both Muon and SOAP across diverse architectures (Dense, MoE), parameter scales (130M to 1.3B), datasets (C4, Pile), and learning-rate schedules (cosine, wsd). Theoretical analysis confirms that LITE facilitates faster convergence along flat directions in anisotropic landscapes, providing a principled approach to efficient LLM pre-training. The code is available at https://github.com/SHUCHENZHU/LITE.

    ENGLISH

    Activation sparsity is a promising approach for accelerating large language model (LLM) inference by reducing computation and memory movement. However, existing activation sparsity methods typically apply uniform sparsity across projections, ignoring the heterogeneous statistical properties of Transformer weights and thereby amplifying performance degradation. In this paper, we propose ActTail, a TopK magnitude-based activation sparsity method with global activation sparsity allocation grounded in Heavy-Tailed Self-Regularization (HT-SR) theory. Specifically, we capture this heterogeneity via the heavy-tail exponent computed from each projection's empirical spectral density (ESD), which is used as a quantitative indicator to assign projection-specific sparsity budgets. Importantly, we provide a theoretical analysis that establishes an explicit relationship between the activation sparsity ratio and the heavy-tail exponent under the HT-SR regime, offering principled guidance for sparsity allocation beyond heuristic design. Experiments on LLaMA and Mistral models show that our method improves both perplexity and downstream task performance at high sparsity compared to uniform allocation. At 80% sparsity, perplexity is reduced by 21.8% on LLaMA-2-7B, 40.1% on LLaMA-2-13B, and 9.4% on Mistral-7B.

    Sonia Laguna and Jorge da Silva Goncalves and Moritz Vandenhirtz and Alain Ryser and Irene Cannistraci and Julia E. Vogt

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    MUNKEY separates instance-specific memories from model weights so deleting a key enables zero-shot forgetting, providing a substantive but limited insight into how models store and remove information (MechInterp 3). Its memory-augmented architecture and deletion mechanism are a main contribution to model memory systems (Systems 4); the abstract does not address composition or reasoning.

    MUNKEY 将特定于实例的记忆与模型权重分离，因此删除一个键即可实现零样本遗忘，为理解模型如何存储和移除信息提供了重要但有限的见解（MechInterp 3）。其记忆增强架构和删除机制是对模型记忆系统的主要贡献（Systems 4）；摘要未涉及组合或推理。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Machine unlearning for vision models is rapidly becoming a practical requirement, driven by privacy regulations, data errors, and the need to remove harmful or corrupted training images. Despite this, most existing approximate unlearning methods tackle the problem from a post-hoc perspective. They attempt to erase the influence of targeted samples through parameter updates that typically require access to the full training data. This creates a mismatch with real deployment scenarios where unlearning requests can be anticipated, revealing a fundamental limitation of post-hoc approaches. We motivate unlearning by design, a novel paradigm for approximate methods in which models are directly trained to support forgetting as an inherent architectural capability. We instantiate this idea with Machine UNlearning via KEY deletion (MUNKEY), a memory-augmented transformer that decouples instance-specific memorization from model weights. Here, unlearning corresponds to removing the instance-identifying key, enabling zero-shot forgetting without weight updates or access to the original samples or labels. Across natural image benchmarks, fine-grained visual recognition, and medical datasets, MUNKEY outperforms all post-hoc baselines. Our results establish that unlearning by design enables fast, deployment-oriented unlearning while preserving predictive performance.

    对于视觉模型而言，机器遗忘正迅速成为实际需求，其驱动因素包括隐私法规、数据错误，以及移除有害或损坏训练图像的需要。尽管如此，现有大多数近似遗忘方法都采用事后处理的思路。它们试图通过参数更新来消除目标样本的影响，而这通常需要访问完整的训练数据。这与实际部署场景不匹配，因为在这些场景中，遗忘请求可以预先预见，这也揭示了事后处理方法的根本局限。我们提出“通过设计实现遗忘”，这是一种用于近似方法的新范式：模型经过直接训练，将遗忘作为内在的架构能力。我们通过“基于键删除的机器遗忘”（MUNKEY）实现这一构想。MUNKEY 是一种记忆增强型 transformer，它将特定于实例的记忆与模型权重分离。在此，遗忘对应于移除用于识别实例的键，从而无需更新权重，也无需访问原始样本或标签，即可实现零样本遗忘。在自然图像基准、细粒度视觉识别和医学数据集上，MUNKEY 的表现优于所有事后处理基线。我们的结果表明，通过设计实现遗忘，能够在保持预测性能的同时，实现快速、面向部署的遗忘。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Fine-tuning Large Language Models (LLMs) has become essential for domain adaptation, but its memory-intensive property exceeds the capabilities of most GPUs. To address this challenge and democratize LLM fine-tuning, we present SlideFormer, a novel system designed for single-GPU environments. Our innovations are: (1) A lightweight asynchronous engine that treats the GPU as a sliding window and overlaps GPU computation with CPU updates and multi-tier I/O. (2) A highly efficient heterogeneous memory management scheme significantly reduces peak memory usage. (3) Optimized Triton kernels to solve key bottlenecks and integrated advanced I/O. This collaborative design enables fine-tuning of the latest 123B+ models on a single RTX 4090, supporting up to 8x larger batch sizes and 6x larger models. In evaluations, SlideFormer achieves 1.40x to 6.27x higher throughput while roughly halving CPU/GPU memory usage compared to baselines, sustaining >95% peak performance on both NVIDIA and AMD GPUs.The code is available at https://github.com/RegiaYoung/SlideFormer.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    HiMu composes atomic visual and audio predicates through a hierarchical logic tree to select temporally relevant video frames, directly advancing compositional multimodal processing. It supports question answering and frame-budgeted inference, but the abstract describes selection rather than a substantive advance in reasoning mechanisms or model-system architecture.

    HiMu 通过分层逻辑树组合视觉和音频原子谓词，以选择时间上相关的视频帧，直接推动了组合式多模态处理的发展。它支持问答和帧预算受限的推理，但摘要描述的是帧选择，而非推理机制或模型系统架构的实质性进展。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Long-form video question answering requires reasoning over extended temporal contexts, making frame selection a critical bottleneck for multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) bound by finite context windows. Within the controlled frame-budget regime that governs practical deployment, prior selectors score frames against a single global query embedding; as a result, compositional multimodal questions that involve temporal ordering or cross-modal cues such as "what happens on screen right after the narrator mentions the reaction?" are flattened into a representation that loses sub-event ordering and modality bindings. We introduce HiMu, a training-free framework for compositional multimodal frame selection. A single text-only LLM call decomposes the query into a hierarchical logic tree whose leaves are atomic predicates, each routed to a lightweight expert spanning vision (CLIP, open-vocabulary detection, OCR) and audio (speech recognition and non-speech sound matching). Expert signals are normalized, smoothed to align across modalities, and composed bottom-up through fuzzy-logic operators that enforce temporal sequencing and adjacency, yielding a continuous per-frame satisfaction curve. Under the standard 16-frame budget on Video-MME, LongVideoBench, and HERBench-Lite, HiMu achieves state-of-the-art accuracy among frame selection methods and improves over uniform sampling across seven diverse MLLMs as a drop-in module, matching the accuracy of uniform sampling at 4x its frame budget, without retraining and without multiple iterative MLLM calls during selection.

    中文

    长视频问答需要对长时间跨度的上下文进行推理，因此帧选择成为受有限上下文窗口约束的多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的关键瓶颈。在决定实际部署的受控帧预算场景中，先前的选择器会依据单一的全局查询嵌入为帧打分；因此，涉及时间顺序或跨模态线索的组合式多模态问题，例如“叙述者提到那个反应后，屏幕上紧接着发生了什么？”，会被压平为一种丢失子事件顺序和模态绑定的表征。我们提出 HiMu，这是一个无需训练的组合式多模态帧选择框架。一次仅调用文本的 LLM，即可将查询分解为分层逻辑树，其叶节点为原子谓词，并将每个谓词分配给一个轻量级专家；这些专家覆盖视觉领域（CLIP、开放词汇检测、OCR）和音频领域（语音识别与非语音声音匹配）。专家信号经过归一化和平滑处理，以实现跨模态对齐，并通过模糊逻辑算子自底向上组合，从而约束时间顺序和邻接关系，得到连续的逐帧满足度曲线。在 Video-MME、LongVideoBench 和 HERBench-Lite 的标准 16 帧预算下，HiMu 在帧选择方法中达到最先进的准确率；作为即插即用模块，它在七种不同的 MLLM 上均优于均匀采样，并且只需均匀采样四分之一的帧预算，即可达到其准确率；无需重新训练，选择过程中也无需多次迭代调用 MLLM。

    The Long Delay to Arithmetic Generalization

    算术泛化的漫长延迟

    Laura Gomezjurado Gonzalez

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper shows that numeral representation and carry structure predict training sample efficiency for arithmetic generalization, and cautions that probes can recover input residues without evidence of learned computation. This offers substantive insight into representations and systematic generalization, but does not directly investigate internal mechanisms or general reasoning.

    本文表明，数字表示和进位结构能够预测算术泛化的训练样本效率，并指出探针无需模型学会计算就能恢复输入余数。这为表征和系统性泛化提供了重要见解，但并未直接研究内部机制或一般推理能力。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language models today still make mistakes on multi-digit arithmetic when they do not have tools, and part of the reason is how numbers are split into tokens. Arithmetic is also a setting where the correct answer to every input and the algorithm that produces it are already known, so training transformers on it lets us study what they learn against a ground truth. These models often fit their training set long before they generalize to held-out inputs, and this delay, known as grokking, decreases as the training set grows. But, how does the representation of numbers change the amount of data a transformer needs to generalize? We study one-step Collatz prediction, in which a transformer reads the digits of an integer in a chosen base and outputs the digits of the next term in its Collatz sequence. We find that the long delay appears only when the training set has few different integers, and that the numeral base determines how many integers are sufficient. In bases where each output digit depends only on a few neighbouring input digits, because the carry between positions depends only on the current digit, a transformer needs several times fewer training integers. We predicted this ordering before training, and input length does not explain it. The same carry structure predicts which bases are easy for a second Collatz map, for integer division, for a decoder-only transformer, and across three model sizes. Finally, a linear probe recovers the low-order residues of the input as accurately from a randomly initialized encoder as from a trained one. Thus, high probe accuracy on such features does not reliably show that a model has learned to compute them. More broadly, we show that the choice of numeral representation affects sample efficiency in ways we can predict from the structure of the task before training.

    中文

    如今，大语言模型在没有工具辅助时仍会在多位数算术上出错，原因之一是数字被切分成 token 的方式。算术也是一个特殊领域：每个输入的正确答案及生成答案的算法都已知，因此在算术上训练 transformer，使我们能够以已知真值为参照研究它们学到了什么。这些模型往往早在泛化到留出输入之前就已拟合训练集；这种称为 grokking 的延迟会随着训练集增大而缩短。但是，数字的表征方式如何改变 transformer 泛化所需的数据量？我们研究一步 Collatz 预测任务：transformer 读取某个进制下整数的数字，并输出其 Collatz 序列中下一项的数字。我们发现，只有当训练集包含的不同整数较少时，才会出现漫长延迟；而数字进制决定了需要多少个整数才足够。在每个输出位只依赖少数几个相邻输入位的进制中，由于位置间的进位只取决于当前位，transformer 所需的训练整数可减少数倍。我们在训练前就预测了这一排序，而且输入长度无法解释这种差异。同样的进位结构还能预测另一种 Collatz 映射、整数除法、仅解码器 transformer 以及三种模型规模中哪些进制更容易。最后，线性探针从随机初始化的编码器中恢复输入低位余数的准确度，与从训练后的编码器中恢复的准确度相同。因此，在这类特征上探针准确率很高，并不能可靠地证明模型已经学会计算它们。更广泛地说，我们表明，数字表示的选择会以可由任务结构在训练前预测的方式影响样本效率。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

This substantially addresses agent memory systems, while security governance alone offers no substantive interpretability, composition, or reasoning contribution.

    这篇综述按生命周期组织持久记忆攻击与防御，并提出用于 LLM 智能体记忆治理的架构原语，以实现可审计、可恢复的控制。它对智能体记忆系统作出了重要贡献，而单纯的安全治理并未对可解释性、组合性或推理作出实质性贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    The emergence of writable, cross-session persistent memory in LLM agents introduces a qualitatively different threat landscape from conventional input-centric security concerns, characterized by three properties: persistence, statefulness, and propagation. To systematically characterize this landscape, we propose a Memory Lifecycle Framework that organizes attacks, defenses, and their cross-phase dependencies along two axes: six lifecycle phases (Write, Store, Retrieve, Execute, Share & Propagate, Forget & Rollback) and four security objectives (Integrity, Confidentiality, Availability, Governance). This analysis in turn exposes the need for explicit security requirements at the system level, motivating Verifiable Memory Governance (VMG), a framework of five architectural primitives for specifying and evaluating auditable, recoverable control over memory state within declared system and threat-model boundaries. Our analysis motivates integrating provenance, versioning, and policy-aware retention with retrieval and execution defenses to support auditable prevention, containment, and recovery across the lifecycle.

    中文

    LLM 智能体中可写、跨会话持久化记忆的出现，带来了与传统以输入为中心的安全问题有本质区别的威胁格局，其特点包括三个方面：持久性、状态性和传播性。为系统地刻画这一格局，我们提出记忆生命周期框架，沿两个维度组织攻击、防御及其跨阶段依赖关系：六个生命周期阶段（写入、存储、检索、执行、共享与传播、遗忘与回滚）以及四个安全目标（完整性、机密性、可用性、治理）。这项分析进一步揭示了在系统层面明确安全要求的必要性，并由此引出可验证记忆治理（VMG）：一个包含五项架构原语的框架，用于在既定系统和威胁模型边界内，对记忆状态进行可审计、可恢复的控制，并对其进行规范和评估。我们的分析表明，应将溯源信息、版本管理和策略感知的保留机制与检索和执行防御相结合，以支持贯穿整个生命周期的可审计预防、遏制和恢复。

    BERAG 提出一种贝叶斯文档集成检索方法，支持逐 token 更新证据、归因和剪枝，并在知识型视觉问答任务上进行评估。其依据证据生成答案的场景与推理只有附带联系；它没有研究模型内部机制或组合性。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    A common approach to question answering with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is to concatenate documents into a single context and pass it to a language model to generate an answer. While simple, this strategy can obscure the contribution of individual documents, making attribution difficult and contributing to the ``lost-in-the-middle'' effect, where relevant information in long contexts is overlooked. Concatenation also scales poorly: computational cost grows quadratically with context length, a problem that becomes especially severe when the context includes visual data, as in visual question answering. Attempts to mitigate these issues by limiting context length can further restrict performance by preventing models from benefiting from the improved recall offered by deeper retrieval. We propose Bayesian Ensemble Retrieval-Augmented Generation (BERAG), along with Bayesian Ensemble Fine-Tuning (BEFT), as a RAG framework in which language models are conditioned on individual retrieved documents rather than a single combined context. BERAG treats document posterior probabilities as ensemble weights and updates them token by token using Bayes' rule during generation. This approach enables probabilistic re-ranking, parallel memory usage, and clear attribution of document contribution, making it well-suited for large document collections. We evaluate BERAG and BEFT primarily on knowledge-based visual question answering tasks, where models must reason over long, imperfect retrieval lists. The results show substantial improvements over standard RAG, including strong gains on Document Visual Question Answering and multimodal needle-in-a-haystack benchmarks. We also demonstrate that BERAG mitigates the ``lost-in-the-middle'' effect. The document posterior can be used to detect insufficient grounding and trigger deflection, while document pruning enables faster decoding than standard RAG.

    中文

    检索增强生成（RAG）问答的一种常见做法，是将文档拼接成单一上下文，再交给语言模型生成答案。虽然这种策略简单，却可能掩盖各个文档的独立贡献，使归因变得困难，并导致“迷失在中间”效应，即长上下文中的相关信息被忽略。拼接的扩展性也较差：计算成本随上下文长度呈二次方增长；当上下文包含视觉数据（如视觉问答任务）时，这一问题尤其严重。通过限制上下文长度来缓解这些问题，可能进一步限制性能，使模型无法受益于更深入检索所带来的召回率提升。我们提出贝叶斯集成检索增强生成（BERAG）及贝叶斯集成微调（BEFT），构成一个 RAG 框架；在该框架中，语言模型以单个检索文档为条件，而非以拼接后的单一上下文为条件。BERAG 将文档后验概率视为集成权重，并在生成过程中逐 token 使用贝叶斯规则更新这些概率。这种方法支持概率重排序、并行记忆使用以及对文档贡献的清晰归因，因此适用于大型文档集合。我们主要在知识型视觉问答任务上评估 BERAG 和 BEFT；在这些任务中，模型必须基于冗长且不完善的检索列表进行推理。结果显示，与标准 RAG 相比，该方法有显著提升，包括在文档视觉问答和多模态“大海捞针”基准上的明显增益。我们还展示了 BERAG 能缓解“迷失在中间”效应。文档后验概率可用于检测依据是否不足并触发拒答，而文档剪枝则能实现比标准 RAG 更快的解码。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Visual planning represents a crucial facet of human intelligence, especially in tasks that require complex spatial reasoning and navigation. Yet, in machine learning, this inherently visual problem is often tackled through a verbal-centric lens. While recent research demonstrates the promise of fully visual approaches, they suffer from significant computational inefficiency due to the step-by-step planning-by-generation paradigm. In this work, we present EAR, an editing-as-reasoning paradigm that reformulates visual planning as a single-step image transformation. To isolate intrinsic reasoning from visual recognition, we employ abstract puzzles as probing tasks and introduce AMAZE, a procedurally generated dataset that features the classical Maze and Queen problems, covering distinct, complementary forms of visual planning. The abstract nature of AMAZE also facilitates automatic evaluation of autoregressive and diffusion-based models in terms of both pixel-wise fidelity and logical validity. We assess leading proprietary and open-source editing models. The results show that they all struggle in the zero-shot setting, finetuning on basic scales enables remarkable generalization to larger in-domain scales and out-of-domain scales and geometries. However, our best model that runs on high-end hardware fails to match the zero-shot efficiency of human solvers, highlighting a persistent gap in neural visual reasoning.

    Semantic indoor navigation requires robots to connect human instructions with spatial destinations, execute missions and retain useful operational experience. This paper presents the Semantic Autonomy Stack (SAS), a six-layer integration framework, and develops its semantic-reasoning, mission-interface and operational-memory layers over a previously validated ROS 2/Nav2 foundation. A deterministic-first cascade combines the route graph, semantic objects, robot state and stored instruction-destination associations, escalating unresolved or guarded cases to a pretrained Vision-Language Model (VLM). Recurrent model-mediated associations can pass a frequency-and-consistency gate and be compiled for deterministic M3 reuse; this gate measures sampled-output stability rather than semantic truth. The frozen v4.8-review implementation was evaluated on two physical robot configurations in one indoor environment, with onboard navigation and perception and shared-workstation reasoning and memory. Of 216 decision cycles outside the start gate, 112 resolved deterministically at sub-millisecond resolver-compute latency. A sealed 28-instruction challenge yielded 17 acceptable outcomes; five fast-path decisions included one incorrect selection. One promoted association was reused on the second platform through deliberate shared-digest installation. A controlled 594-observation offline comparison showed greater agreement with the stored associations and lower decision latency from M3 reuse in five familiar cases. The M3-disabled cascade reduced VLM calls but matched direct-VLM decision quality in standardized context. Large latency savings were concentrated in paths avoiding VLM inference. Together, the results establish a working integration of selective hybrid reasoning and reusable operational memory, while identifying implementation and evaluation boundaries for further development within SAS.

    中文

    语义室内导航要求机器人将人类指令与空间目的地联系起来、执行任务并保留有用的运行经验。本文提出语义自主栈（SAS），一种六层集成框架，并在此前已验证的 ROS 2/Nav2 基础上开发其语义推理、任务接口和运行记忆层。该框架采用确定性优先的级联机制，结合路线图、语义对象、机器人状态以及已存储的指令—目的地关联，并将未解决或带有保护条件的情况升级交由预训练视觉语言模型（VLM）处理。经常出现的模型介导关联可以通过频率与一致性门槛，并被编译以供确定性 M3 重用；该门槛衡量的是采样输出的稳定性，而非语义真实性。冻结的 v4.8-review 实现已在一个室内环境中的两种实体机器人配置上进行评估，其中导航和感知在机器人端运行，推理和记忆则由共享工作站承担。在起始门控之外的 216 个决策周期中，有 112 个由确定性机制解决，解析器计算延迟低于 1 毫秒。一项密封的 28 条指令挑战中有 17 项结果可接受；五个快速路径决策中包含一次错误选择。通过有意安装共享摘要哈希，一项已晋级的关联在第二个平台上得到重用。一项受控的离线比较涵盖 594 条观测，结果显示，在五个熟悉案例中，M3 重用提高了与已存储关联的一致性，并降低了决策延迟。禁用 M3 的级联机制减少了 VLM 调用次数，但在标准化上下文中，其决策质量与直接使用 VLM 相当。延迟的大幅降低主要出现在避免 VLM 推理的路径上。总体而言，结果展示了选择性混合推理与可重用运行记忆的有效集成，同时指出了 SAS 后续开发中实现和评估的边界。

    Terminus-4B: Can a Smaller Model Replace Frontier LLMs at Agentic Execution Tasks?

    Terminus-4B：较小的模型能否在智能体执行任务中取代前沿 LLM？

    Spandan Garg, Vikram Nitin, Yufan Huang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper develops and evaluates a fine-tuned small model as a subagent for terminal execution, with gains in token use and agent reliance. Its training and benchmark results are mainly about agent architecture and task execution; they provide little direct insight into general reasoning mechanisms.

    本文开发并评估了一个用于终端执行的小型微调模型，将其作为子智能体使用，并在 token 使用量和主智能体对其输出的依赖程度方面取得了改善。其训练和基准测试结果主要涉及智能体架构与任务执行，对一般推理机制的直接见解有限。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Modern coding agents increasingly delegate specialized subtasks to subagents, which are smaller, focused agentic loops that handle narrow responsibilities like search, debugging or terminal execution. This architectural pattern keeps the main agent's context window clean by isolating verbose outputs (e.g. build logs, test results, etc.) within the subagent context. Typically when agents employ subagents for such tasks, they use frontier models as these subagents. In this paper, we investigate whether a finetuned small language model (SLM) can achieve comparable performance to frontier models in the task of agentic terminal execution. We present Terminus-4B, which is a post-trained Qwen3-4B model via Supervised Finetuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning (RL) using rubric-based LLM-as-judge reward, specifically for this task. In our extensive evaluation spanning various frontier models, training ablations and main agent configurations, we find that Terminus-4B is able to reduce the token usage of the main agent by up to ~30% compared to the No Subagent baseline with no impact to agent performance on benchmarks like SWE-Bench Pro and our internal SWE-Bench C# benchmark, which tends to be heavy in verbose execution tasks. Furthermore, Terminus-4B improves key metrics showing the main agent relying on the outputs of the subagent and doing fewer terminal execution tasks by itself. We see that our model not only closes the gap between the Vanilla Qwen model and frontier models like Claude Sonnet / Opus / GPT-5.3-Codex, but often even exceeds their performance.

    中文

    现代编码智能体越来越多地将专门子任务委托给子智能体；子智能体是更小、更专注的智能体循环，负责搜索、调试或终端执行等范围明确的工作。这种架构模式将冗长输出（例如构建日志、测试结果等）隔离在子智能体的上下文中，从而保持主智能体的上下文窗口整洁。通常，智能体在这类任务中使用子智能体时，会选用前沿模型。本文研究微调后的小型语言模型（SLM）能否在智能体终端执行任务中达到与前沿模型相当的性能。我们提出 Terminus-4B，这是一个针对该任务通过监督微调（SFT）和强化学习（RL）进行后训练的 Qwen3-4B 模型，奖励采用基于评分标准的 LLM-as-judge。在涵盖多种前沿模型、训练消融实验和主智能体配置的大规模评估中，我们发现，与不使用子智能体的基线相比，Terminus-4B 能将主智能体的 token 使用量最多降低约 30%，同时不影响其在 SWE-Bench Pro 和我们内部的 SWE-Bench C# 基准上的表现；后者往往包含大量冗长的执行任务。此外，Terminus-4B 提升了若干关键指标，表明主智能体更依赖子智能体的输出，并减少了自行执行的终端任务。结果显示，我们的模型不仅缩小了 Vanilla Qwen 与 Claude Sonnet / Opus / GPT-5.3-Codex 等前沿模型之间的差距，而且往往还能超过它们的表现。

    SATFormer：学习何时使用早期值残差

    Skye Gunasekaran, T\'ea Wright, Rui-Jie Zhu, Jason Eshraghian

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    SATFormer adds context-dependent access to early-layer representations and analyzes sparse, depth- and head-specific patterns, making representation reuse a substantial mechanistic contribution. The abstract does not focus on compositional generalization, reasoning, or system-level computation beyond the architecture change.

    SATFormer 增加了对早期层表征的上下文依赖访问机制，并分析了稀疏且依赖深度和注意力头的模式，因此表征重用构成了一项有实质意义的机制贡献。摘要并未聚焦于组合泛化、推理或超出架构改动之外的系统级计算。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Recent Transformer architectures expose later layers to representations computed in earlier layers, motivated by the observation that low-level features can become harder to recover as the residual stream is transformed through depth. One such method adds static value residuals: learned mixing coefficients that expose the first-layer value projection V_1 uniformly across tokens and heads. However, we theorize that the usefulness of $V_1$ is unlikely to be constant across tokens, heads, and contexts, and therefore treat early-representation reuse as a retrieval problem. Here, we introduce Selective Access Transformer (SATFormer), which preserves the first-layer value pathway while controlling access with a context-dependent gate. Across models from 130M to 1.3B parameters, SATFormer improves validation loss over the static value-residual and Transformer baselines at every evaluated scale, and improves average zero-shot accuracy over both at all four scales. Its strongest gains appear on retrieval-intensive benchmarks, where it improves over static value residuals by approximately 1.5 average points, while maintaining near baseline throughput and memory. Mechanistic analyses suggest sparse, depth-dependent, head-specific, and category-sensitive access patterns, supporting the interpretation that SATFormer learns selective reuse of early representations rather than uniform residual copying. Our code is available at https://github.com/skyegunasekaran/satformer.

    中文

    近期的 Transformer 架构让后续层接触在早期层计算的表征，其动机是观察到，随着残差流逐层变换，低级特征可能变得更难恢复。其中一种方法加入静态值残差：通过学习得到的混合系数，让所有 token 和注意力头都能使用第一层的值投影 V_1。然而，我们认为 $V_1$ 的作用不太可能在不同 token、注意力头和上下文之间始终相同，因此将早期表征的重用视为一个检索问题。在此，我们提出选择性访问 Transformer（SATFormer），它保留第一层的值通路，同时通过依赖上下文的门控机制控制访问。在参数量从 130M 到 1.3B 的模型上，与静态值残差和 Transformer 基线相比，SATFormer 在每个评估规模上都改善了验证损失，并在四种规模上均提高了平均零样本准确率。其最大收益出现在检索密集型基准上：相较于静态值残差，平均得分约提高 1.5 分，同时吞吐量和内存占用接近基线。机制分析表明，其访问模式具有稀疏性，并依赖于深度、注意力头和类别；这支持了这样的解释：SATFormer 学会了有选择地重用早期表征，而不是均匀地复制残差。我们的代码见 https://github.com/skyegunasekaran/satformer。

    Predict-then-Diffuse: Adaptive Response Length for Compute-Budgeted Inference in Diffusion LLMs

    先预测，再扩散：面向扩散 LLM 计算预算推理的自适应响应长度

    Michael Rottoli, Subhankar Roy, Stefano Paraboschi

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces an adaptive response-length predictor to reduce wasted computation and latency in diffusion LLM inference while preserving output quality. This is a substantial contribution to compute allocation in model systems; it does not study internal representations, compositional generalization, or reasoning mechanisms.

    本文提出自适应响应长度预测器，在保持输出质量的同时减少扩散 LLM 推理中的计算浪费和延迟。这是对模型系统中计算资源分配的一项实质性贡献；论文没有研究内部表征、组合泛化或推理机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Diffusion-based Large Language Models (D-LLMs) represent a promising frontier in generative AI, offering fully parallel token generation that can lead to significant throughput advantages and superior GPU utilization over the traditional autoregressive paradigm. However, this parallelism is constrained by the requirement of a fixed-size response length prior to generation. This architectural limitation imposes a severe trade-off: oversized response length results in computational waste on semantically meaningless padding tokens, while undersized response length causes output truncation requiring costly re-computations that introduce unpredictable latency spikes. To tackle this issue, we propose Predict-then-Diffuse, a simple and model-agnostic framework that enables compute-budgeted inference per input query by first estimating the response length and then using it to run inference with D-LLM. At its core lies an Adaptive Response Length Predictor (AdaRLP), which estimates the optimal response length given an input query. As a measure against under-estimating the response length and re-running inference with a higher value, we introduce a data-driven safety mechanism based on a small increase of the predicted length. As a whole, our framework avoids wasting computation on padding tokens, at the same time preserving output quality. Experimental validation on multiple datasets demonstrates that Predict-then-Diffuse significantly reduces computational costs (FLOP) compared to the default D-LLM inference mechanism, while being robust to skewed data distributions.

    中文

    基于扩散的大型语言模型（D-LLM）是生成式 AI 一个很有前景的方向，能够完全并行地生成 token，相比传统自回归范式可显著提升吞吐量和 GPU 利用率。然而，这种并行性受到一项要求的限制：必须在生成前确定固定的响应长度。这一架构限制带来了严峻的权衡：响应长度过大会导致计算资源浪费在语义上无意义的填充 token 上，而响应长度过小则会造成输出截断，需要耗费大量计算重新运行，并引发不可预测的延迟峰值。为解决这一问题，我们提出 Predict-then-Diffuse，这是一种简单且与模型无关的框架，可针对每条输入查询进行计算预算推理：先估计响应长度，再据此使用 D-LLM 运行推理。其核心是自适应响应长度预测器（AdaRLP），用于根据输入查询估计最优响应长度。为避免低估响应长度后再以更大的值重新运行推理，我们引入了一种基于数据的安全机制，即在预测长度上小幅增加余量。总体而言，该框架避免了在填充 token 上浪费计算，同时保持输出质量。在多个数据集上的实验验证表明，与默认的 D-LLM 推理机制相比，Predict-then-Diffuse 显著降低了计算成本（FLOP），并且能够稳健应对偏斜的数据分布。

    Why Geometric Continuity Emerges in Deep Neural Networks: Residual Connections and Rotational Symmetry Breaking

    深度神经网络为何会出现几何连续性：残差连接与旋转对称性破缺

    Kyungwon Jeong, Won-Gi Paeng, Honggyo Suh

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper identifies and experimentally distinguishes mechanisms—residual gradient coherence and symmetry-breaking nonlinearities—that produce cross-layer geometric continuity, with projection-specific findings in transformers. This is a substantial contribution to representation geometry, but it does not address composition, reasoning, or system organization.

    本文识别并通过实验区分了产生跨层几何连续性的机制——残差梯度一致性和破缺对称性的非线性函数，并给出了 Transformer 中依投影类型而异的发现。这是对表征几何的一项实质性贡献，但没有涉及组合、推理或系统组织。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Weight matrices in deep networks exhibit geometric continuity---principal singular vectors of adjacent layers point in similar directions. While this property has been widely observed, its origin remains unexplained. Through experiments on toy MLPs and small transformers, we identify two mechanisms: residual connections create cross-layer gradient coherence that aligns weight updates across layers, and symmetry-breaking nonlinearities constrain all layers to a shared coordinate frame, preventing the rotation drift that would otherwise destabilize weight structure. Crucially, a nonlinear but rotation-equivariant activation reaches less than half of ReLU's continuity, isolating symmetry breaking---not nonlinearity alone---as the active ingredient. Activation and normalization play distinct roles: activation concentrates continuity in the leading singular direction, while normalization distributes it across multiple directions. In transformers, continuity is projection-specific: Q, K, Gate, and Up (which read from the residual stream) develop input-space ($\mathbf{v}_1$) continuity; O and Down (which write to it) develop output-space ($\mathbf{u}_1$) continuity; V alone, lacking an adjacent nonlinearity, develops only low continuity.

    中文

    深度网络中的权重矩阵呈现几何连续性——相邻层的主奇异向量方向相似。尽管这一性质已被广泛观察到，其起源仍未得到解释。通过在玩具 MLP 和小型 Transformer 上进行实验，我们识别出两种机制：残差连接产生跨层梯度一致性，使各层的权重更新方向对齐；破缺对称性的非线性函数则将所有层约束在共享的坐标系中，防止旋转漂移，否则这种漂移会破坏权重结构的稳定性。关键的是，非线性但旋转等变的激活函数所达到的连续性不到 ReLU 的一半，这表明起作用的是对称性破缺，而非单纯的非线性。激活函数和归一化发挥着不同作用：激活函数将连续性集中在主奇异方向上，而归一化则将其分散到多个方向上。在 Transformer 中，连续性取决于投影类型：Q、K、Gate 和 Up（从残差流读取）形成输入空间（$\mathbf{v}_1$）连续性；O 和 Down（写入残差流）形成输出空间（$\mathbf{u}_1$）连续性；只有 V 缺少相邻的非线性函数，因此仅呈现较弱的连续性。

    BatMIL: Geometry-Embedding State Space Model for Whole-Slide Image Representation

    BatMIL：用于全切片图像表征的几何嵌入状态空间模型

    Enhui Chai and Sicheng Chen and Tianyi Zhang and Chad Wong and Kecheng Huang and Zeyu Liu and Fei Xia

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    BatMIL’s main contribution combines hyperbolic and Euclidean representations with state-space modeling and expert routing for whole-slide image analysis. Its geometry and routing offer transferable representational and computational ideas, but the abstract does not study model internals or compositional generalization; the pathology task alone does not support a reasoning score.

    BatMIL 的主要贡献是将双曲与欧几里得表征、状态空间建模和专家路由结合起来，用于全切片图像分析。其几何方法和路由机制提供了可迁移的表征与计算思路，但摘要没有研究模型内部机制或组合泛化；仅凭病理学任务本身不足以支持推理能力方面的评价。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Accurate analysis of histopathological images is critical for disease diagnosis and treatment planning. Whole-slide images (WSIs), which digitize tissue specimens at gigapixel resolution, are fundamental to this process but require aggregating thousands of patches for slide-level predictions. Multiple Instance Learning (MIL) tackles this challenge with a two-stage paradigm, decoupling tile-level embedding and slide-level prediction. However, most existing methods implicitly embed patch representations in homogeneous Euclidean spaces, overlooking the hierarchical organization and regional heterogeneity of pathological tissues. This limits current models' ability to capture global tissue architecture and fine-grained cellular morphology. To address this limitation, we introduce a hybrid hyperbolic-Euclidean representation that embeds WSI features in dual geometric spaces, enabling complementary modeling of hierarchical tissue structures and local morphological details. Building on this formulation, we develop BatMIL, an MIL method that leverages both geometric spaces. To model long-range dependencies among thousands of patches, we employ a structured state space sequence model backbone that encodes patch sequences with linear computational complexity. Furthermore, to account for regional heterogeneity, we introduce a mixture-of-experts module that dynamically routes each patch to specialized expert sub-networks based on its features, improving representational capacity while reducing redundant computation. Experiments on seven datasets spanning six cancer types demonstrate that BatMIL achieves outstanding performance against fifteen state-of-the-art MIL approaches, demonstrating that geometry-embedding representation learning offers a promising direction for computational pathology.

    中文

    对组织病理图像进行准确分析对于疾病诊断和治疗规划至关重要。全切片图像（WSI）以十亿像素级分辨率对组织样本进行数字化，是这一过程的基础，但需要聚合数千个图块才能进行切片级预测。多实例学习（MIL）通过将图块级嵌入与切片级预测解耦的两阶段范式应对这一挑战。然而，现有大多数方法都隐式地将图块表征嵌入同质的欧几里得空间，忽略了病理组织的层级组织结构和区域异质性。这限制了当前模型捕获整体组织结构和细粒度细胞形态的能力。为解决这一局限，我们引入一种双曲—欧几里得混合表征，将 WSI 特征嵌入双重几何空间，从而互补地建模层级组织结构与局部形态细节。在此基础上，我们开发了 BatMIL，一种同时利用这两种几何空间的 MIL 方法。为了建模数千个图块之间的长程依赖关系，我们采用结构化状态空间序列模型作为骨干网络，以线性计算复杂度编码图块序列。此外，为了考虑区域异质性，我们引入混合专家模块，根据图块特征动态地将每个图块路由到专门的专家子网络，从而提升表征能力并减少冗余计算。在涵盖六种癌症类型的七个数据集上的实验表明，BatMIL 的表现优于十五种最先进的 MIL 方法，说明几何嵌入表征学习为计算病理学提供了一个有前景的方向。

    Same Signal, Opposite Meaning: Direction-Informed Adaptive Learning for LLM Agents

    相同信号，相反含义：面向 LLM 智能体的方向感知自适应学习

    Ziming Li, Jiatan Huang, Xiaoguang Guo, Guiling Wang, Chuxu Zhang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    DIAL learns a per-environment and per-backbone gate for allocating agent rollout compute, using counterfactual exploration to address cases where extra computation helps or harms. This is a substantial systems contribution to adaptive compute in agents, with reasoning relevance limited to improving task execution rather than explaining or developing reasoning capabilities.

    DIAL 使用反事实探索，为每种环境和骨干模型学习分配智能体 rollout 计算的门控，以处理额外计算可能有益或有害的情况。这是对智能体自适应计算的一项实质性系统贡献；其与推理的关联仅限于改善任务执行，而非解释或发展推理能力。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Adaptive test-time compute for LLM agents aims to invoke extra computation only when it improves performance. Existing methods typically use confidence-, uncertainty-, or difficulty-based gates, assuming a fixed direction from the gating signal through compute need to the value of computation. This makes gating a utility-calibration problem: gating signals should align with whether extra computation improves the final outcome over the base policy. We show that this alignment is unstable: the same signal predicts rollout benefit in one setting and rollout harm in another, with reversals across environments and backbones even when the task is fixed. Wrong-direction gates can therefore worsen performance by precisely selecting harmful states. This reversal reflects a deeper distinction between compute need and compute suitability: a high uncertainty signal may indicate decision-difficult states where rollouts help compare alternatives, or intervention-unsuitable states where the current context does not support useful rollout-based improvement. Under this two-source model, fixed-direction gates are unreliable across heterogeneous settings. To address this, we propose DIAL (Direction-Informed Adaptive Learning), a sparse gate trained from signal-agnostic counterfactual exploration to learn the utility direction of state features per (environment, backbone). Across six environments and three backbones, DIAL yields a stronger overall success-cost trade-off than fixed-direction baselines. Our code is open-sourced at https://github.com/zmli6/DIAL.

    中文

    面向 LLM 智能体的自适应测试时计算旨在仅在额外计算能够提升性能时才调用它。现有方法通常使用基于置信度、不确定性或难度的门控，并假设门控信号、计算需求与计算价值之间存在固定方向的关系。这使门控成为效用校准问题：门控信号应与额外计算相对于基础策略是否能改善最终结果相一致。我们发现，这种一致性并不稳定：同一信号在一种设置下能预测 rollout 的收益，在另一种设置下却能预测 rollout 的损害；即使任务不变，这种方向也会随环境和骨干模型而反转。因此，方向错误的门控可能恰好选中有害状态，从而降低性能。这种反转反映了计算需求与计算适用性之间更深层的区别：较高的不确定性信号可能表示决策困难的状态，在这些状态下 rollout 有助于比较备选方案；也可能表示不适合干预的状态，在这些状态下当前上下文无法支持有益的、基于 rollout 的改进。在这一双来源模型下，固定方向门控在异质设置中并不可靠。为此，我们提出 DIAL（方向感知自适应学习），一种通过信号无关的反事实探索进行训练的稀疏门控，用于按（环境、骨干模型）学习状态特征的效用方向。在六种环境和三种骨干模型上的实验中，与固定方向基线相比，DIAL 实现了更优的整体成功率—成本权衡。我们的代码已开源：https://github.com/zmli6/DIAL。

    Mathematical Reasoning via Intervention-Based Time-Series Causal Discovery Using LLMs as Concept Mastery Simulators

    通过基于干预的时间序列因果发现进行数学推理：将 LLM 用作概念掌握模拟器

    Tsuyoshi Okita

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    CIKA uses prompted concept interventions to estimate which concepts causally affect mathematical correctness, and evaluates this as a reasoning capability probe and activation method. This provides a limited causal view of concept use, but the abstract does not analyze internal representations or model mechanisms directly; composition and system design are not central.

    CIKA 通过提示进行概念干预，以估计哪些概念会对数学正确性产生因果影响，并将这一方法作为推理能力探针和激活方法进行评估。这为概念使用提供了有限的因果视角，但摘要没有直接分析内部表征或模型机制；组合和系统设计并非核心内容。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Recent methods for improving LLM mathematical reasoning, whether through MCTS-based test-time search or causal graph-guided knowledge injection, cannot identify which concepts causally contribute to a correct answer, as the observed association may be spurious, driven by confounders such as problem difficulty. We propose CIKA (Causal Intervention for Knowledge Activation), a framework that uses the LLM itself as an interventional simulator: a prompt sets the concept state to ``mastered'' and the correctness change estimates the causal effect. We formalize this quantity as an Interventional Capability Probe (ICP), which diagnoses whether the LLM can use a given concept -- distinct from merely possessing knowledge. Because the intervention exogenously sets the concept state independently of problem difficulty, ICP separates confounding that observational methods cannot. On 67 screened problems, the ICP of the top-ranked concept (+0.219) is significantly larger than that of the negative control (+0.039; paired $t$-test, $p < 10^{-6}$, Cohen's $d = 0.86$), confirming that the probe discriminates causally relevant concepts from irrelevant ones. Analysis of 601 Omni-MATH problems further shows that solved problems have 6.1$\times$ higher ATE than unsolved ones (0.338 vs. 0.055), confirming that ICP is predictive of problem-solving success. With a 7B-parameter LLM whose weights are entirely frozen, CIKA achieves 69.7\% on the contamination-free Omni-MATH-Rule benchmark and 64.0\% overall, compared to 60.5\% for o1-mini, and 97.2\% on GSM8K, 46--50\% on AIME 2024--2026, and 46.2\% on MathArena. The Causal Knowledge Activation component contributes 33.8\% of correct answers on problems where the base model alone fails, demonstrating that the LLM already possessed but had not activated the requisite knowledge.

    中文

    近期旨在提升 LLM 数学推理能力的方法，无论是基于 MCTS 的测试时搜索还是因果图引导的知识注入，都无法识别哪些概念对答对问题具有因果贡献，因为观察到的关联可能是虚假的，受到问题难度等混杂因素的影响。我们提出 CIKA（知识激活的因果干预），一种将 LLM 本身用作干预模拟器的框架：通过提示将概念状态设为“已掌握”，并以正确率的变化估计因果效应。我们将这一量形式化为干预能力探针（ICP），用于诊断 LLM 是否能够运用某个概念，这与仅仅拥有相关知识不同。由于干预在外部设定概念状态，使其独立于问题难度，ICP 能够区分观察性方法无法消除的混杂因素。在 67 道经过筛选的问题上，排名最高概念的 ICP（+0.219）显著高于负对照（+0.039；配对$t$-检验，$p < 10^{-6}$，Cohen's $d = 0.86$），证实该探针能够区分因果相关概念与无关概念。对 601 道 Omni-MATH 问题的分析还表明，已解问题的 ATE 比未解问题高 6.1$\times$（0.338 对 0.055），证实 ICP 能够预测问题求解的成功率。在一个权重完全冻结的 7B 参数 LLM 上，CIKA 在无污染的 Omni-MATH-Rule 基准上取得了 69.7\%，总体得分为 64.0\%，而 o1-mini 为 60.5\%；此外，CIKA 在 GSM8K 上达到 97.2\%，在 AIME 2024--2026 上达到 46--50\%，在 MathArena 上达到 46.2\%。在基础模型单独作答失败的问题上，因果知识激活组件贡献了 33.8\% 的正确答案，这表明 LLM 已经具备所需知识，只是尚未将其激活。

    Chengqian Zhang, Yucheng Jin, Duo Zhang, Tiejun Li, Han Wang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper identifies a representation gap and shows that aligning generative-model hidden states with MLIP representations transfers stability-aware priors, with atom-wise representation distinguishability predicting transfer effectiveness.     本文发现了表征差距，并表明将生成模型的隐藏状态与 MLIP 表征对齐，可以迁移具有稳定性意识的先验；逐原子表征的可区分性能够预测迁移效果。这些是重要的表征洞见，而晶体生成本身并未体现组合泛化、推理或系统方面的贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Crystal generative models mainly learn what stable crystals look like, with little explicit supervision for what makes them stable. We reveal a substantial representation gap between state-of-the-art crystal generative models and pretrained universal machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) via energy probing, and show this gap can be closed by a simple training-time alignment. We propose Crystal REPresentation Alignment (CrystalREPA), a plug-and-play framework that aligns the atom-wise hidden states of generative encoders with frozen MLIP representations through an element-aware contrastive objective, transferring stability-aware atomistic priors with marginal training overhead and no additional inference cost. Across three generative frameworks, ten MLIP teachers, and two benchmark datasets, CrystalREPA consistently improves the thermodynamic stability, structural validity, and structural fidelity of generated crystals. Equally important, we find that an MLIP's transfer effectiveness is poorly predicted by its accuracy on standard leaderboards (e.g., Matbench Discovery) but strongly predicted by the distinguishability of its atom-wise representation space, yielding a practical, accuracy-independent criterion for selecting MLIP teachers for generative transfer. Code is available at https://github.com/Chengqian-Zhang/CrystalREPA.

    中文

    晶体生成模型主要学习稳定晶体的外观，却很少通过显式监督学习晶体稳定的原因。我们通过能量探测揭示了当前最先进的晶体生成模型与预训练通用机器学习原子间势（MLIP）之间存在显著的表征差距，并表明简单的训练时对齐即可弥合这一差距。我们提出晶体表征对齐（Crystal REPresentation Alignment，CrystalREPA），这是一种即插即用框架，通过元素感知的对比目标，将生成编码器的逐原子隐藏状态与冻结的 MLIP 表征对齐，以极小的额外训练开销且不增加推理成本，迁移具有稳定性意识的原子级先验。在三个生成框架、十种 MLIP 教师模型和两个基准数据集上，CrystalREPA 持续提升生成晶体的热力学稳定性、结构有效性和结构保真度。同样重要的是，我们发现，MLIP 的迁移效果难以通过其在标准排行榜（例如 Matbench Discovery）上的准确率来预测，却能由其逐原子表征空间的可区分性强烈预测；这为选择用于生成迁移的 MLIP 教师模型提供了一项实用且与准确率无关的标准。代码见 https://github.com/Chengqian-Zhang/CrystalREPA。

    Neural Information Causality: A Random-Access Capacity Law for Representation Learning

    神经信息因果性：表征学习的随机访问容量定律

    Jeongho Bang, Marcin Paw{\l}owski

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper derives a capacity law for information retrieval from encoded representations and decomposes retrieval limits into capacity slack, organization across targets, and answer-production losses. This offers transferable insight into representation and memory access; its relevance to systems is partial because memory allocation is an application implication rather than the central systems contribution.

    本文推导出一条关于从编码表征中检索信息的容量定律，并将检索限制分解为容量余量、跨目标信息组织以及答案生成损失。这为表征与记忆访问提供了可迁移的洞见；其与系统的关联较为有限，因为记忆分配只是应用层面的启示，并非核心系统贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    How can a learned representation remain useful when the question it must answer is chosen only after encoding? Preserving information is essential, but does not by itself ensure access to the requested target. We address this problem by deriving "neural information causality (Neural-IC)," a representation law that connects causal access to the physically specified interface capacity. For a fresh database of independent bits, the aggregate information recoverable across later queries cannot exceed that capacity, even with pre-established quantum resources. A decomposition separates capacity slack, information organized jointly across targets, and losses in producing answers. Exhaustive evaluation of trained binary codes reveals why nearly full use of a memory's information budget can coexist with limited retrieval. In a nested Bell-correlation construction, quantum assistance improves average retrieval over the optimal classical one-bit benchmark within the same communicated budget. These results give representation learning a design principle that connects information capacity to the organization and extraction of target information. By locating the constraints on later answers, the framework can inform memory allocation, encoding objectives, and decoder outputs, providing a basis for seeking better retrieval within a fixed budget.

    中文

    如何让学得的表征在编码完成后才确定要回答的问题时仍然有用？保留信息至关重要，但仅此并不能确保能够访问所请求的目标。我们通过推导“神经信息因果性（Neural-IC）”来解决这一问题；这是一条将因果访问与物理上规定的接口容量联系起来的表征定律。对于一个由独立比特组成的新数据库，即使预先建立了量子资源，在后续查询中可恢复的信息总量也不能超过该容量。一种分解方式分别刻画了容量余量、跨目标联合组织的信息，以及答案生成过程中的损失。对训练所得二进制编码进行穷举评估，揭示了为何记忆几乎充分利用其信息预算时，检索能力仍可能有限。在一种嵌套贝尔关联构造中，在相同的通信预算下，量子辅助使平均检索效果优于最优的经典单比特基准。这些结果为表征学习提供了一项设计原则，将信息容量与目标信息的组织和提取联系起来。通过定位后续答案所受的约束，该框架可为记忆分配、编码目标和解码器输出提供指导，从而为在固定预算内寻求更好的检索效果奠定基础。

    Amirhossein Abaskohi, Yuhang He, Peter West, Giuseppe Carenini, Pranit Chawla, Vibhav Vineet

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    ReVision reduces redundant visual tokens to extend the history available to computer-use agents, improving efficiency and task success. This is a substantial contribution to agent computation and context use; the abstract does not describe reasoning mechanisms or compositional generalization.

    ReVision 减少冗余视觉 token，扩展了计算机使用智能体可用的历史信息，并提升效率和任务成功率。这对智能体的计算和上下文利用作出了重要贡献；摘要没有描述推理机制或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Computer-use agents (CUAs) rely on visual observations of graphical user interfaces, where each screenshot is encoded into a large number of visual tokens. As interaction trajectories grow, the token cost increases rapidly, limiting the amount of history that can be incorporated under fixed context and compute budgets. This has resulted in no or very limited improvement in the performance when using history unlike other domains. We address this inefficiency by introducing ReVision, which is used to train multimodal language models on trajectories where redundant visual patches are removed using a learned patch selector that compares patch representations across consecutive screenshots while preserving spatial structure required by the model. Across three benchmarks, OSWorld, WebTailBench, and AgentNetBench, when processing trajectories with 5 history screenshots using Qwen2.5-VL-7B, ReVision reduces token usage by 46% on average while improving success rate by 3% over the no drop baseline. This establishes a clear efficiency gain, enabling agents to process longer trajectories with fewer tokens. With this improved efficiency, we revisit the role of history in CUAs and find that performance continues to improve as more past observations are incorporated when redundancy is removed.

    计算机使用智能体（CUA）依赖图形用户界面的视觉观测，其中每张屏幕截图都会被编码成大量视觉 token。随着交互轨迹变长，token 成本迅速增加，在上下文和计算预算固定时，能够纳入的历史信息因此受到限制。这导致利用历史信息时，性能几乎没有提升，或提升十分有限，与其他领域的情况不同。我们通过引入 ReVision 来解决这一低效问题；ReVision 用于在轨迹上训练多模态语言模型，并借助学习得到的图像块选择器移除冗余视觉图像块。该选择器会比较连续屏幕截图中的图像块表征，同时保留模型所需的空间结构。在三个基准 OSWorld、WebTailBench 和 AgentNetBench 上，使用 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 处理包含 5 张历史截图的轨迹时，ReVision 平均减少 46% 的 token 使用量，并比不丢弃图像块的基线提高 3% 的成功率。这带来了明确的效率提升，使智能体能够以更少的 token 处理更长的轨迹。借助这一效率提升，我们重新审视历史信息在 CUA 中的作用，并发现移除冗余后，纳入更多过去的观测仍能持续提升性能。

    Hyeonjin Kim, Hangyeol Jung, Heechan Yun, Sungjun Yun, and Dong-Jun Han

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    SAEParate separates overlapping concepts in diffusion-model latent features through concept-aware contrastive learning, directly advancing concept representation and feature disentanglement. Joint concept unlearning involves combining styles and objects, but the abstract presents this as an application setting rather than a contribution to compositional generalization.

    SAEParate 通过概念感知对比学习分离扩散模型潜在特征中相互重叠的概念，直接推进了概念表征与特征解耦。联合概念遗忘涉及风格与对象的组合，但摘要将其作为应用场景，而不是对组合泛化的贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Unlearning specific concepts in text-to-image diffusion models has become increasingly important for preventing undesirable content generation. Among prior approaches, sparse autoencoder (SAE)-based methods have attracted attention due to their ability to suppress target concepts through lightweight manipulation of latent features, without modifying model parameters. However, SAEs trained primarily for sparse reconstruction do not explicitly enforce concept-wise separation, allowing semantically related concepts to share latent features. To address this, we propose SAEParate, which explicitly separates semantically overlapping concepts in the SAE latent space through concept-aware contrastive learning, supported by cross-attention-guided spatial aggregation that emphasizes concept-relevant regions. In addition, we enhance the encoder with a nonlinear transformation to increase its expressive capacity under this separation objective, enabling more concept-discriminative latent representations. Experiments on UnlearnCanvas demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, with particularly strong gains in joint style-object unlearning, a challenging setting where existing methods suffer from severe interference between target and non-target concepts.

    遗忘文本到图像扩散模型中的特定概念，对于防止生成不良内容变得日益重要。在以往方法中，基于稀疏自编码器（SAE）的方法因能够通过轻量操作潜在特征来抑制目标概念，而无需修改模型参数，受到广泛关注。然而，主要针对稀疏重建训练的 SAE 并未显式强制按概念分离，因此语义相关的概念可能共享潜在特征。为解决这一问题，我们提出 SAEParate，通过概念感知对比学习，在 SAE 潜在空间中显式分离语义上重叠的概念，并借助交叉注意力引导的空间聚合来突出与概念相关的区域。此外，我们通过非线性变换增强编码器，以提升其在此分离目标下的表达能力，从而获得概念区分性更强的潜在表征。在 UnlearnCanvas 上的实验表明，该方法达到了最先进的性能；在联合风格与对象遗忘方面提升尤为显著。这是一个具有挑战性的设置，现有方法在其中会受到目标概念与非目标概念之间严重干扰的影响。

    Multi-Agent Debate for Belief Optimization in Defeasible Domains

    面向可撤销领域中信念优化的多智能体辩论

    Tommaso Giovannelli and Griffin D. Kent

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    CHAL’s main contribution is a multi-agent framework for revising graph-structured beliefs through defeasible debate, with experiments on belief trajectories, value systems, and participant diversity. This advances reasoning and agent organization, while its latent-space analysis is limited evidence about internal model representations and its structure does not establish compositional generalization.

    CHAL 的主要贡献是一个多智能体框架，通过可撤销辩论来修正图结构信念，并通过实验研究信念轨迹、价值体系和参与者多样性。这推动了推理和智能体组织的发展；其潜在空间分析只能为模型内部表征提供有限证据，而该框架的结构也未能证明组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Multi-agent debate has emerged as a promising approach for improving LLM reasoning on ground-truth tasks, yet current methodologies face certain structural limitations: debate tends to induce a martingale over belief trajectories, majority voting accounts for most observed gains, and LLMs exhibit confidence escalation rather than calibration across rounds. We argue that the genuine value of debate, and dialectic systems as a whole, lies not in ground-truth tasks but in defeasible domains, where every position can in principle be defeated by better reasoning. We present the Council of Hierarchical Agentic Language (CHAL), a multi-agent dialectic framework that treats defeasible argumentation as an engine for belief optimization. Each agent maintains a CHAL Belief Schema (CBS), a graph-structured belief representation with a Bayesian-inspired architecture, that facilitates belief revision through a gradient-informed dynamic mechanism by leveraging the strength of the belief's thesis as a differentiable objective. Meta-cognitive value systems spanning epistemology, logic, and ethics are elevated to configurable hyperparameters governing agent reasoning and adjudication outcomes. We provide a series of ablation experiments that demonstrate systematic and interpretable effects: the adjudicator's value system determines the debate's overall trajectories in latent belief space, council diversity refines beliefs for all participants, and the framework generalizes across broad fields. CHAL is, to our knowledge, the first framework to treat multi-agent debate as structured belief optimization over defeasible domains. Further, the auditable belief artifacts it produces establish the foundation for dedicated evaluation suites for defeasible argumentation, with broader implications for building AI systems whose reasoning and value commitments are transparent, aligned, and subject to human oversight.

    中文

    多智能体辩论已成为提升 LLM 在有标准答案任务上推理能力的一种有前景的方法，但当前方法存在一些结构性局限：辩论往往使信念轨迹形成鞅，大多数已观察到的增益来自多数投票，而且 LLM 在多轮辩论中表现出信心逐步上升，而非校准。我们认为，辩论以及整个辩证系统的真正价值不在于有标准答案的任务，而在于可撤销领域：在这些领域中，原则上任何立场都可能被更好的推理所推翻。我们提出层级智能体语言委员会（Council of Hierarchical Agentic Language，CHAL），这是一种多智能体辩证框架，将可撤销论证作为信念优化的引擎。每个智能体都维护一个 CHAL 信念模式（CBS），即采用受贝叶斯启发架构的图结构信念表征；该模式利用信念论题的强度作为可微目标，通过一种受梯度启发的动态机制促进信念修正。涵盖认识论、逻辑和伦理学的元认知价值体系被提升为可配置超参数，用以支配智能体推理和裁决结果。我们通过一系列消融实验展示了系统且可解释的影响：裁决者的价值体系决定辩论在潜在信念空间中的整体轨迹，委员会的多样性使所有参与者的信念得到完善，而且该框架能够跨多个领域泛化。据我们所知，CHAL 是首个将多智能体辩论视为可撤销领域中结构化信念优化的框架。此外，它所生成的可审计信念产物为专门评估可撤销论证的评测套件奠定了基础，并对构建推理和价值承诺透明、保持对齐且接受人类监督的 AI 系统具有更广泛的意义。

    Web Agents Should Adopt the Compile-and-Execute Paradigm

    Web 智能体应采用编译并执行范式

    Julien Piet, Annabella Chow, Yiwei Hou, Muxi Lyu, Sylvie Venuto, Jinhao Zhu, Raluca Ada Popa, David Wagner

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper argues for compiling web tasks into predefined programs and typed semantic APIs to constrain prompt injection and improve agent execution. This is a substantial agent architecture contribution, but its reasoning and compositional connections are incidental to task execution, with no claims about model reasoning mechanisms or compositional generalization.

    本文主张将 Web 任务编译为预定义程序，并采用类型化语义 API，以限制提示注入并改善智能体执行。这是对智能体架构的重要贡献，但其与推理和组合的关联只是任务执行中的附带因素；本文没有提出关于模型推理机制或组合泛化的主张。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    ReAct has become the default architecture across LLM agents, and many existing web agents follow this paradigm. We argue that it is the wrong default for web agents. Instead, web agents should default to compile-and-execute: commit to a task-specific program before observing runtime web content, then execute it. The reason is that web content mixes inputs from many parties. An e-commerce product page may combine a seller's listing, customer reviews, sponsored advertisements, and platform-generated recommendations. Under ReAct, all of this content flows into the model when deciding on the next action, creating a direct path for prompt injections to steer the agent's control flow. Compile-and-execute changes this boundary: untrusted data may influence values or branches inside a predefined execution graph, but it cannot redefine the user task or cause the model to synthesize new actions at runtime. We analyze WebArena, a popular web agent benchmark, and find that all tasks are compatible with compile-and-execute, while 81% can be completed with a purely static program, without any runtime LLM subroutine. We identify the main barrier to adopting compile-and-execute on the web: For it to work well, tools must map cleanly to semantic actions, with effects known before execution, so a compiler has enough information to emit a program. The web does not naturally expose that interface. Browser tools such as click, type, and scroll have page-dependent meanings. Planning at this layer is near-sighted: the agent can only see actions on the current page, and later actions appear only after it acts. Closing this gap requires typed interfaces that turn website interactions from clicks and keystrokes to task-level operations. This is an infrastructure problem, not a modeling problem. Web tasks do not need reactivity by default; they need typed, complete, auditable website APIs.

    中文

    ReAct 已成为各类 LLM 智能体的默认架构，许多现有 Web 智能体也遵循这一范式。我们认为，对 Web 智能体而言，这不是合适的默认选择。相反，Web 智能体应默认采用编译并执行范式：在观察运行时 Web 内容之前，先确定一个针对具体任务的程序，然后执行该程序。原因在于，Web 内容混合了来自多方的信息。电商商品页面可能同时包含卖家的商品信息、顾客评论、赞助广告和平台生成的推荐。在 ReAct 下，所有这些内容都会流入模型，影响其对下一步行动的决定，从而为提示注入直接操纵智能体控制流程打开通道。编译并执行改变了这一边界：不可信数据可以影响预定义执行图中的值或分支，但不能重新定义用户任务，也不能让模型在运行时合成新行动。我们分析了流行的 Web 智能体基准 WebArena，发现所有任务都兼容编译并执行范式，其中 81% 可以通过完全静态的程序完成，无需任何运行时 LLM 子程序。我们指出了在 Web 上采用编译并执行范式的主要障碍：要使其有效，工具必须能够清晰映射到语义操作，并且其效果须在执行前已知，这样编译器才有足够信息生成程序。Web 本身并未自然提供这种接口。点击、输入和滚动等浏览器工具的含义取决于页面。在这一层进行规划会导致视野短浅：智能体只能看到当前页面上的操作，后续操作只有在它采取行动后才会出现。要弥合这一差距，需要类型化接口，将网站交互从点击和按键操作转变为任务级操作。这是一个基础设施问题，而非建模问题。Web 任务默认并不需要响应式执行；它们需要类型化、完整且可审计的网站 API。

    Where and What to Reward? Understanding Generalization Between Verifiable and Open-Ended Domains in Reinforcement Learning

    奖励什么、在哪里奖励？理解强化学习中可验证领域与开放式领域之间的泛化

    Shangjian Yin, Yu Fu, Yue Dong, Zhouxing Shi

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The controlled study separates prompt domain from reward type and finds that RLHF on open-ended prompts improves conversation as well as reasoning and coding, while RLVR gains in conversation plateau. This is strong evidence about training and transfer of reasoning capabilities; the use of reinforcement learning is only an incidental systems connection.

    这项受控研究将提示领域与奖励类型分开考察，发现使用开放式提示进行 RLHF 能提升对话能力，也能提高推理和编码能力；相比之下，RLVR 在对话方面的收益会停滞。这是关于推理能力训练和迁移的有力证据；强化学习的使用只是与系统相关的附带因素。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is widely used to improve the reasoning capability of language models, since model-generated answers can be easily verified by a rule-based verifier. In contrast, reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) is mainly used to optimize open-ended conversation with a learned reward model, because such responses are not easy to verify. RLVR and RLHF are usually trained separately with their own domain data and training protocols. How gains transfer between these domains is unclear, partly because comparisons change both where a model is trained (the prompts) and what is rewarded (by a verifier or a reward model). We separate the two in a controlled study of RL on multiple base models that fixes the optimizer and the number of training prompts, and varies only the source domain of the prompts (math, multi-domain, chat, or mixtures) and the reward. We find that RLHF on open-ended prompts substantially improves conversational ability and also brings large gains in reasoning and coding, whereas RLVR improves reasoning but its gains in open-ended conversation plateau far below those of RLHF, suggesting that RL on open-ended prompts with a reward model can serve as an effective approach for generalizing across domains.

    中文

    带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）被广泛用于提升语言模型的推理能力，因为模型生成的答案可以通过基于规则的验证器轻松核验。相比之下，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）主要用于优化开放式对话，并使用学习得到的奖励模型，因为这类回答不易验证。RLVR 和 RLHF 通常分别使用各自领域的数据和训练流程进行训练。这些领域之间的增益如何迁移尚不清楚，部分原因在于已有比较同时改变了模型的训练领域（提示）和奖励方式（由验证器或奖励模型给出）。我们对多个基础模型开展受控的强化学习研究，将优化器和训练提示数量固定，只改变提示的来源领域（数学、多领域、聊天或混合领域）和奖励方式。我们发现，使用开放式提示进行 RLHF 能显著提升对话能力，也能大幅提高推理和编码能力；而 RLVR 虽然能提升推理能力，但其在开放式对话上的收益远低于 RLHF，且会趋于停滞。这表明，使用奖励模型在开放式提示上进行强化学习，可以成为实现跨领域泛化的一种有效方法。

    NGM: A Plug-and-Play Training-Free Memory Module for LLMs

    NGM：一种即插即用、无需训练的 LLM 记忆模块

    Yuwen Qu, Wenhui Dong, Camil Hamami, Ming Zhao, Chenyang Si, Caifeng Shan

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    NGM uses pretrained token embeddings as memory and adds cosine-gated retrieval without further training, with reported gains across language and vision-language benchmarks. Its memory design is a substantial systems contribution, but the abstract does not analyze internal representations or establish a reasoning mechanism; benchmark gains alone keep those connections low.

    NGM 将预训练 token 嵌入用作记忆，并以余弦门控加入检索功能，无需进一步训练；实验报告了其在语言和视觉语言基准上的增益。其记忆设计对系统作出了重要贡献，但摘要没有分析内部表征或确立推理机制；仅凭基准成绩提升，与这些方面的关联仍然有限。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Recent studies have introduced memory-augmented architectures that decouple knowledge storage from neural computation, enabling more direct access to stored representations. However, existing approaches often rely on learned memory embeddings or explicit memory and retrieval components, requiring additional training or increasing architectural complexity. To address these limitations, we propose N-gram Memory (NGM), a training-free, plug-and-play module that repurposes a backbone model's pretrained token embedding space as memory. NGM consists of a Causal N-Gram Encoder and a Cosine-Gated Memory Injector. The former constructs N-gram representations by directly aggregating pretrained token embeddings, while the latter uses cosine similarity with ReLU gating to adaptively control the amount of retrieved memory injected into contextual representations. Unlike conventional memory-augmented architectures, NGM requires neither additional embedding training nor a separately learned memory bank or external retrieval infrastructure. We evaluate NGM on ten benchmarks across six language-model backbones spanning two model families and multiple scales, including four Qwen3 models (0.6B, 1.7B, 4B, and 8B) and two Llama-3.2-Instruct models (1B and 3B). NGM consistently improves the ten-task average across all six backbones. Notably, it improves HumanEval by 4.26, HumanEval+ by 2.41, and GPQA-Diamond by 6.56 percentage points. Furthermore, NGM extends beyond text-only language models to vision-language models, with Qwen3-VL-2B achieving improvements across all five VLM benchmarks. Project page: https://pioneerqyw.github.io/ngm-project/

    中文

    近期研究提出了记忆增强架构，将知识存储与神经计算解耦，从而能够更直接地访问存储的表征。然而，现有方法往往依赖学习得到的记忆嵌入或显式记忆与检索组件，因此需要额外训练或增加架构复杂度。为解决这些局限，我们提出 N-gram Memory（NGM），这是一种无需训练、即插即用的模块，将骨干模型的预训练 token 嵌入空间重新用作记忆。NGM 由因果 N 元语法编码器（Causal N-Gram Encoder）和余弦门控记忆注入器（Cosine-Gated Memory Injector）组成。前者直接聚合预训练 token 嵌入来构造 N 元语法表征；后者则利用余弦相似度和 ReLU 门控，自适应地控制检索到的记忆注入上下文表征的数量。与传统记忆增强架构不同，NGM 既不需要额外训练嵌入，也不需要单独学习记忆库或外部检索基础设施。我们在十个基准上评估了 NGM，覆盖六个语言模型骨干，涉及两个模型系列和多个规模，其中包括四个 Qwen3 模型（0.6B、1.7B、4B 和 8B）以及两个 Llama-3.2-Instruct 模型（1B 和 3B）。NGM 在全部六个骨干模型上都持续提升十项任务的平均成绩。值得注意的是，它使 HumanEval 提高 4.26 个百分点、HumanEval+ 提高 2.41 个百分点、GPQA-Diamond 提高 6.56 个百分点。此外，NGM 还可扩展到纯文本语言模型之外的视觉语言模型；Qwen3-VL-2B 在全部五项 VLM 基准上均取得提升。项目页面：https://pioneerqyw.github.io/ngm-project/

    VerifyMAS：用于归因 LLM 多智能体系统故障的假设验证

    Hezhe Qiao, Hanghang Tong, Ee-Peng Lim, Bing Liu, Guansong Pang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The main contribution is a trajectory-level hypothesis verification method for locating failures in multi-agent LLM systems. It offers transferable insight into agent-system reliability and attribution, while coordination errors and multi-step trajectories are application context rather than advances in composition or reasoning mechanisms.

    本文的主要贡献是一种基于轨迹级假设验证的方法，用于定位 LLM 多智能体系统中的故障。它为智能体系统的可靠性和归因提供了可迁移的洞见；协同错误和多步骤轨迹只是应用背景，并非在组合或推理机制方面的进展。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language model-driven multi-agent systems (LLM-MAS) excel at complex tasks, yet unreliable agents remain a key bottleneck to system-level reliability. Automatic failure attribution is therefore critical, but existing approaches, such as direct prediction of agent-error pairs and agent-first failure attribution, rely on local logs of agents and miss global failures that only manifest over full interaction trajectories, such as cross-step inconsistencies and inter-agent coordination errors. Moreover, directly predicting failures induces a large combinatorial search space, hindering fine-grained attribution. To address these challenges, we propose VerifyMAS, a hypothesis verification framework for agent failure attribution. Instead of directly predicting faulty agents and error types, VerifyMAS formulates and verifies failure hypotheses against full trajectories. This verification-based approach decomposes attribution into trajectory-level error validation and fine-grained agent localization, providing an error-first attribution approach that captures global failure patterns while substantially reducing the search space. We further introduce a hypothesis-based data construction strategy grounded in a structured error taxonomy and fine-tune a specialized LLM verifier model for trajectory-level failure verification and agent attribution. Experiments on Aegis-Bench and Who&When show that VerifyMAS consistently improves diverse backbone models, including open-source Qwen and API-based GPT models, outperforming prior methods without sacrificing inference efficiency for long multi-agent trajectories.

    中文

    由大型语言模型驱动的多智能体系统（LLM-MAS）擅长复杂任务，但智能体的不可靠性仍是系统级可靠性的主要瓶颈。因此，自动故障归因至关重要。然而，现有方法（例如直接预测智能体与错误的对应关系，以及优先定位智能体的故障归因方法）依赖智能体的局部日志，因而会遗漏只有在完整交互轨迹中才显现的全局故障，例如跨步骤不一致和智能体间协同错误。此外，直接预测故障会产生庞大的组合搜索空间，妨碍细粒度归因。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 VerifyMAS，一种用于智能体故障归因的假设验证框架。VerifyMAS 不直接预测故障智能体和错误类型，而是针对完整轨迹提出并验证故障假设。这种基于验证的方法将归因分解为轨迹级错误验证和细粒度智能体定位，形成一种以错误为先的归因方法，既能捕捉全局故障模式，也能大幅缩小搜索空间。我们还提出了一种基于假设的数据构建策略，该策略以结构化错误分类体系为基础，并微调了一个专用 LLM 验证器模型，用于轨迹级故障验证和智能体归因。在 Aegis-Bench 和 Who&When 上的实验表明，VerifyMAS 能持续提升多种骨干模型的表现，包括开源 Qwen 和基于 API 的 GPT 模型；在不牺牲长多智能体轨迹推理效率的前提下，其性能优于先前方法。

    Yuxuan Lu, Ziyi Wang, Yingzhou Lu, Yisi Sang, Jiri Gesi, Xianfeng Tang, Yimeng Zhang, Zhenwei Dai, Hui Liu, Hanqing Lu, Chen Luo, Qi He, Benoit Dumoulin, Jing Huang, Dakuo Wang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    FireFly contributes a scalable pipeline for verified tool-call data and offline RL, using API exploration, backward task synthesis, and coherent tool workflows; training results show improved tool use. Its workflow structure gives partial relevance to composition, while data generation and agent training substantially address reasoning-related capability development and tool-agent systems, without directly studying reasoning mechanisms.

    FireFly 提出了一条可扩展的流水线，用于生成经过验证的工具调用数据并开展离线 RL；该流水线使用 API 探索、反向任务合成和连贯的工具工作流，训练结果表明工具使用能力有所提升。其工作流结构与组合有一定关联，而数据生成和智能体训练则显著涉及推理能力发展和工具智能体系统，但没有直接研究推理机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Training tool-calling agents requires large-scale trajectory data with verifiable labels, yet existing approaches either synthesize environments that diverge from real API behavior or generate tasks without ground-truth outcomes for verification. We present FireFly, a pipeline for generating verified tool-call data from real-world MCP servers. Our key insight is to invert the standard synthesis pipeline: rather than generating tasks and hoping they are solvable, we first let a strong LLM explore real APIs along graph-guided DAG structures, then synthesize tasks backward from observed outcomes, guaranteeing label correctness by construction. To handle the scale of real-world tool spaces (${\sim}$1,000 tools), we build a pairwise tool graph and sample sub-DAGs to focus exploration on semantically coherent workflows. To address environment drift in live APIs, we construct a retrieval-augmented simulator that caches all exploration results and replays them during training and evaluation, enabling fully offline and reproducible RL. Applying this pipeline yields 5,144 verified tasks spanning 240 servers and 993 tools. A 4B-parameter model trained with GRPO on FireFly matches Claude Sonnet 4.6 on our held-out test set and shows improvements on multiple tool-calling benchmarks including Tau2-Bench, MCPMark, and MCP-Atlas.

    ENGLISH

    LLM routing matters most in long-horizon applications such as coding agents, deep research systems, and computer-use agents, where a single user request triggers many model calls. Routing each call to the cheapest sufficient model can cut costs without sacrificing quality, yet existing router benchmarks evaluate routers only on one-shot prompts. They never expose the router-visible prefix at an intermediate agent step, never test whether a cheaper replacement preserves downstream task success, and often rely on online LLM judges at evaluation time. We introduce TwinRouterBench, a step-level routing benchmark with two tracks. The static track provides 970 router-visible prefixes from 520 instances across SWE-bench, BFCL, mtRAG, QMSum, and PinchBench, each paired with an execution-verified target tier estimated under a released downgrade-and-cascade protocol; scoring is deterministic arithmetic over tier labels, trajectory membership, and token costs, with no online evaluator-side LLM judge. The dynamic track supplies a harness that runs routers on the full 500-case SWE-bench Verified suite; in this paper we report a 100-case held-out evaluation disjoint from the static SWE supervision split. At each LLM call the router selects a concrete model from a locked pool, and success is measured by official task resolution and realized API spend. The two tracks support fast offline iteration followed by end-to-end validation under live agent execution. Code and data are available at https://github.com/CommonstackAI/TwinRouterBench.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Image-to-video models often generate videos that remain overly static, compared to text-to-video models. While prior approaches mitigate this issue by weakening or modifying the image-conditioning signal, they often require additional training or sacrifice fidelity to the reference image. In this work, we identify reference-frame dominance as a key mechanism behind motion suppression. We observe that non-reference frames in I2V models allocate excessive self-attention to reference-frame key tokens, causing reference information to be over-propagated across time and suppressing inter-frame dynamics. Based on this finding, we propose DyMoS (Dynamic Motion Slider), a training-free and model-agnostic method that rebalances the attention pathway from generated frames to the reference frame during initial denoising steps. DyMoS leaves both the input image and model weights unchanged and introduces a single scalar parameter for continuous control over motion strength. Experiments across multiple state-of-the-art I2V backbones demonstrate that DyMoS consistently improves motion dynamics while maintaining visual quality and fidelity to the reference image.

    Communication protocol design is a central challenge in large language model-based multi-agent systems. Existing single-channel approaches face an inherent communication trilemma: text-based methods are interpretable but verbose, while latent-space methods are efficient but opaque and limited to unidirectional workflows. Inspired by multi-channel communication theory, we propose HyLaT, a hybrid latent-text communication protocol that transmits elaborate cognitive signals through a latent channel for efficiency, while expressing concise critical signals in natural language to preserve interpretability and precision. We introduce a two-stage training framework combining single-agent hybrid generation learning and multi-agent interactive co-training, enabling agents to generate and interpret hybrid messages across multiple rounds of interaction.     Wearable devices provide continuous access to physiological signals such as ECG and PPG, offering a path to answering users' questions about their own physiological state and to early detection of cardiac and physiological abnormalities. Yet existing mobile health (mHealth) systems are largely limited to task-specific prediction pipelines or reactive question answering over static summaries. They lack the temporal reasoning, persistent physiological context, and proactive monitoring required for long-term signal streams. To advance this setting, we introduce VitalBench, a longitudinal physiological monitoring benchmark comprising 1,862 QA pairs for reactive question answering and 90.2 hours of continuous ECG/PPG recordings for proactive monitoring, covering cardiac, physical activity, and stress-related tasks. VitalAgent is built on a longitudinal physiological memory and a tool-augmented reasoning interface that enables dynamic computation over raw signals.     Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in conversational settings where user phrasing ranges from polite to casual to toxic, yet less is known about whether such lexical variation in otherwise semantically equivalent prompts can degrade factual reliability. We study how lexical and tone-based prompt perturbations affect the factual reliability of LLMs. Using controlled prompt variations spanning polite, random, and increasingly toxic levels, we evaluate seven LLMs on ARC-Easy, GSM8K, and MMLU. We find that lexical perturbations reduce factual accuracy and increase predictive uncertainty in most models. Interestingly, increasing toxicity results in decreasing accuracy. To examine whether these answer inconsistencies correspond to internal changes, we conduct attribution-graph analyses of model activations and influences. We find that perturbations amplify perturbation-sensitive variant nodes relative to core reasoning nodes. We also observed a monotonic trend with increasing toxicity score and increasing activation and influence in Variant nodes. These findings position prompt wording and tone as a critical dimension of LLM reliability and provide behavioral and mechanistic evidence that surface-level lexical variation can alter factual outputs and internal computation.

    The paper introduces Bank of Values, showing that token-specific, context-free value vectors in deeper transformer layers can improve performance while reducing compute and memory costs.     The success of the transformer architecture is in large part due to its use of attention layers. An attention layer follows the standard neural network paradigm: it takes the residual stream as input and thereby produces context-dependent query, key, and value vectors. However, we find that model performance meaningfully improves when deeper layers learn only a context-free value vector to preserve the original token information, without drawing on any context from the residual stream. When the model has access to this context-free value vector, adding back the context-dependent component provides little additional benefit for aggregate benchmark performance. Such context-free value vectors can be stored as sparse model parameters, eliminating the need to recompute or persistently cache these values. Through systematic ablations on the key design choices for such context-free value vectors, we propose Bank of Values (BoV), a new way of computing value vectors in attention by learning a lookup table of token-specific value vectors for each of the last third of layers.     ENGLISH

    Transformers have become the dominant architecture for large language models, largely due to the scalability and flexibility of attention, feed-forward layers, residual connections, and normalization. This paper introduces dynamic short convolutions as an additional neural network primitive for improving Transformers. Unlike static short convolutions, dynamic convolutions use input-dependent filters, which preserves the locality bias of convolution while increasing expressivity. Motivating experiments show that applying dynamic short convolutions to key, query, and value representations improves performance on challenging associative recall tasks compared with static convolutional variants. Across language-modeling experiments ranging from 150M to 2B parameters, dynamic convolutions consistently outperform standard Transformers and Transformers augmented with static short convolutions. Fitting scaling laws indicates a 1.33$\times$ compute advantage over compute-matched Transformers when dynamic convolutions are applied to the key, query, and value vectors, and a 1.60$\times$ advantage when adding dynamic convolutions after every linear layer. Dynamic convolutions also offer improvements on linear RNNs (Mamba-2/Gated DeltaNet) and mixture-of-experts architectures. We make these gains practical with custom Triton kernels that enable efficient training with a manageable end-to-end slowdown. These results suggest that dynamic short convolutions are a scalable, hardware-efficient, and expressive primitive for advancing Transformer-based language models.

    The paper finds that different backdoors with the same objective produce similar activation changes, then uses a known dummy backdoor to reduce unknown ones.
