    ENGLISH

    Backdoor attacks pose a serious threat to the safety and reliability of Large Language Models (LLMs), as they cause models to behave normally on clean inputs while producing attacker-specified responses when hidden triggers are present. Removing such unknown backdoors is particularly challenging when the defender does not know the attack types or the internal mechanisms formed during backdoor training. In this work, we propose a simple but effective backdoor removal method based on internal mechanisms shared across different backdoors. First, we show that different backdoors with the same task (attack objective) induce similar trigger-activated changes in their internal activations. Motivated by this observation, our proposed method intentionally embeds a backdoor with a known trigger dummy backdoor and then removes it through further fine-tuning on dummy-triggered inputs paired with clean responses. Because the dummy and unknown backdoors exhibit similar activation changes, this removal process can also reduce the effect of the unknown backdoor. We evaluate our method on three backdoor attack types across multiple model families. Experimental results show that our method substantially reduces the attack success rate of the unknown backdoor while preserving model utility, outperforming representative existing defense methods in both backdoor removal effectiveness and utility preservation. These findings suggest that a defender-controllable backdoor can serve as a helpful proxy for mitigating unknown backdoors in generative LLMs. Our source code is available at https://github.com/kaz-iwahana/dummy_backdoor_defense.

    交互式 LLM 智能体日益频繁地在不同任务中与用户协作，但记住先前的纠正并不意味着智能体未来会改变行为。在一项基于匿名真实世界智能体交互构建的诊断评测中，使用 Mem0 的智能体仍有 57.5% 的适用偏好检查未通过。我们提出 TellOnce，这是一种即插即用的个性化层，可将对话中的纠正转化为持久、适用范围明确且可修订的行为规则，而无需更新底层智能体模型。TellOnce 会识别哪些要求应当持续生效、判断它们何时适用、协调后续反馈与现有规则，并在能够可靠验证时准备可复用的检查。我们通过冻结学得的状态，并在后续任务中进行测试（不再接受额外用户纠正），来评估学得的纠正能否改善未来行为。在 ClawArena 和 MemoryArena 上对三个模型的评估中，TellOnce 在全部六种设置下都取得了最低的偏好违反率；相较于 PGMem，它在 ClawArena 上将违规率降低了 19.3 至 42.3 个百分点，在 MemoryArena 上降低了 3.0 至 22.9 个百分点，同时总体上保持了相当的任务表现。在 SWE-Together 上，TellOnce 还能从先前任务收到的反馈中学习，进一步提升新编码任务的质量。实验代码见 https://github.com/YujunZhou/TellOnce_exp，可部署的 skill 见 https://github.com/YujunZhou/tellonce。

    Gefen: Optimized Stochastic Optimizer

    Gefen：优化的随机优化器

    Nadav Benedek, Tomer Koren, Ohad Fried

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Gefen reduces optimizer memory through automatic block sharing and learned moment quantization, with a Hessian-based explanation for when shared estimates work and empirical training results. This is a substantial training-systems contribution; its optimization theory is not focused on model reasoning or internal representations.

    Gefen 通过自动块共享和学习式动量量化来降低优化器内存，并以 Hessian 为基础解释共享估计何时有效，同时提供了训练实验结果。这是一项重要的训练系统贡献；其优化理论并不侧重于模型推理或内部表征。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    AdamW is a default optimizer for deep learning, but its moment states add two parameter-sized buffers to training memory, increasing the cost of large-scale pretraining. We propose Gefen, a memory-efficient optimizer that automatically shares second-moment estimates across parameter blocks and quantizes the first moment using a learned codebook. Gefen reduces AdamW's optimizer memory footprint by up to 8x while maintaining performance, saving 6.5 GiB per billion parameters. Prior work shares second moments across parameters grouped along the Hessian's block-diagonal structure, but relies on hand-specified architectural rules and leaves unexplained why such grouping works. We prove that large mixed Hessian entries constrain the ratio of squared gradients toward one, explaining why shared second moments are accurate when the squared gradients they pool are similar. The Hessian need not be computed: its block structure is inherited by squared gradients, allowing blocks to be found directly. Gefen therefore infers block structure from initial squared gradients, requiring no architecture-specific metadata or user-tuned hyperparameters beyond AdamW defaults. Gefen learns an exact histogram-based dynamic-programming quantization codebook and reuses the blocks for first-moment scaling. Across diverse pretraining experiments, Gefen achieves the lowest peak optimizer memory among compared methods that maintain AdamW-level performance. In single-machine and distributed training, the reduced footprint enables larger microbatches and substantially improves throughput over AdamW, making Gefen a drop-in replacement that can train larger models or use larger global batch sizes. We provide the complete Python implementation, including fused CUDA kernels at https://github.com/ndvbd/Gefen

    中文

    AdamW 是深度学习的默认优化器，但其动量状态会在训练内存中额外占用两个与参数量相当的缓冲区，从而增加大规模预训练的成本。我们提出 Gefen，这是一种内存高效的优化器，它会自动在参数块之间共享二阶矩估计，并使用学习得到的码本对一阶矩进行量化。Gefen 在保持性能的同时，将 AdamW 的优化器内存占用最多降低 8 倍，每十亿个参数节省 6.5 GiB。先前工作根据 Hessian 的块对角结构对参数分组并共享二阶矩，但依赖手工指定的架构规则，也未解释这种分组为何有效。我们证明，较大的 Hessian 混合项会将平方梯度之比约束在接近 1 的范围内；这解释了为什么当汇总的平方梯度彼此相似时，共享二阶矩是准确的。无需计算 Hessian：其块结构会继承到平方梯度中，因此可以直接找到这些块。由此，Gefen 根据初始平方梯度推断块结构，除了 AdamW 默认设置外，不需要架构专属元数据或用户调节超参数。Gefen 会学习基于直方图和动态规划的精确量化码本，并将这些块重用于一阶矩缩放。在各种预训练实验中，在保持 AdamW 级别性能的对比方法中，Gefen 的优化器峰值内存最低。在单机和分布式训练中，降低后的内存占用支持更大的微批次，并显著提升相较于 AdamW 的吞吐量，因此 Gefen 可作为即插即用替代方案，用于训练更大的模型或采用更大的全局批次。完整 Python 实现（包括融合 CUDA 内核）见 https://github.com/ndvbd/Gefen。

    Samuel Barbeau, Simon Roy, Giovanni Beltrame, Christian Desrosiers, Nicolas Thome

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    LAGO jointly predicts action-conditioned latent dynamics and language-grounded subgoals to support long-horizon planning, with empirical gains across navigation and manipulation. Its world-model planning architecture advances agent computation, while subgoal sequencing and planning are relevant but secondary to the systems contribution; latent representations alone do not establish a mechanistic interpretability contribution.

    LAGO 联合预测动作条件下的潜在动力学和以语言为基础的子目标，以支持长时程规划，并在导航和操作任务中取得了实证提升。其世界模型规划架构推动了智能体计算的发展，而子目标序列生成和规划虽相关，但相较于系统贡献居于次要位置；仅有潜在表征并不能证明其对机制可解释性有所贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) enable agents to plan in latent space by imagining the outcomes of candidate actions, yet task specification remains a bottleneck. Visual targets provide precise local gradients but poor distant guidance, while language is flexible yet limited by noisy cross-modal alignment or dependence on distinct large generative models. We introduce LAGO (Latent Goal Prediction from Language), a hierarchical world model in which a single predictor both forecasts action-conditioned dynamics and grounds language instructions as sequences of intermediate latent subgoals, training both modes with a single regression objective over a shared latent space. At each planning step, LAGO predicts a sequence of latent subgoals from a language instruction and optimizes an action sequence using a soft-minimum alignment cost that rewards subgoal proximity without enforcing a rigid path. Subgoals are repredicted as the agent's state evolves, turning a single long-horizon instruction into a sequence of locally tractable objectives. Across environments spanning navigation and manipulation, LAGO outperforms flat and hierarchical image-goal planners, with the largest gains on long-horizon navigation with curved, hazard-constrained paths, where it more than doubles the success rate of a goal-conditioned behavior cloning policy trained on the same demonstrations. Grounding language in the world model's own latent space also outperforms vision-language reward models, including one that plans with ground-truth dynamics.

    中文

    联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）使智能体能够通过想象候选动作的结果，在潜在空间中进行规划；然而，任务指定仍然是一个瓶颈。视觉目标能提供精确的局部梯度，却难以提供远距离指引；语言虽然灵活，却受限于嘈杂的跨模态对齐，或对独立大型生成模型的依赖。我们提出 LAGO（Latent Goal Prediction from Language，基于语言的潜在目标预测），这是一种分层世界模型，其中单个预测器既预测动作条件下的动力学，也将语言指令落地为一系列中间潜在子目标，并在共享潜在空间上用单一回归目标训练这两种模式。在每个规划步骤中，LAGO 根据语言指令预测一系列潜在子目标，并使用软最小值对齐代价优化动作序列；该代价奖励接近子目标，但不强制规定僵硬的路径。随着智能体状态演变，子目标会被重新预测，从而将单条长时程指令转化为一系列局部上易于处理的目标。在涵盖导航和操作的各种环境中，LAGO 的表现优于扁平式和分层式图像目标规划器；在具有弯曲且受危险约束路径的长时程导航任务中，提升幅度最大，其成功率是使用相同演示训练的目标条件行为克隆策略的两倍以上。将语言落地到世界模型自身的潜在空间，也优于视觉语言奖励模型，包括一个使用真实动力学进行规划的模型。

    迈向根记忆：个性化 LLM 隐式逻辑记忆检索的基准评测与增强

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces a benchmark and a memory framework that distills reusable logic from user histories and routes it alongside semantic retrieval, improving personalized logical memory retrieval. This substantially advances LLM memory systems; the reusable logic and LLM reasoning used to construct it are relevant but secondary to the systems contribution.

    本文提出了一个基准和一种记忆框架，从用户历史中提炼可复用逻辑，并将其与语义检索一同路由，从而改善个性化逻辑记忆检索。这显著推动了 LLM 记忆系统的发展；可复用逻辑及用于构建它的 LLM 推理虽相关，但相较于系统贡献居于次要位置。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Memory systems are essential for personalized Large Language Models (LLMs). However, retrieval within these systems primarily relies on semantic similarity, potentially missing logically critical memories with limited semantic overlap. We refer to this failure as semantic deflection, which remains insufficiently evaluated by existing benchmarks. To address this gap, we construct IMLogic, a benchmark for implicit logical memory retrieval in long dialogues. Each question is designed around the divergence between semantic and logical relevance, with diagnostic response options that probe semantic deflection, hallucination, and lack of personalization. To help systems utilize associations that are difficult to discover through semantic matching, we introduce root memory, a structured representation that distills reusable, response-guiding logic from user histories through LLM reasoning and grounds it in supporting evidence. We further develop RootMem, a plug-and-play framework that constructs and routes root memories to complement semantic retrieval. Extensive experiments reveal persistent challenges across retrieval methods and memory systems, including substantial preference-driven errors even under full-memory access. RootMem consistently improves performance, demonstrating the potential of structured personalized logic while leaving considerable challenges unresolved. Our benchmark and code are available at https://github.com/ThisIsCosine/IMLogic.

    中文

    记忆系统对于个性化大型语言模型（LLM）至关重要。然而，这些系统中的检索主要依赖语义相似性，可能会遗漏语义重叠有限但逻辑上至关重要的记忆。我们将这种失效称为语义偏移，而现有基准对它的评估仍不充分。为弥补这一空缺，我们构建了 IMLogic，这是一个针对长对话中隐式逻辑记忆检索的基准。每个问题都围绕语义相关性与逻辑相关性之间的差异设计，并配有诊断性回答选项，用于探查语义偏移、幻觉和个性化不足。为了帮助系统利用那些难以通过语义匹配发现的关联，我们引入根记忆：一种结构化表示，通过 LLM 推理从用户历史中提炼可复用、能够引导回答的逻辑，并以支持性证据为其提供依据。我们进一步开发了 RootMem，这是一种即插即用的框架，可构建并路由根记忆，以补充语义检索。大量实验揭示了各种检索方法和记忆系统面临的持续挑战，包括即使在可访问完整记忆时仍存在大量由偏好驱动的错误。RootMem 持续提升性能，展现了结构化个性化逻辑的潜力，同时也表明仍有相当多的问题有待解决。我们的基准和代码见 https://github.com/ThisIsCosine/IMLogic。

    Diagnosing and Mitigating Context Rot in Long-horizon Search

    诊断并缓解长时程搜索中的上下文衰退

    Shijie Xia, Yikun Wang, Zhen Huang, Pengfei Liu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper diagnoses premature giving-up and uncertain answers during long-horizon search, then evaluates context-management and behavior-aware sampling mitigations. This substantially informs reasoning performance and test-time exploration, but it offers no direct account of internal mechanisms; its system-design contribution is limited to these search strategies.

    本文诊断了长时程搜索期间过早放弃和给出不确定答案的问题，并评估了上下文管理与感知行为的采样缓解方法。这项工作对推理性能和测试时探索有重要启示，但没有直接说明内部机制；其系统设计贡献仅限于这些搜索策略。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Extensive context has become the norm as Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in long-horizon search tasks. The concern that increasing context length degrades model capabilities, known as context rot, has become a widely recognized issue for these applications. However, in deep search scenarios, it remains unclear how models actually fail under extensive context, and to what extent existing methods can mitigate such failures. Through a systematic study of four flagship models across three benchmarks, we identify a previously overlooked phenomenon: under extensive context, models give up or provide uncertain incorrect answers long before exhausting the context window. We refer to these two failure modes as inconclusive search failures. We show that these are common failure modes even for easy and moderately difficult queries, suggesting premature termination on queries that the model is capable of solving. Based on these findings, we revisit methods to mitigate context rot, including context management and parallel sampling. For context management, we analyze seven methods across three categories and show that they are inherently test-time scaling strategies that redirect models from inconclusive search failures toward further exploration by decreasing the peak context length. We also provide model-dependent principles for method selection. For parallel sampling, we develop a behavior-aware filtering strategy and observe a performance gain of 2.6% to 4.9% across three aggregation methods.

    中文

    随着大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地用于长时程搜索任务，使用大量上下文已成为常态。随着上下文长度增加，模型能力会下降；这一问题称为上下文衰退，如今已被广泛认为是此类应用面临的问题。然而，在深度搜索场景中，模型在大量上下文下究竟如何失效，以及现有方法在多大程度上能够缓解这些失效，仍不清楚。通过对四种旗舰模型在三个基准上进行系统研究，我们发现了一种此前被忽视的现象：在上下文很长时，模型远未用尽上下文窗口就会放弃作答，或给出不确定的错误答案。我们将这两种失效模式称为无结论搜索失败。我们表明，即便对于简单和中等难度的查询，这些失效模式也很常见，说明模型会对本来有能力解决的查询过早终止搜索。基于这些发现，我们重新审视了缓解上下文衰退的方法，包括上下文管理和并行采样。对于上下文管理，我们分析了三个类别中的七种方法，并表明它们本质上都是测试时扩展策略：通过降低峰值上下文长度，将模型从无结论搜索失败引导至进一步探索。我们还提出了依赖模型的选法原则。对于并行采样，我们开发了一种感知行为的筛选策略，并观察到在三种聚合方法下，性能提升了 2.6% 至 4.9%。

    Maxime Heuillet, Sharadind Peddiraju

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    CIPHER evaluates a plan-level test-time scaling framework that generates, selects, executes, and aggregates candidate analyses for data science agents. Its agent architecture and inference-budget allocation are a substantial systems contribution; planning is relevant to reasoning, but the abstract emphasizes workload performance rather than reasoning mechanisms.

    CIPHER 评估了一种计划层面的测试时扩展框架，该框架为数据科学智能体生成、选择、执行并汇总候选分析。其智能体架构和推理预算分配构成了重要的系统贡献；规划与推理相关，但摘要强调的是工作负载表现，而非推理机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Enterprise data science and analytics spans closed-ended information extraction with verifiable answers and open-ended insight discovery. Agents are evaluated on one or the other, so there is no evidence on whether one system can serve both. We present \texttt{CIPHER}, a data science agent built on a Decoupled Exploration--Selection (DES) framework that applies test-time scaling at the plan level: generating $N$ candidate analysis plans, selecting $M{<}N$ for parallel execution, and aggregating the results. We evaluate $48$ distinct design choices for the DES framework (spanning generation, selection, budget and aggregator capacity) jointly on $357$ tasks from Infi-DA-Bench (closed-ended) and InsightBench (open-ended), on a proprietary and an open-weights base model. A single zero-tuning configuration is competitive against purpose-built specialist baselines under matched models, within $1.2$pp of \texttt{DataWise} and $1.3$pp of \texttt{Agent-Poirot}. The joint sweep exposes that generation and aggregation are the most influential performance levers, while random selection --- the only strategy with zero overhead --- matches its tuned alternatives. These results offer new insights on the design of test-time scaling strategies, and on how a fixed inference budget is best allocated across them, for agents deployed on enterprise analytics workloads.

    中文

    企业数据科学与分析涵盖两类任务：答案可验证的封闭式信息提取，以及开放式洞见发现。智能体通常只针对其中一类进行评估，因此尚无证据表明同一个系统能否胜任两者。我们提出 \texttt{CIPHER}，一种基于解耦式探索—选择（DES）框架的数据科学智能体，在计划层面进行测试时扩展：生成 $N$ 个候选分析计划，选出 $M{<}N$ 个并行执行，再对结果进行汇总。我们联合评估了 DES 框架的 $48$ 种不同设计选择（涵盖生成、选择、预算和聚合器容量），在 Infi-DA-Bench（封闭式）和 InsightBench（开放式）的 $357$ 项任务上，分别使用专有基础模型和开放权重基础模型进行测试。在模型匹配的条件下，单一的零调优配置与专门构建的基线相比具有竞争力，得分分别仅比 \texttt{DataWise} 低 $1.2$ 个百分点、比 \texttt{Agent-Poirot} 低 $1.3$ 个百分点。联合扫描表明，生成和聚合是影响性能最大的因素，而随机选择——唯一零开销的策略——与经过调优的替代策略表现相当。这些结果为测试时扩展策略的设计，以及如何在这些策略间分配固定推理预算以服务企业分析工作负载的智能体，提供了新的见解。

    SALT: Salience-Aware Lexical Trie for Long-Context Compression

    SALT：用于长上下文压缩的显著性感知词法 Trie

    Oteo Mamo, Hyunjin Yi, Joydhriti Choudhury, Shangqian Gao, Weikuan Yu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    SALT introduces a trie-based, persistent prompt-compression method that allocates context across recurring themes to reduce inference computation and memory costs. Its structured retrieval has a partial connection to compositional organization, while its main contribution directly advances model memory and inference systems; it does not study reasoning mechanisms or internal representations.

    SALT 提出了一种基于 Trie 且可持续保留的提示压缩方法，通过在反复出现的主题间分配上下文来降低推理计算和内存成本。其结构化检索与组合式组织有一定联系，而主要贡献直接推动了模型记忆和推理系统的发展；它不研究推理机制或内部表征。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    As large language models (LLMs) process increasingly longer prompts, computation and KV-cache memory costs have emerged as major bottlenecks in inference systems. Existing input-level prompt compression methods address this, but rank each sentence by a scalar relevance score, treating the document as an unstructured pool of words and sentences. Under tight budgets, this causes theme collapse, where the dominant theme(s) of a document consumes the budget, discarding less-frequent yet task-relevant themes. Preserving thematic coverage instead requires allocating the budget across recurring themes rather than scoring sentences in isolation. To this end, we propose SALT, a model-agnostic extractive framework that organizes per-sentence keywords into a trie ordered by sentence frequency (SF), a lightweight, reusable proxy for document thematic structure. This trie-based organization smooths memory allocation and prevents dominant themes from monopolizing the budget. Multi-anchor retrieval activates trie nodes labeled by query keywords at any depth, and the trie persists across dialogue turns, supporting multi-turn use without re-encoding the document. By preserving document themes, SALT reduces the prefill computation and memory cost of long-context prompts while remaining composable with KV-cache methods that target decoding-time latency and memory.

    中文

    随着大型语言模型（LLM）处理的提示越来越长，计算量和 KV-cache 内存成本已成为推理系统的主要瓶颈。现有的输入级提示压缩方法虽能解决这一问题，却会用一个标量相关性分数为句子排序，把文档视为无结构的词语和句子集合。在预算紧张时，这会导致主题坍缩：文档中的主导主题占用预算，较少出现但与任务相关的主题则被丢弃。要保留主题覆盖度，就需要将预算分配给反复出现的主题，而不是孤立地为句子打分。为此，我们提出 SALT，这是一种与模型无关的抽取式框架，它将每个句子的关键词组织成按句子频率（SF）排序的 Trie；SF 是文档主题结构的一种轻量、可复用的代理指标。这种基于 Trie 的组织方式使内存分配更加平衡，并防止主导主题独占预算。多锚点检索会激活任意深度上带有查询关键词标签的 Trie 节点，而且 Trie 会在多轮对话中持续保留，无需重新编码文档即可支持多轮使用。通过保留文档主题，SALT 降低了长上下文提示的预填充计算和内存成本，同时还能与针对解码时延迟和内存的 KV-cache 方法组合使用。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    ArbiGraph contributes a controllable benchmark for testing whether tool-assisted agents compose and manage context across dependent task graphs, with exact verification and evidence that performance degrades as dependencies grow. This strongly advances compositional evaluation; reasoning and agent context management are substantive but secondary, while the abstract does not study internal representations.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    We introduce ARBIGRAPH, a benchmark generator for evaluating whether tool-assisted language agents can retain, update, compose, and discard task-relevant context across extended reasoning workflows. ARBIGRAPH represents each task as a natural-language problem with an executable Python solver, and composes tasks through typed intermediate states, instantiated here as scalar and list values. This design enables controllable task graphs whose length, dependency structure, distractor count, and value type can be varied while preserving exact automatic verification. We instantiate ARBIGRAPH with math, GSM-style word-problems, and Python-tracing task categories, and evaluate a Qwen3.5-27B tool-assisted agent across four topologies. The results show high accuracy on isolated tasks but substantial degradation on more complex dependent tasks: accuracy drops by up to 33.3% on branching chains of dependent math tasks. This shows that ARBIGRAPH exposes failures that are not visible from single-task evaluation alone. Our code, generated datasets, and evaluation results are available at https://github.com/pavelgolikov/ArbiGraph.git

    Yang Zhou, Zixuan Huang, Sunzhu Li, Zhuo Yang, Chen Zhang, Shunian Chen, Caijun Yan, Jianyao Xu, Shunyu Liu, Weijie Fu, Peiliang Li, Xiaozhi Chen, Yuxiang Cai

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    SpatialCLI trains VLMs to use specialist spatial tools and then internalize their perceptual capabilities, with a compositional perception benchmark and strong results. Its staged tool-use training substantially advances compositional perception and reasoning, while internalization suggests a limited mechanism-level contribution and the agent system design is secondary.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used in embodied agents to interpret visual inputs, reason about spatial relationships, and make task-level decisions based on that reasoning. However, a fundamental capability mismatch remains: general VLMs can reason about the overall task but often miss the visual details that determine success, while specialist vision models can capture those details but cannot translate them into task-level decisions. In this work, we propose SpatialCLI, a framework that teaches VLMs to reason with spatial tools and progressively internalize the specialist perceptual capabilities they provide. SpatialCLI proceeds in three stages: (1) Call exposes specialist vision models as spatial tools to augment the VLM's perception; (2) Learn uses Cold-Start SFT and agentic RL to improve tool use; and (3) Internalize verbalizes successful tool-use trajectories to internalize specialist perceptual capabilities. We further introduce SpatialCLI-Bench, a 516-example benchmark for compositional perception across localization, segmentation, depth, and pose. On MindCube, SpatialCLI raises Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct from 29.3% to 84.6% with tools, surpassing GPT-5.6 Sol with tools (72.1%), while retaining 73.8% without tools after internalization.

    视觉语言模型（VLM）越来越多地用于具身智能体，以解读视觉输入、推理空间关系，并根据推理结果做出任务级决策。然而，能力上的根本错配依然存在：通用 VLM 能够推理整体任务，却常常忽略决定成败的视觉细节；专用视觉模型能捕捉这些细节，却无法将其转化为任务级决策。在这项工作中，我们提出 SpatialCLI，这一框架教会 VLM 使用空间工具进行推理，并逐步内化这些工具提供的专用感知能力。SpatialCLI 分三个阶段进行：（1）调用：将专用视觉模型作为空间工具开放，以增强 VLM 的感知能力；（2）学习：使用冷启动 SFT 和智能体 RL 改进工具使用；（3）内化：将成功的工具使用轨迹转化为文字表述，使专用感知能力内化。此外，我们还推出 SpatialCLI-Bench，这是一个包含 516 个样例、涵盖定位、分割、深度和姿态的组合感知基准。在 MindCube 上，借助工具时，SpatialCLI 将 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 的得分从 29.3% 提升至 84.6%，超过借助工具时得分为 72.1% 的 GPT-5.6 Sol；完成内化后，即使不使用工具，仍能保持 73.8% 的得分。

    A False Average: Pooled CoT-Monitor Accuracy Conceals a Reasoning-Dependent Fragility

    一个虚假的平均值：汇总 CoT 监控准确率掩盖了依赖推理的脆弱性

    Shikhar Shiromani, Leo Richter, Noah Siegel

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper shows that pooled chain-of-thought monitor accuracy hides severe fragility when agent reasoning is rewritten, and recommends measuring performance on reasoning-dependent cases. This is a strong contribution to reasoning evaluation and monitoring, while the activation probe is incidental and does not establish a mechanistic account of model representations.

    本文表明，汇总的链式思维监控准确率掩盖了严重的脆弱性：一旦改写智能体推理，监控器的表现就会大幅下降；并建议在依赖推理的案例上衡量性能。这是对推理评估和监控的重要贡献，而激活探针只是附带分析，并未建立对模型表征机制的解释。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Chain-of-thought (CoT) monitors are reported by their aggregate accuracy on a pool of reward hacks. We show that this number is a false average. On Terminal Wrench, about 77% of hacks are given away by the actions alone, and the monitor's pooled accuracy is dominated by them; on the remaining 23%, which an action-only monitor misses, the same monitor is fragile. We expose the fragility with a controlled attack: we rewrite only the agent's reasoning to read as good-faith engineering, leaving every command and output byte-identical. One gradient-free rewrite drops a held-out monitor's catch rate on that subset from about 95% to between 4 and 11%, while the pooled rate falls only about 25 points, near what the subset's share of the pool times its collapse predicts. The rewrite stays truthful about what happened and lies only about intent, so the trace-only monitors we test recover little, even when warned about the attack; of our defenses, only information from outside the trace helps much. The attack transfers across monitor and agent families, and the dataset's own hack labels show the same gradient with no monitor in the definition. Live agents told to hack on 27 tasks, with no monitor feedback, produce hollow hacks, but a monitor calibrated on each model's own honest solves catches nearly all of them. Applying the same rewrite to these live hacks keeps all 111 action-visible ones caught and lowers catch on the 16 whose actions score below 0.5 only from 16 to 13: the effect lands where the false average predicts, but the collapse stays a controlled result. A linear probe on a surrogate monitor's activations out-reads its verdict on the obfuscated hacks (AUC up to 0.98), but a behavioral control shows this edge does not, by itself, mean the monitor knows more than it says. Monitor accuracy should be reported on the reasoning-dependent subset, where the defense is load-bearing.

    中文

    链式思维（CoT）监控器的表现通常用其在一组奖励作弊案例上的汇总准确率来报告。我们表明，这个数字是一个虚假的平均值。在 Terminal Wrench 上，仅凭动作就能识破约 77% 的作弊行为，因此监控器的汇总准确率由这些案例主导；而对于剩余 23% 的案例，纯动作监控器无法识破，同一个监控器则很脆弱。我们通过一项受控攻击揭示了这种脆弱性：只改写智能体的推理，使其读起来像是善意的工程实践，同时让每条命令和每个输出字节都完全相同。一次无需梯度的改写，就将一个留出监控器在该子集上的检出率从约 95% 降至 4% 至 11%；而汇总检出率仅下降约 25 个百分点，接近于该子集占总体的比例乘以其检出率崩塌所预测的降幅。改写没有歪曲实际发生的事情，只在意图上撒谎，因此我们测试的纯轨迹监控器即使收到攻击预警，也几乎无法挽回检出率；在我们测试的防御中，只有轨迹之外的信息能提供明显帮助。这种攻击可迁移到不同监控器和智能体系列，而数据集自身的作弊标签也呈现出同样的梯度，且标签定义中不包含任何监控器。被要求在 27 项任务上作弊、且未获得监控反馈的实际智能体会产生空洞的作弊行为；但在每个模型自身的诚实解答上校准的监控器几乎都能识破这些行为。将相同改写应用于这些实际作弊行为后，所有 111 个动作可见的案例仍被检出；对于动作评分低于 0.5 的 16 个案例，检出数量仅从 16 个降至 13 个：这种影响落在虚假平均值所预测的位置，但检出率崩塌仍只是受控实验的结果。在线性探针对替代监控器激活的分析中，它对经过混淆的作弊案例的判读优于该监控器的判定（AUC 最高达 0.98）；但一项行为控制实验表明，这一优势本身并不意味着监控器知道得比它表达出来的更多。监控准确率应在依赖推理的子集上报告，因为防御是否有效取决于在这些案例上的表现。

    准确率等于证据吗？KV 缓存压缩下推理的忠实性

    Mengting Ai, Jingrui He, Yue Guo

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper shows that KV compression can preserve answer accuracy while degrading the faithfulness of visible reasoning traces, and introduces measures to expose that gap. This substantially informs reasoning evaluation; its KV-memory analysis is relevant to systems, but does not establish a broader systems contribution.

    论文表明，KV 压缩可以保留答案准确率，同时降低可见推理轨迹的忠实性，并提出了揭示这一差距的度量方法。这对推理评估有重要意义；其 KV 内存分析与系统领域相关，但并未确立更广泛的系统贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    KV cache compression is commonly evaluated by final-answer accuracy, implicitly assuming that preserving the answer also preserves the reasoning that supports it. We test this assumption for large reasoning models and show that it can fail: under compression, correct answers and the validity of their visible supporting rationales can be preserved at different rates. We study this failure with a controlled fixed-trace replay protocol, which holds reasoning content fixed and isolates whether compression preserves usable information from an already available trace. We evaluate ten token-eviction KV compression methods and one quantization method on three models across mathematical reasoning, scientific QA, clinical calculation, and long-context retrieval. We measure final accuracy, answer-chain consistency, and perturbation faithfulness. Across tasks, token-eviction methods can preserve competitive final-answer accuracy while substantially degrading chain support or perturbation faithfulness. We call this the answer-evidence gap. A coverage-preserving quantization control is substantially less affected, suggesting that the failure is tied less to KV memory reduction itself than to losing access to parts of the reasoning trace. Code is available at https://github.com/famous-blue-raincoat/Safe_KV_Compress.

    中文

    KV 缓存压缩通常通过最终答案准确率来评估，这隐含地假设保留答案也会保留支撑该答案的推理。我们针对大型推理模型检验这一假设，并表明它可能不成立：在压缩条件下，正确答案与其可见支撑理由的有效性可能以不同的比率得到保留。我们通过受控的固定轨迹回放协议研究这一问题；该协议保持推理内容不变，并隔离考察压缩是否能保留已有轨迹中的可用信息。我们在数学推理、科学问答、临床计算和长上下文检索任务上，对三个模型评估了十种 token 淘汰式 KV 压缩方法和一种量化方法。我们测量最终准确率、答案链一致性和扰动忠实性。在各项任务中，token 淘汰方法可能在保持有竞争力的最终答案准确率的同时，显著降低链条支撑度或扰动忠实性。我们将此称为答案—证据差距。保留覆盖范围的量化对照受影响小得多，这表明该问题与其说源于 KV 内存缩减本身，不如说源于无法访问推理轨迹的部分内容。代码见 https://github.com/famous-blue-raincoat/Safe_KV_Compress。

    XPress: Parallel Refinement for Diffusion Drafters in Speculative Decoding

    XPress：用于推测解码扩散草稿模型的并行细化

    Zheng Wang, Davis Wertheimer, Yu Chin Fabian Lim, Mudhakar Srivatsa, Raghu K. Ganti, Minjia Zhang, Naigang Wang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces a parallel causal refiner that restores dependencies among diffusion-drafted tokens and improves speculative-decoding efficiency. This is a substantial inference-systems contribution; token dependencies are incidental to compositional generalization, and the abstract does not study reasoning mechanisms.

    论文提出一种并行因果细化器，用于恢复扩散草拟 token 之间的依赖关系，并提高推测解码效率。这是对推理系统的重要贡献；token 依赖关系与组合泛化仅有附带关联，摘要也未研究推理机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Block-diffusion drafters like dFlash generate an entire block of draft tokens in a single forward pass, drastically reducing the overhead of multiple-token drafting in speculative decoding. The crucial final step of the single-pass discrete denoising process involves using the logit distribution at each position to sample conditionally independent tokens. The resulting draft is thus a set of per-position marginals, rather than a joint distribution: no draft token is guaranteed to depend on its predecessors. Such independently sampled marginals tend to produce sequences with tokens that are individually likely, but jointly improbable under the target model's distribution, which verifies each token conditionally. This can cause early rejection and limits acceptance length. To address this, we propose xPress as a means to restore the missing causality in diffusion drafters. xPress is a lightweight causal refiner that reconciles the whole diffusion block at once through parallel refinement, restoring and propagating causal dependencies across the draft without a token-by-token loop. On Qwen3-8B, across seven math, code, and chat benchmarks, xPress raises acceptance length by about 30% on average (up to +56%) and its end-to-end decoding throughput by about 1.3 on average (up to 1.7) compared to the original dFlash diffusion drafter.

    中文

    像 dFlash 这样的块扩散草稿模型在一次前向传递中生成整个草稿 token 块，大幅降低了推测解码中多 token 草拟的开销。单次传递离散去噪过程的关键最后一步，是利用每个位置的 logit 分布对条件独立的 token 进行采样。因此，生成的草稿是一组逐位置边缘分布，而非联合分布：无法保证任何草稿 token 依赖于其前序 token。这类独立采样的边缘分布往往会生成这样的序列：其中的 token 单独看都很可能出现，但在逐 token 条件验证的目标模型分布下，联合出现的概率很低。这可能导致过早拒绝，并限制接受长度。为解决这一问题，我们提出 xPress，以恢复扩散草稿模型中缺失的因果性。xPress 是一种轻量级因果细化器，通过并行细化一次性协调整个扩散块，在不进行逐 token 循环的情况下恢复并传播草稿中的因果依赖。在 Qwen3-8B 上，针对七项数学、代码和聊天基准测试，与原始 dFlash 扩散草稿模型相比，xPress 平均将接受长度提高约 30%（最高 +56%），并将端到端解码吞吐量平均提高约 1.3 倍（最高 1.7 倍）。

    Vision-language models excel at image and video understanding but suffer from high inference latency due to the need to process thousands of tokens per image, limiting their deployment on resource-constrained edge devices and in real-time surveillance applications. This challenge is further amplified in video processing, where multiple frames must be analyzed simultaneously. Existing token reduction techniques generally rely on a fixed, uniform pruning ratio applied across all inputs, which is suboptimal because the degree of redundancy can vary significantly between different videos, necessitating content-dependent pruning levels to preserve critical information. To address these limitations, we propose an adaptive token pruning strategy specifically designed for video processing. Crucially, the pruning ratio is determined adaptively based on the content of each video. This is achieved by analyzing the correlation structure of token embeddings to quantify redundancy, enabling dynamic token allocation that retains more tokens for dynamic scenes while aggressively pruning repetitive or static content. Importantly, our method is entirely post-hoc and requires no additional training or fine-tuning, while achieving strong empirical gains; notably, it improves accuracy by +7\% on a video captioning benchmark at 10\% token retention, while reducing computation TFLOPs by 95\%.

    中文

    视觉语言模型擅长图像和视频理解，但由于每张图像需要处理数千个 token，推理延迟较高，因而限制了它们在资源受限的边缘设备和实时监控应用中的部署。在视频处理中，必须同时分析多帧，这进一步加剧了这一挑战。现有 token 缩减技术通常依赖于应用于所有输入的固定统一剪枝比例；由于不同视频的冗余程度可能差异很大，这种做法并非最优，因此需要根据内容调整剪枝级别以保留关键信息。为解决这些局限，我们提出一种专为视频处理设计的自适应 token 剪枝策略。关键在于，剪枝比例会根据每段视频的内容自适应确定。具体而言，我们通过分析 token 嵌入的相关结构来量化冗余，从而动态分配 token：动态场景保留更多 token，而对重复或静态内容则大幅剪枝。值得注意的是，我们的方法完全采用后处理方式，无需额外训练或微调，同时取得了显著的实证提升；具体来说，在一个视频描述基准上，当 token 保留率为 10\% 时，准确率提高了 +7\%，同时计算量 TFLOPs 降低了 95\%。

    SAKI-RoPE: Score-Aware Low-Rank Key Indexing with RoPE-Aware Covariance and Random-Matrix Noise Analysis

    SAKI-RoPE：具备 RoPE 感知协方差与随机矩阵噪声分析的分数感知低秩键索引

    Lin Zhang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper derives a score-aware low-rank KV-cache index, extends it for RoPE, and analyzes covariance-estimation noise, improving retrieval recall under compression. This is a strong memory and inference-systems contribution; its analysis concerns attention-score preservation rather than the organization or causal use of model representations, and it does not address composition or reasoning.

    论文推导了一种分数感知低秩 KV 缓存索引，将其扩展为 RoPE 感知形式，并分析协方差估计噪声，从而提高压缩条件下的检索召回率。这是对内存和推理系统的有力贡献；其分析关注注意力分数保留，而非模型表示的组织方式或因果使用，也未涉及组合或推理。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Existing low-rank KV-cache indexes preserve model weights or key variance, not the attention scores that determine retrieval. We derive the expected score distortion of key-side rank-r compression, a two-sided covariance-weighted low-rank problem that uses both query and key statistics, and solve it exactly: the optimum is an optimal rank-r linear score map, computed in closed form from two d x d covariances per head, and its predicted per-head score-MSE reduction matches measurement (Pearson r = 0.997). The resulting training-free index, SAKI, beats key-PCA at every rank on LLaMA-3.1-8B, Qwen2.5-7B, Mistral-7B and Llama-3.2-3B, at every context length from 4K to 64K, and in every calibration-domain pair (0.748 -> 0.799 recall@64 at r = 32 on LLaMA-3.1-8B). Because RoPE rotates keys by their distance from the query, we make the closed form RoPE-aware by averaging the query covariance over rotations; this SAKI-RoPE, our main method, raises recall to 0.861, beats PCA on every head of all four models, and needs only 28-39% of PCA's rank to match it at r = 32 across the four models. Random-matrix theory of the covariance estimation noise shows that 512 calibration tokens suffice and that clipping the Marchenko-Pastur noise bulk helps SAKI when calibration is short. We make no perplexity claim: with the attention sink pinned, perplexity differences between indexes are small and depend on model and text, and we show that any low-rank index calibrated on a long prefix drops the attention-sink token, which collapses 32K perplexity unless the sink is pinned.

    中文

    现有低秩 KV 缓存索引保留的是模型权重或键方差，而非决定检索结果的注意力分数。我们推导了键侧秩-r 压缩的预期分数失真，将其建模为同时利用查询和键统计量的双侧协方差加权低秩问题，并精确求解：其最优解是最优秩-r 线性分数映射，可由每个注意力头的两个 d x d 协方差矩阵通过闭式形式计算；该方法预测的逐头分数 MSE 降幅与实测结果相符（Pearson r = 0.997）。由此得到的免训练索引 SAKI，在 LLaMA-3.1-8B、Qwen2.5-7B、Mistral-7B 和 Llama-3.2-3B 上的所有秩设置、4K 到 64K 的所有上下文长度，以及所有校准域组合中，表现均优于 key-PCA（在 LLaMA-3.1-8B 上，r = 32 时 recall@64 从 0.748 提高到 0.799）。由于 RoPE 会根据键与查询之间的距离旋转键，我们通过对旋转后的查询协方差取平均，使闭式解具备 RoPE 感知能力；这一主要方法 SAKI-RoPE 将召回率提高到 0.861，在四个模型的每个注意力头上都优于 PCA，并且在四个模型的 r = 32 设置下，只需 PCA 秩的 28-39% 就能达到与之相当的效果。协方差估计噪声的随机矩阵理论分析表明，512 个校准 token 已足够；当校准样本较少时，裁剪 Marchenko-Pastur 噪声主体有助于 SAKI。我们不对困惑度作出主张：固定 attention sink 后，索引之间的困惑度差异较小，且取决于模型和文本；我们还表明，任何在长前缀上校准的低秩索引都会丢弃 attention-sink token，除非固定该 token，否则 32K 困惑度会崩溃。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper diagnoses and improves compute use in autoresearch agents through shared debugging, control changes, and tree-search refinements, with the language model held fixed. This substantially advances agent design and search, but the abstract does not establish a core contribution to model reasoning mechanisms or compositional generalization.

    论文通过共享调试、控制改进和树搜索优化，诊断并改善了自主研究智能体对计算资源的使用，同时保持语言模型不变。这显著推进了智能体设计和搜索，但摘要并未确立其对模型推理机制或组合泛化的核心贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    A slew of recent works develop agents for solving research problems end-to-end, a paradigm increasingly referred to as autoresearch. Such agents have inspired large industry investment, motivated by their potential to automate time-consuming human labor and customize machine learning solutions for specialized applications. In this paper, we study the modeling pipeline at the core of these autoresearch systems and identify common failure modes when they are applied to tabular datasets: (1) they waste compute resolving the same bugs over and over again; (2) they often fail to tune hyperparameters even when they have a large remaining compute budget; (3) the tree-search algorithms that power them do not explore; and (4) they perform data analysis, mimicking the humans whose data they are trained on, but do not use that analysis to make downstream decisions. We explore targeted interventions and find that a global debug consultant that shares discovered runtime constraints across all branches of the search tree, prompt- and control-level enhancements, and refined tree-search algorithms successfully recover wasted compute. Our results show that large gains in autoresearch agent performance are achievable through agentic design alone, holding the underlying language model fixed.

    中文

    近期有大量研究开发了端到端解决研究问题的智能体，这一范式日益被称为自主研究。这类智能体激发了业界的大量投入，原因在于它们有望自动化耗时的人工作业，并为专门应用定制机器学习解决方案。在本文中，我们研究了这类自主研究系统核心的建模流程，并找出它们应用于表格数据集时常见的失效模式：(1) 反复解决相同的错误，浪费计算资源；(2) 即使剩余计算预算充足，也常常未能调整超参数；(3) 为其提供动力的树搜索算法并未进行探索；(4) 它们会进行数据分析，模仿其训练数据中的人类行为，却不利用分析结果做出后续决策。我们探索了有针对性的干预措施，发现全局调试顾问（在搜索树的所有分支之间共享已发现的运行约束）、提示和控制层面的改进，以及改进后的树搜索算法，能够成功找回浪费的计算资源。结果表明，在底层语言模型保持不变的情况下，仅通过智能体设计就能大幅提升自主研究智能体的性能。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language models often fail when answer options require combining atomic judgments under explicit logical operators, even when they judge the individual atoms correctly. We study compound options connected by AND, OR, and NEITHER/NOR, introducing a framework that decomposes each option into atomic answers and scores contrastive hypotheses about each one, so the model never sees a compound option. An operator-constrained integer linear program then composes the calibrated scores into a single prediction. We evaluate on LOGICAL-COMMONSENSEQA and introduce LOGICAL-SATA, a reading-comprehension benchmark derived from SATA-Bench. Our framework improves Macro-F1 from 48.3 to 77.0 on the human-validated LOGICAL-COMMONSENSEQA split and from 47.6 to 75.6 on LOGICAL-SATA, with the largest gains on NEITHER/NOR.

    Frozen Memory Is Not Enough: Rethinking External Memory as Extraction

    冻结记忆还不够：重新思考外部记忆作为提取结果

    Mingyuan Li and Guangsheng Yu and Xu Wang and Shaoxiong Ji

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper studies whether an external learned memory can transfer across model backbones and how reader compatibility and adaptation affect its utility. This provides substantive evidence about memory retrieval and reuse in model systems, but does not analyze internal representation mechanisms or reasoning capabilities.

    论文研究外部学习记忆能否跨模型骨干迁移，以及读取器兼容性和适配如何影响其效用。这为模型系统中的记忆检索和复用提供了实质性证据，但未分析内部表征机制或推理能力。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Methods for improving knowledge use in large language models typically fall into two regimes. Non-parametric retrieval offers flexible access to external knowledge, but adds retrieval latency, context overhead, and only shallow integration with the backbone. Parametric adaptation is efficient at inference time, but entangles knowledge with model weights and can be hard to update, audit, or transfer. Engram-style hashed memory occupies a middle regime: it stores learned information in an external, addressable table, yet consumes that table through a small learned reader. This raises a basic question: when such a memory is moved across backbones, what matters more, the frozen memory itself or the target-side reader? We study this question through cross-model frozen-memory extraction, in which a memory trained on a source model is frozen and attached to a different target model, with only a lightweight reader trained. Ablations show that learned memory content and correct addressing both matter, while the amount of usable signal depends on how well the reader is aligned to the target model. In downstream question answering tasks, a dual-layer, four-branch reader nearly closes the gap between same-model and cross-model reuse, achieving an average score of 38.8 under our controlled evaluation protocol. Moreover, when the provider reader is directly compatible with the target interface, the frozen artifact can provide substantial utility without target-side training, while optional reader adaptation yields further improvement. These results suggest that Engram can serve as a reusable external knowledge artifact, provided that the target has access to a compatible reader interface; target-side adaptation can further improve alignment when direct reader reuse is insufficient.

    中文

    提升大型语言模型知识利用能力的方法通常分为两类。非参数检索能够灵活访问外部知识，但会增加检索延迟和上下文开销，而且与骨干模型的整合较浅。参数化适配在推理时效率较高，但会使知识与模型权重纠缠在一起，难以更新、审计或迁移。Engram 风格的哈希记忆处于两者之间：它将学到的信息存储在外部、可寻址的表中，却通过一个小型学习式读取器来读取该表。这引出了一个基本问题：当这类记忆跨骨干模型迁移时，冻结的记忆本身与目标侧读取器，哪一个更重要？我们通过跨模型冻结记忆提取来研究这一问题：将源模型训练得到的记忆冻结并接入另一目标模型，只训练一个轻量级读取器。消融实验表明，学得的记忆内容和正确寻址都很重要，而可用信号的多少取决于读取器与目标模型的对齐程度。在下游问答任务中，双层四分支读取器几乎弥合了同模型复用与跨模型复用之间的差距，在我们的受控评估协议下取得 38.8 的平均分。此外，当提供方读取器与目标接口直接兼容时，冻结后的产物无需目标侧训练即可提供显著效用；可选的读取器适配还能进一步提升效果。这些结果表明，只要目标模型能够访问兼容的读取器接口，Engram 就可以作为可复用的外部知识产物；当直接复用读取器的效果不足时，目标侧适配还可进一步改善对齐。

    Dayang Liang, Lang Feng, Bo An, Yunlong Liu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    SAPO combines policy and value learning in one autoregressive model to improve agentic RL efficiency, with a SARSA objective and turn-level advantage estimation. This is a strong contribution to agent training systems, while reasoning capability is investigated through task performance but not directly mechanistically studied; interpretability and compositional generalization are not addressed.

    SAPO 在一个自回归模型中结合策略和值学习，通过 SARSA 目标和轮次级优势估计提高智能体 RL 的效率。这是对智能体训练系统的重要贡献；其通过任务性能考察推理能力，但未直接从机制层面研究推理；也未涉及可解释性或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as an important post-training approach for enhancing the capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, existing methods face a trade-off between policy performance and resource efficiency. Conventional Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) implementations incur substantial memory overhead from a separate critic, whereas critic-free group-relative methods require multiple rollouts and face potential learning bottlenecks on long-horizon tasks. In this work, we propose Single-rollout Autoregressive Policy Optimization (SAPO), an efficient PPO-style framework that unifies policy optimization and value learning within a single causal language model. SAPO exploits the autoregressive structure of LLMs to sequentially generate action and value estimation at distinct causal boundaries with shared parameters, and then jointly optimizes the PPO objectives and an auxiliary on-policy SARSA objective with turn-level generalized advantage estimation, where the latter is designed to facilitate value learning. Extensive experiments on ALFWorld and WebShop with Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B and Qwen3-14B demonstrate that SAPO reduces peak GPU memory usage by 24.8% and per-iteration runtime by 23.1% over strong PPO baseline, while matching or slightly improving task success rate. Our experiments also show that SAPO outperforms Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and recent cutting-edge variants in both task success and training stability.

    中文

    智能体强化学习（RL）已成为提升大型语言模型（LLM）能力的一种重要后训练方法。然而，现有方法在策略性能与资源效率之间面临权衡。传统的近端策略优化（PPO）实现会因单独的评论家模型而产生大量内存开销；而无需评论家的组相对方法则需要多次 rollout，并且在长时程任务中可能遇到学习瓶颈。在这项工作中，我们提出单次 rollout 自回归策略优化（SAPO），这是一种高效的 PPO 风格框架，可在单个因果语言模型中统一策略优化和值学习。SAPO 利用 LLM 的自回归结构，在不同的因果边界处通过共享参数依次生成动作和值估计，然后联合优化 PPO 目标和一个辅助的在策略 SARSA 目标，并结合轮次级广义优势估计；后者旨在促进值学习。我们在 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 上使用 Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B 和 Qwen3-14B 进行了广泛实验，结果表明，与强基线 PPO 相比，SAPO 将 GPU 峰值内存用量降低了 24.8%，每轮运行时间缩短了 23.1%，同时任务成功率持平或略有提升。实验还表明，在任务成功率和训练稳定性方面，SAPO 均优于组相对策略优化（GRPO）及近期先进变体。

    A Storage-Retrieval Gap in Parametric Knowledge Graph Memory

    参数化知识图谱记忆中的存储—检索鸿沟

    Martino M. L. Pulici and Cuong Xuan Chu and Evgeny Kharlamov and Volker Tresp

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The study shows that entity-specific LoRA adapters can store factual knowledge while semantic or weight-space similarity fails to retrieve it, revealing a storage–retrieval disconnect and motivating query-conditioned adapter composition. This strongly informs mechanisms of knowledge storage and memory design; composition is identified as an open problem rather than demonstrated, and answering factual questions alone does not establish a reasoning contribution.

    研究表明，特定实体的 LoRA 适配器能够存储事实知识，但语义相似度或权重空间相似度无法检索这些知识，揭示了存储与检索之间的脱节，并促使人们探索由查询条件化的适配器组合。这为知识存储机制和记忆设计提供了重要启示；组合仍是被指出的开放问题，并未得到验证，而仅回答事实问题不足以证明其对推理有所贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Graph retrieval-augmented generation places retrieved subgraphs into the model's context window at query time, paying a recurring token cost and exposing source data on every call. We study an alternative: compiling a knowledge graph offline into a bank of LoRA adapters, one per entity, that serve as a parametric knowledge layer queried by injecting weights rather than text, at zero query-time context cost. On the MetaQA dataset, we find that subgraph-trained adapters encode context-free factual knowledge that generalizes to unseen questions: on single-valued relations the adapter gains $+0.243$ exact-match score over a base model that is nearly blind closed-book ($0.007$), and only the correct adapter recovers this knowledge (an oracle gap of $+0.283$ over the base model). However, the stored knowledge is not recoverable by similarity: given a query with no subgraph, embedding-based and weight-space geometry retrieval both perform at chance, because a semantically neighbouring entity's adapter does not contain the answer - knowledge is stored locally and does not transfer. Weight geometry correlates with subgraph semantics ($\rho = +0.329$) but not with functional retrievability. We quantify the byte and context-token costs against graph retrieval-augmented generation and discuss deployment implications. Our results establish that parametric knowledge graph memory is feasible for storing knowledge, and identify selecting and composing the right adapters by a mechanism other than semantic similarity as the central open problem - motivating a learned, query-conditioned composition mechanism.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces execution contracts and trace-integrity metrics to audit whether LLM data-agent answers are supported by valid, inspectable computations. This is a substantial contribution to agent-system reliability, while SQL generation and answer evaluation alone provide only incidental connections to representation, composition, or reasoning mechanisms.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language model (LLM) data agents answer structured-data questions by generating SQL, invoking tools, executing queries, and summarizing results. In operational settings, reliability depends on both reported answer and computation used to produce it, as errors may remain undetected when the resulting answer matches an expected value. We refer to the mismatch between natural-language intent and operator-level computation required to satisfy that intent as the Structure Gap, and define Trace Integrity as a reliability criterion for assessing whether the computation supporting an answer is explicit, executable, schema-valid, operator-faithful, replayable, answer-consistent, and auditable. We operationalize Trace Integrity through execution contracts that record the schema elements, operator plan, assumptions, executable query, verification status, and final-answer linkage associated with a request. We also define the Correct Answer / Invalid Trace (CAIT) Rate, which measures the proportion of correct answers whose recorded computations fail trace-integrity checks. These provide a way to evaluate whether answer-level success is supported by a valid and inspectable computation. We study this on 100 BIRD Mini-Dev text-to-SQL examples using three prompting conditions: Direct SQL, Operation Summary + SQL, and Contract-First SQL. The three conditions achieve answer accuracies 20.0%, 22.0%, and 24.0%, Trace Integrity Pass Rates 39.0%, 43.0%, and 40.0%, and CAIT Rates 55.0%, 59.1%, and 45.8%, respectively. The results show that answer accuracy, trace validity, and the frequency of correct answers supported by invalid traces capture different aspects of system behavior. Trace-level evaluation therefore complements conventional answer-based evaluation by providing evidence about the computational support, inspectability, and reproducibility of LLM data-agent outputs in real-world systems.

    ENGLISH

    Longitudinal clinical agents must maintain an evolving patient state from evidence distributed across visits, time points, and specialties. However, how agent memory should be designed for this setting remains unclear. We introduce a benchmark of multi-visit, multi-specialty patient records that evaluates long-context evidence retrieval, cross-time evidence aggregation, and cross-specialty clinical reasoning. Using this benchmark, we systematically study four memory design choices: curation, organization, retrieval, and memory-augmented reasoning. We find that temporal validity is more important than simply retaining more history; specialty-factorized memory reduces context but can hide shared evidence; and multiple agents help when specialists must reason together, not merely when evidence comes from multiple memories. Guided by these findings, we propose \textit{MedCache}, a hybrid framework that constructs temporally valid patient memory, organizes evidence into overlapping specialty views, routes each query to relevant memories, and adaptively invokes one or multiple specialists. Experiments show that MedCache improves reasoning accuracy and memory efficiency over strong single-agent and multi-agent baselines, while generalizing across model backbones and external datasets.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces committed reveal sampling, making selected tokens persistent context, and analyzes and evaluates its effect in discrete diffusion generation.     ENGLISH

    Uniform-state discrete diffusion models update all tokens in parallel while keeping every position revisable. Even when the commonly used top-$p$ rule leaves only one candidate at a position, that choice affects only the current reverse step and can be revised at the next sampling step. We ask what changes when selected hypotheses instead become persistent context for later predictions. We therefore propose committed reveal sampling (CRS), a training-free sampler that stores selected argmax tokens and inserts them into subsequent model inputs. Our analysis separates persistent context from truncation. Within one reverse step, adaptive top-$p$, randomized or not, reproduces the update induced by a visible token only when a likelihood-ratio ordering holds, while in a simple latent-mode model, keeping the selected token visible helps later parallel predictions agree on the same sequence-level choice. Empirically, paired experiments on Duo-distilled then separate this persistent effect from single-step top-$p$ restriction and scalar temperature scaling. Under the same finalization rule, CRS without top-$p$ truncation reaches lower generative perplexity (GenPPL) than fixed $p=0.95$ and $p=0.9$ baselines across budgets of 8--64 function evaluations (NFE). At 64 NFE, the comparison at matched unigram entropy also gives lower GenPPL for CRS, shifting the GenPPL--entropy tradeoff under this metric. Base Duo shows the same direction in a descriptive comparison, while other diversity and continuation metrics can rank these operating points differently. A distributional distance to held-out text (SOL) under a fixed GPT-2-Large representation also decreases with persistent context at the same late top-$p$ threshold. These results identify support restriction and persistent context as distinct controls of that tradeoff.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Long-running LLM agents rely on persistent memory to preserve not only task context but also the permissions and restrictions governing their actions. When memory misrepresents this evolving authorization state, the agent's own records can make unauthorized actions appear permitted, resulting in misaligned behavior without any external attacks. We term this failure endogenous authorization laundering, where memory creates or retains false authority through semantic misinterpretation or failed updates, and executors act on that authority. We then introduce EAL-Bench to measure how accurately persistent memory preserves evolving authorization state and whether memory errors propagate to unauthorized actions. We evaluate seven LLMs as memory writers and two as executors across procurement, cybersecurity, and finance tasks. Under incremental typed-memory updates, writers create false authority for up to 45.4% of unauthorized requests, and once false authority is present, executors act on it in 99.0% of trials. Memory-level safeguards reduce laundering but can reject legitimate actions, exposing a safety-utility tradeoff. Persistent memory is therefore part of an LLM agent's effective authorization policy, not merely a performance component.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Prioritized Sweeping (PS) accelerates model-based reinforcement learning by selecting backups according to Bellman residual magnitude. In nonstationary reward settings, however, the canonical priority score is shortsighted: after a localized reward shift, residuals propagate only through realized backups, so bottlenecked or topologically distant state estimates may remain static under a limited replanning budget. We introduce the Graph Topology Augmentation framework, which employ the graph's resolvent and its diffusion semantic, to augment the inquired signal. Our application, Graph Topology Augmentation for Prioritized Sweeping (GTA-PS), or which the alias Spectral Prioritized Sweeping (SPS) might be more universal, provides a drop-in ordering score for the setting of fixed dynamics and changing state rewards. GTA-PS uses a smootherized policy, inducing a transition chain, with its in- and out-Laplacian. The standard priority key is augmented with a mixing of regularized Laplacian inverses diffusing the residual magnitude. Furthermore, the topology contribution is annealed by a scheduler based on the Second Largest Eigenvalue Modulus (SLEM), allowing its scale to adapt to the chain's mixing regime. We prove that the forward potential coincides with geometric discounted residual propagation and show that GTA-PS gives active priority instantly to all states. Tabular experiments on FourRooms and GARNET domains demonstrate improved replanning efficiency over standard PS under both exact DP and Dyna-style host planners.

    In-context learning (ICL) enables large language model (LLM) agents to improve decisions using interaction history, yet it remains unclear whether such improvement reflects refined internal reasoning or mere extrapolation of statistical patterns. To disentangle these mechanisms, we study LLM agents in multi-agent incomplete-information games that require recursive belief reasoning. By constructing a public goods game and manipulating the statistical structure of historical feedback, we evaluate decision quality against a history-independent rational expectations equilibrium (REE) benchmark. Our experiments reveal that when historical statistical patterns are disrupted, the benefits of longer context largely vanish, degrading decision quality to the no-context baseline in a way sharply amplified by stronger strategic interdependence. These results suggest that, in such strategic environments, ICL behavior is more consistent with statistical extrapolation than with strategic reasoning. Across 15 academic schemes, no paper describes a halt that skips LLM inference or combines source provenance with cross-source corroboration, and the 7 code releases enforce no stop-loss or position limit outside the LLM.     Forecasting requires large language model (LLM) agents to gather evolving evidence, revise their beliefs, and make calibrated predictions over time. Yet evaluating and improving these capabilities is challenging because real-world events unfold continuously and outcomes may take months to resolve. We introduce Forecast-Dojo, a replayable environment that reconstructs resolved prediction-market events as sequences of dated forecasting steps, enabling reproducible evaluation, longitudinal analysis, and training from agent interactions. It comprises 1,568 Polymarket events split temporally into training and evaluation sets, alongside 18.8 million dated news articles. Across 12 models, research tools consistently improve forecasting performance, and greater capture of new evidence is associated with larger improvements over time. Nevertheless, all models trail historical market forecasts, while carrying a belief notebook across dates reduces research costs without consistently improving forecast quality. We supervise fine-tuned Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507 on collected trajectories from Qwen3-235B-A22B-Thinking-2507 to demonstrate the environment's training utility. The student's accuracy is improved from 34.8% to 42.8% on the evaluation set.

    各自隐蔽，合则有害：基于技能的智能体系统中的技能级联攻击

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces cross-skill cascading attacks and a multi-agent red-teaming benchmark, showing that interactions among modular agent capabilities can evade component-level safeguards.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    A skill is a modular package of natural-language instructions, executable scripts, and reference resources that an agent can load at runtime to extend its capabilities for a specific task. Skill-based agent systems therefore enable flexible reuse of third-party capabilities, but the openness of this skill ecosystem also opens up a new attack surface. Prior work has focused on vulnerabilities within individual skills, but little attention has been paid to risks that arise from interactions across skills. In this paper, we introduce skill cascading attacks, a threat paradigm in which a malicious objective is distributed across multiple skills so that each modification looks benign in isolation, yet their combined execution is harmful. For instance, in a prescription-review pipeline, the first skill weakens signals of recently discontinued medications in the extracted history, the second downgrades the severity of any drug interaction tied to them, and the third suppresses the resulting low-priority alert in the final summary, so that a severe drug-interaction warning silently disappears before reaching the physician. To systematically study this safety blind spot, we develop SkillCascade, an automated multi-agent red-teaming framework, and release SkillCascade-Bench, a benchmark of 213 validated cascading test cases across multiple agent systems and domains. Across representative agents (e.g., OpenClaw, Claude Code, Codex) and LLM backbones, cascaded interactions reliably induce harmful behaviors while evading existing per-skill scanners and runtime monitors. Our findings highlight a gap between component-level integrity and system-level safety, and call for defenses that reason over cross-skill interactions rather than individual skills in isolation.

    技能是一种模块化程序包，包含自然语言指令、可执行脚本和参考资源，智能体可在运行时加载它，以扩展自身在特定任务上的能力。因此，基于技能的智能体系统能够灵活复用第三方能力，但技能生态的开放性也带来了新的攻击面。以往工作关注的是单项技能内部的漏洞，却很少关注技能之间交互所产生的风险。本文提出技能级联攻击这一威胁范式：恶意目标被分散到多个技能中，使每项修改单独看都无害，但组合执行后却会造成危害。例如，在处方审核流程中，第一个技能弱化提取的病史中近期停用药物的信号，第二个技能降低与这些药物相关的任何药物相互作用的严重程度，第三个技能则在最终摘要中压下由此产生的低优先级警报，导致严重药物相互作用警告在送达医生前悄然消失。为系统研究这一安全盲点，我们开发了自动化多智能体红队测试框架 SkillCascade，并发布 SkillCascade-Bench，这是一个涵盖多个智能体系统和领域、包含 213 个经过验证的级联测试用例的基准。在代表性智能体（如 OpenClaw、Claude Code、Codex）及各类 LLM 主干模型上，级联交互会稳定诱发有害行为，同时逃过现有的逐技能扫描器和运行时监控器。我们的研究揭示了组件级完整性与系统级安全之间的差距，并呼吁开发能够推理跨技能交互的防御机制，而不是孤立地检查单项技能。

    LLMs are not stochastic parrots: Evidence for meaning-mediated abstraction from conlang-like tasks

    LLM 并非随机鹦鹉：来自类人工语言任务的意义介导抽象证据

    Julia Witte Zimmerman, Calla G. Beauregard, Tabia Tanzin Prama, Parisa Suchdev, Kathryn Cramer, Elisabeth Kollrack

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper tests whether LLMs follow novel language constraints without examples, finding behavior consistent with meaning-mediated abstraction and rule following. This offers substantive evidence about abstraction and systematic generalization, but does not directly investigate internal mechanisms, so MechInterp remains partial.

    本文检验 LLM 是否能在没有示例的情况下遵循新语言约束，发现其行为符合意义介导的抽象和规则遵循。这为抽象与系统性泛化提供了有实质内容的证据，但没有直接研究内部机制，因此对机制可解释性的贡献有限。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    The strong version of the stochastic parrot argument claims that, although large language models (LLMs) may exceed rote regurgitation, they cannot move beyond statistical pattern matching into abstraction or reasoning, remaining ontologically near the lower bound of pattern reuse despite producing alluringly fluent text. We test this hypothesis using conlang-like tasks. Several LLMs are given only natural-language descriptions of fictional languages that subvert prominent superficial patterns in training data by combining statistically uncommon and unattested features. Crucially, no example outputs are given. We argue that if the models exhibit rule-following behaviour, they cannot be relying solely on superficial statistical patterns; such patterns often work against the correct output. Instead, successful performance requires representations of the constraints specified in the prompt. Across three complementary task families, models systematically move in the meaning-predicted direction: they distinguish prompt exposure from instructed use, alter semantic relationships in response to novel constraints, and sometimes produce exact matches to complex translation answer keys. Although performance varies across the spectrum of models used, these results provide evidence for meaning-mediated abstraction in LLMs and refute the strong stochastic parrot hypothesis. Our work shows that, under appropriate architectural and contextual constraints, statistical learning can produce meaning-mediated abstractions, although generation remains strongly constrained by superficial plausibility. We discuss implications for model development and for understanding how increasingly abstract representations may emerge from plausible-text-generation objectives.

    中文

    随机鹦鹉论的强版本认为，大语言模型（LLM）虽然可能超越机械复述，却无法从统计模式匹配迈向抽象或推理；尽管能生成诱人而流畅的文本，其本体仍接近模式复用的下限。我们使用类人工语言任务检验这一假说。我们仅向若干 LLM 提供虚构语言的自然语言描述。这些语言将统计上罕见且从未出现过的特征组合起来，从而颠覆训练数据中显著的表层模式。关键在于，我们没有提供任何示例输出。我们认为，如果模型表现出遵循规则的行为，就不能仅仅依赖表层统计模式，因为这些模式往往会妨碍生成正确输出。相反，成功完成任务需要模型表征提示中指定的约束。在三类互补任务中，模型的表现系统性地朝着意义所预测的方向变化：它们能区分提示中的内容与按指令实际使用的内容，会根据新约束改变语义关系，有时还能与复杂翻译答案集完全匹配。尽管不同模型的表现各异，这些结果仍为 LLM 中由意义介导的抽象提供了证据，并反驳了随机鹦鹉论的强版本。我们的工作表明，在适当的架构和上下文约束下，统计学习能够产生由意义介导的抽象，但生成仍受到表层合理性的强烈约束。我们讨论了这些发现对模型开发的启示，以及越来越抽象的表征如何可能从生成合理文本的目标中涌现。

    EOPSA: Efficient On-Policy Self-Distilled Safety Alignment

    EOPSA：高效的在线策略自蒸馏安全对齐

    Qirui Liu, Yichen Sun, Yan Wang, Yu Mi, Wei Cao, Yue Shen, Zhixuan Chu, Kui Ren

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    EOPSA changes safety distillation by scheduling rollouts around teacher reliability and updating only safety-critical tokens, improving safety while retaining reasoning with less computation. This directly advances training for reasoning capability, while its computational efficiency is a substantial but secondary systems contribution; it does not probe internal representations.

    EOPSA 通过依据教师模型的可靠性调度展开过程，并且只更新对安全至关重要的 token，改进安全性的同时以更少计算保留了推理能力。这直接推动了面向推理能力的训练；计算效率则是重要但次要的系统贡献。该方法没有探查内部表征。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) has emerged as a promising paradigm for safety alignment, delivering dense, token-level supervision by distilling from a teacher conditioned on refusal-oriented privileged prompts. However, we reveal that this paradigm suffers from critical inefficiencies that degrade both training efficiency and general reasoning capabilities. Specifically, we diagnose two fundamental bottlenecks: (1) supervisory collapse over extended rollouts, where the teacher's corrective efficacy degrades precipitously as the student's generation prefix lengthens, injecting noisy gradients into late-stage tokens; and (2) gradient dilution from stylistic shifts, where the distillation objective is dominated by safety-irrelevant stylistic discrepancies induced by privileged prompting, washing out genuine safety signals and impairing base reasoning. To resolve these issues, we propose Efficient On-Policy Self-Distilled Safety Alignment (EOPSA), which concentrates computational and gradient budgets exclusively on reliably supervised, safety-critical tokens. EOPSA incorporates two coordinated mechanisms: (i) Adaptive Rollout Scheduling, which dynamically bounds the generation horizon guided by a novel Teacher Rescue Rate (TRR) metric to operate strictly within reliable supervision regimes; and (ii) Selective Distillation, which filters out safety-neutral tokens to restrict gradient updates exclusively to safety-pivotal transitions. Extensive evaluations across reasoning models up to 32B parameters demonstrate that EOPSA slashes rollout computation by $\sim$50% and backpropagates through merely $\sim$2% of tokens, consistently outperforming full-token distillation baselines in both safety compliance and reasoning retention.

    在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）已成为一种颇有前景的安全对齐范式：通过从以面向拒绝的特权提示为条件的教师模型进行蒸馏，它能提供密集的 token 级监督。然而，我们发现，这一范式存在严重低效问题，会同时损害训练效率和通用推理能力。具体而言，我们诊断出两个根本瓶颈：（1）长时间展开中的监督崩塌：随着学生模型的生成前缀变长，教师模型的纠正效果急剧下降，向后期 token 注入噪声梯度；（2）风格变化导致的梯度稀释：蒸馏目标被特权提示引发、与安全无关的风格差异所主导，冲淡了真正的安全信号并损害基础推理能力。为解决这些问题，我们提出高效在线策略自蒸馏安全对齐（EOPSA），将计算和梯度预算集中用于监督可靠且对安全至关重要的 token。EOPSA 包含两种协同机制：（i）自适应展开调度：利用一种新颖的教师挽救率（TRR）指标动态限制生成跨度，严格确保处于监督可靠的范围内；（ii）选择性蒸馏：过滤掉与安全无关的 token，将梯度更新限制在对安全起关键作用的状态转移上。在参数规模最高达 32B 的推理模型上进行的大量评估表明，EOPSA 将展开计算量削减了 $\sim$50%，反向传播仅覆盖 $\sim$2% 的 token，同时在安全合规性和推理能力保留方面始终优于全 token 蒸馏基线。

    JRDB-AVR：面向真实世界环境中具身智能体的主动视觉推理基准

    Zhixi Cai, Fucai Ke, Sukai Huang, Maria Garcia de la Banda, Peter J. Stuckey, Gholamreza Haffari, Hamid Rezatofighi

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces an active visual reasoning benchmark and an agent that gathers evidence across time and viewpoints using a graph-based world model.     本文推出主动视觉推理基准及一种智能体：后者利用图结构世界模型，跨时间和视角收集证据。该工作实质性地关注具身推理和智能体组织；基准涵盖组合推理，但这并非主要贡献，摘要也未提供关于模型内部机制的洞见。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    In complex embodied visual reasoning scenarios, an agent often has only a limited field of view, and the evidence needed to answer a question may be distributed across time, viewpoint, and interacting objects. A model may therefore give a plausible answer without ever observing the relevant object, time, or view that supports it. Current visual reasoning benchmarks largely evaluate passive observations and final answers, overlooking settings that require active reasoning and evidence acquisition. We introduce JRDB-AVR, a benchmark derived from existing real-world JRDB robotics data through a structured question-generation engine that turns this gap into an explicit evaluation: an embodied agentic system receives a visual reasoning question, requests bounded observations by timestamp and viewing angle, and is evaluated on both the final answer and the grounded visual evidence supporting it. The benchmark contains diverse questions over multiple real-world environments involving temporal search, viewpoint selection, and human-oriented compositional reasoning. We also introduce JRDB-AVR-Agent, a reference active reasoning agentic method that maintains an explicit observation-grounded graph-based world model and answers through solving. Experiments reveal a substantial gap between answer accuracy and evidence accuracy in current baselines, showing that current VLMs can produce unsupported correct answers and that active evidence-aware evaluation is necessary for embodied visual reasoning. Code and benchmark are available at https://github.com/ControlNet/JRDB-AVR.

    在复杂的具身视觉推理场景中，智能体往往只有有限的视野，回答问题所需的证据可能分散在不同时间、视角和相互作用的物体之间。因此，模型可能给出看似合理的答案，却从未观察到支持该答案的相关物体、时间或视角。当前视觉推理基准大多评估被动观察和最终答案，忽略了需要主动推理和获取证据的场景。我们推出 JRDB-AVR，这是一个基于现有真实世界 JRDB 机器人数据构建的基准。它通过结构化的问题生成引擎，将这一差距转化为明确的评估任务：具身智能体系统接收一道视觉推理问题，按时间戳和视角请求数量受限的观察，并根据最终答案及支撑答案的视觉依据进行评估。该基准包含多个真实世界环境中的多样化问题，涉及时间搜索、视角选择以及面向人的组合推理。我们还推出 JRDB-AVR-Agent，这是一种主动推理智能体参考方法，它维护一个明确且以观察为依据的图结构世界模型，并通过求解来回答问题。实验揭示了当前基线在答案准确率与证据准确率之间存在显著差距，表明当前 VLM 能够给出缺乏依据但正确的答案，也说明具身视觉推理需要主动且关注证据的评估。代码和基准可在 https://github.com/ControlNet/JRDB-AVR 获取。

    Ting-Chih Chen, Emile van Krieken, Shujian Yu, Filip Ilievski

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    VisKG trains models to form question-specific entity-relation representations that filter visual information for chain-of-thought reasoning, with RL and negative-rationale supervision improving performance. This provides a substantive approach to multi-step visual reasoning and structured representation, but does not investigate internal mechanisms or demonstrate compositional generalization; token reduction is a secondary systems benefit.

    VisKG 训练模型构建针对特定问题的实体—关系表征，以筛除视觉信息中的噪声，支持思维链推理；强化学习和负向推理监督则进一步提升了性能。这为多步视觉推理和结构化表征提供了实质性方法，但没有研究内部机制，也未展示组合泛化；减少 token 数量是次要的系统收益。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Recent work in visual question answering has shown that vision-language models can exhibit strong reasoning capabilities by translating visual inputs into textual representations. The effectiveness of this translation depends on how well visual details are retained; models need to surface and align both explicit and implicit knowledge sufficient to support reasoning, without introducing spurious assumptions. Existing methods that leverage detailed image captions introduce visual details unrelated to the reasoning task, inflating input token counts and increasing computational cost. To address these challenges, we propose VisKG, a reinforcement learning (RL) framework in which models learn to translate visual content into question-specific knowledge graph (KG) representations. This process filters out perceptual noise while preserving the entity-relation structure needed for chain-of-thought reasoning, following the principle of minimum sufficient information. To ensure stable RL post-training, VisKG adopts Group reward-Decoupled Normalization Policy Optimization (GDPO). In addition, we strengthen the supervision stage with negative rationale samples, exposing the model to incorrect reasoning paths before RL post-training. Experimental results across science, mathematics, and general visual understanding benchmarks show that VisKG achieves performance comparable to or better than baselines, while requiring fewer tokens than caption-based representations. Moreover, training VisKG with GDPO improves accuracy by 2% over its GRPO-trained counterpart on average. These results suggest that KG representations are a promising approach for supporting multi-step reasoning and open up future work on adaptively selecting the most suitable representation for a given task.

    LongSpark: Efficient speculative decoding with a fixed-cost parallel drafter

    LongSpark：采用固定成本并行起草器的高效推测解码

    Hao-Yuan He, Peng-Fei Liu, Chen Chen, Si Shen, Quan He, Runzhou Liu, Xinqi Li, Zhenhua Dong, Ming Li

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    LongSpark introduces a fixed-cost parallel drafter that uses multiscale views from the target verification pass to reduce speculative-decoding cost and persistent context state. This is a substantial inference-computation contribution, while efficiency alone does not establish advances in interpretability, compositional generalization, or reasoning.

    LongSpark 提出了一种固定成本的并行起草器，利用目标模型验证处理中的多尺度视图，降低推测解码成本和持久上下文状态。这是一项重要的推理计算贡献；但仅凭效率提升，无法证明其在可解释性、组合泛化或推理方面取得进展。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive inference by verifying multiple draft tokens in a single target forward pass. However, as the context grows, existing state-of-the-art drafters become increasingly expensive, eroding the very efficiency advantage they are designed to provide. We argue that this scaling is unnecessary. A standalone language model must grow with its prefix because it is solely responsible for every token it produces. A drafter, by contrast, only proposes candidates; the target catches and corrects every error before any token is committed. The drafter's decoding cost can therefore be made entirely independent of the prefix length. We introduce LongSpark, a block-diffusion drafter that achieves this by extracting fixed-size, multiscale views from the target's verification pass, thereby eliminating the need for a growing persistent state. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that LongSpark achieves state-of-the-art end-to-end efficiency across multiple model scales and realistic serving conditions. Notably, it delivers the lowest time-per-output-token on long-context tasks while reducing the drafter's context state by several orders of magnitude.

    中文

    推测解码通过在一次目标模型前向处理中验证多个草稿词元，加速自回归推理。然而，随着上下文增长，现有最先进的起草器变得越来越昂贵，侵蚀了它们原本旨在提供的效率优势。我们认为，这种扩展并非必要。独立语言模型必须随其前缀增长，因为它独自负责生成每个词元。相比之下，起草器只提出候选内容；在任何词元被提交之前，目标模型都会捕捉并纠正所有错误。因此，起草器的解码成本可以完全不依赖于前缀长度。我们提出 LongSpark，这是一种块扩散起草器，它通过从目标模型的验证处理中提取固定大小的多尺度视图来实现这一点，从而无需不断增长的持久状态。大量评估表明，LongSpark 在多种模型规模和现实服务条件下，实现了最先进的端到端效率。值得注意的是，它在长上下文任务上实现了最低的每输出词元耗时，同时将起草器的上下文状态缩减了数个数量级。

    Chenxing Wei, Sichen Liu, Lizhao Liu, Ningyuan Sun, Chen Bingzhou, Ying He, Bo Jiang, Fei Yu, Yao Shu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    OptiCom introduces a state-conditioned framework that composes optimization mechanisms and adapts strategy using trajectory feedback, supported by an opportunity-loss analysis and benchmark results. Its mechanism composition and iterative optimization offer partial relevance to composition and reasoning, while the main contribution is an optimizer system rather than internal model mechanisms.

    OptiCom 提出了一种状态条件框架，用于组合优化机制并根据轨迹反馈调整策略，并以机会—损失分析和基准结果为支撑。其机制组合和迭代优化与组合能力和推理有一定关联，但主要贡献是优化器系统，而非模型内部机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed to solve complex scientific and practical problems via iterative optimization. However, dynamically coordinating diverse search mechanisms as candidate quality, failure modes, and resource budgets evolve remains a critical open challenge. Targeted empirical diagnostics reveal that mechanism effectiveness is highly state-dependent. Motivated by this, we analyze how individual decisions drive final outcomes, decomposing the expected terminal improvement under a shared budget into cumulative decision opportunities minus cumulative selection losses. Guided by this opportunity-loss theoretical foundation, we propose OptiCom, a unified framework that represents LLM-driven optimizers within a shared configuration space: C=(A,Q,O,E,M,S), corresponding to artifact, query, operator, evaluation, memory, and strategy. Operating within this space, a fast LLM-based Optimization Controller dynamically composes immediate mechanisms through structured Action Packages, while a slower Strategy Adapter refines long-term selection preferences, operator weights, and templates based on accumulated trajectory feedback. Comprehensive evaluations across 32 benchmark groups demonstrate the superiority of framework: OptiCom achieves an average Max-score rank of 1.72 among 14 evaluated configurations, securing the top score in 23 groups. Ultimately, these results highlight the broad applicability and high extensibility of OptiCom as a general-purpose paradigm for robust LLM test-time scaling.

    中文

    大型语言模型（LLM）正越来越多地通过迭代优化来解决复杂的科学与实际问题。然而，随着候选质量、失效模式和资源预算不断变化，动态协调多种搜索机制仍是一项关键的开放挑战。针对性的实证诊断表明，机制的有效性高度依赖状态。受此启发，我们分析各项决策如何影响最终结果，并将共享预算下的预期终端改进分解为累积决策机会减去累积选择损失。在这一机会—损失理论基础的指导下，我们提出 OptiCom 这一统一框架，将 LLM 驱动的优化器表示在共享配置空间中：C=(A,Q,O,E,M,S)，分别对应产物、查询、算子、评估、记忆和策略。在该空间中，基于 LLM 的快速优化控制器通过结构化操作包动态组合即时机制；较慢的策略适配器则根据累积的轨迹反馈，优化长期选择偏好、算子权重和模板。在 32 个基准组上的综合评估表明，该框架表现出色：在评估的 14 种配置中，OptiCom 的平均最高分排名为 1.72，并在 23 个组中取得最高分。总体而言，这些结果凸显了 OptiCom 作为通用 LLM 测试时扩展范式的广泛适用性和高度可扩展性。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    IG-VLA learns latent future scene reasoning for action prediction and compresses reasoning-derived scene-behavior associations into a gist token, improving performance and inference speed. This advances embodied reasoning and efficient inference, with a limited connection to representations; the abstract does not establish compositional generalization or mechanistic interpretability.

    IG-VLA 学习潜在的未来场景推理来预测动作，并将推理得出的场景—行为关联压缩为要旨 token，从而提升性能和推理速度。这项工作推进了具身推理和高效推理，与表征研究有一定联系；摘要并未证实组合泛化或机制可解释性。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Vision-language-action (VLA) models increasingly incorporate intermediate reasoning to improve robotic manipulation, yet existing approaches primarily reason about observed states without explicitly anticipating future scene evolution. Extending such reasoning to explicit future rollouts at every inference step, however, introduces substantial computational overhead. We propose IG-VLA, a VLA reasoning framework that enables models to imagine the future and internalize the gist. Our Latent Spatiotemporal Reasoning learns to imagine task-relevant future scene evolution directly in visual representation space, guiding action prediction without costly pixel-level video generation. To further reduce inference overhead, we introduce Scene Gist Memory, which internalizes reasoning-derived scene-behavior associations into a compact Scene Gist Token, preserving the benefits of future reasoning while bypassing explicit future imagination at inference. Extensive experiments on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and VLABench demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of IG-VLA. On the LIBERO-Plus Language suite, both the reasoning and gist policies outperform the strongest baseline by nearly 6% in success rate. The gist policy also achieves up to 6.38x speedup over baselines, reducing inference latency from 1081ms to 169.5ms per action chunk on a single NVIDIA A6000 GPU. These results demonstrate that future spatiotemporal reasoning can be effectively internalized for efficient VLA deployment.

    视觉—语言—动作（VLA）模型日益融入中间推理以改进机器人操作，但现有方法主要针对已观察到的状态进行推理，并未明确预测场景未来如何演变。然而，在每个推理步骤中都扩展为显式预测未来轨迹，会带来大量计算开销。我们提出 IG-VLA，这是一种使模型能够想象未来并内化要旨的 VLA 推理框架。我们的潜在时空推理直接在视觉表征空间中学习想象与任务相关的未来场景演变，以指导动作预测，避免代价高昂的像素级视频生成。为进一步降低推理开销，我们引入场景要旨记忆，将推理得出的场景—行为关联内化为紧凑的场景要旨 token，在保留未来推理优势的同时，于推理时绕过显式的未来想象。在 LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus 和 VLABench 上的大量实验展示了 IG-VLA 的有效性和效率。在 LIBERO-Plus Language 套件上，推理策略和要旨策略的成功率均比最强基线高出近 6%。要旨策略相较基线还实现了最高 6.38 倍的加速；在单块 NVIDIA A6000 GPU 上，每个动作块的推理延迟从 1081ms 降至 169.5ms。这些结果表明，可以有效地内化未来时空推理，以支持高效部署 VLA。
