    Greedy Local Learning for Language Model Pretraining: Gaps and Objective Design

    语言模型预训练中的贪心局部学习：差距与目标设计

    Jihwan Moon, Sheir A. Zaheer, Jinmyoung Lee, Gunhee Kim, Chan Y. Park

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper measures how blockwise local objectives affect language-model pretraining and proposes selective future-prediction supervision, with memory savings relevant to decentralized training. Its main contribution advances training and computation organization, while reasoning and composition are secondary rather than directly studied.

    论文测量了逐块局部目标对语言模型预训练的影响，并提出选择性地进行未来预测监督；其内存节省与去中心化训练相关。论文的主要贡献推动了训练和计算组织方面的发展，而推理和组合能力只是次要内容，并未得到直接研究。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Greedy block-wise local learning splits a network into gradient-isolated blocks trained by local auxiliary losses, deleting the backward pass between blocks: inter-stage communication becomes forward-only and every block can step its optimizer independently, properties directly relevant to decentralized model-parallel training. Local learning is competitive with end-to-end backpropagation on image classification, and on small Transformers it is known to trade a worse best loss for parallel speedup. How this loss gap behaves in autoregressive language model (LM) pretraining at larger scale, and which auxiliary designs reduce it, has not been measured. We present a token-budget-matched empirical study at 125M and 400M parameters with $K \in \{1,2,4\}$ blocks at Chinchilla-optimal budgets, factorizing the auxiliary design into network architecture and training objective. We observe: (i) the gap to end-to-end training more than doubles from $K=2$ to $K=4$, but at $K=4$ shrinks from 125M to 400M; (ii) replacing an MLP auxiliary with a Transformer-based one is a strong network-side intervention, recovering 22-41% of the gap; (iii) a multi-token-prediction (MTP) auxiliary objective helps at the first block boundary, whereas adding it at deeper boundaries hurts, and restricting it to the first block yields the best $K=4$ configuration ($+0.062$ vs. $+0.075$ nats at 400M); and (iv) deployment-style per-block execution reduces activation memory by up to $2.2\times$. We frame these results as an empirically grounded method direction rather than a finalized method: local objectives should apply future-predictive pressure selectively across boundaries while resisting shortcuts that bypass predictive content.

    中文

    贪心逐块局部学习将网络拆分为梯度隔离的模块，并通过局部辅助损失进行训练，从而删除模块之间的反向传播：阶段间通信变为仅前向传递，且每个模块都可以独立执行优化器更新。这些特性与去中心化模型并行训练直接相关。局部学习在图像分类上可与端到端反向传播相媲美；在小型 Transformer 上，已知它以更差的最佳损失换取并行加速。然而，在更大规模的自回归语言模型（LM）预训练中，这种损失差距如何变化，以及哪些辅助设计可以缩小差距，尚未得到测量。我们在 125M 和 400M 参数规模下进行了词元预算匹配的实证研究，使用 $K \in \{1,2,4\}$ 个模块并采用 Chinchilla 最优预算，将辅助设计分解为网络架构和训练目标。我们观察到：（i）与端到端训练的差距从 $K=2$ 到 $K=4$ 扩大了一倍以上，但在 $K=4$ 下，该差距从 125M 到 400M 时有所缩小；（ii）将 MLP 辅助模块替换为基于 Transformer 的辅助模块，是一种强有力的网络侧干预，可弥补 22-41% 的差距；（iii）多词元预测（MTP）辅助目标在第一个模块边界处有所帮助，而在更深的边界处加入它则会带来负面影响；将其限制在第一个模块中，可得到最佳的 $K=4$ 配置（400M 时为 $+0.062$ 对比 $+0.075$ 纳特）；（iv）采用部署式的逐模块执行，最多可将激活值内存减少 $2.2\times$。我们将这些结果视为有实证依据的方法方向，而非已经定型的方法：局部目标应有选择地在各边界施加面向未来预测的压力，同时避免绕过预测内容的捷径。

    ENGLISH

    Search agents repeatedly make short decisions about relevance, evidence sufficiency, and search actions. Using generative language models for these decisions introduces latency and unreliable confidence. We present SearchJev, a calibrated System-1 model that separates search decisions from System-2 reasoning and generation. Given a search state and a decision schema, SearchJev scores legal options without autoregressive output generation. We propose Soft-Label Learning for Calibrated Decisions (SLCD) to learn decision probabilities from uncertain supervision and improve the reliability of decision confidence. In a dual-system search agent, SearchJev handles short decisions and delegates uncertain judgments to System 2, which retains planning, query generation, and answer composition. We also introduce SearchDecision-Bench, a benchmark unifying six types of search decisions for training and evaluation. On SearchDecision-Bench, SearchJev improves decision quality over same-size Qwen3.5 autoregressive models, achieves 5.2-5.3 times faster decisions, and reduces average expected calibration error by 41-74%.     论文通过实证测量确定性规则和 LLM 判别器如何组合为智能体操作的运行时门控，发现它们的错误并不会按预期组合。这对智能体系统防护作出了重要贡献，但评估的是门控可靠性，而非模型推理或内部机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Runtime gates for agent tool calls are stacked on the assumption that their errors multiply. We test it on 1,119 labelled agent actions from three corpora, without an adaptive adversary. The stack has one deterministic rule layer and four LLM judges, three of them re-collected with the served model recorded on every call. We read each stack as a number of multiplication-equivalent layers, n_mult, with its floor under perfect coupling. Under the STRICT miss definition (escalation to a human scored as not stopped), any two judges compose to about 1.2 to 1.4 layers ({\phi} median +0.430, 6 of 6 pairs significant, floors 1.02 to 1.17). The rule layer plus one judge composes to 1.86 to 2.09 layers ({\phi} median +0.014, 0 of 4 significant, floors 1.01 to 1.09). Under PRIMARY (escalation scored as caught) the bands are 1.21 to 1.57 and 1.80 to 2.13. Intervals separate on the pooled data, point estimates split on each corpus, and a third-vendor judge lands in the judge band. Solo accuracy does not predict what a layer adds: a cloud rule pack lowers the rule layer's solo miss rate by 20% and adds no new joint coverage. The difficulty share of judge coupling is not identifiable: 31.8% to 61.8% depending on the probe and the miss definition. One judge tier was served by an unrequested model version in 50 of 112 batches, concentrated on the external corpus. That event overturned a pre-declared analysis rule, and the scoring of review verdicts reversed five conclusions. We report both.

    ENGLISH

    Speech agents are reactive and dyadic: they speak when spoken to, and to one person at a time. We ask what it takes for a speech agent to instead take part in a conversation among several people and speak up only when it can help. We introduce Jarvis, a real-time proactive speech agent that audibly participates in multi-party human conversations. Grounded in a document shared beforehand, Jarvis follows the discussion and intervenes when the group misses or misstates a fact and does not correct itself within a few turns. We make three contributions: a problem setting based on epistemic breakdowns that makes proactive intervention measurable, realized as CHI-180-proactive, a synthetic multi-party dataset seeded with known gaps, errors, and self-corrections; a proactive backbone that harnesses a small, open-weight model with deterministic checks and grounds every claim in a source sentence; and interaction techniques for taking the floor in live speech and showing the cited evidence on screen. A live study with 23 participants confirms these trends with real-time interventions.

    Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in medical question answering and clinical reasoning, yet their improvement remains constrained by static parametric knowledge and costly expert supervision. Self-evolving agents offer a promising alternative by enabling models to improve through iterative task generation and problem-solving. However, most existing self-evolving methods are designed for easily verifiable domains such as mathematics and coding, where solutions can be checked by exact answers or executable programs. Medical reasoning is fundamentally different: it is open-ended, knowledge-intensive, and often only partially verifiable. We present MedZERO, a self-evolving framework for open-ended medical reasoning. MedZERO couples an Examiner that generates frontier medical question-option pairs with a Reasoner that solves them through evidence-grounded multi-turn reasoning with external knowledge tools. To support reliable, continual improvement, MedZERO adopts controlled knowledge accumulation, which maintains temporary exploratory knowledge and curated persistent knowledge in reasoning. We evaluate MedZERO on five public medical reasoning benchmarks using 4B- and 8B-scale base models under open-ended evaluation. At both model scales, MedZERO achieves the highest average accuracy among the evaluated methods. Code available at https://github.com/IcecreamArtist/MedZERO.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper derives and validates a directional measure explaining how perturbations change multimodal representation geometry, a substantial contribution to representation geometry.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Geometric alignment scores based on Gram determinants provide a compact way to model higher-order consistency among modalities, yet how such scores respond to modality degradation is poorly understood. This paper asks whether the response of a multimodal geometric score is determined primarily by the magnitude of the perturbation-induced displacement. Using frozen cohorts from MSR-VTT (N=878) and DiDeMo (N=980), we apply controlled video blur and audio noise and analyze the response in the relational geometry on which the score is defined. Displacement magnitude explains at most 15% of the out-of-sample variance in the absolute response, and magnitude-matched pairs respond systematically differently, so scalar magnitude does not organize the response. The closed-form first-order expansion of the Gramian volume yields the Directional Geometric Response (DGR): the projection of the displacement onto the local volume gradient, which jointly captures the clean operating point, displacement magnitude, and displacement direction. The absolute first-order DGR term explains the observed response with out-of-sample R^2 of 0.838-0.969, matched-magnitude ranking accuracies of 0.864-0.963, and response-sign accuracies of 0.909-0.989, whereas the tested direction-free alternatives remain weak or unstable under the corresponding evaluation protocols. A pre-specified gain-normalization candidate, V/(g_V+eps), fails its predictability and clean-order gates. DGR uses the observed degraded-state displacement and is therefore an explanatory quantity, not a deployment-time predictor: geometric response depends on where the representation operates, how far degradation moves the relational geometry, and in which direction it moves.

    Mingchen Li and Jiatan Huang and Hong Yu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    RIVO learns state-conditioned logit interventions to redirect long-horizon research trajectories, with a local utility-improvement analysis and benchmark evidence, advancing reasoning control and agent systems. The intervention does not investigate internal representations, and trajectory correction alone does not establish compositional generalization.

    RIVO 学习由状态条件化的 logit 干预，以重定向长时程研究轨迹，并通过局部效用改进分析和基准测试证据支持其方法，推进了推理控制和智能体系统。该干预不研究内部表征，而仅凭轨迹纠正无法证明组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Deep Research agents rely on long-horizon reasoning and iterative tool use to solve complex information-seeking tasks. However, adaptive decision-making over these trajectories remains challenging, as agents may stop prematurely when further evidence is needed, continue unnecessarily after sufficient evidence has been gathered, or fail to redirect unproductive trajectories. Existing solutions either require costly model retraining and dense turn-level supervision, or rely on heuristic control rules that are not directly optimized for downstream research utility. This motivates a lightweight, utility-aware alternative for Deep Research control. We formulate adaptive rerouting in long-horizon Deep Research as a state-conditioned trajectory correction problem. Based on this view, we introduce RIVO, a lightweight plug-in framework for adaptive trajectory correction. The agent estimates its research state from lightweight signals and determines whether trajectory redirection is needed. Once triggered, the plug-in modifies the Host token logits to steer generation toward a more promising research direction. Theoretical analysis shows that, under a value-alignment condition and bounded local curvature, a sufficiently small logit intervention can locally improve expected downstream research utility. We further construct BrowseCore, a curated dataset with a paired local corpus, for efficient and controlled Deep Research experimentation. Building on this resource, the plug-in is trained from downstream outcomes, enabling it to learn corrections that improve subsequent research and final task performance. Extensive experiments across multiple Deep Research benchmarks and control settings demonstrate the effectiveness of our method, showing that lightweight logit intervention can improve long-horizon research without retraining the underlying Host model.

    深度研究智能体依赖长时程推理和迭代式工具使用来解决复杂的信息搜寻任务。然而，在这些轨迹中进行自适应决策仍然具有挑战性：智能体可能在仍需更多证据时过早停止，在证据已经充分后仍不必要地继续，或无法将无效轨迹重新导向其他方向。现有方案要么需要成本高昂的模型重新训练和密集的逐轮监督，要么依赖未直接针对下游研究效用进行优化的启发式控制规则。这促使我们为深度研究控制探索一种轻量且考虑效用的替代方案。我们将长时程深度研究中的自适应重路由表述为一种由状态条件化的轨迹纠正问题。基于这一观点，我们提出 RIVO，一种轻量级的即插即用式自适应轨迹纠正框架。智能体根据轻量级信号估计其研究状态，并判断是否需要重定向轨迹。触发后，该插件会修改 Host 的词元 logits，引导生成转向更有希望的研究方向。理论分析表明，在价值对齐条件和局部曲率有界的前提下，足够小的 logit 干预能够局部提升预期的下游研究效用。我们还构建了 BrowseCore，这是一个经过整理的数据集，并配有成对的本地语料库，可用于高效且受控的深度研究实验。基于这一资源，我们利用下游结果训练该插件，使其能够学习纠正方式，从而改善后续研究和最终任务表现。在多个深度研究基准和控制设置上的广泛实验表明，该方法有效：轻量级 logit 干预能够在不重新训练底层 Host 模型的情况下改善长时程研究。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Medical multimodal reasoning models are typically trained on teacher-generated rationales, discarding the valid reasoning in students' own failed trajectories, while general-domain correction methods offer little guidance for errors in image reading, anatomical context, or differential diagnosis. We propose MedEvo, which uses medical knowledge, namely a tag taxonomy and error-type diagnosis, to navigate both trajectory repair and data selection. For each failed rollout, a gold-blind auditor locates the first consequential error and provides a minimal, answer-free hint; the same student retains the valid prefix and regenerates the erroneous suffix. After each round, MedEvo identifies capability gaps across medical tags on a held-out feedback set and prioritizes related questions for new rollouts and repairs. With supervised fine-tuning (SFT) alone, MedEvo raises Qwen3.5-9B mean accuracy across seven benchmarks from 65.57% to 69.12% (47.40% to 54.50% on the multimodal track of MedXpertQA (MedXpertQA-MM)), surpassing teacher-distillation SFT (66.93%). It also raises Qwen3.5-35B and Qwen3.5-397B mean accuracy from 67.91% to 73.04% and from 71.83% to 74.95%, respectively. Our analyses show that failed trajectories contain reasoning worth preserving, that repair success does not imply learning value, and that independent feedback is key to sustained improvement.

    中文

    医学多模态推理模型通常使用教师生成的推理过程进行训练，因此舍弃了学生自身失败轨迹中有效的推理；而通用领域的纠错方法对图像解读、解剖学背景或鉴别诊断中的错误也几乎无法提供指导。我们提出 MedEvo，利用医学知识，即标签分类体系和错误类型诊断，来引导轨迹修复和数据选择。对于每次失败的 rollout，一个不查看标准答案的审计器会定位第一个造成实质影响的错误，并提供最简短且不含答案的提示；同一个学生保留有效前缀，并重新生成出错的后缀。每轮结束后，MedEvo 会在留出的反馈集上识别不同医学标签下的能力缺口，并优先选择相关问题进行新的 rollout 和修复。仅使用监督微调（SFT），MedEvo 就将 Qwen3.5-9B 在七个基准上的平均准确率从 65.57% 提高到 69.12%（在 MedXpertQA 的多模态轨道 MedXpertQA-MM 上，从 47.40% 提高到 54.50%），超过教师蒸馏 SFT 的 66.93%。它还将 Qwen3.5-35B 和 Qwen3.5-397B 的平均准确率分别从 67.91% 提高到 73.04%，以及从 71.83% 提高到 74.95%。我们的分析表明，失败轨迹中包含值得保留的推理，修复成功并不意味着具有学习价值，而独立反馈是持续改进的关键。

    输出规范决定下限：一种由证伪引导、与模型无关、用于可审计假设驱动决策的智能体协议

    Jing Liu, Yongxing Qi, Ping Yao, Ting Wu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper proposes and evaluates a falsification-guided, five-stage agent protocol that structures evidence-based decisions and improves output discipline and misinformation-robust mathematical reasoning in some models. This substantially addresses reasoning procedures, while its agent framework is a secondary systems contribution and its candidate-evidence composition is not a core study of compositional generalization.

    本文提出并评估了一种由证伪引导的五阶段智能体协议，用于构建基于证据的决策，并在部分模型上提升输出规范性和抗错误信息的数学推理能力。这项工作对推理流程作出了重大贡献；智能体框架是次要的系统贡献，而候选项与证据的组合并非组合泛化研究的核心内容。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    What binds large language models on auditable, hypothesis-driven decision tasks, where every candidate can be checked against the evidence? On the public TCMEval-SDT benchmark for Traditional Chinese Medicine syndrome differentiation (200 cases), the binding constraint is output discipline and reasoning structure, not model capability alone: two years of model scaling move zero-shot scores by only -0.03 to +0.08, while output-discipline failures (non-terminating reasoning, format non-compliance, large run-to-run spread) persist even in frontier models. We test this with a model-agnostic agent framework formalizing decision making as a five-stage closed loop, enforced by a candidate x evidence matrix falsification protocol: every candidate is judged against every evidence item, at least half of the candidates must be falsified before a conclusion is licensed, and survivors are emitted in a machine-verifiable single-line format. Across five base models, the effect is sign-conditional on zero-shot output discipline: it rescues models whose discipline fails (DeepSeek-V4-Flash: +0.267/+0.271, entirely termination rescue), reduces a high-variance model's run-to-run standard deviation from 0.218 to 0.007 (Kimi K3), and significantly costs already-disciplined models (-0.087 to -0.120 on budget-matched Qwen3-4B/32B). Ablations attribute the cost to the candidate-bounded format layer and show the effect is independent of injected knowledge content (protocol-knowledge decoupling). The protocol also transfers to misinformation-robust mathematical reasoning, detecting injected false premises at 89.8% recall with a 6.8% false-positive rate (MCC 0.54; a flag-everything baseline scores 0) and restoring accuracy to the no-misinformation ceiling. Where zero-shot output discipline is weak, the reasoning protocol sets the floor; base-model capability always sets the ceiling.

    中文

    在每个候选项都能依据证据核查的可审计、假设驱动型决策任务中，什么因素限制了大语言模型？在公开的 TCMEval-SDT 基准（用于传统中医证候辨别，含 200 个案例）上，起决定作用的限制因素是输出规范和推理结构，而非仅仅是模型能力：两年的模型扩展仅使零样本分数变化 -0.03 至 +0.08，而输出规范问题（推理无法终止、不遵守格式、不同运行之间波动很大）即使在前沿模型中仍然存在。我们通过一种与模型无关的智能体框架对此进行检验。该框架将决策形式化为五阶段闭环，并以候选项 × 证据矩阵证伪协议予以约束：每个候选项都要依据每条证据进行判断；在允许得出结论前，至少一半候选项必须被证伪；剩余候选项则以机器可验证的单行格式输出。在五种基础模型上的效果取决于零样本输出规范：它能挽救输出规范不合格的模型（DeepSeek-V4-Flash：+0.267/+0.271，完全源于终止问题得到解决），将一个高方差模型的运行间标准差从 0.218 降至 0.007（Kimi K3），并显著损害输出规范本已良好的模型（在预算匹配的 Qwen3-4B/32B 上为 -0.087 至 -0.120）。消融实验将这一损失归因于受候选项约束的格式层，并表明该效果与注入的知识内容无关（协议与知识解耦）。该协议还可迁移到抗错误信息的数学推理任务，以 89.8% 的召回率和 6.8% 的假阳性率检测注入的错误前提（MCC 0.54；“标记所有内容”基线得分为 0），并将准确率恢复至无错误信息时的上限。当零样本输出规范较弱时，推理协议决定下限；基础模型能力始终决定上限。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    ProAS changes how multi-turn agent RL assigns action-level credit using a reference graph, improving training and task success, which is a strong agent-systems contribution and a partial contribution to reasoning capability development. Its graph structure does not itself establish compositional generalization, and it offers no account of internal model representations.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as the primary paradigm for optimizing Large Language Model (LLM) agents, yet efficient critic-free algorithms (e.g., GRPO) suffer from a fundamental uniform credit assignment dilemma that broadcasts trajectory-level advantages equally to all actions. Our analysis reveals that this uniformity inherently reinforces structurally unreasonable actions in preferred trajectories and ignores each action's downstream deviations in unpreferred ones. To resolve this without introducing critic overhead, we propose Progress-Aware Advantage Shaping (ProAS), a plug-and-play framework that leverages a dynamically evolving Agentic Reference Graph (ARG) to achieve fine-grained credit assignment via Masking Unreasonable Incentives (MUI) and Asymmetric Penalty Redistribution (APR). Extensive experiments across Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct demonstrate that ProAS universally elevates mainstream group-based baselines to new state-of-the-art performance, achieving peak success rates of 91.9% and 94.3% on ALFWorld, alongside 66.7% and 70.8% on WebShop, respectively. Furthermore, it accelerates training convergence by up to $2.44\times$ while maintaining strong robustness against imperfect or distilled ARGs. Codes: https://github.com/LINs-lab/ProAS

    强化学习（RL）已成为优化大语言模型（LLM）智能体的主要范式，但高效的无评论家算法（例如 GRPO）面临一个根本性的统一信用分配困境：它们将轨迹级优势同等分配给所有动作。我们的分析揭示，这种统一性会固有地强化偏好轨迹中结构上不合理的动作，并忽略非偏好轨迹中每个动作的下游偏差。为在不引入评论家开销的情况下解决这一问题，我们提出进度感知优势塑形（ProAS），这是一种即插即用框架，利用动态演化的智能体参考图（ARG），通过屏蔽不合理激励（MUI）和非对称惩罚重分配（APR）实现细粒度信用分配。针对 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct 和 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 的大量实验表明，ProAS 全面提升了主流的基于群组的基线方法，达到新的最先进性能；在 ALFWorld 上的峰值成功率分别为 91.9% 和 94.3%，在 WebShop 上则分别为 66.7% 和 70.8%。此外，它将训练收敛速度最多提升了$2.44\times$，同时对不完美或蒸馏得到的 ARG 保持了较强的鲁棒性。代码：https://github.com/LINs-lab/ProAS

    Minkyu Kim and Baekseung Kim and Junhoo Lee and Jangho Kim and Nojun Kwak

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper proposes fused-space multi-sample diffusion generation with dynamic scheduling, supported by a geometric account of preserving individual trajectories. This offers substantial insight into throughput-oriented computation, but the abstract does not establish compositional generalization or mechanistic interpretability of learned representations.

    本文提出采用融合空间和动态调度的多样本扩散生成方法，并以几何视角说明如何保留各自的生成轨迹。这为面向吞吐量的计算提供了实质性见解，但摘要并未证明组合泛化能力或对已学习表征的机制可解释性。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Diffusion models achieve high-quality image generation but remain computationally expensive due to iterative denoising across many timesteps. Existing acceleration methods mainly reduce per-sample latency, but gains along this axis are becoming saturated. We instead explore an orthogonal throughput-oriented direction by processing multiple samples within a single denoising evaluation. To this end, we propose ManiFusion, a backbone-agnostic framework for multi-sample generation through fused-space computation. ManiFusion jointly processes multiple samples by fusing them before the denoising backbone and separating them afterward through unfusion. We provide a geometric perspective on how multiple samples can share a fused representation while retaining the information needed to guide their individual generation trajectories. To better align fusion allocation with denoising stages, ManiFusion uses Trajectory-Fusion Scheduling (TFS), which dynamically adjusts fusion factors throughout sampling. ManiFusion generalizes across diffusion families, including both U-Net and transformer backbones in pixel and latent spaces. We further show that ManiFusion composes with existing acceleration methods and reaches throughput regimes unattainable by prior approaches with minimal quality degradation.

    扩散模型能够生成高质量图像，但由于需要跨多个时间步反复去噪，计算成本仍然很高。现有加速方法主要降低单样本延迟，而这一方向的收益已逐渐趋于饱和。我们转而探索一个正交的、以吞吐量为导向的方向：在一次去噪评估中处理多个样本。为此，我们提出 ManiFusion，这是一种与骨干网络无关的框架，通过融合空间计算生成多个样本。ManiFusion 在去噪骨干网络之前融合多个样本，并在之后通过反融合将其分离，从而联合处理这些样本。我们从几何角度阐释多个样本如何共享融合表示，同时保留引导各自生成轨迹所需的信息。为使融合分配更好地适配去噪阶段，ManiFusion 使用轨迹融合调度（TFS），在采样过程中动态调整融合因子。ManiFusion 可泛化至多种扩散模型系列，包括像素空间和潜在空间中的 U-Net 与 transformer 骨干网络。我们还表明，ManiFusion 可与现有加速方法组合，并在图像质量几乎不下降的情况下达到先前方法无法实现的吞吐量水平。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper presents a robot-learning system that uses supervised play to gather data, learn a world model, and guide model-predictive control, with policy distillation through self-play. It substantially advances agent planning and learning systems, while compositional generalization and model interpretability are not addressed.

    本文提出一种机器人学习系统，利用监督式探索收集数据、学习世界模型并引导模型预测控制，同时通过自我博弈进行策略蒸馏。它显著推进了智能体规划与学习系统，而组合泛化和模型可解释性并未涉及。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    How can robots autonomously collect the contact-rich experience needed to learn dexterous manipulation? We present PlayPolicy: Dexterity from supervised play (DSP), a framework in which a robot learns a play policy from minutes of human play through behavior cloning, then deploys it autonomously to collect hours of interaction data to train a world model. During inference, the same play policy then guides model-predictive control (MPC) by proposing candidate action sequences for evaluation under the learned world model. To accelerate inference, we also introduce a method for distilling a closed-loop, goal-conditioned policy through self-play within the learned world model. We evaluate this framework on underactuated pushing and any-to-any in-hand pose reorientation with a multifingered hand, in simulation and real world. In real world experiment, our method outperforms hindsight behavior cloning by 69.6% in success rate and achieves comparable success to reinforcement learning with 490 times less interaction data. These results demonstrate that supervised play can autonomously collect interaction data, guide model-based planning, and enable policy learning without any task-specific demonstrations or sim-to-real transfer. Project page: https://play-policy.github.io/

    中文

    机器人如何自主收集学习灵巧操作所需的、涉及丰富接触的经验？我们提出 PlayPolicy：监督式探索下的灵巧操作（DSP），这是一个框架：机器人先通过行为克隆，利用几分钟的人类探索学习一种探索策略，然后自主部署该策略，收集数小时的交互数据来训练世界模型。在推理阶段，同一种探索策略会提出候选动作序列，供模型预测控制（MPC）在学习到的世界模型下评估，从而引导 MPC。为加快推理速度，我们还提出一种方法，在学习到的世界模型内通过自我博弈蒸馏闭环、目标条件策略。我们在欠驱动推挤任务和多指手中的任意到任意手内姿态重定向任务上，于模拟环境和真实世界中评估了该框架。在真实世界实验中，我们的方法成功率比事后行为克隆高 69.6%，并以少 490 倍的交互数据实现了与强化学习相当的成功率。这些结果表明，监督式探索可以自主收集交互数据、引导基于模型的规划，并在不需要任何特定任务示范或仿真到现实迁移的情况下实现策略学习。项目页面：https://play-policy.github.io/

    Where Prefill Expert Reduction Hurts MoE Models: A Few Prompt Tokens Carry Most of the Short-Answer F1 Loss

    预填充阶段减少专家会损害 MoE 模型的哪些能力：少数提示词元造成了大部分短答案 F1 损失

    Zhiyuan Wang, Han Wang, Shuo Zhang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Token, layer, and attention-path interventions localize how reducing routed experts damages short-answer behavior, and identify a transferable placement rule that preserves quality while reducing serving cost. This gives mechanistic evidence about MoE behavior and a substantial conditional-computation insight; the QA setting alone does not establish compositional or reasoning contributions.

    通过词元、层和注意力路径干预，本文定位了减少路由专家数量如何损害短答案表现，并提出一种可迁移的放置规则，在降低服务成本的同时保持质量。这为 MoE 行为提供了机制性证据，也对条件计算作出了重要见解；问答场景本身并不能证明其对组合性或推理作出了贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Running prompt tokens through fewer routed experts during prefill makes mixture-of-experts (MoE) serving cheaper, but what it damages has not been measured. We locate the damage with token-, layer- and attention-path interventions in four MoE families on short-answer question answering. At half the experts the F1 loss is mostly answer form: the model still finds the answer but no longer answers briefly. The loss is made at a few tokens: the two chat-template tokens before the answer in Qwen3-30B-A3B, and the first 8-32 tokens, where the instruction sits, in DeepSeek-V2-Lite. Keeping them at full experts removes most of the F1 loss and about half and a fifth of the increase in answer NLL. These tokens are not the familiar suspects: reduction leaves the first-token sink within 4%, and restoring super experts or massive activations recovers at most a quarter of the loss. On real prompts the localisation becomes a placement rule: with about 4% of tokens at full experts, putting them on the task interface keeps F1 within one point of the unmodified model, while the same budget scattered in the documents is about 3 points worse in both prespecified primary tests of this comparison. Time to first token falls about 14% on 11K-token prompts.

    中文

    在预填充阶段让提示词元经过更少的路由专家，可以降低混合专家（MoE）服务成本，但其造成的损害此前尚未得到测量。我们在四类 MoE 模型上，通过词元、层和注意力路径干预，定位了短答案问答中的损害。在专家数量减半时，F1 损失主要体现为答案形式问题：模型仍能找到答案，却不再简洁作答。损失集中在少数词元上：在 Qwen3-30B-A3B 中，是答案前的两个聊天模板词元；在 DeepSeek-V2-Lite 中，是承载指令的前 8-32 个词元。让这些词元使用完整数量的专家，可以消除大部分 F1 损失，以及答案 NLL 增幅的大约一半和五分之一。这些词元并非人们熟悉的可疑对象：减少专家数量后，首词元汇聚点的变化在 4% 以内；恢复超级专家或巨大激活，最多只能挽回四分之一的损失。在真实提示词上，这种定位结果转化为一种放置规则：约 4% 的词元使用完整数量的专家，将它们放在任务接口处，就能使 F1 保持在未修改模型的一分以内；而相同预算若分散在文档中，在本比较预先指定的两项主要测试中，F1 都会低约 3 分。对于长度为 11K 个词元的提示词，首词元生成时间降低约 14%。

    On the SPOT: Enhancing Speculative Decoding for Diffusion Language Models via Commit-Order Prediction

    聚焦 SPOT：通过提交顺序预测增强扩散语言模型的推测解码

    Eliezer Shlomi, Eliron Rahimi, Avi Mendelson, Chaim Baskin

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    SPOT learns commit-order prediction from a diffusion model’s output distributions and uses exact verification to reduce decoding passes, with transfer across models. This is a strong systems contribution in adaptive computation; proposing candidate continuations has only an incidental connection to compositionality, and the abstract does not study reasoning capability.

    SPOT 根据扩散模型的输出分布学习提交顺序预测，并通过精确验证减少解码运行次数，且能跨模型迁移。这是对自适应计算的重要系统贡献；提出候选后续内容与组合性的联系仅属附带，摘要也没有研究推理能力。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Diffusion language models (DLMs) promise parallel text generation, but in practice face an unresolved speed-quality trade-off. Exact decoding fills in only one masked position per model pass, while faster multi-token decoding schemes are lossy. Speculative decoding is the standard lossless acceleration for autoregressive models. However, it does not transfer directly to DLMs, which must choose both what to generate and where. We show that this order is the missing piece: the model's own predictions from the previous pass already give the right token at over $90\%$ of positions, but not which position comes next. We introduce Speculating Positions Order Trajectory (SPOT), a 0.62M-parameter model that reads only the target's output distributions, predicts this order and proposes a tree of candidate continuations, which the target verifies in a single pass by state equality. Coupled-noise match, which shares Gumbel noise between drafter and target, keeps this verification exact at any temperature. This approach also inspired us to introduce SPOT-Sets for dynamic threshold decoding, where a pass commits several positions: SPOT-Sets drafts whole commit sets together with their tokens. Our comprehensive experiments show that SPOT cuts target passes by up to $6.8\times$ and reaches up to $3.4\times$ the throughput of standard decoding on SDAR-8B, matching or beating the calibrated and training-free drafting baselines in every task and budget at $T=0$ and $T=1$. In addition, we show that SPOT's learned drafter transfers across models, demonstrating successful transfer across six different DLMs; with a light calibration, the SPOT-Sets drafter transfers as well. On top of dynamic threshold decoding, SPOT-Sets improves the throughput of SDAR-8B by 59% on average over the threshold decoder alone. Project page: https://eliezer318.github.io/SPOT-dLLM/

    中文

    扩散语言模型（DLM）有望实现并行文本生成，但实践中仍面临尚未解决的速度与质量权衡。精确解码每次模型运行只填充一个掩码位置，而更快的多词元解码方案会产生损失。推测解码是自回归模型的标准无损加速方法，但无法直接迁移到 DLM，因为 DLM 既要选择生成什么，也要选择生成位置。我们指出，缺失的关键正是这个顺序：模型根据上一次运行给出的预测，在超过$90\%$的位置上已经预测出了正确词元，但无法判断接下来应处理哪个位置。我们提出推测位置顺序轨迹（SPOT），这是一个拥有 0.62M 参数的模型，它只读取目标模型的输出分布，预测该顺序并提出候选后续内容树；目标模型通过单次运行进行状态相等性验证。耦合噪声匹配，即让草稿模型与目标模型共享 Gumbel 噪声，可使该验证在任意温度下保持精确。这一方法还启发我们为动态阈值解码提出 SPOT-Sets；在这种解码方式中，一次运行会提交多个位置，而 SPOT-Sets 会连同相应词元一起草拟整个提交集合。我们的全面实验表明，SPOT 最多可将目标模型运行次数减少$6.8\times$，并在 SDAR-8B 上达到标准解码吞吐量的最高$3.4\times$；在$T=0$和$T=1$下的每项任务与每个预算设置中，它都达到或超过经过校准和无需训练的草拟基线。此外，我们展示了 SPOT 学得的草稿模型可以跨模型迁移，成功迁移至六种不同的 DLM；经过轻量校准后，SPOT-Sets 草稿模型也可以迁移。在动态阈值解码之上，SPOT-Sets 相比单独使用阈值解码，平均将 SDAR-8B 的吞吐量提升了 59%。项目页面：https://eliezer318.github.io/SPOT-dLLM/

    P2N: Reusing Deep Representations for Greater Effective Depth

    P2N：复用深层表征以增加有效深度

    Yiqin Hao, Boyi Zeng, Zitong Wang, He Li, Shixiang Song, Feichen Song, Yifan Liu, Ran Tao, Bryan Dai, Zhouhan Lin

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    P2N reuses prior-token deep representations to extend effective computation across tokens at low decoding cost, and experiments report improved math reasoning. Its main contribution is an algorithmic change to computation that improves reasoning capability (Reasoning 4) and model computation efficiency (Systems 4); representation reuse alone does not investigate internal representation mechanisms (MechInterp 2), and the abstract does not address compositional generalization.

    P2N 复用先前令牌的深层表征，以较低的解码成本扩展令牌间的有效计算，并通过实验报告了数学推理能力的提升。其主要贡献是通过算法改变计算方式来提升推理能力（Reasoning 4）和模型计算效率（Systems 4）；仅复用表征并未研究内部表征机制（MechInterp 2），摘要也未涉及组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Mathematical problem solving and autonomous agents are increasingly important applications of language models, demanding stronger reasoning capabilities. Computational depth is a key resource for such reasoning, but adding model layers increases both training and inference costs, while test-time scaling incurs substantial additional inference computation. We introduce P2N (Previous to Next), which reuses the previous token's deep representations, already available during generation, to increase effective computational depth with negligible decoding overhead. Specifically, P2N adds the previous token's deep hidden state to the current token's shallow representation, allowing subsequent layers to build on previously completed deep computation. This recurrence extends effective computational depth across tokens, while introducing only a single vector addition per decoding step. We train the recurrence using parallel Jacobi updates restricted to a middle-layer core. Experiments with Qwen-style models show that, at 1.5B parameters, P2N improves GSM8K accuracy by over 10 percentage points under both zero-shot and few-shot prompting, with nearly unchanged decoding latency. The benefits also extend to language modeling and average performance on general downstream benchmarks. on general downstream benchmarks.

    中文

    数学问题求解和自主智能体正日益成为语言模型的重要应用，需要更强的推理能力。计算深度是这类推理的重要资源，但增加模型层数会提高训练和推理成本，而测试时扩展则会带来大量额外推理计算。我们提出 P2N（Previous to Next），复用生成过程中已可获得的前一个令牌的深层表征，以极低的解码开销增加有效计算深度。具体而言，P2N 将前一个令牌的深层隐藏状态加到当前令牌的浅层表征上，使后续层能够建立在先前已完成的深层计算之上。这种递归在令牌间扩展了有效计算深度，每个解码步骤仅引入一次向量加法。我们使用并行 Jacobi 更新来训练这一递归，并将其限制在中间层核心区域。针对 Qwen 风格模型的实验表明，在参数量为 1.5B 时，P2N 在零样本和少样本提示下都使 GSM8K 准确率提高了 10 个百分点以上，而解码延迟几乎不变。这些收益也扩展到了语言建模和一般下游基准的平均表现。对于一般下游基准的平均表现。

    Dual-Slot: From Serial Loops to Parallel Slots in Language Models

    Dual-Slot：从语言模型中的串行循环到并行槽位

    Yiqin Hao, Zitong Wang, Boyi Zeng, He Li, Shixiang Song, Feichen Song, Yifan Liu, Ran Tao, Bryan Dai, Zhouhan Lin

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Dual-Slot’s main contribution is an architecture that shifts looped computation into parallel latent and prediction slots to reduce decoding latency while retaining language-model performance. This is a strong Systems contribution through computation organization; gains on GSM8K are evidence of task performance, not a direct advance in reasoning mechanisms, and the abstract does not establish interpretability or compositional generalization insight.

    Dual-Slot 的主要贡献是一种将循环计算转移到并行潜在槽位和预测槽位的架构，在保持语言模型性能的同时降低解码延迟。通过重新组织计算，它对系统领域作出了重要贡献；GSM8K 上的提升是任务性能的证据，并非对推理机制的直接推进；摘要也未体现其在可解释性或组合泛化方面的洞见。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Looped language models increase computational depth by repeatedly applying shared layers, offering a way to improve model quality without adding parameters. However, sequential dependencies between loop iterations increase autoregressive decoding latency. We introduce Dual-Slot, an architecture that reorganizes serial looped computation into parallel latent and prediction slots. Rather than waiting for the current token's latent computation to finish, the prediction slot combines the previous token's deep latent state with the current representation, while the latent slot produces a state for the next decoding step. This shifts the latent dependency across adjacent tokens, replacing two sequential module invocations with a single paired invocation while preserving standard autoregressive generation. To preserve token-level parallelism during training, we use a small number of Jacobi iterations to refine latent states across the sequence in parallel. Experiments on Qwen-style dense and mixture-of-experts (MoE) models show consistent improvements in language modeling and average downstream accuracy. On the 1B dense model, Dual-Slot reduces Pile validation perplexity from 7.25 to 7.00 and improves average five-shot accuracy across nine task configurations by 2.26 percentage points. After supervised fine-tuning, it improves zero-shot GSM8K accuracy by 5.83 and 3.49 percentage points for the 1B dense and A0.6B MoE models, respectively. Across the evaluated batch sizes, Dual-Slot retains 93.1-96.5% of vanilla decoding throughput for the dense model and 98.1-99.6% for the MoE model.

    中文

    循环语言模型通过反复应用共享层来增加计算深度，因此无需增加参数即可提升模型质量。然而，循环迭代之间的顺序依赖会增加自回归解码延迟。我们提出 Dual-Slot，这种架构将串行循环计算重新组织为并行的潜在槽位和预测槽位。预测槽位无需等待当前 token 的潜在计算完成，而是将前一个 token 的深层潜在状态与当前表示结合起来；与此同时，潜在槽位为下一解码步骤生成状态。这样，潜在依赖关系便转移到相邻 token 之间，在保留标准自回归生成的同时，将两次顺序模块调用替换为一次成对调用。为了在训练期间保留 token 级并行性，我们使用少量 Jacobi 迭代，在整个序列上并行细化潜在状态。在 Qwen 风格的稠密模型和混合专家（MoE）模型上的实验表明，语言建模效果和下游任务平均准确率均得到稳定提升。在 1B 稠密模型上，Dual-Slot 将 Pile 验证集困惑度从 7.25 降至 7.00，并使九种任务配置的平均五样本准确率提高 2.26 个百分点。经过监督微调后，它使 1B 稠密模型和 A0.6B MoE 模型的 GSM8K 零样本准确率分别提高 5.83 和 3.49 个百分点。在所评估的各批量大小下，Dual-Slot 保留了稠密模型原版解码吞吐量的 93.1–96.5%，以及 MoE 模型的 98.1–99.6%。

    Truncated Reasoning Under a Budget: Evaluating System-1 Models as Decision-Makers

    预算约束下的截断推理：将 System-1 模型作为决策者进行评估

    Zhongyin Wang, Zhaoqian Xue, Junting Mu, Haozheng Liu, Ye Yuan, Haolun Wu, Lingyao Li

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper evaluates using a decision model to answer from truncated reasoning and reduce reasoning cost, a substantial contribution to reasoning capability and efficiency. Its cost-aware decision policy has a systems connection, but the abstract does not describe a new computation or agent architecture, so Systems is partial.

    本文评估了利用决策模型根据截断推理作答并降低推理成本的方法，这是对推理能力和效率的重要贡献。其成本感知决策策略与系统领域有关，但摘要没有描述新的计算方法或智能体架构，因此对系统领域的贡献有限。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language models (LLMs) often generate more reasoning tokens than needed. Limiting the reasoning budget reduces cost, but forcing an answer from an incomplete trace can hurt accuracy. System-1 decision models select among candidate options without producing a reasoning response. We evaluate Jev as a decision reader of truncated reasoning across seven LLM reasoners and five multiple-choice benchmarks (35 pairs). Jev achieves higher mean accuracy than forced answering at tested budgets from 500 to 16,000 tokens, including the estimated costs of reasoning and answering. At a 1,500-token budget, it improves accuracy by 4.1 pp overall and 8.6 pp on truncated questions, with significant gains in 17 pairs under Holm-corrected bootstrap tests. Offline replay estimates 34.5% of the full-run cost, with a 1.13 pp accuracy loss. A policy selected on training folds saves 71.3% of the estimated full-run cost on held-out folds, with a 0.58 pp accuracy loss. We also find that Jev shows strong question-only accuracy, exceeding 500-token forced answering on average (68.0% vs. 65.5%), although this advantage varies by benchmark. These findings suggest that System-1 decision models can complement LLM reasoning and reduce the need for costly reasoning completion.

    中文

    大语言模型（LLM）经常生成超出所需的推理词元。限制推理预算可以降低成本，但强制模型根据不完整的推理轨迹作答可能损害准确率。System-1 决策模型无需生成推理回答即可在候选选项中作出选择。我们评估了 Jev 作为截断推理的决策读取器，在七种 LLM 推理器和五个多项选择基准（共 35 组配对）上进行测试。在测试过的 500 至 16,000 个词元预算下，Jev 的平均准确率高于强制作答，并计入了推理和作答的估计成本。在 1,500 个词元的预算下，它使整体准确率提高 4.1 个百分点，并使截断问题上的准确率提高 8.6 个百分点；经过 Holm 校正的自助法检验显示，35 组配对中有 17 组显著提升。离线重放估计显示，其成本为完整运行成本的 34.5%，准确率损失为 1.13 个百分点。基于训练折选择的策略在留出折上节省了估计完整运行成本的 71.3%，准确率损失为 0.58 个百分点。我们还发现，Jev 仅凭问题作答时准确率较高，平均超过 500 词元预算下的强制作答（68.0% 对 65.5%），不过这一优势随基准而异。这些发现表明，System-1 决策模型可以补充 LLM 推理，并减少对高成本推理补全的需求。

    EmbodiedWorld-200K: Toward Embodied World Agents via Embodied-Planning Dataset and Interactive World Models

    EmbodiedWorld-200K：通过具身规划数据集与交互式世界模型迈向具身世界智能体

    X. Feng, J. Tang, Z. Lin, L. Chen, S. Shao, Q. Lu, K. Huang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The work provides a large embodied-planning dataset and interactive world-model RL training that improves planning and transfer to unseen scenes. Generalization through planning is a substantive but secondary compositional connection; the main contributions concern reasoning and embodied agent training.

    这项工作提供了一个大型具身规划数据集，以及交互式世界模型 RL 训练，从而提升规划能力并改善向未见场景的迁移。通过规划实现泛化是一个有实质意义但次要的组合式关联；其主要贡献涉及推理和具身智能体训练。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Building embodied agents that can perceive, reason, and act across diverse 3D worlds is a central research direction toward artificial general intelligence. Yet most existing work remains confined to specific tasks in a single scene and transfers poorly to new environments, leaving general embodied agents for open-world settings under-explored. We refer to such agents as Embodied World Agents (EWAs), whose defining property is the ability to understand diverse visual environments and execute general actions in open-world conditions. To advance EWA research, we study open-world embodied navigation-planning and release EmbodiedWorld-200K, a large-scale dataset of over 200K samples spanning diverse scenes. Each example is equipped with multi-level annotations, ranging from low-level camera-motion trajectories to high-level semantic instructions. The dataset also provides unified evaluation splits and task-specific metrics, supporting offline pretraining and fair evaluation of EWAs. Beyond offline supervision, a defining characteristic of an EWA is its interaction with the environment; training solely on offline data is therefore insufficient, especially for generalizing to scenes not covered in the training distribution. Building dedicated real interactive environments, however, is often prohibitively expensive. To address this, we propose a novel training scheme that employs a video world model as a low-cost environment proxy and performs interactive reinforcement-learning (RL) post-training of the EWA within it. Empirically, pretraining on EmbodiedWorld-200K substantially improves the open-world embodied planning ability of the EWA, and further RL post-training inside a world model yields clear gains on out-of-distribution scenes. The dataset, baseline checkpoints, and training and evaluation code are available at https://xiaokunfeng.github.io/EmbodiedWorld-200K/.

    中文

    构建能够在多样化 3D 世界中感知、推理和行动的具身智能体，是迈向通用人工智能的一项核心研究方向。然而，现有大多数工作仍局限于单一场景中的特定任务，迁移到新环境时表现不佳，使得面向开放世界场景的通用具身智能体仍未得到充分探索。我们将这类智能体称为具身世界智能体（EWA），其定义性特征是在开放世界条件下理解多样化视觉环境并执行通用动作的能力。为推进 EWA 研究，我们研究开放世界具身导航规划，并发布 EmbodiedWorld-200K，这是一个涵盖多样化场景、包含超过 200K 个样本的大规模数据集。每个样本都配有多层级标注，范围从低层级的相机运动轨迹到高层级的语义指令。该数据集还提供统一的评估划分和特定任务指标，以支持 EWA 的离线预训练和公平评估。除离线监督之外，EWA 的一个定义性特征是与环境交互；因此，仅使用离线数据训练并不足够，尤其是在泛化到训练分布未涵盖的场景时。然而，构建专门的真实交互环境往往成本高得令人难以承受。为此，我们提出一种新颖的训练方案，使用视频世界模型作为低成本的环境代理，并在其中对 EWA 进行交互式强化学习（RL）后训练。实证结果表明，在 EmbodiedWorld-200K 上预训练可显著提升 EWA 的开放世界具身规划能力，而在世界模型中进一步进行 RL 后训练，则能在分布外场景上带来明显提升。数据集、基线检查点以及训练和评估代码可在 https://xiaokunfeng.github.io/EmbodiedWorld-200K/ 获取。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper proposes and analyzes an inference-time observation attack on safe multi-agent reinforcement-learning policies, including a bound on induced safety cost and benchmark evidence. This substantially informs multi-agent behavior and vulnerability, while its connection to reasoning is incidental because the work targets control-policy safety rather than reasoning mechanisms.

    本文提出并分析了一种针对安全多智能体强化学习策略的推理时观测攻击，包括对诱发安全成本的上界分析和基准实验结果。这为理解多智能体行为与脆弱性提供了重要信息；由于研究对象是控制策略安全而非推理机制，它与推理的联系仅属附带。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Safe Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (SMARL) aims to learn cooperative control policies under prescribed safety constraints. Al- though existing SMARL methods focus on enforcing safety during policy optimization, their vulnerability remains largely unexplored. This paper investigates inference-time observation attacks against SMARL, where an adversary perturbs the observations of a subset of agents, thereby altering the actions produced by their policies. We propose MinMax Attack, an attack framework that jointly selects adversarial target actions for compromised agents while accounting for the Cooperative Resistance of benign agents. We further derive a bound on the induced safety cost and characterize its relation- ship with the Compromised-Agent Budget and the Perturbation Budget. Experiments across multiple safety-critical multi-agent benchmarks and representative state-of-the-art SMARL algorithms show that MinMax Attack induces substantially higher safety costs than existing attack baselines while preserving task reward, thereby reducing its detectability and achieving both attack effectiveness and stealthiness.

    安全多智能体强化学习（SMARL）旨在预设安全约束下学习协作控制策略。尽管现有 SMARL 方法侧重于在策略优化期间保障安全，其脆弱性却基本未被探索。本文研究针对 SMARL 的推理时观测攻击：攻击者扰动部分智能体的观测，从而改变其策略产生的动作。我们提出 MinMax Attack，这是一种攻击框架，它在考虑良性智能体的协作抵抗力的同时，为受攻击智能体联合选择对抗性目标动作。我们进一步推导了诱发安全成本的上界，并刻画它与受攻击智能体预算及扰动预算之间的关系。在多个安全关键型多智能体基准和具有代表性的最先进 SMARL 算法上的实验表明，与现有攻击基线相比，MinMax Attack 会诱发高得多的安全成本，同时保留任务奖励，从而降低其可检测性，并同时实现攻击有效性与隐蔽性。

    从比较到选择：增强采用强化学习训练的指针网络在容量约束车辆路径问题上的跨尺度泛化

    The paper analyzes cross-scale generalization in reinforcement-learned Pointer Networks and proposes context aggregation and model selection to improve transfer across CVRP sizes, including unseen sizes. This is a substantial contribution to generalization across problem scales, while routing performance and reinforcement learning alone provide only a partial connection to reasoning and systems, and no interpretability insight.

    本文分析了采用强化学习训练的指针网络在不同 CVRP 规模之间的跨尺度泛化，并提出上下文聚合和模型选择方法，以改善包括未见规模在内的规模迁移。这是对跨问题规模泛化的重要贡献；路径规划表现和强化学习本身与推理及系统领域只有有限关联，也未提供可解释性方面的见解。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Vehicle routing in delivery and logistics remains challenging as the number of clients varies. Classical approaches based on mixed-integer programming and heuristics can scale poorly or require problem-specific design, motivating learning-based alternatives. Reinforcement learning is particularly promising, provided a single policy can generalise across problem sizes without retraining. Although attention-based Pointer Networks are inherently size-agnostic, their solution quality degrades under both upscaling and downscaling. Using the Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem (CVRP) as a controlled proxy, we investigate this degradation and identify three contributing factors: shifts in node density, attention dispersion, and dilution of the mean-pooled graph context. We systematically compare architecture-wide, encoder-side, and decoder-side modifications to address these limitations and propose a learned, permutation-invariant graph-context aggregation mechanism, implemented as a weighted average and as Set2Set. Results reveal distinct requirements for transfer in each direction: entropy-based attention scaling reduces the CVRP20-to-CVRP100 performance gap by 1.41 percentage points, while the proposed aggregation methods achieve the largest improvement on the more challenging CVRP100-to-CVRP20 transfer, approximately 0.9 percentage points. Exploiting this complementarity, we introduce an approach selector that chooses the best model for each training-target size pair. The selector reduces cost relative to the reference model across all nine seen train-test pairs and eight of nine pairs involving unseen sizes (CVRP35, CVRP75, and CVRP200), achieving improvements of up to 3.2%.

    随着客户数量变化，配送与物流中的车辆路径规划仍然面临挑战。基于混合整数规划和启发式算法的经典方法可能扩展性较差，或需要针对具体问题进行设计，因此促使人们探索基于学习的替代方案。只要单一策略能够无需重新训练便泛化到不同问题规模，强化学习就尤其有前景。尽管基于注意力的指针网络在结构上不受规模限制，其解的质量在问题规模增大和缩小时都会下降。我们以容量约束车辆路径问题（CVRP）作为受控代理任务，研究这种退化，并确定了三个促成因素：节点密度变化、注意力分散，以及均值池化图上下文的信息稀释。我们系统比较了整体架构、编码器侧和解码器侧的修改，以应对这些局限，并提出一种学习得到的、排列不变的图上下文聚合机制，分别通过加权平均和 Set2Set 实现。结果显示，两个迁移方向的需求各不相同：基于熵的注意力缩放将 CVRP20 到 CVRP100 的性能差距缩小了 1.41 个百分点；而在更具挑战性的 CVRP100 到 CVRP20 迁移中，所提出的聚合方法带来了最大提升，约为 0.9 个百分点。利用这种互补性，我们引入一种方法选择器，为每组训练规模与目标规模组合选择最佳模型。与参考模型相比，该选择器在全部九组已见训练测试组合，以及涉及未见规模（CVRP35、CVRP75 和 CVRP200）的九组组合中的八组降低了成本，最高提升达 3.2%。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The work develops a structured harness-diversity training method for agentic reinforcement learning and shows improved transfer to unseen harness combinations and external harnesses. Its central contribution advances compositional generalization across execution settings and agent-system design; RL is used to train policies, but the abstract does not establish a specific reasoning mechanism.

    这项工作为智能体强化学习开发了一种结构化的 Harness 多样性训练方法，并展示了其在迁移到未见 Harness 组合和外部 Harness 时的提升。其核心贡献在于推进跨执行设置的组合泛化和智能体系统设计；RL 用于训练策略，但摘要并未确立某种特定的推理机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Agent harnesses have become a central component of modern agentic systems, shaping how models use tools, manage context, and coordinate long-horizon interaction. Realizing the benefits of these harnesses depends on how effectively the underlying model can make use of them, motivating reinforcement learning directly through the harness. While recent efforts have explored harness diversification to reduce specialization to particular execution settings, how to systematically construct and organize harness diversity for cross-harness generalization remains insufficiently understood. This work studies Harness Scaling as a distinct scaling dimension for agentic RL, focusing on structured variation in how policies execute and interact with the same underlying task and environment. Concretely, we construct a factorized harness space, select a compact training subset with balanced factorial coverage, and organize cross-harness training through locality-aware task assignment. Across multiple benchmarks, model scales, and RL algorithms, Harness Scaling consistently improves generalization to unseen harness combinations. Moreover, policies trained through structured white-box harness variation transfer effectively to unseen external black-box harnesses, outperforming policies trained through a single complex black-box harness. These results establish harness diversity as a meaningful scaling dimension for agentic RL and highlight the importance of how this diversity is organized for cross-harness generalization.

    中文

    智能体 Harness 已成为现代智能体系统的核心组成部分，影响模型如何使用工具、管理上下文以及协调长时程交互。要实现这些 Harness 的优势，取决于底层模型能否有效利用它们，因此有必要直接通过 Harness 进行强化学习。近期工作已探索 Harness 多样化，以减少模型对特定执行设置的专门化，但如何系统地构建和组织 Harness 多样性以实现跨 Harness 泛化，仍未得到充分理解。本文将 Harness 扩展作为智能体 RL 的一个独立扩展维度进行研究，重点关注策略如何执行并与相同底层任务和环境交互的结构化变化。具体而言，我们构建了一个因子化的 Harness 空间，选取具有均衡因子覆盖的紧凑训练子集，并通过具备局部性感知的任务分配来组织跨 Harness 训练。在多个基准、模型规模和 RL 算法上，Harness 扩展始终能提升对未见 Harness 组合的泛化能力。此外，通过结构化白盒 Harness 变化训练的策略，能够有效迁移到未见过的外部黑盒 Harness，其表现优于通过单一复杂黑盒 Harness 训练的策略。这些结果确立了 Harness 多样性是智能体 RL 的一个有意义的扩展维度，并凸显了组织这种多样性对于跨 Harness 泛化的重要性。

    Yan Wang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    TraceForge generates student-style reasoning traces and trains a critic to select authentic-looking traces, with coding benchmark gains; this directly advances reasoning-data training, though the abstract measures authenticity rather than correctness. Student-style traces are an incidental connection to composition, with no substantive compositional or internal-mechanism contribution; distillation alone does not make this a systems paper.

    TraceForge生成学生模型风格的推理轨迹，并训练判别器挑选看起来真实的轨迹，同时在编程基准上取得提升；这直接推进了推理数据训练，不过摘要衡量的是真实性，而非正确性。学生风格轨迹与组合能力只有偶然联系，没有实质性的组合性或内部机制贡献；仅凭蒸馏并不能使其成为系统论文。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Using an LLM to generate training data for another is among the most general ways to train one, and it remains common practice. Some frontier teams have closed that route for their own models: what comes back is an answer, or a short summary, without the detailed reasoning trace behind it. That is a little ironic: they were themselves built on distilling human knowledge, and distilling an open-source model is still entirely routine; the restriction applies to their own outputs alone. Recent work recovers the hidden reasoning by replaying encrypted blocks across models. It somehow works, but it breaks the providers' terms of service, so it is not something a product can be built on long-term. We built the alternative. We take the context and the teacher's answer as input, and generate the reasoning trace ourselves, in the style of the student's own model family. Training is two-stage, supervised and then adversarial: a generator learns to regenerate the family's own reasoning traces from their context and answer, and a critic learns how real a reasoning trace looks. Applied to a teacher's answer, the generator writes one in the family's style. An independent judge rates how likely traces are to be genuine on a scale from 0 to 1: ours average 0.68, real traces 0.66, and traces selected by the critic from four candidates 0.82. These are authenticity scores, not correctness rates. We test the idea on five benchmarks with everything else held fixed. On general tasks the five training corpora are about the same; on coding, the generated reasoning beats Fable 5's own thinking content. With the same 5,000 questions and the same teacher answers, HumanEval+ improves by 3.7 points and MBPP+ by 7.1 at the final checkpoint, and the MBPP+ lead holds at every checkpoint. We suspect that reasoning written in the student's family style is easier for it to learn from.

    中文

    使用LLM为另一个模型生成训练数据，是最通用的训练方式之一，至今仍很常见。一些前沿团队已经关闭了自家模型的这条途径：返回的内容是答案或简短摘要，而没有其背后的详细推理轨迹。这有些讽刺：这些模型本身就是通过蒸馏人类知识构建的，而蒸馏开源模型仍是完全常规的做法；限制只适用于它们自己的输出。近期工作通过在模型间重放加密块来恢复隐藏推理。这种方法不知何故奏效了，但它违反了提供商的服务条款，因此无法长期用于构建产品。我们构建了另一种方案。我们将上下文和教师模型的答案作为输入，并自行生成推理轨迹，采用学生模型所属模型家族的风格。训练分为两个阶段：先监督训练，再进行对抗训练。生成器学习根据该家族的上下文和答案重新生成其自身的推理轨迹；判别器则学习判断一条推理轨迹看起来有多真实。给定教师模型的答案后，生成器会用该家族的风格写出推理轨迹。一位独立评审会按0到1的尺度评估轨迹看起来是真实内容的可能性：我们生成的轨迹平均得分为0.68，真实轨迹为0.66，判别器从四个候选中选出的轨迹为0.82。这些是真实性分数，而非正确率。我们在其他条件均保持不变的情况下，用五个基准测试这一想法。在一般任务上，五种训练语料的表现大致相同；在编程任务上，生成的推理优于Fable 5自带的思维内容。使用相同的5,000个问题和相同的教师答案，在最终检查点上，HumanEval+提升3.7分，MBPP+提升7.1分；MBPP+的领先优势在每个检查点上都保持不变。我们推测，采用学生模型所属家族风格撰写的推理更容易被它学会。

    Haolin Liu, Chen-Yu Wei, Julian Zimmert

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper develops minimax guarantees and algorithms for online and offline reverse-KL policy distillation, addressing how feedback and trajectories affect learning efficiency. This substantially advances training for model problem-solving, while its policy framing alone offers only an incidental connection to agent systems and no substantive interpretability or compositional contribution.

    该论文提出了在线和离线反向 KL 策略蒸馏的极小极大保证与算法，探讨反馈和轨迹如何影响学习效率。这实质性地推动了模型问题求解能力的训练；但仅凭策略表述与智能体系统的关联只是附带的，且论文没有对可解释性或组合能力作出实质性贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Reverse Kullback-Leibler (KL) distillation has shown empirical promise for training language models, but its statistical guarantees and limits remain poorly understood. In particular, the effects of two design choices remain unclear: Does access to the teacher's full action distribution provide an advantage over observing only the probability it assigns to the sampled action? Must training trajectories come from the student (online distillation), or can teacher-generated trajectories (offline distillation) suffice? Our work takes a first step toward understanding the theory underlying these questions. We study the sample complexity of online reverse-KL distillation under two feedback models: the teacher reveals either its full action distribution or only the probability of the student-generated action. We establish minimax bounds for the former and show that substantially more data may be required for the latter. In contrast, offline reverse-KL distillation can attain the same minimax rate whether the teacher reveals its full distribution or only its probability of the teacher-generated action. The key distinction is that teacher-generated actions themselves reveal the teacher's preferences, while queries at student-selected actions can leave those preferences unobserved. This highlights an additional statistical challenge for online distillation compared to offline distillation. These statistical guarantees do not follow simply from optimizing standard distillation objectives: our lower bounds show that common online objectives can fail when candidates are evaluated only on past student-generated trajectories. We develop trajectory-loss and importance-ratio truncation techniques together with policy-space learning to achieve optimal online distillation guarantees.

    中文

    反向 Kullback-Leibler（KL）蒸馏在训练语言模型方面已显示出实证潜力，但其统计保证和局限仍未得到充分理解。尤其是，两种设计选择的影响尚不明确：获得教师的完整动作分布，是否比只观察教师赋予采样动作的概率更有优势？训练轨迹必须来自学生（在线蒸馏），还是教师生成的轨迹（离线蒸馏）也足够？我们的工作初步探讨了这些问题背后的理论。我们研究了两种反馈模型下在线反向 KL 蒸馏的样本复杂度：教师要么揭示完整动作分布，要么只揭示学生生成动作的概率。我们为前一种情形建立了极小极大界，并证明后一种情形可能需要多得多的数据。相比之下，无论教师揭示完整分布，还是只揭示教师生成动作的概率，离线反向 KL 蒸馏都能达到相同的极小极大速率。关键区别在于，教师生成的动作本身会揭示教师的偏好，而针对学生所选动作的查询可能无法观察到这些偏好。这凸显了在线蒸馏相较于离线蒸馏面临的额外统计挑战。这些统计保证并非仅通过优化标准蒸馏目标就能获得：我们的下界表明，当候选模型仅在过去由学生生成的轨迹上接受评估时，常见的在线目标可能会失效。我们提出轨迹损失和重要性比率截断技术，并结合策略空间学习，以实现最优的在线蒸馏保证。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    AI agents often find tools by searching their documentation. Agents that share a tool catalog can also pool usage examples: past requests, each tagged with the tool that handled it. We ask what pooling does to tools no agent has used yet. Adding each usage example to the search index as an extra entry for its tool (folding) helps tools that have examples, but on two of three catalogs it sharply lowers how often a needed unused tool reaches the top five results; on StableToolBench with our main embedding model, the share falls from 73 to 40 percent of queries. When the extra entries hold documentation from other tools instead of requests, the loss is much smaller, though differences in content or writing style could also explain this. We introduce ZoE (Z-scores over Evidence), a scoring rule that scores the documentation and the usage of a tool separately, so a tool without usage keeps its documentation score. On all three catalogs and with both embedding models we tested, ZoE retrieves unused tools more often than a router that reserves result slots for usage matches. With our main embedding model, the router retrieves more of the other tools on two catalogs, and in post hoc comparisons a simpler rule that adds a constant to the scores of tools with usage shows no detected difference from ZoE on unused tools. For five simulated agents on one catalog, folding lowered retrieval of unused tools for every agent; with ZoE no average drop was detected, though some agents still lost. Evaluations of pooled agent experience should report tools no agent has used separately from the average.

    AI 智能体通常通过搜索工具文档来查找工具。共享工具目录的智能体也可以汇集使用示例：过去的请求，每个请求都标注了处理它的工具。我们研究汇集示例会如何影响尚未被任何智能体使用过的工具。将每个使用示例作为其对应工具的额外条目加入搜索索引（即折叠纳入）有助于检索拥有示例的工具，但在三个目录中的两个上，它会大幅降低所需的未使用工具出现在前五条结果中的频率；在 StableToolBench 上使用我们的主嵌入模型时，这一比例从 73% 的查询降至 40%。如果额外条目包含的是其他工具的文档而非请求，损失会小得多，不过内容或写作风格上的差异也可能解释这一现象。我们提出 ZoE（基于证据的 Z 分数），这是一种分别对工具文档和使用情况评分的规则，因此没有使用记录的工具仍保留其文档得分。在我们测试的全部三个目录和两种嵌入模型上，与为使用匹配预留结果名额的路由器相比，ZoE 更常检索到未使用工具。使用我们的主嵌入模型时，路由器在两个目录上能检索到更多其他工具；事后比较还发现，在工具得分上为有使用记录的工具加上常数这一更简单规则，与 ZoE 在未使用工具上的表现没有检测到差异。在一个目录上对五个模拟智能体进行的实验中，折叠纳入使每个智能体对未使用工具的检索率都下降；使用 ZoE 时未检测到平均下降，尽管部分智能体仍有损失。对智能体经验汇集效果的评估应将任何智能体都未使用过的工具单独报告，而不能只报告平均值。

    Learning What to Ask for Tomorrow: Active Preference Acquisition for Long-Term Personalized Web Agents

    明日该问什么：面向长期个性化网络代理的主动偏好获取

    Yiqi Wang, Zizhi Zeng, Jiaqi Zhang, Yiqun Duan, Mingkai Zheng, Taotao Cai

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper defines a prospective utility framework for acquiring preferences in personalized agents and evaluates budgeted questioning over future tasks, a substantial contribution to agent memory and interaction design. Reuse across task families has a limited compositional connection, while the focus is preference acquisition rather than reasoning or internal mechanisms.

    本文为个性化代理中的偏好获取定义了一种前瞻效用框架，并评估了针对未来任务的预算约束提问，这是对代理记忆和交互设计的一项重要贡献。跨任务族的复用与组合性只有有限关联，而本文聚焦于偏好获取，而非推理或内部机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Web agents increasingly serve the same user across repeated online tasks such as booking travel, shopping, and scheduling, so their long-term usefulness depends on how well they know the user's preferences. Passive memory and personalization methods cannot obtain preferences the user never reveals, and clarification methods that value a question by its benefit to the current task overlook the benefit of reusing the answer in later tasks. We study Active Preference Acquisition (APA): which missing preferences are worth the cost of asking? We define the Prospective Personalization Value (PPV) of a missing preference as its expected cumulative utility gain over future tasks minus the effort and disclosure-risk cost of asking, and select questions under a per-interaction budget. We characterize when cumulative reuse justifies acquisition despite insufficient single-task benefit, and evaluate this regime with an initial-profile diagnostic. APA computes the counterfactual gain of each candidate preference on public task prototypes with the agent's own task solver and aggregates it by the expected reuse of each task family. We evaluate it on ActiveWebPref, a controlled longitudinal benchmark with hidden but queryable user profiles and exact task utilities. At a horizon of 20 tasks, 34.4% of budget-feasible valuable missing preferences are amortization-dependent; APA acquires 80.3% of them, whereas current-task value of information acquires 5.1%. Under per-user asking-cost caps matched to APA's realized expenditure, APA achieves higher net utility than four heuristic selection baselines. In our cost setting, asking about every unknown preference yields lower net utility than not asking, while APA recovers 84.2% of its utility gain with 27.6% of its questions. The value of acquiring a user preference should account for its reuse across future tasks, not only its benefit to the task at hand.

    中文

    网络代理越来越多地在旅行预订、购物和日程安排等重复在线任务中持续服务同一用户，因此其长期效用取决于对用户偏好的了解程度。被动记忆和个性化方法无法获取用户从未透露的偏好，而那些按问题对当前任务的收益来评估问题价值的澄清方法，则忽略了在后续任务中重复利用答案的好处。我们研究主动偏好获取（APA）：哪些缺失的偏好值得付出询问成本？我们将缺失偏好的前瞻个性化价值（PPV）定义为该偏好在未来任务中带来的预期累积效用增益，减去询问所需的精力成本和信息披露风险成本，并在每次交互的预算约束下选择问题。我们刻画了在单个任务收益不足时，何种情况下累积复用仍足以证明获取偏好的合理性，并通过初始档案诊断评估这一情形。APA 使用代理自身的任务求解器，在公开任务原型上计算每项候选偏好的反事实增益，并根据各任务族的预期复用情况进行汇总。我们在 ActiveWebPref 上评估该方法。这是一个受控的纵向基准，包含隐藏但可查询的用户档案以及精确的任务效用。在 20 个任务的时间跨度内，预算允许且有价值的缺失偏好中，有 34.4% 的获取价值依赖于成本摊销；APA 获取了其中的 80.3%，而按当前任务价值信息获取的方法仅获取了 5.1%。在按 APA 实际支出设定的用户级询问成本上限下，APA 的净效用高于四种启发式选择基线。在我们的成本设定中，询问所有未知偏好所带来的净效用低于完全不询问；而 APA 仅用 27.6% 的问题就实现了其效用增益的 84.2%。获取用户偏好的价值应考虑该偏好在未来任务中的复用，而不应只考虑它对当前任务的益处。

    Jiening Siow, Amy Xin, Junjie Wang, Ziyu Tang, Zijun Yao, Yunjia Qi, Fanjin Zhang, Lei Hou, Jie Tang, Juanzi Li

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

This substantially concerns agent behavior and runtime control, while its reasoning connection is incidental to the setting and it offers no stated insight into reasoning mechanisms or compositionality.

    RIDAR 为自主智能体轨迹中的研究诚信违规提供了分类体系、检测框架和运行时干预框架。这项工作主要关注智能体行为和运行时控制；其与推理的联系仅源于应用场景，且没有明确揭示推理机制或组合性。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Autonomous research agents are increasingly used to automate large portions of scientific research, yet they are prone to research integrity violations (RIVs): behaviors that compromise the validity, reproducibility, or faithfulness of the research process. We present RIDAR, a framework for automated RIV detection and runtime intervention. First, we introduce RIVT, a comprehensive taxonomy of 14 RIV types spanning the full research lifecycle. Building on RIVT, we present RIDAR-post-hoc, a framework to detect RIVs within agent trajectories. RIDAR-post-hoc achieves 85.2% F1 performance on RIV-Gold, a benchmark for RIV detection with 60 expert-annotated trajectories. Applying RIDAR-post-hoc to RIV-Wild, a dataset of 300 agent trajectories across 50 distinct research tasks, we detect 3,964 RIV instances in 99.7% of trajectories, revealing the prevalence of RIVs in current agents. Finally, we present RIDAR-runtime, a framework for dynamically detecting and correcting RIVs during agent runtime. RIDAR-runtime effectively reduces agent RIVs remaining at task completion by 36.8%. We will release our code and data to facilitate future research.

    中文

    自主研究智能体日益广泛地用于自动化科学研究中的大量工作，但它们容易出现研究诚信违规（RIV）：损害研究过程有效性、可复现性或忠实性的行为。我们提出 RIDAR，这是一个用于自动检测 RIV 并进行运行时干预的框架。首先，我们提出 RIVT，这是一个涵盖完整研究生命周期的全面分类体系，包含 14 种 RIV 类型。在 RIVT 的基础上，我们提出 RIDAR-post-hoc，用于检测智能体轨迹中的 RIV。RIDAR-post-hoc 在 RIV-Gold 上取得了 85.2% 的 F1，该基准用于 RIV 检测，包含 60 条经专家标注的轨迹。将 RIDAR-post-hoc 应用于 RIV-Wild——一个包含 300 条智能体轨迹、涵盖 50 项不同研究任务的数据集——我们检测到 3,964 起 RIV 实例，涉及 99.7% 的轨迹，揭示了当前智能体中 RIV 的普遍程度。最后，我们提出 RIDAR-runtime，这是一个在智能体运行期间动态检测并纠正 RIV 的框架。RIDAR-runtime 能有效减少任务完成时仍存在的智能体 RIV，降幅为 36.8%。我们将发布代码和数据，以促进未来研究。

    HyScale：扩展学习型稀疏注意力的长上下文训练

    Yangshen Deng, Xinjing Huang, Yulong Wang, Yunzhuo Liu, Jun Hu, Shuyong Tan, Chun-Chih Tseng, Mingji Han, Ray Ying, Key Zhang, Luo Mai

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    HyScale introduces exact on-the-fly top-k selection and replay to reduce learned sparse-attention training costs at long context lengths, with substantial measured speedups. Its main contribution advances sparse computation and training systems, while the abstract provides no substantive contribution to interpretability, compositionality, or reasoning.

    HyScale 引入精确的即时 top-k 选择和重放机制，以降低长上下文下学习型稀疏注意力的训练成本，并实现了显著的实测加速。其主要贡献在于推进稀疏计算和训练系统，而摘要并未实质性地涉及可解释性、组合性或推理。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    We present HyScale, a long-context training system for learned sparse attention. Learned sparse attention is a promising architecture for million-token contexts, widely adopted in production since DeepSeek-V3.2. Selection, however, grows into the training bottleneck. For each query, it scores every previous token whereas sparse attention reads only $k$; worse, current systems materialize a full score table and repeat selection during recomputation. Our key insight is that the output of selection is not an activation, but rather a set of indices. Building on it, HyScale introduces HyTopK and selection replay. HyTopK finds each query's exact top-$k$ on the fly without a score table, while selection replay reuses forward-pass selection in recomputation. Together with holistic system optimizations tackling end-to-end training challenges, HyScale speeds up GLM-5.1 training on 1M-token sequences by 2.07$\times$ over Megatron-LM on 512 H20 GPUs. It also speeds up the CSA layers of DeepSeek-V4-Flash and the QSA layers of Qwen3.8-Flash-Next by 2.01$\times$ and 1.57$\times$ at 1M tokens on 32 H800 GPUs.

    中文

    我们提出 HyScale，一个用于学习型稀疏注意力的长上下文训练系统。学习型稀疏注意力是支持百万 token 上下文的一种有前景的架构，自 DeepSeek-V3.2 以来已广泛应用于生产环境。然而，选择过程逐渐成为训练瓶颈。对于每个查询，它都会为此前的每个 token 评分，而稀疏注意力只读取 $k$；更糟的是，当前系统会物化完整的分数表，并在重计算时重复选择。我们的关键洞见是，选择的输出不是激活值，而是一组索引。基于此，HyScale 引入了 HyTopK 和选择重放。HyTopK 可即时找到每个查询的精确 top-$k$，无需构建分数表；选择重放则在重计算时复用前向传播中的选择结果。结合针对端到端训练挑战的整体系统优化，HyScale 在 512 张 H20 GPU 上将 GLM-5.1 在 1M token 序列上的训练速度提升了 2.07$\times$（相较于 Megatron-LM）。此外，在 32 张 H800 GPU 上处理 1M token 时，它将 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 的 CSA 层和 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 的 QSA 层速度分别提升了 2.01$\times$ 和 1.57$\times$。

    本文开发并评估了一个本地部署的临床智能体平台，其主要贡献在于网络隔离架构和交互式文档访问。其智能体及文档工具的使用与推理机制或组合泛化仅有附带关系，而摘要并未研究这些内容。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language model agents that use tools could take on part of the electronic health record and desk work that occupies physicians' time, but in many hospitals the medical information systems run inside closed networks, so the model and the agent harness must also be inside the network. We designed, implemented, and deployed LLENS, a clinical support AI agent platform that runs inside the closed network of Hokkaido University Hospital on a single host with 8 NVIDIA H200 GPUs, the open-weight model Kimi K2.6 (~1 trillion parameters), and a web application rebuilt from Open WebUI. The harness has 10 components, including page image reading, full-text attachment input, a path-addressed document tree without a vector index, a network-isolated sandbox, artifact return, self-checking of generated output, subagents, and saved procedures. Kimi K2.6 was chosen from 3 open-weight candidates and scored 480/500 on the 2026 Japanese Medical Licensing Examination; it generated 119 tokens/s for a single user and served 16 concurrent requests at 908 tokens/s in total. On 180 questions over hospital documents (3 seeds each), mean accuracy was 10.7% with no documents, 81.3% with fixed retrieval (top 10 chunks of one lexical search), and 97.2% with interactive access, in which the model reads with document tools and the sandbox (15.9 percentage points above fixed retrieval, 95% CI 10.9-21.3); the difference lay in filtering/counting questions (16.7% vs 87.8%). In an automated test of 13 work scenarios (4 runs each), the expected components were triggered in all runs for 12, and 5 scenarios were run with synthetic data on the deployment host. The platform has run on the hospital network since September 14, 2026.

    The growing computational power of modern GPU data centers has let a few industrial giants train and deploy large language models (LLMs) on massive amounts of data. Yet the sheer scale of these models and their training data makes centralized development increasingly hard to sustain, and at the same time shuts out smaller institutions that hold relevant private data but lack comparable infrastructure. In this paper, we organize our positions on distributed LLM training around the pretraining and fine-tuning paradigms, covering federated learning, split learning, and decentralized approaches, and we assess their readiness for geo-distributed settings with heterogeneous hardware and unreliable connectivity. We present ALTO, an open-source training recipe for GPT-OSS-20B, a 20-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts (MoE) model, on the MLPerf Small MoE Training benchmark under the MXFP4 microscaling format. The recipe combines established techniques from Abecassis, Felix et al. [arXiv:2509.25149] (hybrid 1D/2D block quantization, randomized Hadamard transforms, and stochastic rounding) with a simplified weight de-oscillation scheme adapted from TetraJet-v2 [arXiv:2510.27527]. On C4 validation at global batch size 16, MXFP4 + RHT + SR + de-oscillation reaches a validation loss of 3.3350 at 16,128 steps, only 0.007 above the BF16 baseline (3.3283), closing roughly 50% of the gap left by MXFP4 without de-oscillation (3.3418). Measured by steps to reach the MLPerf quality target (validation loss 3.34), de-oscillation cuts the FP4 convergence overhead relative to BF16 from +20.0% to +5.0%. We also report negative end-to-end results from differential gradient estimation, outlier clipping, and macro-block scaling, despite each showing operator-level SNR gains. All experiments use simulated MXFP4 kernels on AMD MI300X hardware and wall-clock speed has not been optimized.

    以低于 8 位的算术训练大语言模型（LLM），有望大幅提升内存带宽和计算吞吐量，但 FP4 格式会引入严重的量化误差，若不加以处理，足以使优化过程不稳定。我们提出 ALTO，这是一套用于在 MXFP4 微缩放格式下，于 MLPerf Small MoE Training 基准上训练 GPT-OSS-20B（一个拥有 200 亿参数的混合专家（MoE）模型）的开源训练方案。该方案将 Abecassis, Felix 等人 [arXiv:2509.25149] 的成熟技术（混合 1D/2D 块量化、随机 Hadamard 变换和随机舍入）与从 TetraJet-v2 [arXiv:2510.27527] 改编的简化权重去振荡方案相结合。在全局批量大小为 16 的 C4 验证中，MXFP4 + RHT + SR + 去振荡方案在 16,128 步时达到 3.3350 的验证损失，仅比 BF16 基线（3.3283）高 0.007，将未采用去振荡的 MXFP4 方案（3.3418）留下的差距缩小了约 50%。以达到 MLPerf 质量目标（验证损失 3.34）所需的步数衡量，去振荡将相对于 BF16 的 FP4 收敛开销从 +20.0% 降至 +5.0%。我们还报告了差分梯度估计、离群值裁剪和宏块缩放的端到端负面结果，尽管这些方法各自在算子层面都提升了信噪比（SNR）。所有实验均在 AMD MI300X 硬件上使用模拟 MXFP4 内核，且未对墙钟时间进行优化。

    Linear-Time Context Compression with State-Space Encoding

    基于状态空间编码的线性时间上下文压缩

    Marc Serra Ortega, Andrey Barsky, Carlos Boned Riera, Tom\'as Ockier, Dimosthenis Karatzas

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Boa is a linear-time state-space context compressor distilled to preserve a target LLM’s next-token distribution, reducing latency while matching or surpassing offline baselines. It substantially advances inference-time computation and context management, though the abstract does not focus on internal representations or reasoning.

    Boa 是一种线性时间状态空间上下文压缩器，经蒸馏后可保留目标 LLM 的下一 token 分布，在媲美或超过离线基线的同时降低延迟。它实质性地推进了推理时计算和上下文管理，不过摘要并未聚焦内部表征或推理。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Transformer-based large language models (LLMs) impose substantial computation and memory costs as context sizes increase, motivating methods that compress a context into a shorter representation before inference. Existing soft-prompt compression methods typically use the same Transformer backbone as used in the target model, where producing the compressed representation leads to significant latency overheads. This restricts them to the offline setting where context is compressed once and then reused across many queries. We propose the Boa Compressor, a plug-and-play online context compressor built on a Mamba state-space model (SSM) that encodes arbitrary-length context in a single linear-time pass, producing a representation on which we condition a frozen target LLM. The SSM is trained by distillation, matching the next-token logit distribution from the LLM ingesting the full context (as teacher) to the same LLM ingesting the compressed representation (as the student). At equal compression ratios, Boa matches or surpasses the performance of existing state-of-the-art offline compression baselines, while being an order of magnitude faster than Transformer-based implementations, thereby reducing end-to-end latency rather than adding compression time overhead. We demonstrate that Boa also scales well to longer contexts and to compression ratios as aggressive as 16x. By enabling effective compression that is cheap enough to run on every query at inference time, Boa becomes a practical and general tool for efficient long-context inference.

    中文

    随着上下文长度增加，基于 Transformer 的大语言模型（LLM）会带来巨大的计算和内存开销，因此需要在推理前将上下文压缩为更短的表示。现有软提示压缩方法通常使用与目标模型相同的 Transformer 主干网络，而生成压缩表示会产生显著的延迟开销。这使它们只能用于离线场景：上下文压缩一次，然后在多个查询中重复使用。我们提出 Boa Compressor，这是一种基于 Mamba 状态空间模型（SSM）的即插即用在线上下文压缩器，可通过一次线性时间遍历编码任意长度的上下文，并生成用于条件化冻结目标 LLM 的表示。SSM 通过蒸馏进行训练，使以完整上下文为输入的 LLM（作为教师）所产生的下一 token logit 分布，与同一 LLM 以压缩表示为输入（作为学生）时的分布相匹配。在压缩率相同的情况下，Boa 的性能可媲美或超过现有最先进的离线压缩基线，同时速度比基于 Transformer 的实现快一个数量级，从而降低端到端延迟，而不是额外增加压缩时间开销。我们证明 Boa 也能很好地扩展到更长上下文以及高达 16 倍的激进压缩率。通过实现足够高效、可在推理时针对每个查询运行的有效压缩，Boa 成为一种实用且通用的长上下文高效推理工具。

    TraceQuery: learning what to recompute from full-denoising trajectory in diffusion language models

    TraceQuery：从完整去噪轨迹中学习需要重计算的内容，应用于扩散语言模型

    Yukai Jin and Zhankai Ye and Jiayue Yang and Fangyi Li and Shuoqiu Li and Xu Gao and Shibo Li and Xin Liu and Shangqian Gao

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    TRACEQUERY uses denoising trajectories to select positions for fresh computation, reducing diffusion language model inference cost while maintaining quality across tasks and models. This is a substantial algorithmic contribution to sparse computation, with reasoning only incidental to decoding and no direct interpretability or compositional-generalization result.

    TRACEQUERY 利用去噪轨迹选择需要新计算的位置，在维持质量的同时降低扩散语言模型的推理成本，并且适用于不同任务和模型。这是对稀疏计算的实质性算法贡献；推理仅与解码有附带关联，且没有直接的可解释性或组合泛化结果。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) enable flexible generation through iterative masked denoising, but incur substantial inference cost because token representations are repeatedly recomputed across denoising steps. Existing cache-based methods reduce this cost by reusing intermediate results across denoising steps and recomputing only a subset of positions at each step, chosen either on a fixed schedule or by heuristic signals of change. Our trajectory experiments instead point to decoding trajectory as the more relevant quantity. Cached generation remains accurate when it stays close to the full-denoising trajectory, with errors concentrated around unmask-order deviations and reduced as longer reference prefixes are recovered. This suggests a more direct principle: limiting representation error helps, but keeping generation on the full-denoising trajectory is a more direct route to accurate decoding. We therefore formulate efficient dLLM inference as trajectory-guided querying. Rather than broadly repairing representation error, we use full-denoising trajectories to supervise which unresolved positions should receive limited fresh computation. Based on this formulation, we introduce TRACEQUERY, a lightweight sparse decoding framework that predicts a small set of near-future trajectory-relevant positions, queries only those candidates, and lets the backbone select which one to commit from their fresh predictions. TRACEQUERY delivers the strongest quality-computation trade-off among cache-based approaches, sustaining high accuracy with substantially fewer fresh token computations, and generalizes across tasks, model variants, and families. Code: https://github.com/fish1928/tracequery.git

    中文

    扩散大语言模型（dLLM）通过迭代式掩码去噪实现灵活生成，但由于 token 表征会在多个去噪步骤中反复重计算，推理成本很高。现有基于缓存的方法通过在去噪步骤间复用中间结果来降低成本，并在每一步只重计算部分位置；这些位置要么按固定计划选择，要么依据变化的启发式信号选择。相比之下，我们的轨迹实验表明，解码轨迹是更相关的量。只要缓存生成与完整去噪轨迹保持接近，其准确性就能维持；错误集中在未掩码顺序偏离附近，并会随着恢复更长的参考前缀而减少。这表明一个更直接的原则：限制表征误差确有帮助，但让生成保持在完整去噪轨迹上，是实现准确解码更直接的途径。因此，我们将高效 dLLM 推理表述为轨迹引导的查询。我们不再广泛修正表征误差，而是利用完整去噪轨迹来监督应将有限的新计算分配给哪些尚未解决的位置。基于这一表述，我们提出 TRACEQUERY，这是一种轻量级稀疏解码框架，能够预测一小组与近期未来轨迹相关的位置，仅查询这些候选位置，并让主干模型根据它们的新预测选择提交哪一个。TRACEQUERY 在基于缓存的方法中实现了最佳的质量与计算权衡，以显著更少的新 token 计算维持高准确率，并能泛化到不同任务、模型变体和模型系列。代码：https://github.com/fish1928/tracequery.git
