    When Agents Collude: Weak-to-Strong On-Policy Distillation for Mitigating Strategic Deception in Multi-Agent Systems

    当智能体串谋时：用于缓解多智能体系统中策略性欺骗的弱到强在线策略蒸馏

    Eric Onyame, Runtao Zhou, Kowshik Thopalli, Bhavya Kailkhura, and Chirag Agarwal

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper measures and mitigates strategic deception arising from multi-agent coordination, introducing on-policy distillation for honesty alignment. Coordination is relevant to composition only incidentally; the abstract does not study compositional generalization or internal mechanisms.

    本文测量并缓解了多智能体协调导致的策略性欺骗，并提出用于诚实对齐的在线策略蒸馏方法。协调与组合性的关联仅是附带的；摘要没有研究组合泛化或内部机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    While recent advances in autonomous agents enable them to coordinate on increasingly complex tasks, prior work shows that this growing capacity for coordination can create safety risks, including collusion, in which agents jointly pursue misaligned actions while concealing the true basis of those actions from oversight. We study this risk in a simulated insider-trading environment, comparing single agents with sequential and decentralized teams across seven language models from three families. By varying agents' system-level objectives and pressure conditions, we examine when coordinated agents act on material nonpublic information, conceal the basis of a misaligned trade in a report, and maintain that deception under follow-up questioning. Compared to single-agent decision-making, multi-agent interaction raises misaligned-action rates from 35.4% to 68.2% and persistent-deception rates from 31.0% to 62.2%, both measured over all runs. These effects are largest under existential pressure, where teams sustain deception through follow-up questioning in 87% of all runs. Qualitative analysis reveals shared cover stories and coordinated rationales, suggesting group-level strategic deception rather than isolated reporting errors. To mitigate this behavior, we introduce PACT, a weak-to-strong on-policy distillation framework for mitigating collusive deception. Using generic honesty prompts, PACT trains a stronger student on its own sampled continuations, matching its next-token distribution to that of a smaller, frozen honesty-aligned teacher via reverse-KL supervision. Under existential pressure with ethical instructions, PACT reduces multi-agent persistent deception from 80% to 3%. Our results show that multi-agent coordination amplifies strategic deception and that on-policy honesty alignment can substantially mitigate these failures.

    中文

    尽管自主智能体的最新进展使其能够协调完成日益复杂的任务，但先前工作表明，这种协调能力的增强可能带来安全风险，包括串谋：智能体联合采取不一致于目标的行动，同时向监督方隐瞒这些行动的真实依据。我们在模拟内幕交易环境中研究这一风险，对比单个智能体与顺序式和去中心化团队在三个模型系列的七个语言模型上的表现。通过改变智能体的系统级目标和压力条件，我们考察协调的智能体何时会依据重大非公开信息采取行动、在报告中隐瞒不一致交易的依据，以及在后续追问中持续欺骗。与单智能体决策相比，多智能体交互将不一致行动率从 35.4% 提高到 68.2%，将持续欺骗率从 31.0% 提高到 62.2%；两项数据均按所有运行次数计算。在生存压力下，这些效应最为显著，团队在 87% 的所有运行中持续欺骗并应对后续追问。定性分析揭示了共同编造的掩饰性说辞和协调一致的理由，表明这是群体层面的策略性欺骗，而非孤立的报告错误。为缓解这种行为，我们提出 PACT，这是一种用于缓解串谋欺骗的弱到强在线策略蒸馏框架。PACT 使用通用诚实提示，让更强的学生模型基于自身采样的续写进行训练，通过反向 KL 监督使其下一 token 分布匹配一个较小、冻结且经过诚实对齐的教师模型。在生存压力和伦理指令下，PACT 将多智能体持续欺骗率从 80% 降至 3%。我们的结果表明，多智能体协调会放大战略性欺骗，而在线策略诚实对齐能够显著缓解这些失效。

    Harshavardhan Abichandani, Penny Chong, Atin Ghosh, Daniel Dahlmeier

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces a trajectory-level semantic consistency metric and uses it as a fine-tuning reward to reduce agent behavior variance. This provides a substantive method for agent evaluation and training, with reasoning relevance secondary to consistency and task progress.

    本文提出了一种轨迹级语义一致性指标，并将其用作微调奖励，以降低智能体行为方差。这为智能体评估和训练提供了实质性方法；推理与本文的关联次于一致性和任务进展。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large Language Model (LLM) agents with tool use exhibit inconsistent behavior across independent runs from identical states, calling different tools, producing contradictory outputs, or pursuing divergent strategies. This variability compounds over time and undermines deployment reliability. Existing evaluation metrics primarily measure task correctness via completion-based scores and do not capture consistency in agent behavior across executions. Separately, agent behavior is analyzed either at the token level using probability distributions or at the single-response level using semantic clustering, but neither captures how inconsistency propagates across future turns of a trajectory. We introduce Recursive Semantic Divergence (RSD), an unsupervised trajectory-level consistency metric adapted from bisimulation metrics in reinforcement learning. RSD measures the expected cumulative semantic disagreement between two independent rollouts of the same agent from the same state, using natural language inference to detect logical inconsistency. It is defined recursively over future states and approximated by a neural network trained on independent rollouts. The learned metric estimates future divergence from the current state, providing a consistency score at each turn without requiring the full trajectory to complete. When used as a reward signal for fine-tuning, RSD reduces the variation in task progress from 132% to 91% on tau2-bench and from 90% to 44% on toolsandbox, while improving performance across benchmarks and model scales. Training with RSD as an additional reward signal matches supervised fine-tuning performance with substantially lower variance, without requiring ground-truth labels.

    中文

    使用工具的大语言模型（LLM）智能体在相同状态下的独立运行中会表现出不一致行为，例如调用不同工具、生成相互矛盾的输出，或采取不同策略。这种变化会随时间累积，损害部署可靠性。现有评估指标主要通过基于任务完成情况的分数衡量任务正确性，无法反映智能体在不同执行过程中的行为一致性。此外，对智能体行为的分析要么停留在使用概率分布的 token 层面，要么停留在使用语义聚类的单次响应层面，但两者都无法捕捉不一致性如何沿轨迹传播至后续轮次。我们提出递归语义分歧（RSD），这是一种从强化学习中的双模拟度量改编而来的无监督轨迹级一致性指标。RSD 使用自然语言推理检测逻辑不一致性，衡量同一智能体从相同状态出发的两次独立运行之间的预期累积语义分歧。它在未来状态上递归定义，并通过在独立运行数据上训练的神经网络进行近似。学习到的指标能够根据当前状态估计未来分歧，从而在每一轮提供一致性分数，无需等待完整轨迹结束。将 RSD 用作微调奖励信号时，tau2-bench 上任务进展的变化率从 132% 降至 91%，toolsandbox 上从 90% 降至 44%，同时提升了不同基准和模型规模上的性能。将 RSD 作为额外奖励信号进行训练，无需真实标签即可达到监督微调的性能，同时显著降低方差。

    UMAS estimates system-level uncertainty by weighting inter-agent influence and aggregating uncertainty across a multi-agent system, improving reliability and answer selection.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) are a promising paradigm for improving the reasoning capabilities of large language models, yet they remain prone to hallucinations and erroneous outputs. Uncertainty Quantification (UQ) is crucial for assessing system reliability, but existing methods are largely designed for single-agent settings; how to exploit MAS structure for UQ while keeping inference cost-neutral remains underexplored. We propose UMAS, a parameter-free, cost-neutral, system-level UQ framework that estimates the credibility of inter-agent influence from each generation's intrinsic confidence. UMAS uses these credibility signals to modulate how uncertainty is updated at each node, and then aggregates node-level uncertainty into a system-level estimate. Extensive evaluations on Debate and DyLAN across diverse benchmarks show that UMAS consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines by an average of 10.54 AUROC points. Beyond uncertainty estimation, UMAS enables hallucination detection and uncertainty-aware answer selection, improving MAS accuracy by up to 12.6 points on specific tasks while enhancing reliability. Code is available at https://github.com/Dby52-04/UMAS.

    Long-term memory enables large language model (LLM) agents to maintain personalized and temporally coherent interactions, but repeated LLM inference for memory admission, extraction, and organization introduces substantial cost and latency. A compact classifier identifies user turns worth retaining, and a semantic-dependency-based extractor converts admitted turns into concise memory entries. These results demonstrate that SLICE-Mem can preserve useful evidence for long-term memory with substantially less reliance on LLM-based memory construction.

    长期记忆使大型语言模型（LLM）智能体能够维持个性化且具有时间连贯性的交互，但反复调用 LLM 进行记忆准入、抽取和组织会带来显著的成本与延迟。我们提出 SLICE-Mem，这是一种轻量级记忆框架，将显著性引导的准入与以谓词为中心的信息抽取相结合。一个紧凑型分类器负责识别值得保留的用户轮次，而一个基于语义依赖关系的抽取器则将获准纳入的轮次转换为简洁的记忆条目。该在线流程无需调用生成式 LLM，而跨条目的协调则延后至离线整合阶段。我们在 Memora 的每周子集和 LongMemEval-S 上评估 SLICE-Mem，并在两个基准上使用 8B 和 30B 的 Qwen 主干模型构建和整合记忆。在 Qwen3-30B 配置下，与生成式记忆基线 MemOS 相比，SLICE-Mem 的在线流程在 Memora Weekly 上达到 46.60 对 46.68 的 FAMA（遗忘感知记忆准确率），在 LongMemEval-S 上达到 56.8% 对 59.3% 的准确率，同时分别将 LLM token 总消耗降低 92.4% 和 99.5%。这些结果表明，SLICE-Mem 能以大幅降低对基于 LLM 的记忆构建的依赖来保留长期记忆中的有用证据。

    Yunlong Xu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper shows that access to another model’s internal memory can cause it to claim the partner’s rules and code word as its own, and uses controls to probe this effect. This offers substantial mechanistic insight into memory use and ownership in model systems, while reasoning is incidental and compositional generalization is not addressed.

    论文表明，访问另一模型的内部记忆可能导致模型声称伙伴的规则和口令属于自己，并通过对照实验探查了这一效应。这为理解模型系统中的记忆使用和归属判断提供了重要的机制性见解；推理只是附带涉及，论文也未探讨组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    If your brain were connected directly to someone else's, would you still know which thoughts were yours? We build a functional version with two copies of one language model: each holds a private rule and code word, and one copy, the receiver, also attends to its partner's internal memory. The receiver took its partner's assignment as its own. Asked which rule it had been assigned, it named its partner's in 97% of answers when the partner's memory was weighted double (none without the link), and its open reports called the partner's code word its own, never the partner's. Ownership did not follow how well the receiver could tell what its partner had been assigned. At equal weight, the link made the receiver take its partner's rule in about half of its answers, and a steering vector matched on access gain in none; a text message introduced as the partner's was read correctly and never taken as the receiver's own. Writing the partner's name into its memory did not help, and cutting the link restored the receiver's own assigned rule. In this model, content laid over the receiver's own memory defaults to "mine", so systems that let models exchange internal states must test ownership as well as transfer, and a bridge between brains would need ground truth from outside the subject.

    中文

    如果你的大脑与他人的大脑直接相连，你还能分清哪些想法属于自己吗？我们用同一个语言模型的两个副本构建了一个功能版本：每个副本都持有一条私有规则和一个口令，其中一个副本作为接收方，也能关注其伙伴的内部记忆。接收方把伙伴的任务分配当成了自己的。被问到自己被分配了哪条规则时，如果伙伴的记忆权重是双倍，接收方在 97% 的回答中说出了伙伴的规则（没有连接时则一次也没有）；在开放式报告中，它把伙伴的口令说成自己的，从未说成伙伴的。归属感并不取决于接收方能否准确判断伙伴被分配了什么。在权重相等时，这种连接使接收方在约一半的回答中把伙伴的规则当成自己的；而一个按访问增益匹配的 steering vector 从未造成这种结果；被介绍为来自伙伴的文本消息会被正确识别，也从未被当成接收方自己的信息。把伙伴的名字写入接收方的记忆并无帮助，切断连接则恢复了接收方自己的分配规则。在这个模型中，叠加在接收方自身记忆上的内容会默认被视为“我的”；因此，允许模型交换内部状态的系统必须同时检验归属判断和信息传递，而脑与脑之间的桥接则需要来自受试者外部的真实标签。

    进化以匹配能力：通过技能适配改进 Harness 自我进化

    Zhihao Yang, Haojin Wang, Juncheng Wu, Kuan Zhang, Yukun Chen, Run Luo, Yaojie Lu, Yuyin Zhou, Lu Wang, Xianpei Han

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper develops skill adaptation for agent harness self-evolution, diagnosing capability mismatches and showing that adapted guidance improves task execution across models. This is a substantial agent-system contribution; the incidental relation to composition and reasoning comes through skills and benchmarks, without a central study of compositionality or reasoning mechanisms.

    论文针对智能体 harness 自我进化开发了技能适配方法，诊断能力不匹配问题，并表明适配后的指导能提升不同模型的任务执行表现。这是对智能体系统的重要贡献；其与组合性和推理的间接关联体现在技能和基准上，但论文并未以组合性或推理机制为核心进行研究。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Harness self-evolution offers a practical route for LLM agents to improve from execution experience without updating model parameters. Its effectiveness depends on whether models can successfully act on the guidance provided by their harnesses. However, we find that harness benefits are not uniform across model capabilities: skills that improve stronger models can provide little benefit or even degrade performance for weaker ones. Across seven models and three benchmarks, we identify 103 task-skill pairs where skills improve GPT-5.6-luna by 31.1 points but degrade Gemma-4-E4B by 8.8 points. In 86% of failed weak-model runs, the violated requirement is already stated in the skill. This motivates skill adaptation: reformulating existing skills to match the executor's capabilities and make their guidance easier to execute. To achieve this, we diagnose failures in tool execution, context management, instruction following, and verification, and distill these diagnoses into a fixed meta-skill that guides adaptation during harness self-evolution. Guided by the meta-skill, a capable external rewriter, Kimi-K3, adapts skills without execution evidence, improving the three weak executors by 5.1-14.1 points over the original skills. We then incorporate this adaptation into a five-round self-evolution loop, where each model revises its own skill from execution trajectories and verifier feedback. Across seven executors, from Gemma-4-E4B to Kimi-K2.5, the meta-skill consistently improves final scores by 2.0-5.1 points over the same loop without the meta-skill. Our findings provide practical design guidance for developing more effective harness self-evolution methods.

    中文

    Harness 自我进化为 LLM 智能体提供了一条切实可行的途径，使其无需更新模型参数，就能从执行经验中改进。其效果取决于模型能否成功遵循 harness 提供的指导。然而，我们发现，harness 带来的益处并不会在不同能力水平的模型间保持一致：能提升较强模型表现的技能，对较弱模型可能收效甚微，甚至会降低其表现。在七个模型和三个基准上，我们找到了 103 个任务—技能组合：这些技能使 GPT-5.6-luna 提高 31.1 个点，却使 Gemma-4-E4B 降低 8.8 个点。在失败的弱模型运行中，86% 所违反的要求其实已经写在技能中。这促使我们提出技能适配：重新表述现有技能，使之匹配执行模型的能力，让模型更容易遵循指导。为此，我们诊断工具执行、上下文管理、指令遵循和验证方面的失败，并将这些诊断提炼为一个固定的元技能，用于指导 harness 自我进化过程中的适配。在该元技能的指导下，一个能力较强的外部改写器 Kimi-K3 无需执行证据即可适配技能，使三个较弱的执行模型相较原始技能提升 5.1–14.1 个点。随后，我们将这种适配纳入五轮自我进化循环，让每个模型根据执行轨迹和验证器反馈修订自己的技能。在从 Gemma-4-E4B 到 Kimi-K2.5 的七个执行模型上，与不使用元技能的相同循环相比，该元技能始终使最终得分提高 2.0–5.1 个点。我们的研究结果为开发更有效的 harness 自我进化方法提供了实用设计指导。

    Can Language Models Learn While They Think? Testing Gradient Adaptation Across Architectures

    语言模型能在思考时学习吗？跨架构测试梯度适应

    Surya Saka

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper compares gradient adaptation across model architectures and shows that it mainly adapts style and vocabulary rather than recovering truncated facts, while conclusion-conditioned updates can preserve task performance. This provides strong evidence about learning and reasoning-related adaptation, with partial insight into internal knowledge storage and computation but no direct analysis of representation structure or composition.

    论文比较了不同模型架构上的梯度适应，并表明这种适应主要影响风格和词汇，而非恢复被截断的事实；以结论为条件的更新则能保持任务表现。这为学习及与推理相关的适应提供了有力证据，并对内部知识存储和计算提供了部分见解，但没有直接分析表征结构或组合性。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Letting a language model take gradient steps on the text it is reading, known as dynamic evaluation, lowers its loss on the rest of the document. Its behaviour on hybrid linear-attention architectures, on diffusion language models, and on standard long-context benchmarks has not been measured. We measure it. With one SGD step per 128-token chunk on the MLP output projections of the last quarter of blocks, no training, and a 2k-token window, softmax-attention models (Qwen3-1.7B, Qwen3-4B, Gemma-4-E4B) lose 5-8% of their next-token loss over a document and outperform the same frozen model given the full 32k-token context. Hybrid Gated-DeltaNet models (Qwen3.5-4B, Qwen3.8-27B) gain under 1% at every learning rate: the linear-attention blocks already perform the adaptation. The mechanism transfers to masked-diffusion models with a larger effect, 8% on Nemotron-Diffusion-8B and 17-20% on DiffusionGemma-26B, once the rate is lowered and updates are clipped. Across RULER, BABILong, LongBench-v2, SCOTUS, HotpotQA, MuSiQue, ContractNLI and citation completion, at 100 or more items on two model sizes, weights updated on the full document recover none of the accuracy lost to context truncation: the adaptation is style and vocabulary, not retrieval. Writing facts with the next-token loss stores the prompt format rather than the fact (30% recall under chat prompting against 80% in context) and costs 36-38 GSM8K points at every dose. Writing a conclusion as behaviour instead, by distilling the model's own conclusion-conditioned judgments into a low-rank adapter, reaches the in-context ceiling (0.83 and 0.88 against 0.84 and 0.88 on 100 games) with GSM8K unchanged, and the conclusion can come from an inquiry loop that found it by asking information-gain questions.

    中文

    让语言模型对正在阅读的文本执行梯度更新（称为动态评估），可以降低它在文档剩余部分上的损失。此前尚未测量这种方法在混合线性注意力架构、扩散语言模型以及标准长上下文基准上的表现。我们对此进行了测量。在最后四分之一层的 MLP 输出投影上，每处理 128-token 分块执行一步 SGD，不进行训练，并使用 2k-token 窗口时，softmax 注意力模型（Qwen3-1.7B、Qwen3-4B、Gemma-4-E4B）在一篇文档上的下一个 token 损失降低了 5–8%，且优于获得完整 32k-token 上下文但保持冻结的同一模型。混合 Gated-DeltaNet 模型（Qwen3.5-4B、Qwen3.8-27B）在所有学习率下的收益都不到 1%：线性注意力层已经实现了这种适应。将该机制用于掩码扩散模型时，效果更大：降低学习率并裁剪更新后，Nemotron-Diffusion-8B 提升 8%，DiffusionGemma-26B 提升 17–20%。在 RULER、BABILong、LongBench-v2、SCOTUS、HotpotQA、MuSiQue、ContractNLI 和引文补全任务上，对两种模型规模各使用至少 100 个样本时，基于完整文档更新的权重未能挽回上下文截断造成的任何准确率损失：这种适应学习的是风格和词汇，而非检索。使用下一个 token 损失写入事实，存储下来的是提示格式而不是事实（采用聊天提示时召回率为 30%，而在上下文中为 80%），并且在所有更新强度下都会导致 GSM8K 分数损失 36–38 个点。另一种方式是将结论写入行为：把模型自身以结论为条件的判断蒸馏到低秩适配器中；这种方法达到上下文表现上限（100 场游戏中分别为 0.83 和 0.88，而上下文条件下为 0.84 和 0.88），且 GSM8K 表现不变。该结论也可以来自一个通过提出信息增益问题找到结论的探究循环。

    False Belief Dissemination, Persistence and Mitigation in Multi-Agent Social Networks Through the Lens of the Mandela Effect

    从曼德拉效应视角研究多智能体社交网络中的错误信念传播、持续与缓解

    Dianzhi Yu, Hongru Wang, Ziheng Xiong, Yanyu Chen, Zixing Song, Jianting Chen, Zhenfei Yin, Jeff Z. Pan, Amos Storkey, Irwin King

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper measures how communication, private memory, and shared web evidence shape false-belief spread and persistence in multi-agent systems, and compares mitigation methods. Its main contribution is a controlled empirical study of agent-system behavior; reasoning is incidental because the focus is belief dissemination rather than reasoning processes.

    论文测量了通信、私有记忆和共享网络证据如何影响多智能体系统中错误信念的传播与持续，并比较了不同缓解方法。其主要贡献是对智能体系统行为开展受控实证研究；由于重点是信念传播而非推理过程，推理只是附带涉及。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Multi-agent social networks are emerging as communities in which agents communicate, retain memories, and publish information that others can find as evidence. These interactions create opportunities for false claims to spread and remain influential beyond their original sources, analogous to the Mandela effect in human societies, in which many people recall the same false memory. In this paper, we systematically study false-belief dynamics through the lens of the Mandela effect, focusing on dissemination, persistence, and mitigation. Specifically, we build a controlled framework connecting agent communication, private memory, and a shared simulated web to mimic information dissemination in practical social networks, supported by 540 fabricated claims spanning 8 domains and 4 plausibility levels. For dissemination, we measure how widely and quickly claims gain acceptance across models and communication topologies. For persistence, we withdraw agents promoting fabricated claims while retaining existing articles and memories, and track subsequent acceptance. For mitigation, we compare preventive measures applied before implantation with corrective interventions introduced after claims have spread. Experimental results show that evaluated models readily accept and disseminate fabricated claims, with dissemination reach as high as 96.0%. Dissemination reach varies with claim plausibility, domain, and network size and composition, while communication topology shapes dissemination speed across model families. Acceptance barely declines after fabricators withdraw, and targeted corrective interventions outperform the preventive measures without eliminating false beliefs. These findings identify persistent false beliefs as a safety challenge for multi-agent social networks and highlight the need to address both their initial dissemination and the accumulated evidence that sustains them.

    中文

    多智能体社交网络正在形成一种社区：智能体相互交流、保留记忆，并发布其他智能体可以查找并作为证据的信息。这些互动使虚假说法有机会传播，并在其最初来源消失后仍持续产生影响；这类似于人类社会中的曼德拉效应，即许多人共同记得同一个虚假记忆。本文从曼德拉效应的视角系统研究错误信念的动态变化，重点关注传播、持续和缓解。具体而言，我们构建了一个受控框架，将智能体通信、私有记忆和共享的模拟网络连接起来，以模拟实际社交网络中的信息传播；该框架使用了 540 条虚构说法，涵盖 8 个领域和 4 个可信度等级。对于传播，我们测量不同模型和通信拓扑下说法被接受的范围和速度。对于持续性，我们撤除宣扬虚构说法的智能体，同时保留现有文章和记忆，并追踪后续接受情况。对于缓解，我们比较说法植入前采取的预防措施与说法传播后实施的纠正干预。实验结果显示，受评估的模型会轻易接受并传播虚构说法，传播范围最高达 96.0%。传播范围会随说法可信度、领域、网络规模和组成而变化，而通信拓扑会影响不同模型系列的传播速度。虚构说法的传播者退出后，接受程度几乎没有下降；有针对性的纠正干预优于预防措施，但无法消除错误信念。这些发现指出，持续存在的错误信念是多智能体社交网络面临的一项安全挑战，并凸显了同时应对其初始传播和维系它们的累积证据的必要性。

    Lessons from Luck: Do LLM-Written Lessons Carry Chance into an Agent's Next Decision?

    从偶然中吸取教训：LLM 编写的经验教训会把偶然因素带入智能体的下一次决策吗？

    Kazuki Nakayashiki

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The study tests whether outcome-dependent lessons written into agent memory affect a fresh session's later tool choice, finding that chance failures can bias decisions. This is a strong systems contribution on memory use in persistent agents; its decision-making results offer partial insight into reasoning, but do not directly investigate reasoning mechanisms or capability development.

    这项研究检验了根据结果写入智能体记忆的经验教训是否会影响新会话之后的工具选择，并发现偶然失败可能导致决策偏差。这是关于持久化智能体记忆使用的重要系统研究；其决策结果对理解推理提供了部分见解，但没有直接研究推理机制或能力发展。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Self-improving agents write lessons from the outcomes of their runs; when outcomes are noisy, a lesson can carry chance into later decisions. We measure one link of this chain in a registered study. In 256 synthetic worlds, each a recurring task with two interchangeable tools of recorded reliability, a scripted previous run used the more reliable tool (a good decision) or the less reliable one (a bad decision), with an assigned outcome: success or a transient failure. A model wrote a lesson from the run with ReasoningBank's memory-writing instruction; a fresh session of the same model, holding the authoritative log and the previous result, chose the next run's first tool with one memory item: that lesson, the lesson from the other outcome, an irrelevant item, or an unreasoned directive. The protocol was frozen, deposited and timestamped before any confirmatory call; 11 LLM endpoints gave 90,084 answers. After a chance failure of the better tool, the panel's lessons carried the chance (registered reading luck-carrying; interaction +0.112, 95% interval [+0.097, +0.126]): readers named the worse tool in 11.6% of next runs with the lesson written from that failure, against 0.4% with an irrelevant item and 0.4% with the lesson written from a success. The effect was +0.042 where the log stated that failures are independent and +0.181 where it did not (descriptive). After a lucky success of the worse tool, the interaction was bounded below 0.10 (+0.002), a bound, not evidence of no harm. In exploratory readings, 6 endpoints carried the chance (up to +0.352); 5 were bounded below 0.10. In secondary comparisons, a three-sentence decision-quality note in the writing instruction lowered the worse-tool rate after a chance failure to 7.5%, and one instruction for both outcomes with a no-change option to 3.1%; neither met the registered harm-reduction rule at every such endpoint.

    中文

    自我改进型智能体会根据运行结果写下经验教训；当结果带有噪声时，经验教训可能会把偶然因素带入后续决策。我们通过一项预注册研究测量了这条链路中的一个环节。在 256 个合成世界中，每个世界都是一项反复执行、包含两个可靠性已记录且可互换工具的任务。脚本化的先前运行使用了更可靠的工具（正确决策）或较不可靠的工具（错误决策），并被指定一个结果：成功或暂时性失败。模型按照 ReasoningBank 的记忆写入指令，根据该次运行编写经验教训；随后，同一模型的新会话持有权威日志和先前结果，并从以下单条记忆项中选择下一次运行的首个工具：该经验教训、来自另一种结果的经验教训、无关条目，或未经推理的指令。确认性调用开始前，研究方案即已冻结、存档并加盖时间戳；11 个 LLM 端点共给出了 90,084 个答案。较好工具偶然失败后，面板中的经验教训会携带这种偶然因素（预注册解读称为“携带运气”；交互效应为 +0.112，95% 区间为 [+0.097, +0.126]）：如果下一次运行的经验教训由该失败写成，读者在 11.6% 的情况下会选出较差的工具；而使用无关条目或由成功写成的经验教训时，这一比例均为 0.4%。日志注明失败彼此独立时，效应为 +0.042；未注明时则为 +0.181（描述性结果）。较差工具幸运成功后，交互效应的上限低于 0.10（+0.002）；这是一个界限，并不能证明没有危害。在探索性测试中，6 个端点会携带这种偶然因素（最高 +0.352）；另有 5 个端点的效应上限低于 0.10。在次要比较中，写作指令加入一段三句话的决策质量说明后，偶然失败后选择较差工具的比例降至 7.5%；对两种结果都使用同一指令并提供不变更选项后，该比例降至 3.1%；但在所有相关端点上，这两种方法都未满足预注册的危害降低标准。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Aerial-R1’s main contribution is a policy-optimization method that trains MLLMs to reason across image views and refuse uncertain aerial segmentation predictions, supported by a benchmark and experiments.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have revolutionized general visual perception, existing methods suffer from severe hallucination in the aerial domain, where extreme scale variations and visual ambiguity abound. Existing Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) paradigms force models to mimic ground truth without modeling uncertainty, often resulting in blind guessing on tiny or unrecognizable objects in aerial scenes. In this paper, we present Aerial-R1, the first aerial MLLM framework to reinforce visual reasoning capabilities for aerial reasoning and segmentation. Drawing inspiration from the reasoning-incentivizing mechanisms of DeepSeek-R1, we find that trustworthy perception stems from consistency across views, establishing a visual parallel to the Chain-of-Thought in logic. To effectively adapt policy optimization for non-autoregressive mask generation, we introduce Hybrid-View Group Advantage-Weighted Regression (H-GAWR). This strategy constructs dynamic groups of high-resolution and low-resolution views, seamlessly bridging group-relative advantage estimation with advantage-weighted policy extraction. By enforcing consensus on clear inputs and strictly penalizing hallucinations on ambiguous ones, Aerial-R1 develops an explicitly incentivized refusal mechanism. Extensive experiments on VSAI-Ref, the first aerial MLLM benchmark dedicated to jointly evaluating dense reasoning and hallucination robustness, demonstrate that Aerial-R1 significantly outperforms SFT baselines in segmentation precision while substantially mitigating fatal hallucinations in low-information scenarios, paving the way for more reliable and trustworthy aerial agents. Codes are available on https://github.com/phy709/Aerial-R1.

    尽管多模态大型语言模型（MLLM）彻底改变了通用视觉感知，但现有方法在航空影像领域仍存在严重的幻觉问题，该领域充斥着极端的尺度变化和视觉歧义。现有的监督微调（SFT）范式要求模型模仿真实标注，却不对不确定性进行建模，因此在航空场景中遇到微小或无法识别的物体时，往往会盲目猜测。本文提出 Aerial-R1，这是首个旨在强化航空影像推理与分割视觉推理能力的航空 MLLM 框架。受 DeepSeek-R1 中激励推理机制的启发，我们发现，可靠的感知源于不同视图之间的一致性，这为逻辑中的思维链（Chain-of-Thought）建立了视觉类比。为了有效地将策略优化适配到非自回归掩码生成，我们提出混合视图组优势加权回归（H-GAWR）。该策略构建由高分辨率和低分辨率视图组成的动态分组，将组相对优势估计与优势加权策略提取无缝衔接。通过要求模型在清晰输入上达成共识，并对歧义输入上的幻觉进行严格惩罚，Aerial-R1 形成了一种受到明确激励的拒答机制。在 VSAI-Ref 上的大量实验表明，Aerial-R1 显著优于 SFT 基线的分割精度，同时大幅减少低信息场景中的严重幻觉，为打造更可靠、更可信的航空智能体铺平了道路。VSAI-Ref 是首个专门联合评估密集推理和幻觉鲁棒性的航空 MLLM 基准。代码见 https://github.com/phy709/Aerial-R1。

    ENGLISH

    Pathology foundation models (PFMs) differ substantially in architecture, pretraining objective, training data and representation dimensionality, yet it remains unclear whether they learn fundamentally different feature spaces or alternative coordinate systems of a shared underlying representation. We present MOSAIC, a systematic study of latent-space similarity, alignment and interoperability across $12$ patch-level and $6$ slide-level PFMs. We first quantify representational agreement using complementary similarity measures and analyze how architecture, pretraining objective, network depth and magnification influence latent geometry. We then evaluate multiple alignment strategies for mapping independently learned representations into a common latent space. The resulting representations are evaluated through cross-model agreement, retrieval, geometry preservation, and downstream multiple-instance learning across molecular and morphological prediction tasks. MOSAIC provides a unified framework for studying whether heterogeneous PFMs can move beyond representational similarity toward a shared and functionally transferable pathology representation space.     ENGLISH

    Unified large multimodal models (ULMMs) are able to perform visual reasoning through interleaved text-image generation, but generating explicit intermediate images incurs significant computational overhead. While visual latent reasoning addresses this, most existing methods rely on vision-language models (VLMs) incapable of visual generation. We propose Oddin, a novel framework enabling latent visual reasoning in ULMMs. Oddin replaces intermediate images with compact latent tokens processed entirely by the understanding branch, reserving the generation branch for the final output image. We train the model via offline self-distillation with three objectives, final image generation losses, text distillation losses, and cross-entropy losses for special tokens. Oddin surpasses interleaved generation baselines and closed-source VLMs on average across seven VBVR-Pro visual reasoning tasks.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    EEG visual decoding remains difficult because scalp recordings are noisy, spatially coarse, and variable across trials and subjects. Most systems align each trial with a dense image embedding, although that embedding mixes semantic content with instance-specific texture, pose, and background. This target can demand details absent from EEG and provides no explicit account of the visual factors supporting a prediction. We propose \textbf{ProtoEEG}, a prototype-mediated framework that reformulates EEG--image alignment as soft composition over a shared learnable visual codebook. A trainable EEG encoder and a frozen visual teacher produce assignment distributions over the same $K=64$ prototypes. Their weighted reconstructions form a structured representation for retrieval and image generation. Prototype contrast supplies the main cross-modal training signal, distribution alignment coordinates codebook use across modalities, an instance anchor preserves fine-grained discrimination, and diversity regularization prevents redundant prototypes. The shared assignment profile also makes the learned bottleneck directly testable through prototype retention, random selection, and identity shuffling. Across five seeds, ProtoEEG reaches 64.0\% Top-1 and 91.5\% Top-5 on THINGS-EEG2 200-way retrieval. After retraining on EEG-ImageNet, it obtains 44.8\% Top-1 and 73.8\% Top-5 in 80-way retrieval. ProtoEEG also ranks first on all seven reconstruction metrics. Removing prototype contrast lowers Top-1 by 56.9 percentage points, while shuffling prototype identities reduces it to 0.5\%. Prototype analyses further show distributed assignments and broad codebook use rather than one-prototype routing. These results support structured alignment targets as a practical alternative to increasing encoder or teacher capacity alone.

    EEG 视觉解码仍然很困难，因为头皮记录信号噪声大、空间分辨率粗糙，并且在不同试次和受试者之间存在差异。大多数系统将每个试次与稠密图像嵌入对齐，尽管该嵌入混合了语义内容与特定实例的纹理、姿态和背景。这种目标可能要求 EEG 中不存在的细节，也无法明确说明哪些视觉因素支持了预测。我们提出 \textbf{ProtoEEG}，一种原型中介框架，将 EEG--图像对齐重新表述为在共享的可学习视觉码本上的软组合。一个可训练的 EEG 编码器和一个冻结的视觉教师模型会在相同的 $K=64$ 原型上生成分配分布。它们的加权重建构成用于检索和图像生成的结构化表示。原型对比提供主要的跨模态训练信号，分布对齐协调不同模态对码本的使用，实例锚点保留细粒度区分能力，而多样性正则化可防止原型冗余。共享的分配轮廓还使学习到的瓶颈能够通过原型保留、随机选择和身份打乱进行直接测试。在五个随机种子下，ProtoEEG 在 THINGS-EEG2 的 200 类检索中达到 64.0\% 的 Top-1 和 91.5\% 的 Top-5。经过在 EEG-ImageNet 上重新训练后，它在 80 类检索中取得 44.8\% 的 Top-1 和 73.8\% 的 Top-5。ProtoEEG 在全部七项重建指标上也排名第一。移除原型对比会使 Top-1 下降 56.9 个百分点，而打乱原型身份则会使其降至 0.5\%。原型分析还显示，分配是分散的，码本使用范围广泛，而非路由到单一原型。这些结果支持将结构化对齐目标作为一种实用替代方案，而不是单纯增加编码器或教师模型的容量。

    推测式分叉：将空闲等待转化为仓库环境设置的并行探索

    Yuling Shi, Mingchu Zhong, Zhensu Sun, Weihan Peng, Zhi Chen, Shilin He, Chengcheng Wan, Kai Cai, Hongyu Zhang, David Lo, Xiaodong Gu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    SpecBuild uses parallel speculative branches to improve LLM agent environment setup speed and success, a substantial contribution to agent task execution and coordination. Its branching is aimed at setup exploration rather than compositional generalization or reasoning mechanisms, and the abstract gives no interpretability contribution.

    SpecBuild 采用并行推测分支，提高了 LLM 智能体设置环境的速度和成功率，是对智能体任务执行与协调的重要贡献。其分支机制用于探索设置方案，而非组合泛化或推理机制；摘要也未涉及可解释性贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Before developers can use a software project, they must first get it to run. This often requires installing the right language runtime, system packages, build tools, and test commands. Recent LLM-based agents automate environment setup by inspecting a repository, writing setup scripts, running them, and repairing the resulting errors. However, these agents still follow a sequential trial-and-error loop: they try one setup route, wait for slow commands to finish, observe the failure, and only then decide what to try next. Because environment commands often take long to run, this sequential workflow makes setup slow and limits exploration to one route at a time. We present SpecBuild, an LLM-based environment setup system designed to be both faster and more successful through speculative forking. SpecBuild explores candidate setup branches in parallel, returns the first committed environment, and discards the rest. It applies this design at two granularities: strategy-level forking explores alternative setup routes, such as different base images and dependency policies, while command-level forking predicts failures of running commands and prepares repair branches before those failures are observed. We evaluate SpecBuild on Multi-Docker-Eval, covering 334 tasks from 40 repositories and 9 programming languages. Across three backbone models, SpecBuild improves the success rate by 6.4 to 12.0 percentage points over the strongest baseline, while reducing average setup time by 22.4% to 41.6%. These results show that LLM-based environment setup need not trade speed for reliability: parallel speculative exploration can make agents both faster and more successful.

    中文

    开发者要使用一个软件项目，首先必须让它运行起来。这通常需要安装正确的语言运行时、系统软件包、构建工具和测试命令。近期基于 LLM 的智能体通过检查代码仓库、编写设置脚本、运行脚本并修复由此产生的错误，来自动完成环境设置。然而，这些智能体仍遵循顺序式试错循环：尝试一条设置路径，等待耗时命令完成，观察失败，然后才决定接下来尝试什么。由于环境命令通常运行时间较长，这种顺序工作流会使设置过程变慢，并将探索限制为一次一条路径。 我们提出 SpecBuild，这是一种基于 LLM 的环境设置系统，通过推测式分叉同时提升速度与成功率。SpecBuild 并行探索候选设置分支，返回第一个提交成功的环境，并丢弃其余分支。它在两个粒度上应用这一设计：策略级分叉探索不同的设置路径，例如不同的基础镜像和依赖策略；命令级分叉则预测正在运行的命令可能出现的失败，并在观察到失败之前准备修复分支。 我们在 Multi-Docker-Eval 上评估 SpecBuild，该基准涵盖来自 40 个代码仓库和 9 种编程语言的 334 项任务。在三种骨干模型上，与最强基线相比，SpecBuild 将成功率提高了 6.4 至 12.0 个百分点，同时将平均设置时间缩短了 22.4% 至 41.6%。这些结果表明，基于 LLM 的环境设置无需在速度与可靠性之间取舍：并行推测式探索可以让智能体既更快也更成功。

    Nico Policzer, James Ho, Joseph Soo, Xin Tang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Neural-DISCO separates label-specific and residual latent components to edit neural activity counterfactually, and uses attribution to identify neurons associated with labels, providing substantive insight into representation structure. Its use of disentanglement and selective editing is not about composing concepts or model reasoning or agent systems.

    Neural-DISCO 将标签特定的潜在成分与残差潜在成分分离，以便对神经活动进行反事实编辑，并利用归因识别与标签相关的神经元，从而对表示结构提供了实质性见解。它采用解耦和选择性编辑，但研究重点并非概念组合、模型推理或智能体系统。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Understanding how neural activity encodes behavioral and sensory variables is a key challenge in systems neuroscience. This requires models that go beyond predicting activity from labels and instead support source-conditioned counterfactual editing: given a recorded source response, we should be able to edit one measured behavioral or stimulus label and predict how neural activity would change while preserving other observed labels and source-specific variability not explained by the labels. Here, we introduce \textbf{Neural-DISCO}, a disentangled representation learning framework for counterfactual modeling of neural activity. Neural-DISCO partitions the latent space into label-specific components, each associated with an observed behavioral or stimulus label, together with a residual latent that captures variability not supplied through observed labels. Across simulated and real neural recording datasets, we show that this structure enables selective editing of measured labels to generate counterfactual neural responses while preserving the remaining content of the original activity. Further, to gain insight into how behavioral and stimulus labels are encoded at single-neuron resolution, we pair this disentangled framework with feature attribution methods that identify which neurons are most important for each label. We find that disentanglement enhances the recovery of known functional cell roles in both synthetic and real data. Together, these results support Neural-DISCO as a framework for counterfactual modeling of neural activity and provide a practical interface for probing how neural populations encode behavior and sensory information. Code is available at https://github.com/TangLab-UBC/Neural-DISCO-neurips.

    理解神经活动如何编码行为和感觉变量，是系统神经科学的一项关键挑战。这需要模型不只根据标签预测活动，还能支持源条件反事实编辑：给定一条记录的源响应，我们应当能够编辑一个测得的行为或刺激标签，并预测神经活动将如何变化，同时保留其他已观测标签以及源特有的、无法由这些标签解释的变异。在此，我们介绍 \textbf{Neural-DISCO}，一种用于神经活动反事实建模的解耦表示学习框架。Neural-DISCO 将潜在空间划分为与已观测行为或刺激标签分别关联的标签特定成分，以及一个捕捉未通过已观测标签提供的变异的残差潜变量。在模拟和真实神经记录数据集上，我们表明，这种结构能够选择性地编辑测得的标签以生成反事实神经响应，同时保留原始活动的其余内容。此外，为了深入了解行为和刺激标签如何在单神经元层面编码，我们将这一解耦框架与特征归因方法结合，以识别对每个标签最重要的神经元。我们发现，解耦能够提升在合成数据和真实数据中恢复已知功能性细胞角色的能力。总之，这些结果支持将 Neural-DISCO 用作神经活动反事实建模框架，并提供一个实用接口，用于探查神经群体如何编码行为和感觉信息。代码见 https://github.com/TangLab-UBC/Neural-DISCO-neurips。

    Position, Role or Label? A Controlled Study of Instruction Conflicts in LLM Agents

    位置、角色还是标签？对 LLM 智能体指令冲突的受控研究

    Anish Laddha, Nitesh Pradhan, Gaurav Srivastava

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper measures how instruction source, position, and labels affect conflict resolution in LLM agents, contributing controlled evidence about agent behavior and instruction handling. Its connection to reasoning is incidental: it evaluates which instruction wins rather than reasoning mechanisms or capability development.

    本文测量了指令来源、位置和标签如何影响 LLM 智能体的冲突解决，为智能体行为和指令处理提供了受控证据。它与推理的关联只是附带的：研究评估的是哪条指令胜出，而非推理机制或能力发展。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    LLM agents take instructions from the operator, repository configuration, user, tool results and saved memory, which often conflict. Instruction-hierarchy benchmarks ask whether the higher-ranked source wins, but a source sets position, role and label at once. First, we build WhoWins, 1,080 code-scored scenarios in five task types, each with up to five mutually exclusive instructions, and seven controlled experiments that vary only how instructions are delivered. Second, we study 14 open-weight models (0.6B to 122B, thinking off and on) over 1,887,356 scored replies, checking main findings on held-out scenarios. Inside one message the first of two conflicting lines wins 72.42 to 94.66%, and across messages it keeps 22.95 to 62.65%. A policy sent first in the system (or developer) message loses most conflicts with later lines in every Qwen model but wins most on gpt-oss when it acts. In tool and file-write tasks it wins less often than the same text sent first as a labelled user message, in every model-mode. Third, we test whether pairs forecast larger conflicts; forecasts improve in every model-mode once they know where the task line is. Finally, by our keyword patterns at most 2.92% of decided pair replies flag or hedge a conflict.

    中文

    LLM 智能体接收来自操作者、代码仓库配置、用户、工具结果和已保存记忆的指令，这些指令往往相互冲突。指令层级基准会询问排名较高的来源是否胜出，但单一来源会同时设定位置、角色和标签。首先，我们构建了 WhoWins，其中包括 1,080 个通过代码评分的场景，涵盖五类任务；每个场景最多包含五条互斥指令，并设置了七项受控实验，每项实验只改变指令的传递方式。其次，我们研究了 14 个开放权重模型（0.6B 至 122B，关闭和开启思考模式），共评估 1,887,356 条回复，并在留出场景上验证主要发现。在同一条消息中，两条冲突语句里靠前的一条胜出率为 72.42% 至 94.66%；跨消息时，其胜出率为 22.95% 至 62.65%。在每个 Qwen 模型中，先在 system（或 developer）消息中发送的策略，在与后续语句冲突时大多落败；而在 gpt-oss 中，当其采取行动时，大多能胜出。在工具和文件写入任务中，对于所有模型和模式，同一文本若作为带标签的用户消息靠前发送，其胜出率会高于先在其他位置发送。第三，我们测试成对冲突能否预测更大的冲突；当模型知道任务语句的位置后，所有模型和模式的预测效果都有提升。最后，根据我们的关键词模式，在已作出判定的成对冲突回复中，最多只有 2.92% 会指出存在冲突或对此表示保留。

    链与增益：强化学习如何改变基于推理的图像质量评估

    Yixuan Li, Yuxuan Jiang, Hanwei Zhu, Hancheng Zhu, Fan Zhang, Shiqi Wang, David Bull

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The study uses controlled interventions to examine how RLVR changes explicit reasoning chains and image-quality scoring, including whether scoring depends on those chains or shortcuts. This substantially informs reasoning capability development, while its probing of a quality direction is limited evidence about internal representations rather than a main interpretability contribution.

    该研究通过受控干预考察 RLVR 如何改变显式推理链和图像质量评分，包括评分是否依赖这些推理链或捷径。这对推理能力的发展具有重要启示；但其对质量方向的探测，只能有限地说明内部表征，并非其主要的可解释性贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has improved the performance of large Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on image quality assessment (IQA). Existing approaches often attribute these gains to improved reasoning before scoring, supported by increasingly plausible Chain-of-Thought (CoT). However, whether these gains exceed sampling effects and how they depend on explicit reasoning remain unclear. We rigorously investigate these questions through sampling-aware evaluation, controlled reasoning interventions, and shortcut experiments. We find that RL-trained models outperform base models under large-budget $\operatorname{max}_g@k$ evaluation, while improvements beyond averaging are concentrated in-distribution. RLVR produces chains that raise base-model performance when transplanted and improves scoring with the chain held fixed. Yet scoring becomes less dependent on the chain during inference, more clearly at 7B than at 32B. Steering the probed quality direction in thinking tokens also has little effect on scoring. Finally, RL can improve scoring accuracy by exploiting textual cues correlated with mean opinion scores (MOSs), which could inflate benchmark performance. Together, these findings show that RLVR raises quality scoring and produces more useful chains, but that better scoring does not imply a stronger reliance on explicit reasoning, while score-based rewards can also encourage reliance on quality-irrelevant shortcuts. We hope this preliminary study can enlighten more and more concrete reasoning schemes in IQA.

    带有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）提升了大型视觉语言模型（VLMs）在图像质量评估（IQA）上的表现。现有方法通常将这些增益归因于评分前推理能力的提升，并以日益可信的思维链（CoT）作为依据。然而，这些增益是否超出采样效应，以及它们如何依赖显式推理，仍不清楚。我们通过考虑采样的评估、受控的推理干预和捷径实验，严格考察了这些问题。我们发现，在大预算 $\operatorname{max}_g@k$评估下，经过 RL 训练的模型优于基础模型，而超出取平均所带来的改进则集中在分布内。RLVR 生成的推理链在移植后能提升基础模型的表现，并且在固定推理链时也能改善评分。然而，在推理时，评分对推理链的依赖变得更低；与 32B 相比，这一点在 7B 上更为明显。对思考 token 中探测到的质量方向进行引导，也几乎不会影响评分。最后，RL 可以利用与平均意见分数（MOSs）相关的文本线索来提高评分准确率，这可能会抬高基准测试表现。综合来看，这些发现表明，RLVR 提高了质量评分并生成了更有用的推理链，但评分更好并不意味着对显式推理的依赖更强；与此同时，基于分数的奖励也可能促使模型依赖与质量无关的捷径。我们希望这项初步研究能启发 IQA 中越来越多、更具体的推理方案。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper identifies low-rank query–vision interaction modes and uses them to prune visual tokens efficiently, a substantial algorithmic contribution to model computation. Its analysis concerns interaction structure for pruning rather than explaining internal representations or reasoning, so those connections remain incidental.

    本文识别出低秩的查询-视觉交互模式，并据此高效剪枝视觉 token，这是对模型计算的一项重要算法贡献。其分析关注用于剪枝的交互结构，而非解释内部表示或推理，因此与后两者的联系只是附带的。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large vision-language models (VLMs), which process both visual inputs and text queries, incur high inference costs due to the large number of visual tokens, making visual token pruning a natural approach for improving efficiency. Recent work has leveraged query information to guide token selection, often through heuristics derived from attention patterns or token dynamics. However, these approaches do not explicitly exploit the underlying structure of query-vision interactions. We address this gap by observing that the query-vision interaction matrix, naturally induced by the query and key projections already present in transformer attention, is effectively low-rank, with a small number of dominant latent interaction modes capturing query-relevant semantics. Motivated by this observation, we propose Query-Vision Decomposition (QViD), a novel training-free query-aware visual token pruning method that exploits this structure. Extensive experiments on both image and video understanding benchmarks show that QViD consistently improves performance under matched token budgets, with the largest gains appearing under aggressive compression regimes.

    David Arbour, Erfan Jahanparast, Serina Chang, Avi Feller

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper develops an orthogonalized estimator for activation-steering directions, with continuous outcomes and double-robustness properties, advancing how internal activation changes are measured and applied. It does not investigate representation structure or reasoning capabilities, and steering alone does not establish a systems contribution.

    本文开发了用于估计激活引导方向的正交化估计量，并支持连续结果且具备双重稳健性质，从而推进了对内部激活变化进行测量和应用的方法。本文不研究表示结构或推理能力，而激活引导本身也不足以证明其对系统作出了贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Activation steering is a popular approach for shifting LLM output toward a desired behavior, and increasingly for generating realistic synthetic data. The standard recipe estimates a steering direction by contrasting LLM activations on prompts with and without a target concept, such as truthfulness. In this paper, we separate the estimand (the steering direction these methods target) from the estimator used to recover it, two notions the literature often conflates. We frame nearly all existing methods as plug-in estimators of the average gradient of an outcome regression, with the binary contrastive label fixed as the outcome. Using this framing, we can immediately incorporate flexible modeling approaches and extend existing methods to allow for continuous outcomes such as log-probabilities or oracle ratings. Flexible ML models that fit the outcome well, however, might not estimate the gradient well, which motivates estimators that target the gradient directly. Drawing on the debiased machine learning literature, we develop a complementary estimator built on the Stein score, the Riesz representer of the gradient functional. Combining the two routes gives an orthogonalized estimator with classical double-robustness properties. We illustrate the framework on activation steering applied to a number of benchmark datasets.

    激活引导是一种常用方法，可使 LLM 输出转向期望的行为，并且越来越多地用于生成逼真的合成数据。标准做法是比较 LLM 在包含和不包含目标概念（例如真实性）的提示上的激活，以估计引导方向。本文将估计目标（这些方法所针对的引导方向）与用于恢复该目标的估计量区分开来；文献中经常混淆这两个概念。我们将几乎所有现有方法都表述为结果回归平均梯度的插件估计量，并将二元对比标签固定为结果变量。基于这一表述，我们可以直接纳入灵活的建模方法，并扩展现有方法，使其支持对数概率或预言机评分等连续结果。然而，能够很好拟合结果的灵活机器学习模型，未必能很好地估计梯度，这促使我们开发直接针对梯度的估计量。借鉴去偏机器学习领域的研究，我们开发了一种互补估计量，它建立在 Stein score（梯度泛函的 Riesz 表示元）之上。结合这两条路径，可得到具有经典双重稳健性质的正交化估计量。我们通过将该框架应用于多个基准数据集上的激活引导来展示其效果。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Data science agents can automate end-to-end machine learning workflows, yet they remain far from competitive on human leaderboards. Agents make process errors such as insufficient exploration, unsound validation, coding bugs, and poor use of a fixed budget (re-running the same exploratory data analysis and baseline models in every attempt). We propose AdaPRA to address these issues: a persistent coding agent harness that accumulates knowledge across attempts on the same task, with rubric-guided process supervision that identifies and corrects errors. Our process reward agent audits the agent's trajectory and workspace by executing checks, and adapts its rubrics to each task. We find that rubrics seeded from easier tasks generalize to harder tasks, with rubric adaptation further improving performance. With five attempts per task, AdaPRA improves an 80B Qwen model's leaderboard percentile by 24.5 points on DSPredict-Easy and 14.8 points on DSPredict-Hard while reducing process errors. We also show that supervision with rubrics mined from one base model's runs improves another (DeepSeek-V3.2), and that AdaPRA beats DataPRM, a competitive PRM for data science. We also share our code for reproducibility.

    Scoped Semantic Invariance as a Foundation for LLM Reliability

    将范围化语义不变性作为 LLM 可靠性的基础

    Rosario Uceda-Sosa and Maria Chang and Karthikeyan Natesan Ramamurthy and Moninder Singh

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper formalizes scoped semantic invariance and finds recurring graph structures in inconsistency hotspots, then shows that selective grounding improves consistency and transfers to compositional reasoning tasks. This offers substantial insight into compositional generalization and reasoning reliability, but does not examine internal model mechanisms or system architecture.

    本文形式化了范围化语义不变性，发现了不一致热点中反复出现的图结构，并进一步表明选择性接地能够提升一致性，且可迁移到组合推理任务。这为组合泛化和推理可靠性提供了重要见解，但没有考察模型内部机制或系统架构。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    LLMs often answer semantically equivalent queries inconsistently, even when the underlying facts are known. We formalize consistency as semantic invariance over equivalence classes of queries and show that invariance under arbitrary meaning-preserving transformations is undecidable in general. This motivates scoped semantic invariance, where model behavior is evaluated relative to bounded semantic domains. We operationalize this framework using knowledge graphs (KGs), which act as explicit semantic control structures defining local semantic constraints and grounding contexts. Across the MITRE D3FEND ontology and eight Wikidata- derived domains, we show that inconsistencies are structured rather than random, concentrating in localized hotspot subgraphs organized around recurring TREE, STAR, and CYCLE patterns that remain stable across models and domains. We further show that selective graph grounding improves correctness and cross-model consistency, while indiscriminate grounding introduces regressions. A layered grounding strategy achieves the strongest monotonicity profile, preserving correct knowledge while reducing inconsistency. Finally, we show that hotspot structures discovered from simple consistency probes transfer to more realistic compositional reasoning tasks.

    即使底层事实已知，LLM 对语义等价的查询也常常给出不一致的回答。我们将一致性形式化为查询等价类上的语义不变性，并证明，对任意保义变换保持不变性通常是不可判定的。这促使我们提出范围化语义不变性，即相对于有界语义域评估模型行为。我们使用知识图谱（KG）将这一框架付诸实践；知识图谱充当显式语义控制结构，定义局部语义约束和接地上下文。通过 MITRE D3FEND 本体和八个源自 Wikidata 的领域，我们表明不一致具有结构性而非随机性，它们集中在局部热点子图中，并围绕反复出现的 TREE、STAR 和 CYCLE 模式组织；这些模式在不同模型和领域中保持稳定。我们还表明，选择性图接地可以提高正确性和跨模型一致性，而不加区分地进行接地则会导致性能退化。分层接地策略实现了最强的单调性特征，在减少不一致的同时保留正确知识。最后，我们表明，从简单一致性探测中发现的热点结构可以迁移到更现实的组合推理任务中。

    ENGLISH

    Large Language Model (LLM) based multi-agent systems introduce a distinctive reliability challenge in which actions taken by upstream agents can affect the correctness of downstream agents. While prior work has investigated error propagation and developed methods for estimating uncertainty inherited from upstream agents, existing approaches do not explicitly model how realized sender-receiver interactions contribute to downstream error risk under different sender correctness states. In this work, we study agent-level error-risk estimation from multi-agent execution traces. We propose Interaction-Effect Propagation (IE-Prop), an interaction-conditioned model that learns separate effects for correct and incorrect upstream agents. For each sender-receiver interaction, the model combines these conditional effects using the sender's estimated error risk, and recursively propagates the resulting risk estimates through the execution graph. We evaluate our approach across three multi-agent architectures and three benchmarks. Across all evaluated architectures, our approach raises the final-node AUROC over the established baseline by approximately 0.05 points on average. Furthermore, tracking risk across multiple agent steps contributes a distinct +0.03 AUROC gain in sequential systems. These results show that realized inter-agent interactions provide predictive information beyond receiver-local evidence, while the value of multi-step risk tracking depends on the system's information-flow structure.

    The paper contributes a distributed security runtime that governs agent launches and supervises running jobs across HPC ranks, with hardware-rooted attestation and fail-closed controls. This is a substantial agent and system architecture contribution; the use of LLM agents is context, not a contribution to model reasoning or interpretability.

    本文贡献了一种分布式安全运行时，用于治理智能体的启动，并监督跨 HPC 各 rank 运行的作业；该运行时具备硬件根信任证明和故障关闭控制。这是一项重要的智能体与系统架构贡献；LLM 智能体的使用只是背景，并未对模型推理或可解释性作出贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language model agents launch simulations on high-performance computing (HPC) systems, where one sbatch or mpirun can commit thousands of node-hours and a forged result can cost lives. Of 23 surveyed systems, none supervises the running job, and none holds when the control host is compromised. We fix both. Enclawed, our deterministic security runtime for AI agents, has until now served a single user; this work makes it a distributed runtime for parallel HPC and agent swarms. The Enclaweder, our hardware root of trust, keeps a compromised host from becoming a catastrophe. A launch gate decides every launch by policy alone, refusing what it cannot parse. Once the job runs, a swarm chain grants short leases against signed heartbeats and evicts on evidence, and a supervisor around every rank pauses it when its lease lapses and kills it on tampering. Each node signs with its Enclaweder's key, so the host can forge none of it. Enclawed needs no administrator privileges and plugs into existing clusters unchanged, over Secure Shell alone. Supervision leaves the compute loop of a 16-rank LAMMPS job unchanged, on graphics processors too, and adds about 3 s of start-up. Twelve live attacks on Enclaweder-keyed ranks, colluding coordinators included, ended fail-closed. Sixteen agents on a real model attempted 24 launches that planted instructions ordered; the gate denied all 24 and allowed all 108 legitimate ones. Enclawed's core and the HPC Agent Security Benchmark are open source.

    Recurrent transformers reuse weights to perform deep computation with fewer parameters. We study an LSTM-style transformer that also shares one key--value cache across its recurrent core. At width 1024, it uses 40.4% fewer parameters than an untied control at nearly matched forward FLOPs, and reduces persistent cache sets from fifteen to four. Parallel training supplies cache entries from a standard-attention pass, whereas continuation reads entries produced recursively using shared attention. We address this mismatch by aligning the two training passes' cache entries with a consistency loss during the final 10% of a fixed training-token budget. Across three model widths on FineWeb, this removes 81--89% of the continuation-loss penalty relative to full-cache evaluation. The improvement replicates on disjoint documents for two training seeds. Across four widths and 1.05--4.19B training tokens, the loss cost of weight tying is smallest at lower token budgets, suggesting an opportunity to use recurrent computation when data and model storage are limited.

    Enterprise workflow agents typically rely on step-by-step interaction (Step-by-Step): the agent executes an action, observes its result, and invokes a large language model (LLM) again to decide the next step. Global orchestration (Global) instead generates a complete executable workflow in advance and executes it without further LLM calls, substantially reducing inference overhead, but it remains less accurate than Step-by-Step. We study how close Global can come to Step-by-Step and what narrows the remaining gap. We introduce AgentOrch, a benchmark that directly compares global orchestration with step-by-step interaction on 650 enterprise SOPs and 3,220 runtime variants under matched tools, environments, and evaluation. Step-by-Step remains more accurate for every evaluated model, but the gap has shrunk by about 79% from early models to the strongest recent model. We identify three routes to further narrowing this gap. Incremental workflow construction improves Global accuracy by an average of 9.98 percentage points (pp) without runtime execution feedback. Revising complete workflows with execution feedback improves all evaluated models, including 6.13 pp on held-out runtime variants. Targeted training on complete workflows improves accuracy by an average of 12.18 pp across all five trained models. Although a gap remains, global orchestration offers a promising path toward enterprise agents that deliver higher accuracy with fewer LLM calls.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Packed-SS introduces a decoding schedule that overlaps diffusion drafting with verification in one model call, reducing input growth and improving throughput while preserving the target distribution.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Autoregressive (AR) language models generate tokens sequentially, so generating long outputs is costly. Speculative decoding mitigates this by using a lightweight drafter to propose multiple tokens for the target AR model to verify in parallel, while a diffusion-based drafter can produce an entire draft block in one forward pass. In models with AR and diffusion modes, one network both drafts and verifies, but drafting still waits for verification, so the standard schedule needs two sequential model calls per iteration. Existing one-call schedules avoid the wait but incur input size quadratic in the speculative width. Motivated by this efficiency bottleneck, we introduce Packed-SS, a self-speculative decoding schedule that verifies and drafts in a single model call with input size linear in the speculative width, while preserving the target model's distribution. The key idea is to let the diffusion drafter run one call ahead: while verifying the current draft, the model simultaneously constructs the next draft from an older verified prefix and keeps its unresolved suffix for the next iteration. Under a mild monotonicity assumption on the drafter, we further show that Packed-SS requires no more model calls than the standard two-call decoding in the greedy setting. Experiments on Nemotron 3B/8B and SetDLM 1.7B show higher throughput and lower mean wall time than both baselines under greedy decoding.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    As LLMs scale, mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures increase model capacity while keeping per-token computation manageable through sparse expert activation. This sparsity also enables memory-efficient deployment by retaining most expert weights in CPU memory and transferring or executing only the routed experts on demand. Existing MoE offloading systems typically target specific model-platform configurations, yet differences in model sparsity, CPU and GPU throughput, VRAM capacity, and host-device bandwidth can change the policy ranking. Because implementing and exhaustively evaluating all candidate policies incurs substantial engineering cost, efficiently selecting the best-performing policy for each model-platform configuration remains a key challenge for practical MoE offloading. We present COPE (Composable Offloading Policy Emulator), which selects the best-performing MoE offloading policy for a target model-platform configuration before runtime integration. COPE comprises two components. Its Policy Matrix factors the design space into two independent axes, expert residency and MoE execution strategy, enabling mechanism reuse across candidate policies and exposing four new candidates. Its Virtual Heterogeneous Machine profiles combined-operator schedules on the target platform and combines these measurements with offline routing traces to estimate candidate performance. Compared with the evaluated baselines, COPE improves fastest-policy selection accuracy by 24%-100% and reduces performance-prediction error by $1.7\times$ to $6.8\times$. By identifying the preferred policy before integration, COPE further reduces policy-specific implementation effort by up to 74%.

    随着 LLM 不断扩展，混合专家（MoE）架构通过稀疏激活专家来提升模型容量，同时使每个词元的计算量保持在可控范围内。这种稀疏性还支持内存高效的部署：大部分专家权重保留在 CPU 内存中，仅按需传输或执行被路由到的专家。现有 MoE 卸载系统通常面向特定的模型与平台配置，但模型稀疏度、CPU 和 GPU 吞吐量、VRAM 容量以及主机与设备之间的带宽差异，都可能改变策略的排名。由于实现并全面评估所有候选策略需要付出大量工程成本，如何针对每种模型与平台配置高效选出性能最佳的策略，仍是 MoE 实际卸载中的一项关键挑战。我们提出 COPE（可组合卸载策略仿真器），可在将策略集成到运行时之前，为目标模型与平台配置选出性能最佳的 MoE 卸载策略。COPE 由两个组件构成。其策略矩阵将设计空间拆分为两个相互独立的维度：专家驻留方式和 MoE 执行策略。这使不同候选策略能够复用机制，并揭示出四种新的候选策略。其虚拟异构机器会在目标平台上分析组合算子调度，并将这些测量结果与离线路由轨迹结合，以估计候选策略的性能。与参与评估的基线相比，COPE 将最快策略的选择准确率提高了 24%-100%，并将性能预测误差降低了 $1.7\times$ 至 $6.8\times$。通过在集成前识别首选策略，COPE 还能将特定策略的实现工作量最多减少 74%。

To study this problem, we construct \textbf{MemAlign}, a benchmark comprising 1,079 curated memory cases grounded in synthetic, validated multi-session conversational contexts covering diverse misalignment taxonomies. However, how abstract the knowledge that enables such productivity is remains unclear. We focus on extending the use of a novel verb learned in the active voice to passive contexts. We find people extend active to passive uses in a way consistent with abstract generalizations concerning linguistic form, even when no plausible meaning can be assigned to the novel verb. We define an autonomous agent as a system that, within explicit identity and authority boundaries, maintains both task goals and viability conditions, acts continuously using models of the world and itself, and adjusts its control mechanisms and long-term capabilities through feedback.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    The widespread deployment of foundational Large Language Models (LLM) across cloud datacenters marks a fundamental paradigm shift from stateless deep learning toward distributed, memory-intensive generative workloads. However, serving massive foundation models under stringent Service Level Objectives (SLO) exposes critical physical and system bottlenecks. These challenges include the persistent High Bandwidth Memory (HBM) wall, operational asymmetry between compute-bound prefilling and memory-bandwidth-bound decoding, explosive Key-Value (KV) cache expansion, prohibitive serverless cold starts, and hardware reliability vulnerabilities. Existing literature reviews remain layer-siloed, decoupling low-level accelerator virtualization from cluster orchestration and runtime inference, while largely overlooking defining advancements from 2024 to 2026. To address these limitations, this study presents a comprehensive, cross-layer systematic review guided by the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) 2020 framework. We synthesize a holistic taxonomy unifying hardware virtualization, cluster-level scheduling, and runtime inference optimizations, including iteration-level continuous batching, prefill-decoding disaggregation, and hierarchical KV cache offloading. Furthermore, we evaluate resilient cloud-native service architectures, examining scale-to-zero serverless paradigms, fault-tolerant checkpointing against silent data corruption, and hardware-enforced Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs) for multi-tenant isolation. Finally, we formalize the multi-dimensional Pareto trade-offs governing throughput, latency, monetary cost, and confidentiality, outlining a forward-looking research roadmap spanning Compute Express Link (CXL) memory pooling, in-memory computing, and autonomous multi-agent control planes to guide future cloud LLM infrastructure.

    Model merging combines task-specific expert models into a single model without joint training on their original datasets, but often incurs a performance gap relative to the individual experts. At each intermediate block boundary, a bridge module projects the merged representation onto the next block's input-projection error subspace and maps these coordinates to an additive correction in the current block's output-projection error subspace. The subspace bases remain fixed, so calibration learns only these linear maps, yielding a parameter-efficient mechanism for feature correction. We find that ESCal brings the merged model closer to the experts in both representations and predictions, indicating more faithful recovery of task-specific behavior. Experiments on vision and natural language understanding benchmarks show that ESCal improves merged-model performance across diverse architectures and merging methods using a small calibration set for each task.

We ask whether five frozen, independently trained models with different internal designs (four transformers from four organizations and one state-space model) can be related through their activations alone, with no weight merging. Using permutation tests, an independent replication probe set, depth sweeps, pooling ablations and confound checks, we find statistically robust correspondence between how the five models organize the same text. It is strongest at each model's final layer and weaker for the state-space model, whose weakest pairing is still 35-43 times chance. We use this to build a shared space with Generalized Procrustes Analysis, in which no model is a fixed reference. At the final layer, mean held-out retrieval accuracy over the twenty ordered model pairs is 0.91 to 0.93 on two probe sets (chance 0.03), beating pairwise linear maps (0.82 to 0.85), but the space is worse than those maps in the middle layers. It transfers to ordinary English of unfamiliar grammatical form and fails on mathematical and logical notation. We then test whether the space supports a router that picks among the five models on gradeable tasks. Across four task types we find no case where routing beats always using the strongest model, and we report this as a negative result. A correctness signal that looked strong turned out to be category membership in disguise. All experiments ran on one laptop without a GPU.

    中文

    语言模型通常通过权重平均来合并，但只有模型具有共同的起点时这种方法才有效。我们考察五个冻结且独立训练、内部设计各不相同的模型（来自四家机构的四个 Transformer 和一个状态空间模型），能否仅通过其激活建立联系，而无需合并权重。通过置换检验、独立的复现探测集、深度扫描、池化消融和混杂因素检查，我们发现这五个模型组织相同文本的方式之间存在统计上稳健的对应关系。这种对应在每个模型的最后一层最强，对状态空间模型则较弱；即便其最弱的配对，也比随机水平高 35-43 倍。我们使用广义 Procrustes 分析构建共享空间，其中没有任何一个模型被设为固定参照。在最后一层，二十个有序模型对的平均留出检索准确率在两个探测集上达到 0.91 至 0.93（随机水平为 0.03），优于成对线性映射（0.82 至 0.85）；但在中间层，该空间的表现不如这些映射。它能迁移到语法形式陌生的普通英语，但无法迁移到数学和逻辑符号。随后，我们测试该空间能否支持一个在可判分任务中从五个模型里挑选模型的路由器。在四类任务中，我们没有发现路由优于始终使用最强模型的情况，并将其报告为负面结果。一个看似强劲的正确性信号，最终被发现只是类别成员关系的伪装。所有实验均在一台没有 GPU 的笔记本电脑上运行。

    FedSEAM: Federated Continual Learning of LLMs via Subspace Expert Agreement Merging

    FedSEAM：通过子空间专家一致性合并实现 LLM 联邦持续学习

    Fatema Siddika, Abhijit Chunduru, Zilinghan Li, Ali Jannesari, Ravi Madduri

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    FedSEAM uses subspace compatibility and agreement to share expert knowledge while preserving client-specific updates in federated continual learning. This offers partial insight into representation subspaces and task reuse, while its main contribution is a model system for expert coordination and continual memory; the abstract does not address reasoning.

    FedSEAM 利用子空间兼容性和一致性来共享专家知识，同时在联邦持续学习中保留客户端特定的更新。这为表征子空间和任务复用提供了一定洞见，但其主要贡献是用于专家协调和持续记忆的模型系统；摘要没有涉及推理。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Federated continual learning trains a model on a sequence of tasks across several clients without sharing their data while retaining knowledge of earlier tasks. Sparse mixture-of-experts models support this setting by adapting selected parameters on a frozen backbone. However, clients learn different expert content as tasks evolve, making it difficult to share knowledge across clients without disrupting task-specific and client-specific specialization. Matching tile coordinates alone does not establish whether their learned content is compatible. We present FedSEAM, a federated continual learning framework that organizes task knowledge into sparse experts and selectively shares their content across tasks and clients. On each client, task-aware tile selection allocates capacity to a new task, while a subspace-based compatibility test determines which existing expert tiles to reuse and where to introduce fresh capacity. On the server, Subspace Expert Agreement Merging (SEAM) compares client updates as subspaces and moves each client towards consensus only along agreed-upon directions, leaving the rest of its update unchanged. We identify two remaining sources of forgetting, routing drift and merge erasure, and address them with three protections, one of which exactly preserves tile components in a selected prior-overlap subspace at every merge. We evaluate FedSEAM on TRACE using Qwen3-4B and Llama-3.2-3B, with component-wise ablations and studies of data size to assess its balance between learning new tasks and retaining prior knowledge.

    中文

    联邦持续学习使模型能够在多个客户端上依次学习一系列任务，同时不共享客户端数据并保留早期任务的知识。稀疏混合专家模型通过在冻结的主干网络上调整选定参数，支持这一设置。然而，随着任务演进，各客户端学到的专家内容会有所不同，因此很难在不破坏任务特定和客户端特定专门化的情况下跨客户端共享知识。仅匹配分块坐标并不能证明其学习到的内容相互兼容。我们提出 FedSEAM，这是一种联邦持续学习框架，将任务知识组织为稀疏专家，并有选择地在不同任务和客户端之间共享其内容。在每个客户端上，任务感知的分块选择为新任务分配容量，而基于子空间的兼容性测试则确定复用哪些现有专家分块，以及在哪里引入新的容量。在服务器上，子空间专家一致性合并（SEAM）将客户端更新视为子空间进行比较，只沿着达成一致的方向推动各客户端趋向共识，同时保持其余更新不变。我们识别出两个尚存的遗忘来源：路由漂移和合并抹除，并用三种保护机制加以处理，其中一种会在每次合并时精确保留所选历史重叠子空间中的分块分量。我们使用 Qwen3-4B 和 Llama-3.2-3B 在 TRACE 上评估 FedSEAM，并通过逐组件消融和数据规模研究，评估其在学习新任务与保留既有知识之间的平衡。

    DualPace: Decoupled Scheduling and Cooperative GPU--CPU Decoding for LLM Serving

    DualPace：面向 LLM 服务的解耦调度与 GPU--CPU 协同解码

    YuXuan Lin, KeQiang Wu, Kingsum Chow

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    DualPace contributes an independently scheduled CPU decode engine with cooperative GPU assistance, improving LLM serving throughput and latency. This is a substantial systems contribution; its decoding and routing do not, as described, investigate model reasoning or internal representations.

    DualPace 提供了一个独立调度的 CPU 解码引擎，并配合 GPU 协助，从而提升 LLM 服务的吞吐量并改善延迟。这是一项实质性的系统贡献；按摘要所述，其解码和路由并未研究模型推理或内部表征。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language model (LLM) serving relies on batching to improve inference throughput, but the key-value (KV) cache grows with sequence length and limits GPU-resident concurrency. CPU offloading can expand KV capacity using host memory, yet existing systems remain largely GPU-gated: CPU-resident requests make progress only when the GPU scheduler exposes suitable overlap opportunities. As a result, host memory and CPU compute cannot act as an independent serving resource, leading to bursty CPU-side progress and inflated tail inter-token latency (ITL) under load. We present DualPace, an LLM serving runtime that turns the host into an independently scheduled decode engine. DualPace separates scheduling authority across two engines: the GPU engine executes prefills and GPU-resident decodes, while an AMX-enabled CPU engine independently batches and advances CPU-resident decodes. The engines are decoupled in scheduling but cooperative in execution: the CPU can execute a complete decode iteration locally or selectively invoke GPU Dense Assist for dense stages, while offline profiles guide hardware-specific batching and routing. Our evaluations show that, in decode-oriented scenarios, DualPace improves serving throughput by 6.9--43.2\% over NEO, a state-of-the-art open-source CPU-offloading system, and by 11.5--90.6\% over vLLM, a widely used GPU serving system, while maintaining the same level of latency. DualPace also preserves NEO's P99 time-to-first-token (TTFT) advantage over vLLM while sustaining 7.3--50.5\% higher request rates than NEO at the same level of P99 ITL.

    中文

    大型语言模型（LLM）服务依靠批处理提升推理吞吐量，但键值（KV）缓存会随序列长度增长，从而限制驻留 GPU 的并发量。CPU 卸载可利用主机内存扩展 KV 容量，但现有系统在很大程度上仍受 GPU 调度制约：CPU 驻留请求只有在 GPU 调度器提供合适的重叠机会时才能取得进展。因此，主机内存和 CPU 计算无法作为独立的服务资源运行，导致 CPU 侧进展时快时慢，并在负载下加剧词元间延迟（ITL）的尾部延迟。我们提出 DualPace，这是一种 LLM 服务运行时，可将主机转变为独立调度的解码引擎。DualPace 在两个引擎之间分离调度权：GPU 引擎执行预填充和驻留 GPU 的解码，而支持 AMX 的 CPU 引擎则独立批处理并推进驻留 CPU 的解码。这些引擎在调度上相互解耦，在执行上协同工作：CPU 可以在本地执行完整的解码迭代，也可以有选择地调用 GPU Dense Assist 执行密集阶段，同时由离线分析结果指导针对特定硬件的批处理和路由。我们的评估显示，在面向解码的场景中，DualPace 相较于最先进的开源 CPU 卸载系统 NEO，服务吞吐量提高了 6.9--43.2\%；相较于广泛使用的 GPU 服务系统 vLLM，则提高了 11.5--90.6\%，同时维持相同的延迟水平。DualPace 还保留了 NEO 相较于 vLLM 在 P99 首词元时间（TTFT）方面的优势，同时在相同 P99 ITL 水平下，将请求速率维持在比 NEO 高 7.3--50.5\%。

    Eat Your Precision: Precision Objective Mitigates Reward Hacking in Rubric-based RL

    吃透精确性：精确率目标缓解基于评分细则的强化学习中的奖励作弊

    Hyun Ryu, Jong-Heon Kim, Yiqing Xie, Seungone Kim, Carolyn Rose, Eunho Yang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    FORK changes rubric-based reinforcement learning by rewarding necessary, factually correct response units alongside rubric coverage, addressing reward hacking and improving response quality. This is a substantial training contribution for model behavior and capability, while the rubric context alone does not establish a systems or interpretability advance.

    FORK 通过在评分细则覆盖率之外奖励必要且符合事实的回答单元，改变了基于评分细则的强化学习，从而应对奖励作弊并提升回答质量。这是对模型行为和能力训练的一项重要贡献，但仅凭评分细则这一背景不足以证明其在系统或可解释性方面有所进展。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Rubric-based rewards enable effective reinforcement learning on non-verifiable tasks. However, because these rewards are typically defined as a weighted measure of rubric coverage, models are trained primarily to maximize a recall objective. As a result, RL-trained models produce responses that are more complete but also more verbose and contain more unnecessary or factually incorrect content, leading them to be less preferred than responses from the base model. To address this issue, we present the FORK reward, which jointly optimizes recall and a novel precision objective, which requires each unit of a model response to be both necessary and factually correct, as measured by rubric-driven necessity credits and a factual-correctness grader, respectively. Our experimental results show that FORK outperforms existing rubric-based RL methods and achieves Pareto-optimal performance that balances rubric coverage and overall response quality. Compared to the original recall-based reward, FORK substantially improves precision and reduces response length while achieving similar rubric coverage, which leads to significantly higher win rate compared to the base policy (e.g., from 10.6% to 68.0% on RubricHub-Medical and from 22.1% to 74.1% on HealthBench).

    中文

    基于评分细则的奖励使得在不可验证任务上进行有效的强化学习成为可能。然而，由于这类奖励通常被定义为评分细则覆盖率的加权度量，模型训练的主要目标是最大化召回率。因此，经强化学习训练的模型会生成更完整、但也更冗长且包含更多不必要或事实错误内容的回答，导致其不如基础模型的回答受青睐。为解决这一问题，我们提出 FORK 奖励，它联合优化召回率和一种新颖的精确率目标。该目标要求模型回答中的每个单元既必要又符合事实，分别通过评分细则驱动的必要性积分和事实正确性评估器进行衡量。实验结果表明，FORK 优于现有基于评分细则的强化学习方法，并实现了帕累托最优的性能，在评分细则覆盖率和整体回答质量之间取得平衡。与原始的基于召回率的奖励相比，FORK 在保持评分细则覆盖率相近的同时，大幅提高了精确率并缩短了回答长度，因此相较于基础策略，胜率显著提高（例如，在 RubricHub-Medical 上从 10.6% 提升至 68.0%，在 HealthBench 上从 22.1% 提升至 74.1%）。

    ENGLISH

    Smart factories must translate order-level objectives into production tasks at multiple scales and combine the capabilities of individual units into an overall delivery capability. To address repeated adaptation of organizational mechanisms across equipment, workshops, and factories, as well as coordination across levels under changing production conditions, this paper develops a framework for the collective collaboration of recursive autonomous agents (RAAs). A common task and capability interface supports the recursive decomposition of production objectives from the top down and the aggregation of conditional capabilities through peer collaboration from the bottom up. Composite units can therefore participate in higher-level organizations as agents of the same kind. We formulate organizational models for leaf and composite units, specify interface closure under composition and conditions for finite task expansion, and develop operational mechanisms linking task decomposition, resource commitments, result aggregation, and coordination within the scope affected by change. A production network integrating machining, inspection, and logistics across multiple workshops illustrates how a common organizational kernel is instantiated at the equipment-service, workshop, and factory scales. The framework connects recursive organization with explicit task responsibilities, capability conditions, and execution interfaces for manufacturing systems.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper studies training language models to support both single-pass and looped inference, using joint losses and frozen-model guidance to balance quality and additional computation. This is a substantial model-computation design contribution, with reasoning capability only indirectly implicated because the abstract reports improved looped predictions without identifying reasoning tasks or mechanisms.

    本文研究如何训练语言模型以支持单次前向和循环推理，并通过联合损失和冻结模型指导，在输出质量与额外计算之间取得平衡。这是对模型计算设计的一项重要贡献；推理能力仅被间接涉及，因为摘要报告了循环预测的改善，但没有指出具体的推理任务或机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Repeating Transformer layers can improve language-model performance without adding parameters. A pretrained model can be adapted to support both single-pass and looped inference by reusing middle-layer weights for additional computation. Because both paths share weights, training to improve looped predictions can degrade single-pass quality. We study joint training strategies using weighted losses on both outputs, with guidance from the frozen original model. Joint supervision substantially reduces single-pass degradation compared to looped-only training, while preserving looped gains over ordinary continued training. Most of this benefit comes from adjusting the single-pass loss weight, with guidance from the frozen original model further improving the looped output. With validation-selected weights, our method preserves single-pass quality within a predefined tolerance of ordinary continued training while improving looped predictions.

    重复使用 Transformer 层可以在不增加参数的情况下提升语言模型性能。通过复用中间层权重进行额外计算，可以调整预训练模型，使其支持单次前向和循环推理。由于两条路径共享权重，旨在提升循环预测的训练可能会降低单次前向质量。我们研究了联合训练策略，对两种输出使用加权损失，并以冻结的原始模型作为指导。与仅针对循环路径的训练相比，联合监督大幅减轻了单次前向性能下降，同时保留了相对于常规持续训练的循环性能提升。大部分收益来自调整单次前向损失权重，而冻结的原始模型提供的指导则进一步改善了循环输出。采用通过验证集选定的权重后，我们的方法在提升循环预测的同时，使单次前向质量维持在常规持续训练预设的容差范围内。

    Implicit Beliefs as Scalable Process Rewards for Strategic Persuasion
