    ENGLISH

    Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets) are trained to sample objects from compositional spaces with probability proportional to a reward function, but ineffective exploration can cause learned samplers to concentrate on a few high-reward regions. An intuitive remedy is to train multiple GFlowNets independently in parallel and combine their samples. However, this does not prevent multiple models from collapsing onto the same high-reward areas, leaving large regions of the state space unexplored. With this in mind, we propose Hierarchical Cooperative GFlowNets (HCG), an approach that dynamically partitions the search space to coordinate discovery without relying on hand-crafted boundaries. HCG imposes an ordering in which the highest-ranked model may explore the entire space, while lower-ranked models are progressively pushed toward regions not covered by higher-ranked ones. We provide a theoretical characterization of how specific learning objectives can shift probability mass away from designated areas, instantiating this mechanism within our architecture. A shared classifier coordinates the hierarchy by partitioning the search space, keeping the GFlowNets independently parameterized and enabling asynchronous training. Furthermore, we derive a normalizer-weighted aggregation rule for the ensemble and prove that it recovers the target reward-proportional distribution under the stated assumptions. Finally, experiments across multimodal distributions, sequence generation, combinatorial optimization, and biological sequence design show that HCG improves mode coverage and target approximation, translating increases in the number of coordinated samplers into broader, complementary exploration.

    中文

    生成流网络（GFlowNet）经过训练后，会按照与奖励函数成比例的概率从组合空间中采样对象，但探索效果不佳可能导致学习到的采样器集中于少数高奖励区域。一种直观的补救办法是并行独立训练多个 GFlowNet 并合并它们的样本。然而，这并不能阻止多个模型都坍缩到相同的高奖励区域，从而使状态空间中的大片区域未被探索。为此，我们提出分层协作式 GFlowNet（HCG），通过动态划分搜索空间来协调探索，而无需依赖手工设计的边界。HCG 施加一种排序：排名最高的模型可以探索整个空间，而排名较低的模型则逐渐被引导至更高排名模型尚未覆盖的区域。我们从理论上刻画了特定学习目标如何将概率质量从指定区域移开，并在我们的架构中实现了这一机制。一个共享分类器通过划分搜索空间来协调这一层级结构，同时保持各 GFlowNet 参数独立，从而支持异步训练。此外，我们推导出一种对集成模型按归一化因子加权的聚合规则，并证明在给定假设下，该规则能够恢复与目标奖励成比例的分布。最后，在多峰分布、序列生成、组合优化和生物序列设计上的实验表明，HCG 提高了模态覆盖率和目标近似效果，并且随着协同采样器数量增加，探索范围更广、互补性更强。

    表征形成的信息几何

    Sanjukta Krishnagopal

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper uses representation-space trajectories to study how internal structures form, relate to input factors, and predict stability, and shows that trajectory geometry can be shaped through optimization; this is a substantial contribution to representation geometry. Higher-order input interactions connect to composition, but the abstract does not center compositional generalization, while reasoning and system design are not substantive topics.

    本文利用表征空间轨迹研究内部结构如何形成、如何与输入因素相关以及如何预测稳定性，并展示了可以通过优化塑造轨迹几何；这是对表征几何的重要贡献。输入因素之间的高阶交互与组合有关，但摘要并未以组合泛化为中心，推理和系统设计也不是实质性主题。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Most analyses of neural representations focus on trained endpoints, leaving the process by which internal structure forms comparatively unmeasured. We instead treat representation formation itself as an object of study, asking whether the path a representation takes through training reveals information that its endpoint does not. We formalize this idea by viewing representation learning as a geometric trajectory, using Bures geometry to measure movement through representation space and quantum Fisher information to characterize local sensitivity to input factors. We find that learning concentrates local sensitivity on task-relevant factors, and that changing only the prediction target reorganizes this geometry around the corresponding visual factor. More strikingly, representation trajectories become systematically less direct as the learned computation requires higher-order interactions among input factors. This effect persists under matched-performance and training-duration controls and transfers from synthetic vector inputs to residual CNNs on rendered and natural images. Importantly, formation history contains predictive information about the stability of the learned representation: controlling for interaction order, path tortuosity predicts its subsequent drift under continued training and sensitivity to parameter perturbations, whereas endpoint displacement does not. Finally, representation-aware optimization lets us actively shape these trajectories, showing that formation geometry is not only measurable but actionable. Together, these results establish representation formation as a new source of information about learning: its geometry reveals properties of the computation being constructed, predicts subsequent representational stability, and provides a target for intervention during optimization.

    中文

    对神经表征的大多数分析都聚焦于训练后的终点，因此内部结构形成的过程相对缺乏测量。我们转而将表征形成本身作为研究对象，探究表征在训练中经历的路径是否能揭示其终点无法提供的信息。我们通过将表征学习视为几何轨迹来形式化这一想法，使用 Bures 几何测量表征空间中的移动，并使用量子 Fisher 信息刻画对输入因素的局部敏感性。我们发现，学习会将局部敏感性集中在与任务相关的因素上；仅改变预测目标，就会使这种几何结构围绕相应的视觉因素重新组织。更引人注目的是，随着所学习的计算需要输入因素之间更高阶的交互作用，表征轨迹会系统性地变得不那么直接。在控制性能和训练时长相匹配的情况下，这一效应依然存在；它也从合成向量输入迁移到处理渲染图像和自然图像的残差 CNN。重要的是，形成历史包含关于所学表征稳定性的预测信息：在控制交互阶数后，路径曲折度能够预测表征在继续训练时的后续漂移，以及其对参数扰动的敏感性，而终点位移不能。最后，表征感知优化使我们能够主动塑造这些轨迹，表明形成几何不仅可以测量，也可以干预。总之，这些结果确立了表征形成为关于学习的新信息来源：其几何结构揭示所构建计算的属性，预测表征后续的稳定性，并在优化期间提供可供干预的目标。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Autonomous agents are increasingly deployed across sequences of related tasks, yet they often fail to retain and improve their knowledge over time. Existing approaches convert interaction trajectories into memories or reusable skills, but experience is not automatically reliable knowledge. Automatically collected skills and memories can propagate errors, mislead, and corrupt useful knowledge. To address this gap, we introduce Knowledge Evolution from Expertise and Lessons (KEEL), an agent-agnostic framework that uses verifier evidence to transform successful behavior into reusable skills and failures into corrective lessons. As new evidence accumulates, individual skill claims can be supported, contradicted, replaced, or retired. On SkillFlow benchmark, KEEL improves task success by 4.2 to 21.7 percentage points over the no-knowledge baseline, compared with gains of 2.4 to 9.6 points from SkillFlow's default method. Ablations show that skills and lessons are complementary. These results show that reliable continual agent learning depends not simply on accumulating experience, but on continually validating and evolving the knowledge derived from it. Our code is available at: https://github.com/microsoft/KEEL-TTCL26.

    RLVR 中采样器不匹配导致熵漂移的符号定律

    Zhiyuan Wang, Jacob Steeves, Chang Liu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper derives and tests how sampler mismatch drives entropy changes during RLVR, and proposes corrections that improve held-out reasoning-model accuracy. Its main contribution advances reasoning-related training; sampler and policy details alone offer only incidental systems relevance.

    本文推导并测试了采样器不匹配如何驱动 RLVR 中的熵变化，并提出能提高推理模型留出集准确率的校正方法。其主要贡献推进了与推理相关的训练；采样器和策略细节只具有附带的系统相关性。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Entropy in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) moves up or down depending on choices that should be neutral, such as whether over-length responses are masked or counted as failures. We trace this to sampler mismatch, where rollouts are drawn with top-k/top-p truncation or at a temperature the learner does not apply, and prove that a constant advantage shift then changes the entropy of a softmax policy, at first order and in expectation, with a sign fixed by the sampler: positive shifts sharpen the policy under any sampler whose likelihood ratio to the policy increases with token probability, including top-k, top-p, min-p, and temperatures below one, and flatten it under flatter samplers. In group-based RLVR with token-level losses, the baseline-controlled part of this drift is set by the token-weighted net advantage, which masking and failing over-length responses can push to opposite signs; the remainder, a covariance between advantages and the sampler's sharpness gap, can feed back over long horizons. On a 2B model, the entropy slope is linear in shifts of the net advantage under truncated sampling and indistinguishable from flat under exact sampling, and token-level importance ratios leave 98% of the drift. In 100-step runs, a net-zero baseline only delays an entropy explosion that exact sampling does not show, a fixed positive shift delays it further, and a baseline weighted by the sharpness gap keeps entropy stable without changing the learner. On a 9B reasoning model over ten steps, the uncorrected rule loses held-out accuracy, whereas zeroing the net advantage or renormalizing the learner gains 8.2 and 8.8 points over it, with no held-out effect under exact sampling.

    在带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）中，熵会上升或下降，具体取决于一些本应无关紧要的选择，例如是否将超长回答屏蔽掉或视为失败。我们将其归因于采样器不匹配：rollout 使用 top-k/top-p 截断采样，或使用学习器未采用的温度进行采样。我们证明，恒定的优势偏移会以一阶效应改变 softmax 策略的熵，且期望变化的符号由采样器决定：对于任何似然比（采样器相对于策略）随 token 概率增加而增加的采样器，包括 top-k、top-p、min-p 和低于 1 的温度，正向偏移会使策略变得更尖锐；而对于更平坦的采样器，策略则会变平。在基于分组、采用 token 级损失的 RLVR 中，漂移中由基线控制的部分由 token 加权的净优势决定；屏蔽超长回答和将其视为失败可能使净优势符号相反。剩余部分是优势与采样器尖锐度差之间的协方差，可能在长时间范围内形成反馈。在一个 2B 模型上，截断采样时熵斜率随净优势偏移呈线性变化，而精确采样时则无法与平坦情况区分；token 级重要性比率仅能消除 2% 的漂移。在 100 步运行中，净优势为零的基线只能推迟熵爆炸，而精确采样不会出现这种现象；固定正向偏移能进一步推迟熵爆炸；按尖锐度差加权的基线则能在不改变学习器的情况下保持熵稳定。在一个 9B 推理模型上运行十步时，未经校正的规则会降低留出集准确率，而将净优势设为零或对学习器重新归一化，准确率分别比该规则高 8.2 和 8.8 个百分点；在精确采样下，留出集效果没有变化。

    Xuan He, Sining Zhoubian, Ruozhen Yang, Yuhao Wen, Zhineng Wang, Yuyang Hu, Ke Yang, Yuyu Zhang, Ping Nie, Jiawei Han, ChengXiang Zhai

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper evaluates agent memory against direct retrieval and introduces a framework that separates memory benefit from memory tax, analyzing how memory systems can obscure evidence and affect evaluation. This substantially advances understanding of memory design and assessment in agents, though the abstract does not address model internals, composition, or reasoning mechanisms.

    本文将智能体记忆与直接检索进行评估对比，并提出区分记忆收益与记忆税的框架，分析记忆系统如何掩盖证据并影响评估。这显著推进了对智能体记忆设计与评估的理解，但摘要没有涉及模型内部机制、组合或推理机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Memory is increasingly used in long-horizon agents, yet the net value of building memory over direct retrieval from raw history remains largely unclear. Through a large-scale evaluation across multiple benchmarks and model backbones, we find many dedicated memory systems underperform naive RAG in many cases, indicating a negative net value. Taking RAG as a reference, we dissect the net value of memory into the gains and losses over direct retrieval, termed memory benefit and memory tax. These gains and losses arise because memory process changes how the raw information is organized and accessed. We view such changes as the double-edged deviations from the raw history. They are originally designed and introduced to benefit the task, for example by reorganizing facts or distilling preferences, but some may also remove or obscure evidence, giving rise to memory tax. Since memory benefit reflects the expected gains of its design, we then focus more on the overlooked memory tax, study how it arises from the system and evaluation side, and generalize the concept to more application scenarios of memory. We hope the notion of memory tax can provide a new lens and shift more attention from standalone performance to the net value of memory, informing more reliable memory designs and evaluations. We will open-source the code and results to the community. Project Page: https://hexuan21.github.io/MemoryTax/

    中文

    记忆越来越多地用于长时程智能体，但相对于直接从原始历史中检索，构建记忆的净价值仍不明确。通过在多个基准测试和模型骨干网络上进行大规模评估，我们发现许多专用记忆系统在不少情况下的表现不如朴素 RAG，表明其净价值为负。以 RAG 为参照，我们将记忆的净价值分解为相对于直接检索所获的收益和损失，分别称为记忆收益和记忆税。这些收益和损失源自记忆处理过程改变了原始信息的组织和访问方式。我们将这类变化视为相对于原始历史的双刃偏离。它们最初是为有利于任务而设计和引入的，例如重新组织事实或提炼偏好，但有些变化也可能删除或掩盖证据，从而产生记忆税。由于记忆收益反映了其设计预期带来的增益，我们便将更多关注放在此前被忽视的记忆税上，研究它如何从系统和评估两方面产生，并将这一概念推广到更多记忆应用场景。我们希望记忆税这一概念能提供新的观察视角，使人们不再只关注单项性能，而更多关注记忆的净价值，从而为更可靠的记忆设计与评估提供参考。我们将向社区开源代码和结果。项目页面：https://hexuan21.github.io/MemoryTax/

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    T2D contributes latency-aware structured pruning and distillation to build aligned draft models, advancing efficient computation for speculative decoding. Its connection to reasoning is incidental: the abstract focuses on generation speed and draft-model design, not reasoning mechanisms or capabilities.

    T2D 通过延迟感知的结构化剪枝和蒸馏来构建对齐的草稿模型，推动了推测解码的高效计算。它与推理的关联只是附带的：摘要关注生成速度和草稿模型设计，而非推理机制或能力。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Speculative decoding significantly accelerates autoregressive text generation in Large Language Models (LLMs), but its efficacy depends largely on two key factors: the distributional alignment between the draft and the target model, and the draft model's latency during inference. However, existing approaches typically utilize independently pretrained small draft models or seek to prune the target model to a manually chosen architecture, thereby failing to explicitly balance the trade-off between draft model alignment and token generation efficiency. To address this gap, we formulate draft model design as an optimization problem and propose T2D, a framework that constructs draft models directly from the target model using latency-aware structured pruning and knowledge distillation. In this manner, T2D obtains draft models that are jointly optimized for both measured inference latency and cross-entropy loss on the target model's responses, resulting in superlative speculative decoding performance. Through extensive experiments on multi-domain speculative decoding benchmarks and across several target model families of differing scale, we demonstrate how T2D prunes up to 92\% of the target model to obtain highly performant draft models compared to competitive baselines. Moreover, draft models obtained via T2D can also be utilized by other speculative decoding token-alignment and knowledge distillation methods in a plug-and-play fashion, leading to further gains. Our findings underscore the importance of jointly navigating the draft model architecture-alignment frontier to unlock the full potential of speculative decoding for LLMs.

    Mengdi Chu, Jintao Huang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper evaluates whether LLMs use evidence and forward-looking utility to make rational sequential collaboration decisions, revealing systematic decision errors. Sequential choices and partner interaction connect to agent systems, but the main contribution is a reasoning benchmark and behavioral analysis rather than an agent architecture.

    本文评估 LLM 是否利用证据和前瞻性效用来作出理性的序贯协作决策，并揭示了系统性的决策错误。序贯选择和伙伴交互与智能体系统有关，但主要贡献是推理基准和行为分析，而非智能体架构。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language models increasingly collaborate with humans and peer AI agents whose contributions may be incomplete, inconsistent, or incorrect. Effective collaboration requires calibrated trust, whereby decisions to rely on, verify, or assist a partner adapt rationally as empirical evidence accumulates. We investigate whether models translate partner evidence into appropriate reliance policies. We introduce a benchmark of 324 scenarios across 23 collaboration categories. Each scenario involves three sequential decisions with explicit transition dynamics, feedback emissions, and cost schedules, permitting exact analytical evaluation of choices against their expected consequences over the remaining interaction. Evaluating seven models alongside 36 controlled-history probes, we dissociate evidence sensitivity from normatively appropriate action. While the strongest frontier model approaches near-optimal decisions, other models exhibit recurring pathologies: procuring excessive safeguards, purchasing verification tests with zero expected value of information, prioritizing immediate savings over cooperative learning, and misallocating assistance to suboptimal channels. Supplying explicit posterior distributions resolves certain errors while introducing new failure modes. Calibrated trust in autonomous agents critically demands coupling empirical evidence with forward-looking decision utility.

    大型语言模型日益与人类及其他 AI 智能体协作，而伙伴的贡献可能不完整、不一致或不正确。有效协作需要校准式信任：随着经验性证据不断积累，依赖、核验或协助伙伴的决策应作出理性调整。我们研究模型能否将伙伴提供的证据转化为恰当的依赖策略。我们提出一个基准，包含 23 个协作类别中的 324 个场景。每个场景包含三个连续决策，并明确规定状态转移动态、反馈发出机制和成本安排，因此可以依据交互剩余阶段的预期后果，对选择进行精确的解析评估。我们评估了七个模型，并结合 36 个受控历史探测，将证据敏感性与规范上恰当的行动区分开来。最强的前沿模型接近最优决策，而其他模型则表现出反复出现的行为问题：采取过多保障措施、购买预期信息价值为零的核验测试、将眼前节省置于合作学习之上，以及将帮助分配到次优渠道。提供明确的后验分布能够消除某些错误，却也会带来新的失效模式。自主智能体中的校准式信任，关键在于将经验性证据与前瞻性的决策效用相结合。

    BE-CTDE：区块链赋能的多智能体强化学习，结合异常检测与代币经济机制

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper develops an accountable multi-agent RL training system with behavioral verification, token incentives, and theoretical bounds on incentives, exclusion time, and detector capacity. Its main contribution concerns agent coordination and training organization; the path-finding application does not provide substantive evidence about compositional generalization or model internals.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Multi-agent reinforcement learning supports cooperative decision-making in Internet of Things systems, but strategic deviations can disrupt coordination and undermine confidence in the training process. This paper proposes Blockchain-Enabled Centralized Training and Decentralized Execution (BE-CTDE), which uses blockchain as an active training-management layer. A behavioral verifier compares executed trajectories with shared-policy recommendations; its flags drive a token mechanism combining slashing, burning, rewards, and compensation. Retained balances determine each agent's contribution to the global policy update, connecting auditable behavior to learning influence. We derive a one-round incentive condition that accounts for action-dependent compensation and the payoff from deviation, and a finite expected exclusion-time bound under explicit conditional detection and accounting assumptions, showing perfect detection is unnecessary. An exact finite-population capacity bound characterizes the limits of the population-relative detector. In multi-agent path finding experiments, BE-CTDE outperforms a state-of-the-art learning-based path planner with substantially higher success rates under attack, even when adversaries form the majority. It also outperforms partially defended baselines in all configurations, with collision rates up to 35% lower than under detection without economic consequences and up to 43% lower than under conventional stake slashing. Together, these results characterize how behavioral verification and token feedback can support accountable cooperative learning.

    中文

    多智能体强化学习支持物联网系统中的协作决策，但策略性偏离可能扰乱协调，并削弱人们对训练过程的信心。本文提出区块链赋能的集中训练与分散执行（BE-CTDE），将区块链用作主动的训练管理层。行为验证器将执行轨迹与共享策略的建议进行比较；其标记会驱动一种结合罚没、销毁、奖励和补偿的代币机制。保留的余额决定每个智能体对全局策略更新的贡献，从而将可审计行为与学习影响力联系起来。我们推导出一个单轮激励条件，该条件考虑了依赖动作的补偿和偏离所带来的收益；同时，在明确的条件检测和记账假设下，我们推导出有限的预期排除时间上界，表明无需完美检测。一个精确的有限群体容量上界刻画了相对群体检测器的能力限制。在多智能体寻路实验中，BE-CTDE 的表现优于最先进的基于学习的路径规划器，在攻击下取得显著更高的成功率，即使对手占多数时也是如此。在所有配置中，它也优于防御不完整的基线：与仅检测但不施加经济后果的方法相比，碰撞率最多降低 35%；与传统的质押罚没方法相比，最多降低 43%。总体而言，这些结果刻画了行为验证与代币反馈如何支持可问责的协作学习。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper tests whether semantically identified CLIP fine-tuning updates causally support model behavior, using reversion, retention, and direction removal to measure their functional contribution. This is a substantial interpretability contribution; composition, reasoning, and systems are not central to the abstract.

    本文通过回退、保留和方向移除来衡量语义识别出的 CLIP 微调更新对模型行为的功能贡献，并检验这些更新是否因果性地支持模型行为。这是一项重要的可解释性贡献；组合、推理和系统并非摘要的重点。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Fine-tuning adapts pretrained models to new tasks, but identifying which weight changes support the resulting behavior remains difficult. Weight-space interpretability assigns semantic descriptions to these changes, called fine-tuning deltas. Such descriptions leave open how much task performance depends on the identified updates, particularly when other updates can support the same predictions. We address this gap by pairing reversion, which restores selected parameters to their pretrained values, with retention, which keeps only selected fine-tuning updates. We evaluate Contrastive Language-Image Pretraining (CLIP) models on synthetic financial charts, Flowers102, EuroSAT, and FGVCAircraft with ViT-L/14, and on Flowers102 with ViT-B/16, using a shared recipe that tunes the final six visual blocks. Our contributions are threefold. First, attention value-output (VO) updates alone recover 43-87% of the accuracy improvement, although reverting them leaves chart accuracy unchanged. Cross-entropy loss preserves this contrast on Charts and EuroSAT, while correct-class score margins reveal additional contributions. Second, VO weights recover more loss improvement than all ten equally sized, layer-matched random subsets in each setting. VO and multilayer perceptron (MLP) retentions jointly correct 25-81% of pretrained errors, demonstrating overlapping recovered behavior, which we call operational redundancy. Third, removing semantically selected directions reduces VO-retained recovery more than matched-random removal in all five settings. Together, these results distinguish semantic alignment, removal cost, and retained recovery as complementary evidence about the functional role of fine-tuning updates within the evaluated CLIP recipe.

    微调能够使预训练模型适应新任务，但要确定哪些权重变化支撑了由此产生的行为仍然很困难。权重空间可解释性会为这些变化赋予语义描述，这些变化称为微调增量。这类描述并未说明任务性能在多大程度上依赖已识别的更新，尤其是在其他更新也能支持相同预测时。为弥补这一不足，我们将回退与保留结合起来：回退会将选定参数恢复为预训练值，保留则只保留选定的微调更新。我们使用统一的方案微调最后六个视觉模块，在 ViT-L/14 上评估 Contrastive Language-Image Pretraining（CLIP）模型，数据集包括合成金融图表、Flowers102、EuroSAT 和 FGVCAircraft；此外，还在 ViT-B/16 上评估 Flowers102。我们的贡献有三点。第一，仅注意力值-输出（VO）更新就能恢复 43-87% 的准确率提升，尽管回退这些更新不会改变图表准确率。在 Charts 和 EuroSAT 上，交叉熵损失保留了这一差异，而正确类别的得分间隔揭示了额外贡献。第二，在每种设置中，VO 权重恢复的损失改善幅度都超过了十组大小相同且按层匹配的随机子集。VO 与多层感知机（MLP）的保留共同纠正了 25-81% 的预训练错误，表明恢复的行为有所重叠，我们将其称为操作冗余。第三，在全部五种设置中，移除语义选定的方向对 VO 保留所恢复性能的影响都大于移除匹配的随机方向。总体而言，这些结果表明，在所评估的 CLIP 配置中，语义对齐、移除代价和保留后恢复效果是关于微调更新功能作用的互补证据。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) excel at zero-shot reasoning, their spatial capabilities are primarily evaluated through static, passive observation. In complex, human-centric scenes, occlusion often hides crucial geometric evidence, and passive benchmarks force models to guess rather than recognize their own visual uncertainty. To bridge this gap, we introduce SATE-Bench, a novel interactive benchmark comprising 316 real-world scenes and 2,525 multi-turn QA pairs to evaluate visual self-awareness and active exocentric view-exploration. It combines a Passive multi-view control with an Active exploration setting, where models start from a severely occluded view and must iteratively query adjacent viewpoints until they gather enough evidence to fully ``sate'' the question, scored by a step-penalized efficiency reward. Evaluating state-of-the-art MLLMs reveals that they terminate exploration prematurely while reporting high confidence, and struggle with fine-grained 3D geometric tasks; matched-view controls further attribute the Active--Passive gap primarily to insufficient evidence acquisition. Moreover, fine-tuning with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) shows that rewarding view-seeking increases active exploration but lowers overall accuracy, as models over-explore and fail to fuse expanding multi-view contexts across turns. These findings indicate that scaling passive multi-view perception does not intrinsically yield active spatial reasoning, highlighting the need for models that know where to look, how to integrate what they see, and when to stop. Code and data are available at https://gtc-gh.github.io/SATE-Bench/

    尽管多模态大型语言模型（MLLM）擅长零样本推理，其空间能力主要通过静态、被动观察来评估。在复杂且以人为中心的场景中，遮挡往往会隐藏关键的几何证据，而被动基准迫使模型进行猜测，而不是识别自身的视觉不确定性。为弥补这一不足，我们推出 SATE-Bench，这是一个新的交互式基准，包含 316 个真实场景和 2,525 组多轮问答，用于评估视觉自我感知和主动外中心视角探索。该基准将被动多视角对照与主动探索设置结合起来：模型从严重遮挡的视角开始，必须反复查询相邻视角，直到收集到足够证据、能够彻底“满足”问题为止，并通过带步数惩罚的效率奖励进行评分。对最先进 MLLM 的评估显示，它们会过早终止探索，同时报告很高的置信度，并且难以完成细粒度的 3D 几何任务；匹配视角的对照实验进一步表明，主动与被动设置之间的差距主要源于证据获取不足。此外，采用群体相对策略优化（GRPO）进行微调表明，奖励主动寻找视角会增加主动探索，却降低总体准确率，因为模型会过度探索，并且无法跨轮次融合不断扩展的多视角上下文。这些发现表明，扩大被动多视角感知的规模并不会自然带来主动空间推理能力，凸显了模型需要知道该看哪里、如何整合所见信息，以及何时停止。代码和数据见 https://gtc-gh.github.io/SATE-Bench/

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper contributes a benchmark and trace-based oracle for measuring unauthorized side effects in tool-using language model agents, with empirical analysis across models; its direct focus on agent behavior and tool use supports Systems, while task structure and goal completion connect only incidentally to composition and reasoning.

    本文提供了一个基准和基于轨迹的判定器，用于衡量工具使用型语言模型智能体的未经授权副作用，并对多个模型进行了实证分析；其对智能体行为和工具使用的直接关注支持系统研究，而任务结构与目标完成则只是与组合和推理附带相关。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Tool-using language model agents are usually evaluated by whether they finish the user's task. That metric misses a common failure: an agent can complete the requested work while also taking an unauthorized side-effecting action, such as writing to the wrong object, expanding the scope of the request, or contacting an unintended recipient. We call this failure mode collateral damage (CD). We introduce SABench (Side-effect-Aware Benchmark), a benchmark of 201 email, calendar, and ticket tasks. Each task crosses one of four state structures (independent, dependent, externally reachable, cross-tool) with one of four trap families (ambiguity, mis-targeting, cascade harm, overreach), and each task has a deterministic trace-based oracle for both goal satisfaction and authorization compliance. Across 2,211 model-task pairs from 11 frontier LLMs spanning major commercial and open model families, 15.2% of all runs incur CD, with risk concentrated in ambiguity tasks (38.8% violation rate) while non-ambiguous traps average 8.4% CD. Among goal-satisfied runs, 12.8% still produce unauthorized writes. Cross-tool and dependent states have about twice the CD rate of independent states. CD rates vary by 4.7x across models at comparable goal rates, which suggests that task success alone is a poor proxy for safe tool use. The SABench task corpus is released at https://huggingface.co/datasets/Phaedrus/sabench; the traces, oracle, code, and analysis pipeline are released at https://github.com/hjj194/sabench-artifact.

    工具使用型语言模型智能体通常根据是否完成用户任务来评估。这一指标会遗漏一种常见失误：智能体可能完成了所要求的工作，同时还执行了未经授权、会产生副作用的操作，例如写入错误对象、擅自扩大请求范围，或联系了非预期的收件人。我们将这种失误模式称为附带损害（CD）。我们推出 SABench（副作用感知基准），一个包含 201 项电子邮件、日历和工单任务的基准。每项任务都结合四种状态结构之一（独立、依赖、外部可达、跨工具）与四类陷阱之一（歧义、目标误选、连锁伤害、越权），并为目标满足情况和授权合规情况分别提供基于轨迹的确定性判定器。在涵盖主要商业和开放模型系列的 11 个前沿 LLM 上，共有 2,211 组模型-任务组合；其中 15.2% 的运行产生 CD，风险集中在歧义任务中（违规率为 38.8%），而非歧义陷阱的 CD 平均率为 8.4%。在目标已满足的运行中，仍有 12.8% 出现未经授权的写入。跨工具和依赖状态下的 CD 率约为独立状态的两倍。在目标完成率相近的情况下，各模型的 CD 率相差 4.7 倍，这表明仅凭任务成功率并不能很好地衡量工具使用安全性。SABench 任务集发布于 https://huggingface.co/datasets/Phaedrus/sabench；轨迹、判定器、代码和分析流程发布于 https://github.com/hjj194/sabench-artifact。

    ENGLISH

    Latent reasoning performs intermediate computation in continuous space rather than through explicit tokens, which is particularly appealing in chemistry, where errors in explicit reasoning can propagate to the final answer. Yet if latent states truly constitute an implicit reasoning chain, they should be causally important. We find otherwise: swapping or moderately perturbing intermediate latent states has little effect on performance, while removing them entirely sometimes causes a substantial score drop. Thus, the latent states matter, but their molecule-specific content appears to matter far less. This points to a simpler interpretation. Rather than encoding a step-by-step reasoning chain, latent states may primarily steer subsequent model computation, much like soft prompts. Indeed, a single fixed prefix shared across molecules reproduces LatentChem's performance, and a learned static soft prompt performs comparably to per-input latent generation in controlled models. The tolerance of latent sequences to substitution and moderate perturbation further supports this connection. We therefore suggest that latent chemical reasoning may be better viewed as soft prompting than as a reasoning chain hidden in continuous space.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper separates token filtering from slot allocation in recurrent memory and evaluates their effects on long-context retrieval.     本文将循环记忆中的令牌筛选与槽位分配区分开来，并评估它们对长上下文检索的影响。其主要贡献涉及记忆写入和容量，是一项实质性的模型系统贡献；合成事实查询只是评估设置，并不能证明存在更广泛的推理或组合机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Long-sequence models must retain earlier information. Full attention keeps all past tokens but grows expensive, and recurrent-memory models compress history into fixed slots for linear-time processing. Limited capacity makes writes consequential: distractors can interfere with useful content, while skipped evidence cannot be recalled. Existing multi-slot memories write every token to the same number of slots, merging whether to store it with how many slots to update. We introduce Factorized Write Routing (FWR), which first keeps or skips each token and then chooses a fixed or token-adaptive number of slots. Queries still read all slots. Across ten seeds on two synthetic tasks that query facts after long contexts, we observe a density-dependent reversal. With four slots per write, long-context accuracy favors always writing on dense Feature Recall (0.472 vs 0.337), but learned selective writing on sparse-fact Passkey (0.222 vs 0.048). The tested adaptive rule underperforms fixed allocation under the learned gate on both tasks. A diagnostic oracle given fact labels unavailable at deployment reaches 0.372 on Passkey, showing headroom in filtering distractors. The results suggest avoiding missed writes in information-dense contexts and filtering distractors when they dominate.

    长序列模型必须保留较早的信息。全注意力会保留所有过去的令牌，但计算开销会不断增加；循环记忆模型则将历史压缩到固定槽位中，以实现线性时间处理。容量有限使写入决策至关重要：干扰项可能妨碍有用内容，而被跳过的证据则无法再被回忆。现有多槽位记忆会将每个令牌写入相同数量的槽位，把是否存储该令牌与更新多少槽位这两个决策合并在一起。我们提出因子化写入路由（FWR）：先决定保留或跳过每个令牌，再选择固定数量或随令牌变化的槽位数。查询仍会读取所有槽位。在两个长上下文后查询事实的合成任务中，我们对十个随机种子进行了实验，观察到随信息密度变化的性能反转。每次写入四个槽位时，在信息密集的 Feature Recall 任务中，长上下文准确率偏向于始终写入（0.472 对 0.337）；而在事实稀疏的 Passkey 任务中，偏向于学习得到的选择性写入（0.222 对 0.048）。在已学习门控下，所测试的自适应规则在两项任务中的表现都不如固定分配。一个诊断性预言机获得了部署时无法取得的事实标签，在 Passkey 上达到 0.372，表明过滤干扰项仍有提升空间。结果表明，在信息密集的上下文中应避免漏写，而在干扰项占主导时则应过滤干扰项。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    SRA identifies sparse teacher–student divergences along reasoning paths and introduces a gated residual adapter to improve distilled models’ multi-step mathematical reasoning, with theoretical error bounds and benchmark gains. Its localized logit corrections touch model internals, but the abstract does not investigate representations or mechanisms, and the adapter is not a systems contribution.

    SRA 识别推理路径上稀疏的教师与学生模型差异，并引入门控残差适配器，以提升蒸馏模型的多步数学推理能力，同时给出理论误差界和基准测试增益。其局部 logit 修正涉及模型内部，但摘要没有研究表征或机制，而且该适配器不属于系统贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Knowledge distillation transfers reasoning capabilities from large language models to lightweight students. However, distilled small models still struggle with multi-step reasoning. We observe that the distribution divergences between teacher and student models along reasoning paths are highly sparse, and target tokens almost always fall within the student top-$K$ candidate set. Based on this finding, unlike approaches updating student backbones or requiring runtime teacher computation, we propose Selective Residual Adaptation (SRA), a plug-and-play framework that internalizes localized corrections. Concretely, SRA employs a Discrepancy Gate to identify divergence positions alongside a Candidate Residual Adapter for top-$K$ logit calibration to correct the mismatch. Theoretically, we establish error bounds ensuring strict sequence level performance gains. Across mathematical benchmarks on Qwen3 models from 0.6B to 4B, SRA consistently enhances distilled student models, raising average Pass@16 by up to 4.37 percentage points while preserving general capabilities.

    中文

    知识蒸馏将推理能力从大型语言模型迁移到轻量级学生模型。然而，蒸馏得到的小模型在多步推理方面仍面临困难。我们观察到，教师模型与学生模型沿推理路径的分布差异高度稀疏，且目标词元几乎总是落在学生模型的 top-$K$候选集合中。基于这一发现，不同于更新学生模型主干网络或要求运行时计算教师模型的方法，我们提出选择性残差适配（SRA），这是一种即插即用的框架，能够将局部修正内化。具体而言，SRA 使用差异门来识别发生差异的位置，并配合候选残差适配器对 top-$K$logit 进行校准，以修正不匹配。从理论上说，我们建立了误差界，保证序列级性能严格提升。在 Qwen3 0.6B 至 4B 模型上的数学基准测试中，SRA 持续增强蒸馏学生模型，使平均 Pass@16 提高至多 4.37 个百分点，同时保留通用能力。

    MatOS organizes scientific tools, workflows, and other capabilities as reusable assets, runs stateful execution graphs, and updates assets from records and feedback, with evaluations and research cases demonstrating its agent system.     MatOS 将科学工具、工作流和其他能力组织为可复用资产，运行有状态执行图，并根据记录和反馈更新资产；评估结果和研究案例展示了其智能体系统。设计中包含复用和组合，但摘要没有证明其核心贡献在于组合泛化或推理机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Materials research relies on scattered and growing data, knowledge, and simulation tools, and a single study often spans multi-day workflows across literature analysis, computation, and experiment. Large language model agents can now retrieve materials data, operate simulation codes, and close design-synthesis-characterization loops with autonomous laboratories. However, extending these agents with new capabilities, keeping long-running tasks on track, and letting them learn from past tasks and user feedback remain difficult. Here we present MatOS, an agent operating system for materials research with three core components: (1) a layered scientific asset graph that organizes data, knowledge, tools, skills, roles, and workflows as reusable assets; (2) a stateful adaptive workflow that runs tasks as explicit execution graphs with scientific checks, so that they can be resumed and traced; and (3) evidence-driven asset evolution, which revises these assets from execution records and user feedback. On ResearchClawBench, MatOS improves on the previously best-performing agent by 11.15% with the same base model and extends the cost-score Pareto frontier. With a common base model, it outperforms Codex CLI and Claude Code, exceeding Codex CLI by 2.13% on MatTools and 4.17% on SciAgentGym. In eight research cases, MatOS narrowed more than 30 million candidate structures to 97 solid-electrolyte candidates, identified 89 halide variants with higher computed conductivity than their parent structures, linked the force errors of 11 pretrained interatomic potentials to local atomic environments, and supported two new methods that reduce errors by 3.1% and 13.6% relative to their baselines. These results show that organizing research capabilities as reusable, evolving assets enables agents to carry out long, multistage materials studies. Code is available at https://github.com/DingyangLyu/MatOS.

    中文

    材料研究依赖分散且不断增长的数据、知识和模拟工具，单项研究往往涉及跨越数日的工作流程，涵盖文献分析、计算和实验。大型语言模型智能体如今能够检索材料数据、操作模拟代码，并与自主实验室协作，完成设计—合成—表征闭环。然而，为这些智能体扩展新能力、让长时间运行的任务保持正轨，以及使其从过往任务和用户反馈中学习，仍然很困难。本文提出 MatOS，这是一种面向材料研究的智能体操作系统，包含三个核心组件：（1）分层科学资产图，将数据、知识、工具、技能、角色和工作流组织为可复用资产；（2）有状态自适应工作流，将任务作为带有科学检查的显式执行图运行，以便恢复和追踪；（3）证据驱动的资产演进，根据执行记录和用户反馈修订这些资产。在 ResearchClawBench 上，使用相同基础模型时，MatOS 的表现比此前最佳智能体高 11.15%，并拓展了成本—得分帕累托前沿。使用通用基础模型时，它优于 Codex CLI 和 Claude Code，在 MatTools 上比 Codex CLI 高 2.13%，在 SciAgentGym 上高 4.17%。在八个研究案例中，MatOS 将超过 3,000 万个候选结构缩减为 97 个固态电解质候选，找出 89 种计算电导率高于其母体结构的卤化物变体，将 11 种预训练原子间势的力误差与局部原子环境关联起来，并支持提出两种新方法，它们相较各自基线分别将误差降低了 3.1% 和 13.6%。这些结果表明，将研究能力组织为可复用、可演进的资产，能够使智能体开展长期、多阶段的材料研究。代码见 https://github.com/DingyangLyu/MatOS。

    CORMA: Constraint-Routed Decision Mamba for Generalizable Multi-Constraint Offline Safe Reinforcement Learning

    CORMA：面向可泛化多约束离线安全强化学习的约束路由决策 Mamba

    Changxu Ni, Feiran You, Yongan Guo, Hongyang Du, Kang Wei, Le Liang, Yiyang Ni, Jun Li

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    CORMA combines constraint-specific experts through a router-guided product of experts to guide a Mamba policy, improving safe offline RL and generalization to unseen safety-budget combinations. Its compositional generalization contribution is meaningful but focused on budget combinations, while policy learning and adaptive inference substantially advance reasoning-related optimization and conditional computation; the abstract offers no model-interpretability contribution.

    CORMA 通过路由器引导的专家乘积组合特定于约束的专家，为 Mamba 策略提供指导，从而提升离线安全 RL 性能，并增强对未见过的安全预算组合的泛化能力。其组合泛化贡献具有实际意义，但聚焦于预算组合；策略学习和自适应推理则显著推进了与推理相关的优化和条件计算。摘要没有提供模型可解释性方面的贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Offline safe reinforcement learning (RL) learns safety-aware policies from static datasets while satisfying safety constraints during deployment. Motivated by the strong trajectorymodeling capabilities of Transformers, recent Decision Transformer (DT)-based methods formulate offline safe RL as conditional sequence modeling by conditioning action generation on return-to-go (RTG) and cost-to-go (CTG) tokens, thereby enabling adaptation to varying safety budgets. However, existing DT-based methods are developed for single-constraint tasks. For tasks with multiple constraints, generalizing learned policies to unseen combinations of safety budgets remains challenging due to the conflicting requirements imposed by heterogeneous constraints. Moreover, the quadratic complexity of Transformer architectures significantly increases the computational overhead in multi-constraint tasks, as representing additional constraints requires more CTG tokens. Recently, Mamba has emerged as an efficient sequence-modeling backbone, offering linear computational complexity and strong generalization capabilities. In this paper, we propose CORMA, a constraint-routed decision Mamba framework for generalizable multi-constraint offline safe RL. CORMA decomposes policy inference into constraint-aware RTG estimation and adaptive action generation, where constraint-specific experts model feasible RTG distributions and a router-guided product-of-experts mechanism fuses these distributions to provide safety-aware guidance for a Mamba-based action decoder. A three-stage optimization strategy is designed to improve training stability. Extensive experiments on OSRL benchmarks demonstrate that CORMA achieves superior reward-safety trade-offs, reduces inference latency by 37% compared with DT-based methods, and exhibits stronger zero-shot generalization to unseen safety-budget combinations than offline safe RL baselines.

    中文

    离线安全强化学习（RL）从静态数据集中学习具备安全意识的策略，同时在部署期间满足安全约束。受 Transformer 强大轨迹建模能力的启发，近期基于决策 Transformer（DT）的方法将离线安全 RL 表述为条件序列建模，通过以回报至终点（RTG）和代价至终点（CTG）词元为条件生成动作，从而适应不同的安全预算。然而，现有基于 DT 的方法针对的是单约束任务。对于多约束任务，由于异质约束带来的要求相互冲突，如何将学到的策略泛化到未见过的安全预算组合仍然具有挑战性。此外，Transformer 架构的二次复杂度显著增加了多约束任务的计算开销，因为表示更多约束需要更多 CTG 词元。近期，Mamba 已成为一种高效的序列建模骨干网络，具有线性计算复杂度和较强的泛化能力。本文提出 CORMA，这是一种用于可泛化多约束离线安全 RL 的约束路由决策 Mamba 框架。CORMA 将策略推理分解为约束感知的 RTG 估计和自适应动作生成，其中，特定于约束的专家对可行 RTG 分布建模，路由器引导的专家乘积机制融合这些分布，为基于 Mamba 的动作解码器提供安全感知指导。我们设计了三阶段优化策略，以提高训练稳定性。在 OSRL 基准上的大量实验表明，CORMA 实现了更优的奖励—安全性权衡，与基于 DT 的方法相比，推理延迟降低了 37%，并且相较离线安全 RL 基线，对未见过的安全预算组合表现出更强的零样本泛化能力。

    The paper adds human-readable concept bottlenecks to molecular graph generators so users can inspect, debug, and steer generation.     本文将人类可理解的概念瓶颈加入分子图生成器，使用户能够检查、调试并引导生成。这对可解释性作出了重要贡献，但其目标是图生成，而非通用 AI 模型内部的机制或表征；组合、推理和系统都不是实质性重点。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Deep graph generators (DGGs) largely lack interpretability, which is a significant limitation for one of their most crucial applications, drug discovery, where interpretable and transparent generation could provide greater control over the desirability of generated molecules, thereby reducing trial-and-error in candidate selection. Common approaches to interpretability, such as disentanglement, cannot guarantee that the learned representations are human-interpretable. To address this, we propose incorporating concept bottlenecks into DGGs, allowing users to interpret, debug, and steer the generation process. We show that this consistently improves distributional fidelity (lower FCD), with only modest, non-systematic effects on validity and uniqueness. We further explore Concept Controller, an optimization-based steering approach that has proven to be effective for steerable image generation. We evaluate our approach on a one-shot molecular graph generation framework, though the underlying ideas can be transferred to sequential graph generation as well.

    深度图生成器（DGG）大多缺乏可解释性，这对其最重要的应用之一——药物发现——构成了重大限制。在药物发现中，可解释且透明的生成能够更好地控制生成分子的理想程度，从而减少候选筛选中的反复试错。常见的可解释性方法（如解耦）无法保证学到的表征是人类可理解的。为此，我们提出将概念瓶颈融入 DGG，使用户能够理解、调试并引导生成过程。我们表明，这种方法能够持续提高分布保真度（降低 FCD），而对有效性和唯一性的影响较小且无系统性。我们还进一步探索了 Concept Controller，这是一种基于优化的引导方法，已证明对可引导图像生成有效。我们在一种单次分子图生成框架上评估了该方法，不过其基本思想也可迁移到序列式图生成。

    Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown remarkable success in robotic manipulation, yet their ability to execute long-horizon tasks remains limited by insufficient long- term memory modeling. In this paper, we propose CogMemory, a novel variational cognitive memory framework that enables VLA systems to selectively preserve and reuse task-relevant historical information. Our approach encodes multimodal trajectories into compact latent memory representations through a selective state- space memory encoder, multi-slot temporal abstraction, and variational information compression. During action generation, dynamic cross-attention retrieval with gated fusion adaptively incorporates relevant memories into policy prediction. With merely 3.45M additional parameters, CogMemory stays lightweight and seamlessly fits both early- and intermediate-fusion VLA backbones.     Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    MultiEvoSkill represents procedures and candidate edits as typed graphs, then uses multi-agent debate and dependency-aware evolution to improve transferable agent skills. This substantially advances structured composition and agent organization, while reasoning is relevant through procedural problem solving but is not the central mechanism; it does not study internal model representations.

    MultiEvoSkill 将流程和候选修改表示为带类型的图，再通过多智能体辩论和依赖感知演进来改进可迁移的智能体技能。它显著推进了结构化组合与智能体组织；推理与程序性问题求解相关，但并非核心机制。该工作没有研究模型内部表征。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Skill documents are becoming the default adaptation surface for frozen large language model (LLM) agents, but current skill generators face two key limitations. First, humans and different LLMs differ in how they organize procedural knowledge and approach task solving. Skills authored from a human or single-model perspective may therefore fail to align with the reasoning behaviors of other backbones, limiting cross-model generalization. Second, sequential skill descriptions inadequately represent procedures with parallel branches and explicit dependencies, while existing skill optimizers primarily operate on prose and lack explicit support for graph-structured skill evolution. We introduce MultiEvoSkill, a skill-optimization framework comprising three core components: 1) Skill compiler casts the skill as a typed graph with tailored operators, producing a compact, informative representation with explicit procedural topology; 2) Heterogeneous agent system proposes revision advices using collective intelligence, where minimal and informative issues are identified based on multiple sets of experiences. 3) Structure-aware debate and evolution mechanism organizes candidate edits into a heterogeneous graph, resolves them under dependency and importance constraints, and distills the collective proposal into the artifact. Multi-dimensional gating ensures the information gain and topological correctness of each evolution. Optimal skills are then obtained when the system converges at a consistent state. Various experiments and ablations against SOTA methods validate the effectiveness and generalization of MultiEvoSkill.

    中文

    技能文档正成为冻结的大型语言模型（LLM）智能体默认的适配方式，但当前技能生成器面临两个主要局限。首先，人类和不同 LLM 在组织程序性知识和解决任务的方式上存在差异。因此，由人类或单个模型视角撰写的技能可能无法契合其他骨干模型的推理行为，从而限制跨模型泛化。其次，顺序式技能描述无法充分表示具有并行分支和显式依赖关系的过程，而现有技能优化器主要处理文字，缺乏对图结构技能演进的显式支持。我们提出 MultiEvoSkill，一种技能优化框架，包含三个核心组件：1）技能编译器将技能表示为带类型的图，并配备定制算子，生成紧凑、信息丰富且具有显式程序拓扑结构的表示；2）异质智能体系统利用集体智能提出修订建议，并基于多组经验识别精简而有信息量的问题；3）结构感知辩论与演进机制将候选修改组织成异质图，在依赖关系和重要性约束下解决冲突，并将集体提案提炼到技能制品中。多维门控确保每次演进都能带来信息增益并保持拓扑正确性。系统收敛至一致状态后即可获得最优技能。与 SOTA 方法的多种实验和消融研究验证了 MultiEvoSkill 的有效性和泛化能力。

    DoubleFree reuses RL exploration trajectories and precomputed teacher supervision to reduce the cost of multi-task LLM consolidation, and analyzes when these updates approximate on-policy distillation.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Multi-task post-training can develop domain specialists through independent reinforcement learning (RL) and consolidate their capabilities through multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD). However, standard MOPD generates on-policy student responses and keeps multiple teachers online throughout consolidation, introducing substantial system costs. We view this pipeline as domain-wise exploration followed by cross-domain exploitation. Domain RL produces not only the final specialists, but also the trajectories collected throughout their training. Existing methods primarily use the former while leaving the latter underutilized. We introduce DoubleFree, which reuses these historical trajectories for rollout-free consolidation and precomputes teacher supervision for online-teacher-free student training. To understand why this works, we analyze when updates from historical trajectories can approximate on-policy distillation updates and how combining trajectories across exploration stages can better support an evolving student. DoubleFree requires only minimal changes to existing post-training frameworks. Across math, code, and instruction following on Qwen3-4B, Qwen3-8B, and SmolLM3-3B, DoubleFree achieves $2.99$-$5.75\times$ consolidation speedups and reduces GPU-hours by $80.9$-$90.1\%$, while maintaining comparable multi-domain performance.

    多任务后训练可以通过独立强化学习（RL）培养领域专家，再通过多教师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）整合其能力。然而，标准 MOPD 会生成学生模型的在线策略响应，并在整个整合过程中让多个教师模型保持在线运行，造成显著的系统开销。我们将这一流程视为先按领域探索，再跨领域利用。领域 RL 不仅产出最终的专家模型，也会产生训练期间收集的轨迹。现有方法主要利用前者，却没有充分利用后者。我们提出 DoubleFree，复用这些历史轨迹进行免 rollout 的能力整合，并预先计算教师监督信号，从而在无需在线教师的情况下训练学生模型。为理解其有效原因，我们分析历史轨迹上的更新在何种情况下能够近似在线策略蒸馏更新，以及如何结合不同探索阶段的轨迹，更好地支持不断演进的学生模型。DoubleFree 只需对现有后训练框架作最小改动。在 Qwen3-4B、Qwen3-8B 和 SmolLM3-3B 上针对数学、代码和指令遵循任务进行评估时，DoubleFree 实现了 $2.99$-$5.75\times$的整合加速，并将 GPU 小时数降低了 $80.9$-$90.1\%$，同时保持了相当的多领域性能。

    Muhammad Atif Saeed, Azka Atiq, Adarsh Kumar, Akhtar Jamil, Uzair Iqbal, Roland Aydin

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    SHIFT-Jev combines certified abstention, shift monitoring, and gain-gated continual adaptation for LLM decision models, with empirical results across shifted environments. It advances deployment and adaptation mechanisms, while reasoning is only incidental to the decision-task setting and the abstract gives no evidence about internal representations or compositional generalization.

    SHIFT-Jev 将经认证的弃答、偏移监控和增益门控持续适配结合起来，用于 LLM 决策模型，并在多个偏移环境中报告了实证结果。它推进了部署和适配机制；推理仅与决策任务场景有间接关系，摘要也没有提供内部表征或组合泛化方面的证据。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language models (LLMs) can act as decision models that return a probability distribution over a fixed set of options, but deployed decision models face domain, label-prior, emerging-class and candidate-set shift. We study how such models fail under shift and propose SHIFT-Jev, a monitoring, abstention and continual-adaptation procedure for them. It scores the risk of each decision from uncertainty, format and option-consistency signals, certifies abstention thresholds with Learn-then-Test, monitors the decision stream with drift and label-shift detectors, and accepts a model update only when an expected-gain gate finds a significant held-out improvement without loss on earlier regimes. On a benchmark of ten shifted test environments with Qwen3-0.6B and Qwen3-4B (three seeds each) and Phi-4-mini, fine-tuning with KL anchors and temperature scaling lowers calibration error under shift from 0.289 to 0.087. At a target risk of 10%, a learned uncertainty score with a certified threshold exceeds the target in 3 to 5 of 27 environment-seed tests, against 5 to 15 for a max-probability score with the same certification and 9 to 14 for conformal prediction sets; drift-based routing changes little. A chi-squared test on predicted labels detects 95 to 99% of class-prior shifts that confidence- and embedding-based detectors miss. In continual adaptation, SHIFT-Jev reaches 70.5% accuracy on Qwen3-0.6B, above replay, LwF, EWC and fine-tuning baselines in every seed, whereas on Qwen3-4B its conservative gate leaves it 0.4 to 1.4 points behind them.

    中文

    大型语言模型（LLM）可以作为决策模型，返回固定选项集合上的概率分布，但部署后的决策模型会面临领域、标签先验、新类别和候选集合偏移。我们研究此类模型在偏移下的失效方式，并提出 SHIFT-Jev，一套用于此类模型的监控、弃答和持续适配流程。该流程根据不确定性、格式和选项一致性信号为每项决策评估风险，使用 Learn-then-Test 认证弃答阈值，通过漂移和标签偏移检测器监控决策流，并且仅在预期增益门控发现显著的留出集性能提升且此前各阶段性能没有损失时才接受模型更新。在包含十种偏移测试环境的基准上，使用 Qwen3-0.6B 和 Qwen3-4B（各三个随机种子）以及 Phi-4-mini 时，采用 KL 锚定和温度缩放的微调将偏移下的校准误差从 0.289 降至 0.087。在目标风险为 10% 时，采用认证阈值的学习型不确定性分数在 27 个环境—随机种子测试中的 3 至 5 个超出目标；采用相同认证方式的最大概率分数在 5 至 15 个测试中超出目标，保形预测集则在 9 至 14 个测试中超出目标；基于漂移的路由变化不大。对预测标签进行卡方检验，能够检测出 95% 至 99% 的类别先验偏移，而基于置信度和嵌入的检测器会漏掉这些偏移。在持续适配中，SHIFT-Jev 在 Qwen3-0.6B 上达到 70.5% 的准确率，每个随机种子上的表现都优于回放、LwF、EWC 和微调基线；而在 Qwen3-4B 上，其保守门控使表现比这些基线低 0.4 至 1.4 个百分点。

    CoLink：面向多轮对话建模的全局压缩与知识链接

    Lian Yan, Zhenbo Xia, Haotian Wang, Chen Tang, Yi Guan, Jie Liu, Jingchi Jiang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    CoLink’s main contribution is a dialogue-memory system that links and compresses long histories into memory and knowledge slots, with an information-theoretic objective. Its topic graphs provide an incidental connection to composition, but the abstract does not establish a contribution to compositional generalization or internal model representations.

    CoLink 的主要贡献是一个对话记忆系统，它将长篇历史记录链接并压缩到记忆槽位和知识槽位中，并采用信息论目标。其主题图与组合性存在附带联系，但摘要并未证明该方法对组合泛化或模型内部表示有所贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Extracting salient information from long-horizon dialogue histories remains a significant challenge for Large Language Models (LLMs) due to the restricted context windows and efficient retrieval challenges. Current methods typically rely on history organization or local token-level optimization, suffering from information loss, retrieval redundancy, and myopic attention. Inspired by the view in cognitive science that dialogue constitutes sense-making and memory association, we propose CoLink, a framework that enhances LLMs' global context awareness in domain-specific multi-turn dialogues through information linking and compression. CoLink first clusters historical contexts into topic graphs to establish cross-semantic associations with external knowledge. Guided by the adaptive control of thought, it then retrieves and activates knowledge via synergizing semantic relevance and graph-structural topology. Crucially, to achieve effective compression of history and knowledge, we ground multi-turn dialogues in information theory and derive a principled optimization objective for extracting the core sense-making information. Coupled with a competitive slot mechanism, CoLink condenses the global context into dedicated memory and knowledge slots, efficiently distilling lengthy, redundant inputs into an extremely compact latent representation. Extensive empirical results on both public and our MMD datasets validate CoLink's superiority and generalizability in knowledge linking and sense modeling.

    中文

    由于上下文窗口受限以及高效检索面临挑战，从长时间跨度的对话历史中提取显著信息仍是大型语言模型（LLM）的一项重大挑战。当前方法通常依赖历史记录组织或局部的 token 级优化，因而遭受信息丢失、检索冗余和注意力短视等问题。受认知科学中“对话构成意义建构与记忆关联”这一观点的启发，我们提出 CoLink，这是一个通过信息链接与压缩，增强 LLM 在特定领域多轮对话中全局上下文感知能力的框架。CoLink 首先将历史上下文聚类为主题图，以建立与外部知识的跨语义关联。在思维自适应控制理论的指导下，它随后通过协同利用语义相关性与图结构拓扑来检索和激活知识。关键的是，为了有效压缩历史记录与知识，我们以信息论为基础来处理多轮对话，并推导出一个有原则的优化目标，用于提取核心的意义建构信息。结合竞争式槽位机制，CoLink 将全局上下文压缩到专用的记忆槽位和知识槽位中，从而将冗长、冗余的输入高效提炼为极其紧凑的潜在表示。在公开数据集和我们自己的 MMD 数据集上进行的大量实证结果，验证了 CoLink 在知识链接和意义建模方面的优越性与泛化能力。

    通过长短对比剪枝提高剪枝推理模型的思维链可压缩性

    Tao Jing, Chen Kang, Feifei Zhai, Pengyuan Liu, Dong Yu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    CSD uses neuron activation contrasts to identify redundant reasoning and coordinate pruning with chain-of-thought compression, reducing thinking tokens while maintaining accuracy on math benchmarks. This gives a limited mechanistic connection to interpretability and a substantial contribution to reasoning efficiency; the pruning is relevant to model computation, but the abstract does not make system organization its central focus.

    CSD 利用神经元激活对比来识别冗余推理，并协调剪枝与思维链压缩，在数学基准上减少思考 token 的同时维持准确率。这在机制层面与可解释性存在有限联系，并对推理效率作出了实质贡献；剪枝与模型计算相关，但摘要并未将系统组织作为核心重点。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large reasoning models are costly to serve because they are large and because they generate long chains of thought (CoT). Weight pruning and CoT compression address these two costs separately, but they interfere in that pruning adds redundant reasoning on problems the model still solves and incomplete reasoning on those it no longer solves, and on harder problems makes the model less compressible by subsequent length-preference optimization. We trace this to a blind spot on each side: pruning criteria do not distinguish necessary from redundant reasoning, and preference-based CoT compression receives no training signal on problems a pruned model always or never solves. We propose Contrastive Set-Difference (CSD), which identifies neurons enriched in redundant reasoning by contrasting their activations on long and short correct solutions of the same problem and prunes them preferentially, and we extend preference pairs to the problems a pruned model always or never solves. Pruning 20\% of DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B, the combination uses 8--22\% fewer thinking tokens on four math benchmarks than pruning with reasoning-aware calibration (RAC) followed by the same compression, with accuracy within 0.5 points.

    中文

    大型推理模型的服务成本高昂，既因为模型规模大，也因为它们会生成很长的思维链（CoT）。权重剪枝和 CoT 压缩分别应对这两项成本，但二者会相互干扰：对于模型仍能解决的问题，剪枝会增加冗余推理；对于模型已无法解决的问题，剪枝会导致推理不完整；而在更难的问题上，剪枝还会降低模型随后通过长度偏好优化进行压缩的能力。我们将此归因于两方面的盲点：剪枝标准无法区分必要推理与冗余推理，而基于偏好的 CoT 压缩在剪枝模型总能或从不能解决的问题上得不到训练信号。我们提出对比集合差分（CSD），通过对比同一问题的正确长解答与短解答中的神经元激活，找出在冗余推理中富集的神经元并优先剪除；我们还将偏好对扩展到剪枝模型总能或从不能解决的问题。对 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B 剪枝 20\% 后，与采用具备推理感知校准（RAC）的剪枝再进行相同压缩相比，该组合方法在四个数学基准上少用 8--22\% 的思考 token，同时准确率相差不超过 0.5 个百分点。

    ENGLISH

    Mobile-use multimodal agents are typically evaluated by task success from a clean initial state, which does not isolate their ability to recover from intermediate errors. Because mobile environments change dynamically, a general mobile-use agent must complete tasks robustly even from unexpected states and in unseen environments. This requires knowing when and where an agent makes errors, and whether it can recover from errors and subsequent states. To evaluate this capability, we introduce AndroidFlux, a failure-recovery benchmark built on AndroidWorld. AndroidFlux restores recorded trajectories to controlled checkpoints before, at, and after the first recoverable error, so that different agents continue from the same device state and history. On these checkpoints, a complementary reward-modeling benchmark evaluates recovery-action preferences using downstream rollout outcomes. We further release an offline reinforcement learning (RL) dataset that improves both error recovery and overall task success. Our evaluations show that recovery performance only partially correlates with clean-start success, and that explicit reasoning helps only models trained with GUI-domain specific RL.

    ParetoRSI-Gym: Can AI Agents Improve Language Models Across Multiple Domains?

    ParetoRSI-Gym：AI 智能体能否跨多个领域改进语言模型？

    Haojin Wang, Yangzhen Wu, Zeyi Chen, Jian Xie, Jiaying Ye, Lili Meng, Shuyun Tang, Shangding Gu, Dawn Song

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    ParetoRSI-Gym evaluates agents that iteratively select and curate data, train successor models, and use multi-domain results to guide further work. This is a substantial agent-system evaluation, while capability gains in math and code are outcomes rather than a study of reasoning mechanisms or compositional generalization.

    ParetoRSI-Gym 评估能够迭代地选择和整理数据、训练后继模型，并利用多领域结果指导后续工作的智能体。这是对智能体系统评估的一项实质贡献；数学和代码方面的能力提升属于实验结果，而非对推理机制或组合泛化的研究。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Recursive self-improvement (RSI) requires an agentic system to design, train, and evaluate its own successor. Data-driven post-training is a central part of that loop, yet existing evaluations measure it on a single benchmark, where an agent selects from a static pool or distills a stronger model to push one score up in one run. Real post-training is multi-domain, and a gain in one domain has to be weighed against a regression in another. We propose ParetoRSI-Gym, in which an agent searches for data, curates it, trains, reads back per-domain results, and repeats, with everything but the data held fixed: the initial LLM, the five domains (math, code, finance, medicine, science), the toolset, and the SFT pipeline. Generalization benchmarks in each domain separate capability gains from overfitting to the scores the agent optimizes against. Across three agent systems, three base models, five rounds and multiple seeds, the strongest system, Claude Code with Opus-5, raises the generalization scores of its proxy-best checkpoint by 9.2% relative to the starting model (+2.3 absolute points), averaged with equal weight over three base models and five domains, with a single-domain relative gain of up to 63% (medicine on Ministral-3-3B). Further analysis shows that the harness matters as much as the model it drives, and that each agent keeps a unique data selection strategy. We see our work as a step towards evaluation of RSI systems in real-world machine learning engineering.

    中文

    递归自我改进（RSI）要求智能体系统设计、训练并评估自己的后继模型。数据驱动的后训练是这一循环的核心环节，但现有评估只在单个基准上衡量它：智能体从静态数据池中选择数据，或蒸馏更强的模型，在一次运行中推高一个分数。现实中的后训练涉及多个领域，一个领域的提升必须与另一领域的退步权衡。我们提出 ParetoRSI-Gym，在其中，智能体搜索数据、整理数据、训练模型、读取各领域结果并重复这一过程，同时固定数据以外的所有因素：初始 LLM、五个领域（数学、代码、金融、医学、科学）、工具集和 SFT 流程。每个领域中的泛化基准用于区分能力提升与对智能体所优化分数的过拟合。在三个智能体系统、三个基础模型、五轮迭代和多个随机种子的实验中，表现最强的系统 Claude Code with Opus-5 将其代理指标最佳检查点的泛化分数相对于起始模型提高了 9.2%（绝对提高 2.3 个百分点）；该结果是对三个基础模型和五个领域等权平均得出的，其中单一领域的相对提升最高达 63%（Ministral-3-3B 在医学领域）。进一步分析表明，执行框架与其驱动的模型同等重要，而且每个智能体都采用独特的数据选择策略。我们认为，这项工作是朝着在真实世界机器学习工程中评估 RSI 系统迈出的一步。

    ENGLISH

    Autonomous control of sixth-generation (6G) low Earth orbit satellite networks is hindered by the gap between high-level human intent and low-level control logic: translating a request such as "uninterrupted Arctic video" into a valid reinforcement learning reward still takes days of manual trial and error, and existing large language model translators cannot learn from the failures of the policies they generate. This article presents ALMOND (Agentic Large-Model-Orchestrated autonomous Network Design), a cognitive framework that closes this intent-to-action loop under on-orbit compute constraints. The contribution in artificial intelligence is a bidirectional semantic engine that translates natural-language demands into multi-objective reward functions and, conversely, mines implicit operational constraints from failed reinforcement-learning trajectories through counterfactually validated forensics, together with a large language model-guided graph neuroevolution that seeds and critiques policy architectures. The contribution in engineering is a ground-centric, compute-frugal architecture for autonomous 6G non-terrestrial network operation, in which satellites execute only distilled policies below 50,000 parameters with sub-15 ms inference and no on-board large language model. On a 350-satellite digital twin driven by real ephemeris data, ALMOND raises polar handover success from 55% to over 95%, converges about three times faster than baseline reinforcement learning, and reduces reward engineering from 48 hours to 4.5 hours, demonstrating a practical path toward trustworthy in-orbit autonomy.

    Matthias Busch, Marius Tacke, Roland C. Aydin, Christian Feiler, Christian J. Cyron

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper studies LLM agents that decide when and how to compact context, and evaluates effects on task success and cost across long sessions. This is a strong contribution on agent memory management; benchmark tasks involve multi-step problem solving, but reasoning mechanisms are not the focus.

    本文研究由 LLM 智能体决定何时以及如何压缩上下文，并评估其对长会话中任务成功率和成本的影响。这是对智能体记忆管理的一项重要贡献；基准任务涉及多步问题求解，但推理机制并非研究重点。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Agent harnesses keep long sessions inside the context window by compacting the history when a token threshold is crossed. We study an alternative in which the model manages its own context: it decides when to compact, what to keep and what to write as the hand-off, given two tools and one paragraph of guidance. Since earlier work found that open-weight models cannot manage their own context without scaffolding, we compare seven frontier models under identical conditions, with and without the context tools, on token cost and benchmark score, and we compare our harness with three widely used harnesses on two of these models. The benchmark is assembled from existing ones: coding exercises, multi-step SciCode problems and SWE-bench Pro and Terminal-Bench 4.0 tasks are interleaved with planted facts, ephemeral observations and standing instructions, all checked deterministically, in sessions of 35-212 turns that resemble a user working through different tasks in one chat. Most of the strongest models manage their context: they compact and curate regularly, the live context of the mixed sessions stays mostly below 100k tokens, and their benchmark scores mostly do not drop significantly. For the models that manage their context well, the cost reduction is substantial but varies between models, because some models compact so often that other costs increase. With Claude Opus 5.5, the self-managed harness matches Claude Code on task success at 34% lower cost than its explicit 200k-window configuration and 49% lower than its default, with no context window to choose. We release the agent, the benchmark and all result rows.

    中文

    智能体执行框架会在 token 数达到阈值时压缩历史记录，从而让长时间会话保持在上下文窗口内。我们研究一种替代方案：由模型自行管理上下文；在获得两个工具和一段指导说明后，模型决定何时压缩、保留哪些内容，以及交接时写下什么。此前研究发现，开放权重模型若没有辅助框架便无法自行管理上下文，因此我们在相同条件下比较七个前沿模型使用和不使用上下文工具时的 token 成本与基准分数，并在其中两个模型上将我们的执行框架与三种广泛使用的框架进行比较。该基准由现有基准组合而成：编程练习、多步骤 SciCode 问题、SWE-bench Pro 和 Terminal-Bench 4.0 任务，与预先植入的事实、临时观察和持续有效的指令交错出现；所有内容均以确定性方式检查，会话包含 35-212 轮，模拟用户在一次聊天中处理不同任务的情形。大多数能力最强的模型都能管理自己的上下文：它们会定期压缩和整理内容，混合任务会话中的活动上下文大多保持在 100k token 以下，而且基准分数通常不会显著下降。对于上下文管理良好的模型，成本降幅很大，但模型之间差异明显，因为有些模型压缩得过于频繁，反而增加了其他成本。使用 Claude Opus 5.5 时，在任务成功率相当的情况下，自管理执行框架的成本比显式配置 200k 窗口低 34%，比其默认配置低 49%，且无需选择上下文窗口大小。我们将发布该智能体、基准和所有结果数据行。

    Dezhen Lu, Zixiang Ni, and Runguo Li

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper develops an exact replay and deferred rollout method for efficient reinforcement learning on looped transformers, with measured throughput and training results. It advances model computation and training systems substantially, while the GSM8K results are evidence of capability development rather than a contribution to reasoning mechanisms.

    本文为循环 Transformer 开发了用于高效强化学习的精确重放和延迟 rollout 方法，并测量其吞吐量与训练效果。这项工作实质性推进了模型计算和训练系统；GSM8K 结果展示的是能力提升，而非对推理机制的贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Looped language models such as Ouro reuse one block of layers several times per token. A rollout engine can batch the deeper loops of several response positions and run them only when a deep readout is due. This deferred schedule is fast, but the learner of an on-policy RL algorithm recomputes the sampled tokens' log-probabilities with a dense pass, and the two computations differ in floating point: in FP32 at 4096 tokens about 18% of the sampled tokens miss a $10^{-5}$ same-weight gate, and with bf16 weights nearly every token does. We use a hybrid learner log-probability, $\ell=\ell_{\mathrm{dense}}+\mathrm{sg}(\ell_{\mathrm{sched}}-\ell_{\mathrm{dense}})$, where $\mathrm{sg}$ denotes stop-gradient. Its value is a no-grad replay through the rollout's own schedule, and its gradient is the dense learner's. The replay reproduces the rollout bit for bit in all 167 FP32 and 28 bf16 real-weight cells we ran on three platforms, including rollouts whose batch shrinks at stop tokens, and the gradient has the same FP32 error as other dense implementations in all 102 pre-registered comparisons from 96 to 4096 tokens; the full GRPO loss of a training step matches a float64 reference to $3.1\times10^{-4}$. On one GPU, deferral raises rollout throughput by $1.47$ to $1.56\times$, and by $1.18$ to $1.54\times$ once every step runs from CUDA graphs, bit for bit. In a two-node GRPO loop, one-wave KV admission and CUDA graphs shorten an update by $2.71\times$ with the gate bitwise at every update, and four nodes keep the update time within 2% at the same per-GPU load. In 100-update runs held-out GSM8K accuracy rose from 23% to 82% with the mixed-depth readout that deferral relies on and from 34% to 90% with the native readout, which reached a higher accuracy in less time. For looped models beyond one node we analyse a ring mapping of layers to GPUs and measure its communication paths.

    中文

    Ouro 等循环语言模型会在每个 token 上多次重复使用同一个层块。Rollout 引擎可以将多个响应位置中更深层的循环批处理，并仅在需要深层读出时运行它们。这种延迟调度速度很快，但在线 RL 算法的学习器会通过一次密集计算重新计算采样 token 的对数概率，而两种计算在浮点数值上存在差异：在 4096 个 token、FP32 下，约 18% 的采样 token 未通过一个 $10^{-5}$ 同权重门限；使用 bf16 权重时，几乎所有 token 都未通过。我们采用混合式学习器对数概率：$\ell=\ell_{\mathrm{dense}}+\mathrm{sg}(\ell_{\mathrm{sched}}-\ell_{\mathrm{dense}})$，其中 $\mathrm{sg}$ 表示停止梯度。其数值是通过 rollout 自身调度进行的无梯度重放，而其梯度则来自密集计算学习器。我们在三个平台上运行的全部 167 个 FP32 和 28 个 bf16 真实权重测试单元中，重放都能逐位复现 rollout，包括批次大小会在停止 token 处缩小的 rollout；在从 96 到 4096 个 token 的全部 102 项预注册比较中，其梯度的 FP32 误差与其他密集实现相同；训练步骤的完整 GRPO 损失与 float64 参考值的差异不超过 $3.1\times10^{-4}$。在单 GPU 上，延迟执行将 rollout 吞吐量提高了 $1.47$ 至 $1.56\times$；当每一步都通过 CUDA 图运行时，吞吐量提高了 $1.18$ 至 $1.54\times$，且结果逐位一致。在双节点 GRPO 循环中，单波 KV 接纳和 CUDA 图将一次更新缩短了 $2.71\times$，且每次更新时门限判断都逐位一致；在相同的每 GPU 负载下，四个节点可使更新时间维持在原有水平的 2% 以内。在 100 次更新的运行中，留出的 GSM8K 准确率在依赖延迟执行的混合深度读出下从 23% 升至 82%，在原生读出下从 34% 升至 90%；后者以更短时间达到了更高准确率。对于超过单节点的循环模型，我们分析了将层环形映射到 GPU 的方案，并测量其通信路径。

    Speculative Decoding for Mixture-of-Experts Models: Expert Bytes, Kernel Bandwidth and the Best Draft Length

    混合专家模型的推测解码：专家字节数、内核带宽与最佳草稿长度

    Yuzheng Lan

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper derives and validates a bandwidth-aware model for choosing speculative draft lengths in MoE decoding, including when expert deduplication helps and how prediction errors affect results. This is a substantial algorithmic contribution to model computation efficiency, while expert routing and token prediction are incidental to interpretability, compositionality, and reasoning.

    本文推导并验证了一个带宽感知模型，用于选择 MoE 解码中的推测草稿长度，包括专家去重何时有益以及预测误差会如何影响结果。这是对模型计算效率的一项实质性算法贡献；专家路由和 token 预测与可解释性、组合性和推理的联系只是附带的。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Speculative decoding checks several drafted tokens in one verification pass. On a mixture-of-experts (MoE) model, consecutive tokens often select the same experts. A deduplicating engine reads each selected expert once per pass, so it requests fewer bytes than a per-slot engine, which reads it once per token. We write a step's time as the bytes each kernel requests over its effective bandwidth, plus fixed time. Under geometric acceptance, we derive from this step time when speculation is faster than plain decoding. The best draft length is a monotone staircase in the acceptance rate. We bound how a bandwidth error moves each result, and we check the main steps in Lean. Deduplication is faster exactly where its share $\bar u(n)$ of the per-slot bytes is below its ratio $r(n)$ of the per-slot bandwidth. On llama.cpp Metal, MLX-LM and llama.cpp CUDA, which we modified to deduplicate, the per-slot kernel has the higher effective bandwidth (r = 0.32 to 0.75). Thus deduplication is faster only from 5 to 8 tokens per pass, or never. We fit the bandwidths on one layer's expert operation, run alone, in under an hour per model. Bytes from routing traces over these bandwidths predict the time that deduplication saves. The measured saving lies inside its error bound at every point on CUDA and MLX-LM and at 36 of 48 points on Metal. The crossover is the first pass size at which deduplication is faster. The prediction places it within one pass size in 10 of 12 configurations of engine, model and depth. We computed these predictions after the measurements. On DeepSeek-V2-Lite, operation times measured before its speculative runs give the best draft length on CUDA within one at all 22 acceptance values.

    中文

    推测解码会在一次验证过程中检查多个草拟 token。在混合专家（MoE）模型中，相邻 token 往往会选择相同的专家。去重引擎在每次处理中只读取每个被选中的专家一次，因此它请求的字节数少于按槽位处理的引擎；后者每个 token 都会读取一次该专家。我们将一个步骤的耗时表示为每个内核请求的字节数除以其有效带宽，再加上固定耗时。在接受率服从几何分布的条件下，我们根据此步骤耗时推导出推测解码何时比普通解码更快。最佳草稿长度随接受率呈单调阶梯变化。我们界定带宽误差会如何改变各项结果，并在 Lean 中验证主要步骤。只有当去重引擎所需字节占按槽位处理字节数的比例 $\bar u(n)$ 低于其带宽占按槽位处理带宽的比例 $r(n)$ 时，去重才会更快。在我们修改以支持去重的 llama.cpp Metal、MLX-LM 和 llama.cpp CUDA 上，按槽位处理的内核具有更高的有效带宽（r = 0.32 至 0.75）。因此，去重只会在每次处理 5 到 8 个 token 时更快，或者始终不会更快。我们在每个模型的一层专家操作单独运行时拟合带宽，用时不到一小时。根据路由轨迹中的字节数和这些带宽，可以预测去重节省的时间。在 CUDA 和 MLX-LM 的每个测量点上，以及 Metal 的 48 个测量点中的 36 个，实测节省时间均落在误差界内。交叉点是去重首次变快时的处理规模。在 12 种引擎、模型和深度配置中的 10 种里，预测的交叉点与实测值相差不超过一个处理规模。我们在测量完成后计算了这些预测。在 DeepSeek-V2-Lite 上，推测解码运行前测得的操作耗时，在 CUDA 上对全部 22 个接受率给出的最佳草稿长度预测，与实际值相差不超过 1。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    IntNet jointly learns intent sharing, observation prediction, and adaptive communication scheduling to improve cooperative driving safety and bandwidth efficiency. Its main contribution is a multi-agent communication and coordination architecture, supporting a strong Systems score; coordination and forecasting connect only incidentally to composition and reasoning, with no explicit compositional or reasoning mechanism.

    IntNet 联合学习意图共享、观测预测和自适应通信调度，以提升协作驾驶的安全性和带宽效率。其主要贡献是多智能体通信与协调架构，因此在系统领域具有很强的贡献；协调和预测与组合及推理只有附带关联，并未提出明确的组合或推理机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Achieving safety in autonomous driving through Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) is a critical yet challenging task due to non-stationarity, partial observability, and the need for effective coordination among agents. Although earlier cooperative MARL methods have aimed to improve coordination by sharing encoded state observations, we find these strategies are insufficient in safety-critical scenarios. To address this gap, we present IntNet, a novel MARL framework that enhances safety by incorporating the transmission of vehicle intent and adaptive communication scheduling into a unified end-to-end learning paradigm, jointly optimising all components for safe coordination. Central to our approach is an observation prediction module that enables agents to forecast subsequent policy outputs, which they can then share across a vehicle-to-vehicle network. Our model-free architecture employs a Graph Attention Network to process incoming messages and a scheduler component to dynamically optimise the communication graph for bandwidth efficiency. We compare IntNet against state-of-the-art communicative MARL methods in complex urban environments with both autonomous and human-operated vehicles, achieving improved coordination, lower collision rates, and reducing communication efforts by up to 60\%. Through extensive experiments, we assess the framework's learning efficiency, scalability, and the balance between information sharing and bandwidth usage for collision-free trajectories.

    中文

    通过多智能体强化学习（MARL）实现自动驾驶安全至关重要，但由于非平稳性、部分可观测性以及智能体之间需要有效协调，这项任务颇具挑战。尽管早期的协作式 MARL 方法试图通过共享编码后的状态观测来改善协调，但我们发现这些策略不足以应对安全关键场景。为弥补这一缺口，我们提出 IntNet，这是一种新型 MARL 框架，通过将车辆意图传输和自适应通信调度纳入统一的端到端学习范式，并联合优化所有组成部分以实现安全协调，从而提升安全性。我们方法的核心是一个观测预测模块，使智能体能够预测后续策略输出，并通过车车通信网络共享这些输出。我们的无模型架构采用图注意力网络处理传入消息，并通过调度器组件动态优化通信图，以提高带宽效率。我们在复杂城市环境中，将 IntNet 与最先进的通信式 MARL 方法进行比较；环境中既有自动驾驶车辆，也有人类驾驶车辆。IntNet 实现了更好的协调、更低的碰撞率，并将通信开销最多减少 60\%。通过大量实验，我们评估了该框架的学习效率、可扩展性，以及在实现无碰撞轨迹时信息共享与带宽使用之间的平衡。

    The paper shows that models’ premise checking and answer commitment change when unsupported facts become usable, with the effect replicated across several manipulations and benchmarks. This is a strong empirical contribution about reasoning behavior, but it offers no internal-mechanism analysis; the application to question answering does not substantively address composition or model systems.

    本文表明，当缺乏依据的事实变得可供使用时，模型的前提检查和作答承诺会发生变化；这一效果在多种操纵和基准上均得到复现。这是关于推理行为的重要实证贡献，但没有分析内部机制；其问答应用也没有实质性涉及组合能力或模型系统。

    Ask a model "how many settlements did the Normans control?" and it answers that the passage does not say. Tell it "given that the Normans controlled 12 settlements of 400 inhabitants, what is the total?" and it computes 4,800. Nothing was added to the passage; the unsupported fact merely became usable. Benchmarks for unanswerable questions are built almost entirely by omission, deleting the fact a question needs and scoring refusal, so they never probe this. Holding source support fixed and varying only whether an unsupported premise is usable, flagging drops 8-30 points and commitment to an answer rises 1.5-2.3x on GSM8K across four models spanning two families and 2B-26B; all 16 paired contrasts remain significant after Holm correction. Two further manipulations reproduce it, one also on SQuAD: a fact asserted rather than asked about, and a corrupted intermediate value rather than a removed one. Models articulate the exact gap they then ignore, stating that "there is no financial information provided" for an inert premise and silently adopting a fabricated price for the same item. We read these as one behaviour: whether a model checks depends substantially on whether usable material is present, even when source support is held fixed. Because the main design never instructs models to reject premises introduced in the question, adopting such a premise can also be read as conditional reasoning, and we delimit what the design does and does not show. In the judging seat the pattern differs: asked whether the answer follows, judges pass solutions with a required step deleted 78-99% of the time at every scale tested. A natural prompt-level mitigation lowers accuracy by 22 points without improving detection.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    In formal systems such as Lean 4, efficiently finding answers to mathematical problems and generating verifiable proofs is an important task in automated mathematical reasoning. In the traditional way where an upstream solver provides multiple candidate answers, the common workflow requires searching for proofs for each candidate separately, incurring redundant computational cost. To this end, we propose a joint proof framework that integrates candidate answer selection, answer supplementation, and formal proof generation into a unified reasoning process. At its core is a trained prover that selects given or proposes new answers and generates a proof for at least one answer in a single call. Joint proof can also reuse generated proofs to check for faithfulness errors. For problems with a unique answer, if two distinct answers both obtain verifiable proofs under the same formal statement, this confirms the statement does not faithfully preserve the original problem semantics. On MATH-500, AMC 2023, and AIME 2024/2025/2026, our framework achieves the same formal proof success rate as per-candidate proof generation with about one sixth of the token cost, and identifies at least 6.1% of the formalized statements as unfaithful without requiring additional judges. Our model and code are available at https://github.com/Linppz/Gobble-Prover.

    What Effort Level Should I Choose? On the Economics of Reasoning Effort in LLM Agents

    我应该选择多大的努力等级？论 LLM 智能体推理努力的经济学

    Kaiser Sun, Yongchan Kwon, Zain Hasan, Shang Zhu, Kaitlyn Zhou, Federico Bianchi

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The study measures how inference-time reasoning effort affects accuracy, cost, and agent trajectories, and evaluates an escalation strategy that matches or improves fixed high effort at lower cost. This directly informs reasoning capability and adaptive compute allocation, but the abstract provides no evidence about internal representations or compositional generalization.

    这项研究测量了推理时努力程度对准确率、成本和智能体执行轨迹的影响，并评估了一种升级策略：它以更低成本达到或超过固定使用高努力等级的效果。这项研究直接关系到推理能力和自适应计算分配，但摘要没有提供关于内部表征或组合泛化的证据。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Generative models increasingly expose a reasoning effort setting that lets users scale inference-time compute, trading higher cost for potentially improved performance. Users must choose an effort level before knowing whether extra reasoning will help, and even a successful run does not reveal whether the effort purchased was necessary. Reasoning effort is therefore a credence good: buyers observe the outcome but cannot assess the marginal value of the computation they paid for. In this work, we measure the counterfactual effect of effort levels on both proprietary and open-weight models on four benchmarks, spanning single-call reasoning and long-horizon agentic tasks. Effort, it turns out, does not consistently preserve tasks that lower effort solves, can overspend, and can change trajectory behavior. First, we find that although higher effort can raise accuracy in aggregate, it frequently fails on tasks that lower effort solved. Second, on the subset of easy tasks that every effort level solves, higher effort is generally more costly, with the highest effort level costing up to 42x as much as the lowest. Lastly, effort changes not only how many tokens are used, but also how agents solve tasks: at higher effort, agents verify their own work more heavily and more often search for solutions than work through problems directly, both of which lengthen trajectories without necessarily altering the outcome. These findings show that naively choosing the highest level is not only cost-inefficient but also offers no guarantee of the best instance-level performance. A simple alternative, starting at the lowest effort and escalating only after a verified failure, matches or improves on fixed top effort across all models and benchmarks at lower cost for most proprietary models.

    中文

    生成模型越来越多地提供推理努力设置，让用户可以调节推理时计算量，以更高成本换取可能更好的性能。用户必须在不知道额外推理是否有帮助时选择努力等级；即使运行成功，也无法看出所付出的努力是否必要。因此，推理努力是一种信任品：购买者能观察结果，却无法评估所支付计算量的边际价值。在这项工作中，我们在四个基准上测量不同努力等级对专有模型和开放权重模型的反事实影响，涵盖单次调用推理和长时程智能体任务。结果表明，努力等级无法稳定保住低努力等级能够解决的任务，可能造成过度开销，也会改变执行轨迹。首先，我们发现，尽管更高的努力等级总体上可能提升准确率，但它经常无法解决低努力等级已经解决的任务。其次，在所有努力等级都能解决的简单任务子集中，更高努力等级通常成本更高，最高努力等级的成本可达最低等级的 42 倍。最后，努力等级改变的不只是 token 用量，也改变智能体解决任务的方式：在更高努力等级下，智能体会更仔细地验证自身工作，也更常搜索解法，而不是直接推演问题；这两种做法都会延长执行轨迹，却未必改变结果。这些发现表明，直接选择最高等级不仅成本效率低，也无法保证单个实例上的性能最佳。一种简单的替代方案是从最低努力等级开始，仅在经验证确实失败后才升级；在所有模型和基准上，这种方案的表现与固定使用最高努力等级相当或更好，而且对大多数专有模型而言成本更低。
