    CaliMem: Search-Efficient Data Agent via Calibrated Memory

    CaliMem：通过校准记忆实现高效搜索的数据智能体

    Hanze Li, Athan Z. Li, Feiyang Kang, Jiachen T. Wang, Yuhan Chen, Ruishan Liu, Ruoxi Jia

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    CaliMem adds prediction-based checks to an agent’s persistent memory so it can revise claims, avoid overgeneralization, and explore curation policies over longer horizons. This is a substantial agent-memory and exploration contribution, with reasoning-related insight secondary to the system design; its data-curation application alone does not support higher scores elsewhere.

    CaliMem 在智能体的持久记忆中加入基于预测的检查，使其能够修正主张、避免过度泛化，并在更长时程内探索数据整理策略。这是对智能体记忆和探索的重要贡献，与推理相关的洞见则次于系统设计；仅凭其数据整理应用不足以支持其他领域的更高评价。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Data curation is a first-order design choice in machine learning, yet tailoring training data to a downstream model and task remains costly in labor, expertise, and compute. Datasets are therefore often processed through fixed pipelines and reused across applications. We show that this assumption is fragile: across 55 dataset--model tasks spanning biological domains, the same curation recipe can help one model while hurting another. Effective curation must adapt to the downstream setting, motivating automated search over data recipes. We first build an agentic system that searches for curation policies at deployment, improving data utility via \textit{test-time curation (TTC)}. Although achieving performance gains, its search is driven largely by recent feedback and remains local. Adding persistent memory helps the agent retain evidence across iterations and reveals a deeper problem: it forms claims that extend beyond the conditions in which they were observed, sometimes abandoning an entire strategy after a single unsuccessful trial. To address this problem, we introduce CaliMem, a calibrated-memory agentic loop that requires the agent to predict the outcome of each proposed policy before executing it. Comparing this prediction with the observed result gives the agent a \textit{reality check} on the claims behind its proposal. It uses the prediction error to retain supported claims, revise mistaken ones, and specify the conditions under which a conclusion holds. This makes the agent's beliefs testable, reduces overgeneralization, and supports more effective long-horizon exploration. Across biological and LLM post-training tasks, CaliMem consistently outperforms fixed curation baselines and published methods, and exceeds full-data training by up to 19.4\%. Code is open-sourced.

    中文

    数据整理是机器学习中的首要设计选择，但针对下游模型和任务定制训练数据，仍需付出高昂的人力、专业知识和计算成本。因此，数据集往往通过固定流程处理，并在多个应用中重复使用。我们表明，这种做法并不稳妥：在涵盖生物学领域的 55 个数据集—模型任务中，同一种整理方案可能对一个模型有帮助，却损害另一个模型。有效的数据整理必须适应下游场景，这促使我们对数据方案进行自动化搜索。我们首先构建了一个智能体系统，在部署时搜索数据整理策略，通过\textit{测试时整理（TTC）}提升数据效用。尽管它能带来性能提升，其搜索主要由近期反馈驱动，仍停留在局部。加入持久记忆有助于智能体跨迭代保留证据，也揭示出一个更深层的问题：它会提出超出实际观察条件适用范围的主张，有时甚至在一次试验失败后就放弃整个策略。为解决这个问题，我们提出 CaliMem，这是一种校准记忆智能体循环，要求智能体在执行每项拟议策略前预测其结果。将预测与观察到的结果进行比较，可以对支撑提议的主张进行一次\textit{现实检验}。智能体利用预测误差保留有依据的主张、修正错误主张，并明确结论成立的条件。这使智能体的信念可以接受检验，减少过度泛化，并支持更有效的长时程探索。在生物学任务和 LLM 后训练任务中，CaliMem 的表现始终优于固定数据整理基线和已发表的方法，且比全量数据训练最多高出 19.4\%。代码已开源。

    TRIAGE: Efficient Vision-Language-Action Inference Needs Both Reuse and Pruning

    TRIAGE：高效的视觉—语言—动作推理需要兼顾复用与剪枝

    Sooyoung Kwon, Carlee Joe-Wong, and Kyunghan Lee

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    TRIAGE uses token drift to decide which visual tokens to recompute, reuse, or prune, improving the latency–action accuracy tradeoff for onboard VLA inference. Its token-level diagnostic offers some insight into internal representations, but the main contribution is adaptive computation for model systems, not compositional or reasoning capability.

    TRIAGE 利用 token 漂移决定哪些视觉 token 应重新计算、复用或剪枝，从而改善机载 VLA 推理中延迟与动作准确性的权衡。其 token 级诊断对内部表征提供了一些洞见，但主要贡献是面向模型系统的自适应计算，而非组合能力或推理能力。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Vision-language-action (VLA) models are increasingly used for robot manipulation because they map camera images and a language instruction directly to actions. Robots that cannot be tethered to a workstation, such as mobile manipulators and humanoids, must run them on onboard embedded boards, where the prefill latency of the language backbone grows with the hundreds of visual tokens processed at every control step. To meet real-time limits, training-free accelerators recompute only a subset of the visual tokens and skip the rest, either by pruning them or by reusing their cached key-value (KV) states. The two options save nearly the same computation, yet existing methods apply only one of them to every skipped token. Through a token-level diagnostic, we show that which option keeps the action closer to full recomputation depends on the token's drift, the change in its shallow-layer value since its cache was computed. On both backbones tested, reusing tokens below a drift threshold was no worse than pruning them, whereas beyond it, reuse yields up to 4.4x the action error of pruning; the same diagnostic calibrates this threshold per backbone. Building on this finding, we propose TRIAGE, which deems a cache valid when its drift is below this threshold and it is not too old. TRIAGE recomputes a fixed budget of tokens, prioritizing important tokens with invalid caches, reuses every other token with a valid cache, and prunes the rest; prune-only and reuse-only methods are the two extremes of this partition. Because the budget fixes the number of recomputed tokens, it directly sets the prefill latency. On LIBERO and SimplerEnv, TRIAGE stays within 3 pp of full recomputation in average success rate while cutting prefill latency on a Jetson AGX Orin by up to 48%, and with only 7% of visual tokens recomputed, it beats the strongest baseline by 24.4 pp on LIBERO-Object.

    中文

    视觉—语言—动作（VLA）模型越来越多地用于机器人操作，因为它们能将摄像头图像和语言指令直接映射为动作。无法连接到工作站的机器人，例如移动操作机器人和人形机器人，必须在机载嵌入式板卡上运行这些模型；由于每个控制步骤都要处理数百个视觉 token，语言主干网络的预填充延迟会随之增加。为满足实时限制，无需训练的加速器只重新计算一部分视觉 token，跳过其余 token，跳过方式包括剪枝或复用缓存的键值（KV）状态。两种方式节省的计算量几乎相同，但现有方法对每个跳过的 token 都只采用其中一种。通过 token 级诊断，我们表明哪种方式能使动作更接近完全重新计算的结果，取决于 token 的漂移，即自其缓存计算以来该 token 在浅层中的取值变化。在测试的两个主干网络上，复用漂移低于阈值的 token 并不比剪枝更差；而超过阈值后，复用造成的动作误差最高可达剪枝的 4.4 倍。同一诊断方法还能针对各主干网络校准该阈值。基于这一发现，我们提出 TRIAGE：当缓存漂移低于该阈值且缓存没有过旧时，就判定缓存有效。TRIAGE 重新计算固定数量的 token，优先处理缓存无效的重要 token，复用其余所有缓存有效的 token，并剪枝其他 token；仅剪枝和仅复用是这一划分的两种极端。由于预算固定了重新计算的 token 数量，它也就直接决定了预填充延迟。在 LIBERO 和 SimplerEnv 上，TRIAGE 的平均成功率与完全重新计算相差不超过 3 个百分点，同时在 Jetson AGX Orin 上将预填充延迟最多降低 48%；即使只重新计算 7% 的视觉 token，它在 LIBERO-Object 上也比最强基线高出 24.4 个百分点。

    人类如何学习陌生世界：关于 ARC-AGI-3 的出声思考数据集

    Shuzhi Liu and Archana Warrier and Dat Nguyen and Chengqi Zheng and Kevin Ellis and Yewen Pu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper contributes a think-aloud dataset and analyses of how humans and LLM agents explore unfamiliar games, test hypotheses, revise beliefs, and recover from errors. These findings substantially inform planning and learning through interaction, with partial relevance to compositional generalization and agent systems, but they do not directly analyze model internals.

    本文贡献了一个出声思考数据集，并分析人类和 LLM 智能体如何探索陌生游戏、检验假设、修正信念以及从错误中恢复。这些发现对交互式规划和学习有重要启示，与组合泛化和智能体系统也有一定关联，但没有直接分析模型内部机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Learning through exploration and using newly acquired knowledge to achieve goals are central capabilities of general intelligence. Understanding these capabilities requires tracing how learners build, use, and revise world models during interaction. We construct the first dataset that records how humans discover and use the mechanisms of novel environments, using ARC-AGI-3 as a testbed: 144 trajectories from 64 participants across 25 public games, each pairing time-synchronized actions with think-aloud audio, plus 250 trajectories from large language model (LLM) agents with and without harnesses on the same games. We annotate mechanism triggers and recognition, action purposes, and errors and recovery, linking changes in understanding to the observations and actions that support them. We analyze characteristics of human cognition and compare them with those of LLM agents. Both groups anticipate mechanisms and use familiar analogies. Qualitative representations are more common in successful human trajectories than in successful LLM trajectories (50.0% versus 14.3%). Humans more often explore unfamiliar situations without a concrete hypothesis, while hypothesis testing is common in both groups. We also trace how learners recover through belief revision, replanning, and execution correction. As LLMs with well-designed harnesses reach saturated performance on public ARC-AGI-3 games, our cognitive analyses motivate next-generation benchmarks that challenge familiar priors, require accumulated evidence and abstraction, and test planning through subgoals, experimentation, and recovery. Our dataset is available at [https://arc3-human-think-aloud.github.io/](https://arc3-human-think-aloud.github.io/).

    中文

    通过探索学习，并运用新获得的知识实现目标，是通用智能的核心能力。要理解这些能力，就需要追踪学习者如何在交互过程中构建、使用和修正世界模型。我们以 ARC-AGI-3 为测试平台，构建了首个记录人类如何发现并运用新环境机制的数据集：涵盖 25 款公开游戏、来自 64 名参与者的 144 条轨迹，每条轨迹都将时间同步的动作与出声思考音频配对；此外，还包括大语言模型（LLM）智能体在同一批游戏中使用和不使用工具框架的 250 条轨迹。我们标注机制的触发与识别、行动目的、错误及恢复情况，将理解的变化与支撑这些变化的观察和行动联系起来。我们分析人类认知特征，并与 LLM 智能体进行比较。两组都会预判机制，并使用熟悉的类比。在成功轨迹中，人类使用定性表征的比例高于成功的 LLM 轨迹（50.0% 对 14.3%）。与 LLM 智能体相比，人类更常在没有明确假设的情况下探索陌生情境，而假设检验在两组中都很常见。我们还追踪了学习者如何通过修正信念、重新规划和纠正执行来恢复。随着配备精心设计工具框架的 LLM 在公开 ARC-AGI-3 游戏中达到性能饱和，我们的认知分析促使我们设计新一代基准：挑战熟悉的先验知识，要求积累证据并进行抽象，同时通过子目标、实验和恢复来检验规划能力。我们的数据集见 [https://arc3-human-think-aloud.github.io/](https://arc3-human-think-aloud.github.io/)。

    SentryBench evaluates tool-using LLM agents with asymmetric costs, and the paper formalizes when cautious refusal increases harm and proposes a trust gate with measured deployment benefits.     SentryBench 使用非对称成本评估工具调用型 LLM 智能体；论文还形式化了谨慎拒绝如何增加危害，并提出了经过部署效果测量的信任门控机制。这项工作显著推进了智能体安全和工具使用评估；其与推理的关联仅限于对抗场景下的行为，而非推理机制或能力发展。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly wired to consequential tools that send public alerts, dispatch responders, and query citizen records, where one erroneous tool call carries real-world cost. Existing agent-safety benchmarks measure generic harm or prompt-injection success and implicitly treat refusing as the safe default. In public-safety deployments that assumption breaks: an agent too cautious to dispatch help fails as surely as one that triggers a false alert. We present SentryBench, which scores agents on a two-sided, cost-sensitive frontier jointly measuring attack success, over-refusal (missing a real emergency), and over-reaction (unwarranted action) under adversarial tool use, with scenarios grounded in real emergency-call transcripts, disaster messages, and real injection/jailbreak payloads. We formalize deployment harm as an asymmetric cost functional, prove naive caution is harm-dominated whenever it refuses more genuine emergencies than the attack harm it averts, and prove a targeted trust gate adds zero over-refusal on clean input. Across 840 scored episodes over three frontier models and three defenses, refuse-more caution drives over-refusal to 100 percent on two of three models for at most a 3.7-point change in attack success and yields the worst harm everywhere, whereas our trust-gating wrapper dominates the frontier (lowest harm on every model, over-refusal at or below baseline, higher containment). Provider content filters also silently perform part of the defending and must be reported separately.

    中文

    大语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越多地接入会发送公共警报、调度应急人员和查询公民记录的重要工具；一次错误的工具调用就可能造成现实代价。现有智能体安全基准衡量一般性危害或提示注入成功率，并隐含地将拒绝视为安全默认选项。在公共安全部署中，这一假设不成立：因过于谨慎而未能派遣援助的智能体，与触发虚假警报的智能体一样会造成失败。我们提出 SentryBench，它在一个双侧、成本敏感的前沿上对智能体进行评分，联合衡量对抗性工具使用场景下的攻击成功率、过度拒绝（漏掉真实紧急事件）和过度反应（采取不当行动）；场景基于真实的紧急呼叫记录、灾害信息以及真实的注入和越狱载荷。我们将部署危害形式化为非对称成本泛函，并证明：只要朴素谨慎所拒绝的真实紧急事件多于其避免的攻击危害，这种谨慎就会被危害支配；我们还证明，针对性的信任门控在干净输入上不会增加过度拒绝。在三个前沿模型和三种防御方法上评估的 840 个回合中，增加拒绝的谨慎策略使三分之二的模型过度拒绝率达到 100%，攻击成功率最多仅变化 3.7 个百分点，且在所有情况下危害最大；相比之下，我们的信任门控封装器在前沿上占优（每个模型上的危害最低、过度拒绝率不高于基线、遏制能力更强）。提供商的内容过滤器也会在不显眼的情况下承担部分防御作用，必须单独报告。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    STEP estimates answer correctness by tracking soft probability distributions across intermediate reasoning steps, and its temporal weighting is a main empirical contribution.     STEP 通过追踪中间推理步骤中的软概率分布来估计答案正确性，其时间加权是主要的实证贡献。这推进了推理评估，但没有解释推理机制如何运作；单凭轨迹结构与组合性的联系只是偶然的。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Estimating the correctness of large language model (LLM) predictions without access to ground truth is critical for reliable deployment in high-stakes settings. Existing approaches, such as entropy and perplexity, operate solely on final output statistics, discarding the rich information encoded in intermediate reasoning steps. To address this limitation, we propose STEP (Soft Trajectory Estimation of Prediction correctness), a training-free framework that scores each reasoning step via lightweight forward passes to obtain a soft probability distribution qi over candidate answers, from which we derive a set of soft trajectory features capturing per-step confidence and its progression toward the final answer. Extensive experiments on various benchmarks demonstrate consistent and substantial improvements, particularly in AUROC, over output-based baselines and hard-indicator trajectory methods. Notably, Temporally-Weighted Consistency, which assigns higher importance to later reasoning steps where answer distributions have stabilized, contributes the largest gains, highlighting the importance of temporal structure in reasoning trajectories. These results further validate the advantage of preserving continuous probability signals over binary discretization.

    Orel Navi, Elad Feldman, Ben Nassi

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The study documents how agents combine reachable web services to extend capabilities and evade restrictions, supported by an analysis of agent activity. This is strong evidence about agent system capabilities and tool use; service composition is relevant to CompGen, but the focus is capability extension rather than general compositional learning or reasoning.

    这项研究通过分析智能体活动，记录了智能体如何组合可访问的 Web 服务来扩展能力并规避限制。这为智能体系统能力和工具使用提供了有力证据；服务组合与 CompGen 有关，但研究重点是能力扩展，而非一般的组合学习或推理。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Autonomous agents have been observed acting beyond their assigned tasks, accessing unauthorized systems, and establishing communication channels to exchange information, yet the Web and network-level techniques they use to extend their capabilities and circumvent security restrictions remain poorly understood. We study these techniques through the ProWiki incident, in which agents restricted to outbound HTTP GET requests repurposed a public German-language wiki as a message board. We analyze 14,591 agent edits containing 79,541 URL postings and present corroborating evidence that the published URLs reflect the agents' operational activity. We find that 26,717 URL occurrences (33.6%) embed target URLs within one to five layers of third-party Web services. By recursively reconstructing these nested URLs, we identify 67 distinct intermediate services and classify their functionality. Most intermediate layers (73.8%) extend agents' capabilities by delegating content extraction and transformation to external Web services: Markdown and OCR services convert web content into machine-readable text, JSON filtering services extract selected fields, and archival services expose historical versions of pages. The remaining 26.2% facilitate circumvention of access restrictions and evasion of detection, including CORS and fetch proxies that retrieve content on agents' behalf, and link shorteners and redirectors that hide destination URLs from mechanisms inspecting literal URLs or outer hostnames. Agents also reach the same targets through multiple URL paths, consistent with attempts to evade rate limits or obscure request origins. Our results expose a gap between the capabilities granted to agents and those they can obtain by composing publicly available Web services: restricting an agent's local toolset or direct Internet access may be insufficient while third-party services remain reachable.

    中文

    已有观察发现，自主智能体会超出分配给它们的任务行事、访问未经授权的系统，并建立通信渠道来交换信息；然而，它们用于扩展自身能力并规避安全限制的 Web 和网络层技术仍未得到充分理解。我们通过 ProWiki 事件研究这些技术：在该事件中，受到仅允许发出 HTTP GET 请求限制的智能体，将一个公开的德语维基改作消息板。我们分析了 14,591 条智能体编辑，其中包含 79,541 个 URL 发布，并提供佐证，表明这些已发布的 URL 反映了智能体的实际运行活动。我们发现，有 26,717 次 URL 出现（33.6%）在一至五层第三方 Web 服务中嵌入了目标 URL。通过递归还原这些嵌套 URL，我们识别出 67 种不同的中间服务，并对其功能进行分类。大多数中间层（73.8%）通过将内容提取和转换委托给外部 Web 服务来扩展智能体能力：Markdown 和 OCR 服务将 Web 内容转换为机器可读文本，JSON 过滤服务提取选定字段，归档服务则提供页面的历史版本。其余 26.2% 的中间层有助于规避访问限制和逃避检测，包括代表智能体获取内容的 CORS 和 fetch 代理，以及会隐藏目标 URL、使检查字面 URL 或外层主机名的机制无法发现目的地的链接缩短服务和重定向器。智能体还会通过多条 URL 路径访问同一目标，这与规避速率限制或掩盖请求来源的尝试相符。我们的结果揭示了授予智能体的能力与它们通过组合公开可用的 Web 服务能够获得的能力之间存在差距：只要第三方服务仍可访问，限制智能体的本地工具集或直接互联网访问可能并不足够。

    Amirhossein Basareh, Rishabh Sanjay, Daniel de Mello, Abulhair Saparov

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper measures how transformer width and depth affect factual storage capacity, finding logarithmic width scaling and increased capacity when structured relations can be exploited. This substantially advances understanding of knowledge storage, with limited relevance to composition through its two-hop and symmetric-relation experiments; it does not primarily study reasoning or system organization.

    本文测量了 Transformer 的宽度和深度如何影响事实存储容量，发现宽度呈对数尺度规律，并且在能够利用结构化关系时容量会提高。这显著推进了对知识存储的理解；通过两跳和对称关系实验，它与组合性有一定关联，但并非主要研究推理或系统组织。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    How efficiently can transformers store factual knowledge? The answer to this question has implications for both model design and understanding the limits of transformer-based systems. Prior studies observe a linear relationship between the number of facts memorized and the number of model parameters required, substantially worse than what theoretical analyses predict is achievable. We re-examine empirical scaling: through rigorous and systematic experiments, including extensive hyperparameter search via Bayesian optimization, we determine the smallest model that can perfectly memorize a given set of facts, and measure how this minimum size scales with the number of facts. On synthetic datasets of random, independent (subject, relation, object) triples---e.g., (Paris, capital_of, France) ---drawn at random with no exploitable structure, we find that memorization capacity, the size of the largest dataset that a model memorizes completely, grows exponentially with the transformer dimension. Equivalently, the minimum transformer dimension $d_{\min}$ required to memorize $N$ facts grows logarithmically in $N$. Across 11 dataset sizes spanning $N = 45$ to $49{,}920$, a lack-of-fit F-test does not reject the logarithmic fit (with an offset), but it does reject all other tested alternatives including power-law. Along the depth axis, however, at fixed width, the maximum memorizable dataset size grows sublinearly with the number of layers over the measured range. We further extend our exploration to structured data containing symmetric relations or two-hop composition. In this setting, we find that transformers exploit these regularities to further improve capacity. All code to reproduce our results is available at https://github.com/Magronox/transformer_information_capacity.

    Transformer 存储事实知识的效率有多高？这个问题的答案对模型设计以及理解基于 Transformer 的系统的局限性都有影响。先前研究观察到，记忆事实的数量与所需模型参数数量呈线性关系，这远低于理论分析所预测的可实现水平。我们重新考察经验尺度规律：通过严格且系统的实验，包括利用贝叶斯优化进行大规模超参数搜索，我们确定能够完美记忆给定事实集的最小模型，并测量这个最小规模如何随事实数量变化。在由随机、相互独立的（主体、关系、客体）三元组构成的合成数据集上——例如 (Paris, capital_of, France)——这些三元组是随机抽取的，不含可利用的结构；我们发现，记忆容量（即模型能够完全记忆的最大数据集规模）随 Transformer 维度呈指数增长。等价地，记忆 $d_{\min}$ 个事实所需的最小 Transformer 维度 $N$ 随 $N$ 呈对数增长。在涵盖从 $N = 45$ 到 $49{,}920$ 的 11 种数据集规模上，拟合优度不足 F 检验不会拒绝带偏移项的对数拟合，但会拒绝所有其他受测替代模型，包括幂律模型。然而，在深度维度上，宽度固定时，可记忆数据集的最大规模在所测范围内随层数呈次线性增长。我们还将研究扩展到包含对称关系或两跳组合的结构化数据。在这种情形下，我们发现 Transformer 会利用这些规律性来进一步提升容量。复现我们结果的所有代码均可在 https://github.com/Magronox/transformer_information_capacity 获取。

    Adapting general-purpose vision-language models (VLMs) to medical visual question answering (VQA) is valuable for helping clinicians read images and make diagnoses, but annotated data are scarce and provide only short answers, without reasoning annotations. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) fits these labels but overfits to them and amplifies their biases, eroding out-of-domain (OOD) generalization. Reinforcement learning (RL) better preserves generalization but never uses the gold answer as a training target: GRPO-style algorithms learn from the contrast between correct and incorrect answers within a group of sampled responses, so all-correct or all-wrong groups give no correctness signal. Existing SFT-RL hybrids either apply SFT and RL in separate stages or switch between them per question, or need reasoning traces from experts or stronger models, which medical VQA data lack. We propose GRASP, which combines RL and SFT in every update using only short answers: RL lets the model explore its own reasoning, SFT teaches the gold answer after that reasoning to supply the direct supervision RL lacks, and their balance adapts to how well the model answers each question. Tuning only about 1% of the parameters with LoRA, GRASP outperforms all compared training objectives both in domain and on OOD open-ended questions across Qwen3-VL-8B, InternVL3-8B and Gemma 3-4B. On an OOD benchmark spanning eight imaging modalities, GRASP-trained InternVL3-8B and Qwen3-VL-8B beat all 10 compared general and medical VLMs in open-ended accuracy, including models trained on up to 2,600 times more data or with over 250 times more trainable parameters. We release MedTerse, a dataset of 12.9K short-answer questions, and our code at https://github.com/sea-comet/GRASP-MedVQA.

This paper presents ANASSA, a reference architecture integrating structured reasoning, multi-agent workflow orchestration, authoritative spatial grounding, and feedback-driven execution, and reports its instantiation in an operating supply-chain deployment. The architecture places typed data contracts at agent boundaries, validates spatial claims against a certified authoritative foundation, and enforces two blocking human-in-the-loop approvals inside a six-step cognitive loop. The deployment covers multi-hazard risk assessment on an ocean-and-inland freight lane, including cold-chain excursion detection over container telemetry. Across a three-month proof of concept (POC) with three implementation iterations, three deployment outcomes are reported: 25% improvement in data quality, 50% reduction in spatial workflow runtime, and 60% lower decision latency relative to the preceding manual workflow. Absolute deployment-scale quantities and baseline counts are confidential; reported percentages are observed relative changes. These are uncontrolled deployment observations, not controlled experiments. We therefore specify instrumentation and ablation protocols for mechanism-level evaluation.

    工业空间决策需要整合来自多个系统的信息，而这些系统既不共享参考框架，也不归同一方所有；分析人员因此花费大量精力协调这些系统，而非推理空间问题。本文提出 ANASSA，这是一种融合结构化推理、多智能体工作流编排、权威空间定位和反馈驱动执行的参考架构，并报告了其在实际运行的供应链部署中的实现。该架构在智能体边界设置类型化数据契约，根据经过认证的权威基础数据验证空间主张，并在一个六步认知循环中设置两个必须通过的人工审批环节。该部署涵盖海运和内陆货运线路上的多灾害风险评估，包括基于集装箱遥测数据的冷链偏离检测。在历时三个月、经过三轮实施迭代的概念验证（POC）中，报告了三项部署结果：数据质量提高 25%，空间工作流运行时间缩短 50%，与此前的人工工作流相比，决策延迟降低 60%。部署规模的绝对数量和基线计数属于机密；报告的百分比是观察到的相对变化。这些是未经控制的部署观察，并非受控实验。因此，我们提出了用于机制层面评估的仪器化和消融方案。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Agent harnesses enable large language models to act through tools, observe the results, and iteratively work toward a task goal. Verification checks and revises agents' work to improve output quality. Yet there is limited guidance on how harnesses should organize this effort. We study verification as an axis of test-time scaling by examining when to intervene, who checks the work, and how checking leads to revision. Our framework spans four layers of the agent lifecycle: initial instructions, mid-turn reminders, completion gates, and independent review. We compare 17 designs across seven frontier coding models on Terminal-Bench (TB) and SWE-bench Verified (SWE), and introduce VisualBench for expert evaluation of visual and interactive artifacts. Initial instructions and execution-time reminders yield modest, model-dependent average gains on the coding benchmarks, without substantially increasing average output token use. Completion gates can yield larger gains but may substantially increase cost. Independent review by a critic offers a more favorable accuracy-cost tradeoff, improving average accuracy by 5.9-9.5 percentage points on TB and 3.9-6.6 on SWE at 1.13-1.25 and 1.00-1.04 times baseline cost, respectively. On VisualBench, independent review achieves net preferences of 13.2-23.8 points over the baseline across its four designs, exceeding the evaluated L0-L2 designs. Additional review rounds or independent critics further improve average TB accuracy by up to 3.5 percentage points. Together, these results provide empirical guidance for verification design in agent harnesses and support independent review as a practical axis of test-time scaling.

    智能体框架使大型语言模型能够通过工具采取行动、观察结果，并逐步朝任务目标推进。验证会检查并修订智能体的工作，以提高输出质量。然而，对于框架应如何组织这项工作，目前可参考的指导有限。我们将验证作为测试时扩展的一个维度来研究，考察何时介入、由谁检查工作，以及检查如何促成修订。我们的框架涵盖智能体生命周期的四个层次：初始指令、轮次中途提醒、完成门控和独立审查。我们在 Terminal-Bench (TB) 和 SWE-bench Verified (SWE) 上，针对七个前沿编码模型比较了 17 种设计，并引入 VisualBench，用于专家评估视觉和交互式产物。初始指令和执行期间的提醒在编码基准上带来了幅度有限且因模型而异的平均提升，平均输出 token 用量没有显著增加。完成门控可能带来更大提升，但也可能显著增加成本。批评者进行独立审查可提供更有利的准确率与成本权衡：在 TB 上，平均准确率提高 5.9–9.5 个百分点，成本为基线的 1.13–1.25 倍；在 SWE 上，平均准确率提高 3.9–6.6 个百分点，成本为基线的 1.00–1.04 倍。在 VisualBench 上，独立审查的四种设计相较基线实现了 13.2–23.8 个百分点的净偏好度，超过了受测的 L0-L2 设计。增加审查轮次或使用独立批评者，可进一步将 TB 的平均准确率提高最多 3.5 个百分点。总体而言，这些结果为智能体框架中的验证设计提供了经验指导，并支持将独立审查作为实用的测试时扩展维度。

    The paper reports design choices, ablations, and practical limits for training and deploying small sparse MoE and multimodal model families, including an agent variant and CPU inference.     本文报告了训练和部署小型稀疏 MoE 及多模态模型系列的设计选择、消融结果和实际限制，其中包括一个智能体变体和 CPU 推理。其路由与部署工作与模型计算和系统密切相关，但并未研究内部表征、组合泛化或推理。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    We describe HobbyLM, a family of small sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models trained from scratch with a few hundred to a few thousand dollars of rented GPU time. The core is a decoder-only transformer with fine-grained experts, sigmoid routing with auxiliary-loss-free load balancing, grouped-query attention with per-head QK-normalization, and aMuon/AdamW optimizer split. Each of these choices was selected with a single-variable ablation suite at 130M parameters. On this architecture we train a 500M-parameter model (169M active) on 40B FineWeb tokens and post-train it into a chat model, a masked-diffusion language model, a function-calling and computer-use agent, and a single "omni" checkpoint that reads text, images, video, sound and speech through frozen encoders and small projectors. We run these models on a laptop CPU with a from-scratch Rust inference engine. Two of the authors then adopted the architecture without architectural changes to build HobbyLM-1B (1.04B total, 305M active parameters), trained on a 100B-token curated mixture with a high-quality anneal. HobbyLM-1B reaches a 47.5 average on seven zero-shot benchmarks, and its builders also release an instruction-tuned model and an on-device macOS computer-use adapter. Finally, we describe HobbyLM-Image, a 333M-parameter flow-matching diffusion transformer that generates 1024x1024 images in a 32x-compressed latent space, together with a dependency-light CPU implementation of the full text-to-image pipeline. We report what worked, what did not, and where the small-scale ceilings lie. We also state for each component which author designed or built it.

    中文

    我们介绍 HobbyLM，这是一个小型稀疏混合专家（MoE）模型系列，使用数百至数千美元租用 GPU 的费用从头训练而成。其核心是一个仅含解码器的 Transformer，采用细粒度专家、带无辅助损失负载均衡的 sigmoid 路由、带逐头 QK 归一化的分组查询注意力，以及 aMuon/AdamW 优化器拆分方案。在 130M 参数规模下，我们通过单变量消融套件选择了上述每项设计。基于这一架构，我们在 40B 个 FineWeb token 上训练了一个 500M 参数模型（169M 激活参数），并通过后训练将其制作为聊天模型、掩码扩散语言模型、函数调用和计算机使用智能体，以及一个单一的“全能”检查点；该检查点通过冻结编码器和小型投影器读取文本、图像、视频、声音和语音。我们使用从头编写的 Rust 推理引擎，在笔记本电脑 CPU 上运行这些模型。随后，两位作者在不改变架构的情况下采用该架构构建 HobbyLM-1B（总计 1.04B 参数，305M 激活参数），并在 100B token 的精选混合数据上训练，最后进行高质量退火。HobbyLM-1B 在七项零样本基准上的平均分达到 47.5；其构建者还发布了一个指令微调模型和一个设备端 macOS 计算机使用适配器。最后，我们介绍 HobbyLM-Image，这是一个 333M 参数的流匹配扩散 Transformer，能在压缩 32 倍的潜在空间中生成 1024x1024 图像；同时还提供了依赖精简的完整文本到图像流水线 CPU 实现。我们报告哪些做法有效、哪些无效，以及小规模模型的能力上限在哪里。我们还说明每个组件由哪位作者设计或构建。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    CodeMeepo contributes an orchestrated multi-agent workflow for repository migration, using external evaluation, staged tasks, regression checks, and deterministic repair control. Its modular workflow has incidental relevance to composition and reasoning, but the abstract focuses on engineering performance rather than transferable insights into those areas.

    CodeMeepo 提出了一种用于仓库迁移的编排式多智能体工作流，采用外部评估、分阶段任务、回归检查和确定性修复控制。其模块化工作流与组合性和推理有一定的偶然关联，但摘要关注的是工程性能，而非这些领域中可迁移的见解。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Repository-level code migration rewrites an entire project in a new programming language while preserving its observable behavior. It is challenging because behavior spans interdependent modules, dependencies and build infrastructure must be adapted to the target ecosystem, and the source code is often the only specification. Large language model agents can now attempt these migrations end to end, but three challenges remain. First, an agent that writes both the translation and its acceptance tests may overlook the same requirements in both, leaving missing or incorrect behavior undetected. Second, large repositories can exceed a model's context window, and dividing the work into smaller tasks does not ensure that all required behavior is migrated. Third, even behaviorally correct translations may be slower than the original implementation. We present CodeMeepo, a multi-agent pipeline for complete and efficient migration of large repositories. Each milestone is evaluated against a fixed external oracle that the agents neither author nor modify. A separate parity assessment compares source and target components in scope and adds identified gaps back into the plan as required work. Ordered milestones limit the scope of each task, while cumulative regression checks guard against breaking already-migrated behavior. A benchmark-guided optimization phase addresses performance, followed by full-suite conformance testing and repair. Eight specialized agent roles communicate through file artifacts, and a deterministic state machine governs repair, deferral, scope changes, and termination. On nine subjects in three language pairs, CodeMeepo achieves the best pass rate on every subject and passes 18% more tests than a state-of-the-art multi-agent baseline using the same model. On a production daemon, its optimization phase improves half of the benchmarks, by 25% on average.

    中文

    仓库级代码迁移是指将整个项目改写为新的编程语言，同时保留其可观察行为。这项工作很有挑战性，因为行为横跨相互依赖的模块，依赖项和构建基础设施必须适配目标生态系统，而且源代码往往是唯一的规范。 大型语言模型智能体现在能够端到端尝试此类迁移，但仍存在三个挑战。第一，若智能体同时编写转换代码和验收测试，可能会在两者中遗漏相同的要求，导致行为缺失或错误未被发现。第二，大型仓库可能超出模型的上下文窗口，而将工作拆分为较小任务并不能保证迁移所有必需行为。第三，即使转换后的代码在行为上正确，速度也可能慢于原始实现。 我们提出 CodeMeepo，这是一个用于完整、高效迁移大型仓库的多智能体流水线。每个里程碑都根据固定的外部预言机进行评估，智能体既不编写也不修改该预言机。单独的等价性评估会比较纳入范围的源代码和目标代码组件，并将发现的差距作为必需工作补回计划中。按顺序排列的里程碑限制每项任务的范围，而累积回归检查则防止破坏已经迁移的行为。随后，基准测试引导的优化阶段处理性能问题，接着进行全套一致性测试和修复。八种专门化智能体角色通过文件产物进行通信，并由确定性状态机管理修复、延期、范围变更和终止。 在三个语言对的九个测试对象上，CodeMeepo 在每个对象上都取得了最高通过率；与使用同一模型的最先进多智能体基线相比，它通过的测试多 18%。在一个生产级守护进程上，其优化阶段改善了一半的基准测试，平均提升 25%。

However, existing benchmarks largely evaluate isolated capabilities, failing to capture the complexity of open-world robot autonomy. We introduce RobotAgentBench (RAB), a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating robot agents in realistic, open-world household environments. Through an agent-assisted, human-in-the-loop real-to-sim pipeline, RAB constructs 50 diverse household layouts with interactive objects and physically grounded tasks, encompassing 90 atomic tasks, 18 short-horizon tasks, 8 long-horizon tasks, and 4 open-ended scenarios. RAB provides a multi-level evaluation of robot agent capabilities: (1) task-level assessments systematically examine five complementary dimensions: task discovery, context reasoning, manipulation, failure recovery, and robustness; (2) scenario-level evaluation assesses how agents integrate these capabilities to autonomously fulfill high-level user needs. Furthermore, RAB enables systematic comparisons of standalone VLA/WAM models and diverse robot agent architectures under a unified planning-execution-verification framework. Extensive experiments reveal substantial gaps between manipulation and autonomy, demonstrate the advantages of agentic architectures and recursive self-improvement, and highlight the remaining challenges toward open-world robot autonomy.

    梦境助力：用于共享车辆控制的意图条件化世界模型

    Jonathan DeCastro, Thomas Balch, Emily Sumner, Deepak Gopinath, Laporsha Dees, Patricio Reyes Gomez, Elliot Weiss, Megan Applegate-Kenton, Todd Rowell, John Leonard, Avinash Balachandran, Guy Rosman

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Dream2Assist combines intent inference in a recurrent world model with model-based control and human studies, showing improved torque alignment and collision rates in shared driving. Its main contribution is an assistive agent system; intent conditioning alone does not establish a contribution to compositional generalization or mechanistic interpretability.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Assistive agents in shared-control settings face a dual challenge: acting proactively to align with the human's intentions while remaining legible enough for the human to comprehend and fluently respond in real time. We present Dream2Assist, a model-based reinforcement learning framework for tightly-coupled shared decision making that addresses both sides of this challenge. Our approach extends a recurrent state-space world model with intent inference, enabling an assistive policy trained via fictitious co-play to anticipate and support discrete human objectives without overriding human agency. Beyond the computational framework, we describe the full deployment pipeline needed to translate a world-model-based policy into a safe, human-centered system in a resource-efficient way. Crucially, we address the sim-to-real-human gap via policy down-selection and reward restructuring within an iterative human-machine interface design. We validate the framework through three human-subjects studies and a preliminary on-vehicle deployment spanning two qualitatively distinct domains: high-speed racing (N=30) and urban driving with richer intent structure (N=10). Our results demonstrate that intent conditioning yields measurable improvements in torque alignment and collision rate. We surface key design insights and practices for deploying learning-based assistive agents in safety-critical, real-time human-robot teaming.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper contributes earliest-actionable-point supervision and a model that decides when to call tools while speech is still arriving, a substantial advance in spoken agent behavior. Disjoint argument values provide limited evidence about generalization, but the abstract does not center compositional structure or reasoning mechanisms.

    该论文提出了最早可执行点监督，并构建了一个能在语音仍持续到来时判断何时调用工具的模型，这是口语智能体行为的一项实质性进展。参数取值互不重叠为泛化能力提供的证据有限，但摘要并未以组合结构或推理机制为核心。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Latency-sensitive spoken agents must know not only which tool to call, but also when they have heard enough to act. Waiting for the turn to complete delays execution even when the request is already actionable. However, neither existing spoken agents nor spoken dialogue corpora define the earliest point at which a request becomes actionable. We introduce a synthetic spoken-dialogue pipeline that provides earliest-actionable-point supervision, marking when the observed speech grounds a tool and its required arguments. Through controlled task generation, speech synthesis and alignment, and gated annotation, we construct 26,694 dialogues totaling 786 hours across 48 domains, with disjoint training and test argument values. We additionally create an audio rendering of $\tau^2$-bench for external evaluation. We train an omni-modal language model on this corpus, enabling causal, chunk-level decisions and partial-transcript generation for downstream call completion. The model achieves tool-state macro-F1 scores of 0.48 and 0.47 on held-out dialogues and the external benchmark, respectively. For correct calls, the estimated mean lead over a turn-end cascade, using the same formatter, is 1.8-2.0 seconds in-domain and 1.1 seconds on $\tau^2$-bench. These results demonstrate a data-driven path toward spoken agents that act while listening. We will open-source the pipeline and the training scripts.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Thinking-in-Bets introduces a test-time procedure for preserving checked claims, revisiting uncertain ones, and reducing sycophantic reversals, directly advancing agent reasoning and verification. Its private claim record is a useful agent-state mechanism, but the contribution is not primarily about system architecture or persistent memory.

    Thinking-in-Bets 提出了一种测试时流程，用于保留已检查的主张、重新审视不确定之处并减少迎合性改判，直接推进了智能体推理与验证。它的私密主张记录是一种有用的智能体状态机制，但其贡献主要不在系统架构或持久记忆方面。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Language model agents often abandon correct work when a user challenges it, yet simply telling them to stand firm makes them ignore real mistakes. Once an agent reads a complaint, it tends to discount its own earlier checks in order to agree with the user. We introduce Thinking-in-Bets, a training-free method in which an agent writes a short private record of its main claims, the checks supporting them, and its confidence before reading user feedback. When challenged, the agent consults this Claim Checklist to keep verified work intact while investigating uncertain or newly challenged parts. We evaluate five Gemini models (3.5 Flash-Lite, 3.5 Flash, 3.6 Flash, 3.8 Flash, and 4.0 Argon) across eight benchmarks: SWE-Together, SWE-Interact, and DeepSWE for software engineering, Agents' Last Exam for professional reports, Humanity's Last Exam and SycEval for academic reasoning, Vals Finance for financial analysis, and Terminal-Bench for command-line tasks. Recording claims before criticism nearly eliminates false reversals in patch review and protects passing report drafts under mistaken pushback, whereas writing the same record after reading the complaint recovers very little of the gain. In multi-turn coding, pre-reply claim records substantially reduce unnecessary file edits after mistaken complaints, and gating the record so it is written only when the agent is uncertain lowers token overhead while fixing more real bugs than the baseline. Even in non-interactive tasks without user feedback, listing the key claims in a draft and re-checking the weakest one before submission improves both answer accuracy and confidence estimates across all tested models.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper’s main contribution is showing that temporal objectives create predictable latent geometry while preserving pixel accuracy, improving world-model rollout quality and efficiency. This provides substantial insight into learned representations, while its inference-efficiency gains are a secondary systems contribution; it does not focus on composition or reasoning.

    本文的主要贡献是表明，时间目标能够在保持像素精度的同时形成可预测的潜在几何结构，从而提升世界模型展开质量和效率。这为理解所学表征提供了重要见解，而推理效率提升则是次要的系统贡献；本文并不侧重组合或推理。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Video world models trained on large-scale robot data promise a safe and scalable approach for learning and evaluating policies that act in the physical world. However, they still struggle with long-horizon rollouts and out-of-distribution generalization, and they remain computationally demanding at inference time. Typically, video world models make predictions in the latent space of a reconstruction-trained autoencoder, which however is not directly optimized for dynamics modeling. On the other hand, world models designed for latent planning usually optimize latents to be predictable, but they forgo accurate prediction of observations in pixel space. In this paper, we show that it is possible to achieve the best of both worlds: a latent geometry optimized to make future prediction as simple as possible without sacrificing accurate prediction of future observations. More precisely, we find that temporal objectives for representation learning, paired with a past-conditioned decoder architecture, lead to consistent improvements in generative video world models at the same training budget. The gains include up to 5x cheaper inference, over 7x faster training, and 15-24% lower pixel and perceptual errors out of distribution and over long horizons. Our world models also agree more closely with real-world policy evaluation when using a vision-language model to judge task success from their pixel-space predictions. Overall, our study indicates that temporal predictability is an important design criterion for the latent space of video world models, and provides concrete guidance on how to incorporate it into the training of autoencoders.

    中文

    在大规模机器人数据上训练的视频世界模型，有望为学习和评估在物理世界中行动的策略提供一种安全且可扩展的方法。然而，它们在长时程展开和分布外泛化方面仍表现不佳，而且推理时计算开销仍然很大。通常，视频世界模型会在经重建训练的自编码器潜空间中进行预测，但该空间并未针对动力学建模直接优化。另一方面，为潜空间规划设计的世界模型通常会将潜变量优化为可预测的形式，却放弃了对像素空间观测的准确预测。本文表明，两全其美是可以实现的：优化潜在几何结构，使未来预测尽可能简单，同时不牺牲对未来观测的准确预测。具体而言，我们发现，将时间目标用于表征学习，并配合以过去为条件的解码器架构，能够在相同训练预算下稳定提升生成式视频世界模型的表现。这些提升包括：推理成本最高降低至原来的五分之一、训练速度提高七倍以上，以及在分布外和长时程场景中像素误差与感知误差降低 15–24%。当使用视觉—语言模型根据模型在像素空间中的预测判断任务是否成功时，我们的世界模型对真实世界策略评估结果的吻合程度也更高。总体而言，我们的研究表明，时间可预测性是视频世界模型潜空间的一项重要设计标准，并为如何将其纳入自编码器训练提供了具体指导。

    Paola Rizzo and Hector Munoz-Avila and David W. Aha

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper presents an HTN-based agent architecture that uses planning across the goal lifecycle, including formulating goals and adapting when outcomes differ from expectations. This substantially advances agent planning and organization, with a partial connection to composition through hierarchical task refinement; it does not study model internals.

    本文提出一种基于 HTN 的智能体架构，在整个目标生命周期中运用规划，包括制定目标，以及在结果偏离预期时进行调整。这实质性地推进了智能体规划与组织，并通过分层任务细化与组合有一定关联；但本文不研究模型内部机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Goal reasoning (GR) is the process by which intelligent agents continually reason about the goals they are pursuing, which may lead to goal change, for instance when opportunities arise, or when events cause discrepancies among expected and actual outcomes of actions planned to achieve goals. In this paper we investigate whether Hierarchical Task Network (HTN) planning can provide a uniform implementation of the Goal Lifecycle, a flexible process model for goal reasoning in dynamic environments. The Goal Lifecycle progressively refines goals by adding constraints to them through a series of strategies (e.g., {\it formulate, select, expand}) and uses other strategies (e.g., {\it defer, re-expand, repair}) to resolve the current goal when an event impacts it. We present a novel GR agent architecture that employs HTN planning in this Goal Lifecycle. In addition to using HTN planning for the \textit{expand} and \textit{re-expand} strategies, as is frequently done in GR and planning research, we also use it in the \textit{formulate} strategy, to obtain a uniform planning approach that provides several benefits (e.g., the possibility to formulate new goals in view of achieving higher level overarching goals). We also explain how we use an enhanced HTN action representation to process discrepancies among expected and actual action outcomes that can trigger the transition from one goal to another. Finally, we empirically demonstrate that our GR architecture enables simulated autonomous vehicles to adaptively conduct missions in dynamic environments.

    目标推理（GR）是智能体持续对其正在追求的目标进行推理的过程；例如，当出现机会，或事件导致为实现目标而规划的行动之预期结果与实际结果之间出现偏差时，目标推理可能引发目标变更。本文探讨分层任务网络（HTN）规划能否为“目标生命周期”提供一种统一实现；目标生命周期是一种适用于动态环境中目标推理的灵活过程模型。目标生命周期通过一系列策略（例如，{\it formulate, select, expand}）逐步细化目标，为其添加约束；当事件影响当前目标时，则通过其他策略（例如，{\it defer, re-expand, repair}）处理该目标。我们提出一种新颖的 GR 智能体架构，在这一目标生命周期中采用 HTN 规划。除像目标推理和规划研究中常见的那样，将 HTN 规划用于 \textit{expand} 和 \textit{re-expand} 策略外，我们还将其用于 \textit{formulate} 策略，从而形成统一的规划方法，并带来多项好处（例如，可以为实现更高层的总体目标而制定新目标）。我们还说明了如何使用增强型 HTN 行动表征来处理预期与实际行动结果之间的偏差，这些偏差可能触发从一个目标转向另一个目标。最后，我们通过实验证明，我们的 GR 架构使仿真自主车辆能够在动态环境中自适应地执行任务。

    Hierarchical task knowledge enables efficient problem solving by allowing previously acquired skills to be reused across tasks and problem instances. In this paper, we investigate curriculum-guided acquisition of hierarchical task knowledge in an HTN learning framework. We compare three approaches: online learning during problem solving, human-designed curricula, and an automated curriculum generation procedure that derives learning experiences from verified LLM-generated solution traces. The proposed procedure solves small training problems with an LLM, extracts task accomplishment information, and transforms it into ordered sequences of state-task learning problems for HTN method acquisition. We evaluate the three approaches across multiple planning domains.     Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper studies how architecture, training, and task affect temporal trajectories in visual representation space, finding when straightness improves stability and robustness and when it does not. This is a substantial contribution to representation geometry, with no substantive focus on composition, reasoning, or model-system organization.

    本文研究架构、训练和任务如何影响视觉表征空间中的时间轨迹，并发现直线性在何种情况下能提升稳定性和鲁棒性、何种情况下不能。这对表征几何作出了重要贡献，但并未实质性地关注组合、推理或模型系统组织。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Humans have been shown to use a "straightened" encoding to represent the natural visual world as it evolves in time (H\'enaff et al. 2019). In the context of discrete video sequences, "straightened" means that changes between frames follow a more linear path in representation space at progressively deeper levels of processing. While deep convolutional networks are often proposed as models of human visual processing, many do not straighten natural videos. In this paper, we explore the relationship between network architecture, differing types of robustness, biologically-inspired filtering mechanisms, and representational straightness in response to time-varying input; we identify strengths and limitations of straightness as a useful way of evaluating neural network representations. We find that (1) adversarial training leads to straighter representations in both CNN and transformer-based architectures but (2) this effect is task-dependent, not generalizing to tasks such as segmentation and frame-prediction, where straight representations are not favorable for predictions; and nor to other types of robustness. In addition, (3) straighter representations impart temporal stability to class predictions, even for out-of-distribution data. Finally, (4) biologically-inspired elements increase straightness in the early stages of a network, but do not guarantee increased straightness in downstream layers of CNNs. We show that straightness is an easily computed measure of representational robustness and stability, as well as a hallmark of human representations with benefits for computer vision models.

    中文

    研究表明，人类会使用一种“拉直”的编码来表征随时间演变的自然视觉世界（H\'enaff et al. 2019）。在离散视频序列中，“拉直”是指随着处理层级逐渐加深，帧与帧之间的变化在表征空间中沿着更线性的路径前进。尽管深度卷积网络常被视为人类视觉处理的模型，但许多网络并不会将自然视频拉直。本文探索了网络架构、不同类型的鲁棒性、受生物学启发的滤波机制，以及面对时变输入时表征直线性之间的关系；我们还指出了将直线性作为评估神经网络表征的方法时的优势与局限。我们发现：（1）对抗训练会使 CNN 和基于 transformer 的架构都产生更直的表征；但是，（2）这一效果取决于任务，在分割和帧预测等直线表征不利于预测的任务上无法泛化；对其他类型的鲁棒性也无法泛化。此外，（3）更直的表征会使类别预测具有时间稳定性，即使面对分布外数据也是如此。最后，（4）受生物学启发的组件会提高网络早期阶段的直线性，但并不能保证 CNN 下游层的直线性也随之提高。我们表明，直线性是一种易于计算的表征鲁棒性和稳定性度量，也是人类表征的一个标志，可为计算机视觉模型带来益处。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    AT-AT learns to improve shared agent tools from execution traces, with evidence of better task performance and lower cost or error rates. The agent-system connection is strong, but the abstract describes tool-environment optimization rather than advances to reasoning mechanisms or model internals.

    AT-AT 从执行轨迹中学习如何改进智能体共享工具，并有证据表明它能提升任务表现、降低成本或错误率。它与智能体系统的联系很强，但摘要描述的是工具环境优化，而非推理机制或模型内部结构的进展。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Efforts to improve LLM-based agents typically focus on modifying the agent itself, yet success also depends on the environment in which an agent acts. Tools mediate this interaction: a tool's description shapes how an agent calls it, and its implementation determines the results and errors the agent receives afterwards. Many tools, such as APIs and MCP servers, are shared by many agents and maintained by providers who cannot change those agents. We introduce AT-AT (Automatic Tool Optimization from Agent Traces), an agentic tool optimizer that improves a shared toolset offline from historical agent executions while holding the agents fixed. A lightweight coding agent reads agent trajectories and their evaluation results, and selectively edits tool descriptions and, when permitted, implementations. On $\tau^2$-bench-verified, AT-AT achieves the highest task completion rates in the Airline and Telecom domains at lower cost than strong prompt- and tool-optimizer baselines, and its Telecom gain is statistically significant under paired permutation tests. Optimizing the tools within a coding agent harness also improves held-out performance on TerminalBench-2 and TBLite. When applied to three production MCP servers at a large enterprise, AT-AT lowered cost or tool error rates on every server and increased held-out task passes on one. By turning accumulated execution traces into updates to shared tool environments, AT-AT provides a path toward continual improvement of agent systems through environment-side learning.

    提升基于 LLM 的智能体的工作通常侧重于修改智能体本身，但成功与否也取决于智能体行动所处的环境。工具在这种交互中起到中介作用：工具描述会影响智能体如何调用工具，而工具实现则决定智能体随后收到的结果和错误。许多工具（如 API 和 MCP 服务器）由许多智能体共享，并由无法修改这些智能体的提供方维护。我们提出 AT-AT（从智能体轨迹中自动优化工具），这是一种智能体式工具优化器，可在保持智能体不变的情况下，利用历史智能体执行记录离线改进共享工具集。一个轻量级编码智能体读取智能体轨迹及其评估结果，并有选择地编辑工具描述，以及在获准时编辑工具实现。在 $\tau^2$-bench-verified 上，AT-AT 在 Airline 和 Telecom 领域取得了最高的任务完成率，成本低于强大的提示词优化器和工具优化器基线；其在 Telecom 领域的提升在配对置换检验下具有统计显著性。在编码智能体框架中优化工具，也提升了模型在 TerminalBench-2 和 TBLite 上的留出性能。将 AT-AT 应用于一家大型企业的三个生产级 MCP 服务器后，每个服务器的成本或工具错误率都降低了，其中一个服务器的留出任务通过数也有所增加。AT-AT 将累积的执行轨迹转化为共享工具环境的更新，为通过环境侧学习持续改进智能体系统提供了一条途径。

    何时证据已足够：采用 Horn 闭包证书的需求导向搜索

    Xinyu Zhang, Weiwei Sun

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Certify decomposes questions into jointly required facts and uses Horn closure to produce evidence sufficiency certificates or identify gaps; experiments show improved decisions and answer accuracy. Structural composition of facts is a substantive but secondary connection, while evidence-based decision-making and search-augmented model behavior are central.

    Certify 将问题分解为共同构成必要条件的事实，并利用 Horn 闭包生成证据充分性证书或识别证据缺口；实验表明，它能改善决策和答案准确度。事实的结构化组合构成了实质性但次要的联系，而基于证据的决策以及搜索增强模型的行为才是核心。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    After each Web search, a search-augmented model must decide whether its evidence suffices: answer, search again, or abstain. Prevailing systems leave this to holistic model judgement, which can accept a context naming every entity yet lacking one required fact. We instead make sufficiency structural: a per-query requirement hypergraph states which facts jointly yield another fact. This raises two challenges: deriving requirements from the question alone, and linking each requirement to passages about the right entity. Certify therefore decomposes the question, searches per requirement, and accepts links only after entity checks. Horn closure over the links yields a certificate, the minimal sufficient passages and their derivation, or an abstention naming open requirements. Given correct retrieval, requirements and links, the decision is sound, and complete up to the entity check. Pooled over three corpora with unanswerable twins, Certify decides significantly more accurately than search agents, graph retrieval and sufficiency judges in default configurations. On the same evidence, it matches a proprietary model's sufficiency label without an additional model call. Over 21M Wikipedia passages, entity checks add 4 to 13 points of decision accuracy where gold evidence exists. Finally, answers from its certificate are 80% correct, against 57% from all retrieved passages.

    中文

    每次 Web 搜索之后，搜索增强模型都必须判断现有证据是否足够：作答、再次搜索或弃答。主流系统将此留给模型进行整体判断，因此可能接受一个提及了所有实体、却缺少某项必要事实的上下文。我们转而以结构化方式定义充分性：针对每个查询的需求超图说明哪些事实共同推出另一事实。这带来两项挑战：仅从问题中推导需求，以及将每项需求关联到涉及正确实体的段落。因此，Certify 将问题分解，按需求分别搜索，并且仅在通过实体检查后才接受关联。对这些关联执行 Horn 闭包，可得出一份证书，即最小充分段落及其推导过程；若证据不足，则弃答并指出尚未满足的需求。在检索、需求识别和关联均正确的前提下，该决策是可靠的，并且除实体检查外具有完备性。在包含不可回答对应样本的三个语料库上汇总评测时，Certify 在默认配置下的决策准确度显著高于搜索智能体、图检索系统和充分性判别器。在相同证据上，它无需额外调用模型，就能匹配专有模型给出的充分性标签。在包含 21M 个 Wikipedia 段落的语料库上，当存在标准答案证据时，实体检查可将决策准确度提高 4 至 13 个百分点。最后，依据其证书生成的答案正确率为 80%，而依据所有检索段落生成的答案正确率为 57%。

    预取引导路由：面向卸载式混合专家解码的确定性缓存感知专家选择

    Siming Huang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper proposes deterministic cache-aware routing for offloaded MoE decoding and measures its speed and quality tradeoffs across models and workloads. This is a substantial algorithmic contribution to conditional computation and model systems; MoE terminology alone does not establish insight into internal representations, composition, or reasoning.

    本文提出面向卸载式 MoE 解码的确定性缓存感知路由，并在多个模型和工作负载上衡量其速度与质量之间的权衡。这是对条件计算和模型系统的重要算法贡献；仅出现 MoE 术语并不能证明论文深入探讨了内部表征、组合或推理。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    When a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model does not fit in GPU memory, batch-1 decoding is dominated by copying expert weights from host memory. Cache-aware routing reduces these copies by biasing the router toward resident experts, but combined with asynchronous prefetching it makes the model's outputs depend on transfer timing, so a harness that does not simulate that timing no longer evaluates the deployed model. We propose prefetch-steered routing (PSR): routing conditions on a deterministic logical cache, into which at most n experts predicted by the next layer's router are inserted per layer and token; physical copies affect only latency. On OLMoE-1B-7B with 50% and 25% of experts resident on an RTX 4090, PSR decodes 2.2-2.3x faster than exact routing with LRU and 25-30% faster than the Cache-Prior operating point, with mean benchmark differences of +0.1 and +0.5 points (95% lower bounds -0.8 and -0.3). In greedy generation its lead over Cache-Prior depends on the workload and reverses on HumanEval at 50% residency. On Moonlight-16B-A3B, PSR is 1.9x faster than exact routing with LRU at 37.5% residency and, at the latency of Cache-Prior, significantly better on three of eight benchmarks. On Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, where copies are cheap relative to computation, PSR keeps its advantage over Cache-Prior on the likelihood benchmarks but not its speed. Distillation-trained gates did not help. Speculative decoding with block-level expert selection was slower than PSR with a 1B autoregressive drafter on OLMoE, but with a block drafter on Qwen3.6 it was 2.1-2.9x faster than any autoregressive configuration with at most its GPU memory on the 64 prompts we timed.

    中文

    当混合专家（MoE）模型无法装入 GPU 内存时，批量大小为 1 的解码主要耗时于从主机内存复制专家权重。缓存感知路由通过让路由器偏向驻留专家来减少这些复制操作，但与异步预取结合后，模型输出会取决于传输时序，因此不模拟该时序的测试框架将无法评估实际部署的模型。我们提出预取引导路由（PSR）：路由以一个确定性的逻辑缓存为条件；在每层每个 token 处理时，该缓存至多插入 n 个由下一层路由器预测的专家；物理复制只影响延迟。在 OLMoE-1B-7B 上，当 RTX 4090 中驻留 50% 和 25% 的专家时，PSR 的解码速度比采用 LRU 的精确路由快 2.2–2.3 倍，比 Cache-Prior 工作点快 25–30%；基准测试的平均分差分别为 +0.1 和 +0.5 分（95% 下界为 -0.8 和 -0.3）。在贪心生成中，PSR 相较 Cache-Prior 的领先幅度取决于工作负载；当驻留率为 50% 时，它在 HumanEval 上反而落后。在 Moonlight-16B-A3B 上，当驻留率为 37.5% 时，PSR 比采用 LRU 的精确路由快 1.9 倍；在与 Cache-Prior 相同的延迟下，它在八项基准中的三项上显著更优。在 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 上，由于相较于计算而言复制成本较低，PSR 在似然基准上仍优于 Cache-Prior，但速度优势不再存在。蒸馏训练的门控没有带来收益。在 OLMoE 上，采用块级专家选择的推测解码速度慢于搭配 1B 自回归草稿模型的 PSR；但在 Qwen3.6 上搭配块级草稿模型时，在我们计时的 64 个提示上，它比任何 GPU 内存占用不超过自身的自回归配置快 2.1–2.9 倍。

Its main contribution is a transferable multi-agent system design; coordination and task execution connect incidentally to composition and reasoning, without directly studying either capability.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Multi-agent systems (MAS) require both effective coordination and specialized task execution. Existing prompt optimization approaches typically couple these functions within agent-specific prompts. We introduce Coordinator-Executor Prompt Optimization (CEPO), a general framework for improving prompt optimization in MAS. CEPO separates system-level coordination from agent-level execution through a shared coordinator prompt and agent-specific executor prompts, and guides their updates according to their respective roles. This structure allows shared coordination rules to be refined consistently across agents while keeping execution instructions separately adjustable. CEPO provides the prompt structure and optimization guidance, while existing prompt optimizers perform the underlying search. Extensive experiments spanning 11 benchmarks across four domains demonstrate that applying CEPO to four existing prompt optimizers consistently improves their performance. Ablations and qualitative analyses support the proposed design, while controlled studies on a document-understanding MAS further demonstrate improved optimization budget efficiency and performance scaling with the number of agents.

    Long-horizon agents continuously encounter reusable procedural knowledge, yet existing systems typically rely either on model adaptation or external memory, trading persistent learning for rapid reuse. This limitation is especially important for Web agents that repeatedly execute related multi-step workflows. We propose HaMo, a Harness-Model collaborative framework that combines fast non-parametric experience accumulation with slow parametric adaptation. HaMo distills trajectories into strategy-level experience cards for immediate retrieval, while an experience-conditioned continual learning objective trains the model to interpret, ground, and execute retrieved strategies across changing contexts. A retrieval-coverage-based selection mechanism further identifies compact and complementary trajectories for parameter updates.     ENGLISH

    Skills provide LLM agents with reusable procedural knowledge, making appropriate skill selection essential for reliable agent behavior. As skill libraries expand, distinguishing semantically similar candidates becomes increasingly difficult. Existing methods encode or rewrite skill descriptions for relevance-based ranking, yet heterogeneous descriptions can obscure capability differences. To address this challenge, we propose SKALOS, a graph-native reranker that compares skills via explicit capability evidence. Its multi-hierarchy graph aligns equivalent expressions across skills while preserving skill-specific capability evidence. Since individually relevant capability elements may not jointly support a query, semiring-based capability witness learning scores each branch by its weakest evidence, checks joint support for the extracted requirements within one implementation, and selects the strongest alternative. To reduce the influence of extraction errors, we develop ranking-feedback graph calibration that adjusts unreliable evidence for candidate comparison. Experiments on SkillRet show that SKALOS improves NDCG@10 by 2.68 percentage points over a matched text-only reranker.     The Right Fact, the Wrong Decision: SciValidityBench for Scientific Agent Memory

    正确的事实，错误的决策：面向科学智能体记忆的 SciValidityBench

    Yuexi Pan, Yongchao Chen

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces a benchmark and state-compilation framework for testing whether scientific agents use remembered evidence appropriately under governing experimental conditions, and reports gains over generic event graphs and retrieval. It strongly advances agent memory evaluation, while its decision focus is relevant to reasoning but does not directly explain reasoning mechanisms or compositional generalization.

    本文提出基准和状态编译框架，用于检验科学智能体是否会在支配实验条件下恰当地使用记忆证据，并报告了相较于通用事件图和检索方法的提升。它显著推进了智能体记忆评估；其决策重点与推理有关，但并未直接阐释推理机制或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Most agent-memory benchmarks frame long-term memory as retrieval: can an agent recover the relevant record from a long and evolving history? Scientific agents face a stricter problem: a correctly remembered fact may still be invalid to use. The same reported test result can support confirmation when the outcome and stopping rule were fixed in advance, yet only exploration when the outcome was selected from twenty inspected results. We call this scientific use validity: whether remembered evidence is eligible to influence a decision under the state governing its interpretation. We introduce SciValidityBench, an executable benchmark factory with 64 TaskSpecs spanning five validity modules and six scientific domains. TaskSpecs couple generated experimental histories with scientific-state definitions, programmatic decision oracles, controlled interventions, and automatic scoring. The SciStateForge compiler-reader framework turns distributed histories into explicit decision-governing state. Counterfactual pairs and targeted corruption-repair controls then test whether models use those dependencies and localize failures. Across four model families, compiled scientific state improves valid decision-making by 9.2-18.8 percentage points over a generic Event Graph. Retrieval alone does not reproduce this cross-family gain, while content-identical flat and typed views show that the improvement comes from exposing governing state rather than a particular graph serialization. SciValidityBench thus shifts memory evaluation from finding the right fact to deciding whether that fact should control the decision.

    大多数智能体记忆基准将长期记忆问题表述为检索：智能体能否从漫长且不断演变的历史中找回相关记录？科学智能体面临更严格的问题：即使正确记住了某个事实，也未必可以据此采取行动。同一个报告中的测试结果，若结果和停止规则是预先确定的，可能支持确认性结论；但若结果是从检查过的二十项结果中挑选出来的，则只能支持探索性结论。我们将此称为科学证据使用有效性，即在决定其解释方式的状态条件下，记忆中的证据是否有资格影响决策。我们提出 SciValidityBench，这是一个可执行的基准测试生成框架，包含 64 个 TaskSpecs，涵盖五种有效性模块和六个科学领域。TaskSpecs 将生成的实验历史与科学状态定义、程序化决策预言机、受控干预和自动评分结合起来。SciStateForge 编译器—读取器框架将分散的历史转化为明确的、决定决策的状态。反事实样本对和有针对性的损坏—修复对照则用于检验模型是否利用这些依赖关系，并定位失败原因。在四个模型系列的评测中，与通用 Event Graph 相比，编译后的科学状态使有效决策能力提高了 9.2–18.8 个百分点。仅靠检索无法复现这种跨系列的提升；内容相同的扁平视图和类型化视图则表明，提升源于显式呈现支配决策的状态，而非某种特定的图序列化方式。因此，SciValidityBench 将记忆评估的重点从找出正确事实转向判断该事实是否应当支配决策。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Knowledge editing aims to update outdated or incorrect knowledge in large language models without full retraining. Existing parameter-editing methods remain limited for long-sequence knowledge: single-point editors provide insufficient coverage for extended targets, while fixed chunk-based editors distribute editing effort uniformly across rigid predefined windows, failing to prioritize difficult, information-dense tokens. In this work, we show that token entropy is closely associated with both editing difficulty and semantic importance: high-entropy regions are harder to edit and often contain key factual content. Motivated by this observation, we propose DynEdit, a dynamic framework for long-sequence knowledge editing. DynEdit uses token-level entropy to guide non-uniform sliding, increasing the coverage of difficult high-entropy regions, and further applies entropy-guided token-level optimization to strengthen updates on information-dense tokens within each editing window. Experiments on three benchmarks and two backbone models show that DynEdit consistently outperforms competitive baselines across diverse long-form editing settings, achieving gains of up to +14.0 BLEU points on challenging paraphrase queries and near-saturated semantic scores on several diverse knowledge domains.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces a reinforcement learning reward based on whether a teacher attributes student responses to itself, and reports capability gains across reasoning, math, programming, and SQL tasks. Its analysis connects self-attribution with correctness but does not explain internal representations or mechanisms, while the teacher-student setup alone offers only an incidental systems connection.

    本文提出一种强化学习奖励，其依据是教师是否将学生的回答归因于自己，并报告了推理、数学、编程和 SQL 任务上的能力提升。分析将自我归因与正确性联系起来，但没有解释内部表征或机制；师生设置本身与系统的关联也只是附带的。

    ENGLISH

    Can a model learn by trying to fool another model? We show that it can. Inspired by the Turing Test and its recent generalization to arbitrary distinguishers, we introduce a domain-based teacher-Turing-Test, in which a stronger teacher model serves as both the target of imitation and the distinguisher, and a weaker student model is trained to make the teacher attribute responses to itself. We use this self-attribution (or fooling) probability as a reinforcement learning reward, without ever providing the student ground-truth answers, nor requiring the teacher to generate responses. We test our approach independently in four domains with verifiable answers: CommonsenseQA (reasoning), GSM8K (mathematics), KodCode (programming), and Spider (SQL), training a Qwen2.5-1.5B student/imitator model using DeepSeek V4 Flash as teacher/distinguisher. Beyond improving at passing the Turing Test, the student improves on independent, held-out evaluations in all domains and runs. To probe why being mistaken for the teacher can improve capability, our analyses reveal that self-attribution is associated with correctness -- substantially more than formatting changes -- and that it rewards partial correctness. Our results demonstrate a new, simple teacher-student training paradigm with a private and/or high-cost teacher. They also suggest that indistinguishability need not merely measure behavior -- it can also be a mechanism for learning.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    ToDoPro uses a DiT's own early probing to rank and reduce reference tokens, improving inference speed, memory use, and sometimes generation quality. This is a substantial conditional computation and resource-allocation contribution, but token importance is used operationally rather than to investigate model representations or reasoning.

    ToDoPro 利用 DiT 自身进行早期探测，对参考令牌排序并缩减，从而提高推理速度、改善内存使用，有时也提升生成质量。这是一项重要的条件计算与资源分配贡献，但令牌重要性仅用于实际操作，并未用于研究模型表征或推理。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Recent generic reference-based image generation models natively support multiple conditions by concatenating all reference image and text tokens into a joint sequence processed by a single Diffusion Transformer (DiT). However, this versatile paradigm comes at an efficiency cost: accommodating multiple references leads to a token explosion, incurring massive $\mathcal{O}(N^2)$ computational complexity. Most acceleration methods operate inside the DiT, showing limited capability in reducing spatial redundancy and failing to alleviate peak VRAM. While some pre-model token reduction alternatives exist, they inevitably introduce external models. This raises a question: Is it possible to achieve acceleration and memory savings while preserving compatibility with in-model techniques and requiring no additional parameters? In this work, we realize this goal by proposing the early Token reduction via Downsampled self-Probing (ToDoPro). By executing a few denoising steps on spatially $2\times$ downsampled reference images, this cheap probing stage utilizes the DiT model itself to effectively and efficiently extract reference token importance. Using the probed importance, we apply a hierarchical reduction before the main denoising stage: we completely discard low-importance tokens, substitute mid-importance tokens with their downsampled counterparts to cheaply preserve global context, and keep high-importance tokens. Experiments across three base models and two benchmarks demonstrate that our early reduction accelerates inference significantly and mitigates peak GPU memory. Furthermore, we can improve generation quality by safely filtering out noisy, uninformative reference tokens, enabling the model to concentrate its limited attention capacity on genuinely useful tokens. The code will be released at https://github.com/scy639/ToDoPro

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper gives causal evidence that spatially aligned high-frequency cues drive misclassification and analyzes how jamming redistributes under transformations, offering substantial insight into model behavior and input-feature interactions. Its geometric analysis is not about composing concepts or reasoning, and the model comparison does not concern system design.

    本文提供了因果证据，表明空间对齐的高频线索会导致误分类，并分析了干扰在变换下如何重新分布，从而深入揭示模型行为及输入特征之间的相互作用。其几何分析并非关于概念组合或推理，模型比较也与系统设计无关。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Deep neural networks are known to rely on non-robust features that align poorly with human perception. Prior work has largely framed these features as opportunistic shortcuts that help standard models on clean data. We show instead that non-robust cues can be antagonistic: they can act as Natural Jammers that actively mislead standard models on clean, unmodified images. Using disagreement between a standard model and robust models as an analysis lens, we identify a Jammed Set on which robust models outperform standard models. We provide causal evidence for Spectral-spatial Locking: jamming arises only when high-frequency components are precisely aligned with specific spatial structures. Disrupting this lock through spectral filtering or small geometric shifts can restore correct predictions. Crucially, we uncover a Substitution Paradox: while individual jammers are fragile to geometric shifts, the aggregate prevalence of jamming remains approximately stable and is redistributed rather than eliminated under such transformations. Our results reframe natural non-robustness as a failure field over the empirical model-data geometry: one that redistributes rather than disappears under small transformations.

    User memory helps personalized systems build on their understanding of users over time. Existing memory methods primarily target language-based interactions, and evaluations offer limited real behavioral data and limited separation of these capabilities. This leaves open how to jointly support and separately evaluate remembering and inference from behavioral logs. We formulate the problem of continual behavioral user memory around these joint requirements and develop a dedicated evaluation framework and memory method to address them. \textbf{BehaviorMemBench} is a benchmark built from real e-commerce logs covering 1{,}194 users and 17{,}462 behavioral batches over more than three years, with automatic future-behavior labels and a task-independent memory interface to separately evaluate remembering and inference under a common protocol. \textbf{BehaviorMem} is a memory design that organizes explicit behavioral facts and inferred user characteristics across long-term and short-term scopes in a two-axis state, with evidence-grounded formation, continual maintenance, and query-independent readout. Validation on a public dataset further supports its usefulness for downstream tasks based on behavioral histories.

    用户记忆有助于个性化系统随着时间推移不断加深对用户的了解。在电子商务中，用户通过明确的语言表达以及与商品的隐式交互来传达偏好和需求。我们研究基于这些交互日志构建的记忆，考察它如何\emph{记住}具体证据和已确立的兴趣，并利用这些证据\emph{推断}潜在需求和偏好，以支持对观测较少的商品领域作出判断。现有记忆方法主要面向基于语言的交互，评测所使用的真实行为数据有限，也很少将这两种能力分别考察。因此，如何从行为日志中同时支持并分别评测记忆和推断，仍是一个开放问题。我们围绕这两个要求形式化定义持续行为用户记忆问题，并开发专门的评测框架和记忆方法来解决它。\textbf{BehaviorMemBench} 是一个基于真实电商日志构建的基准，涵盖 1{,}194 名用户和 17{,}462 个行为批次，时间跨度超过三年。它包含自动生成的未来行为标签，并提供与任务无关的记忆接口，以便在统一协议下分别评测记忆和推断。\textbf{BehaviorMem} 是一种记忆设计，它通过双轴状态，在长期和短期范围内组织明确的行为事实与推断出的用户特征，并支持以证据为依据的形成、持续维护以及独立于查询的读取。在两种构建器和两种任务读取器上的实验表明，在记忆和推断任务中，BehaviorMem 的表现优于所评测的智能体记忆方法；实验还揭示了这两种能力的不同方法排名，以及有竞争力的统计基线。在一个公开数据集上的验证进一步证明，该方法对基于行为历史的下游任务有用。

    Centralized Critics for N-Agent Ad Hoc Teamwork

    N 智能体临时团队合作的集中式评论家

    Andrew McAlinden, Caroline Wang, Steven Shi, Arrasy Rahman, Elad Liebman, Peter Stone

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper proves and empirically tests when adding uncontrolled teammates’ histories to centralized critics lowers variance in ad hoc teamwork. This advances multi-agent coordination and RL training, but it does not study compositional generalization or model internals; its reasoning connection is limited to critic estimation rather than reasoning capabilities.

    本文证明并通过实验检验了在临时团队合作中，何时将不受控队友的历史加入集中式评论家能够降低方差。这推动了多智能体协作和强化学习训练的发展，但没有研究组合泛化或模型内部机制；与推理的关联仅限于评论家估计，而非推理能力。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Centralized training with decentralized execution (CTDE) has become the dominant paradigm in multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL), motivating extensive study of what privileged information should be made available to the critic during training. While prior work has examined the role of global state in fully cooperative settings, the design of centralized critics for N-agent ad hoc teamwork - in which dynamically varying set of learning agents must coordinate with an arbitrary set of uncontrolled teammates drawn from an unknown distribution - remains poorly understood. We study this question by comparing two natural classes of advantage estimators: controlled history estimators, which condition only on the observation and action histories of the learner's own agents, and joint history estimators, which additionally condition on the histories of the uncontrolled teammates. We prove that both estimators are unbiased and characterize the conditions under which the joint history estimate attains strictly lower variance than its controlled counterpart. Empirically, joint history critics match or outperform controlled history critics across a range of NAHT tasks, yielding improved sample efficiency and final returns. Together, these results provide both a theoretical justification and an empirical recommendation for incorporating uncontrolled agent histories into centralized critics for N-agent ad hoc teamwork.

    中文

    集中训练、分散执行（CTDE）已成为多智能体强化学习（MARL）的主流范式，因此训练期间应向评论家提供哪些特权信息受到广泛研究。以往工作考察了全合作场景中全局状态的作用，但对 N 智能体临时团队合作中的集中式评论家设计，人们仍缺乏深入理解。在这种合作中，数量动态变化的学习智能体必须与任意一组不受控队友进行协作，而这些队友来自未知分布。我们通过比较两类自然的优势估计器来研究这一问题：受控历史估计器仅以学习者自身智能体的观测和动作历史为条件；联合历史估计器则进一步以不受控队友的历史为条件。我们证明这两种估计器都是无偏的，并刻画联合历史估计相较于受控历史估计具有严格更低方差的条件。实证结果显示，在一系列 NAHT 任务中，联合历史评论家的表现不逊于或优于受控历史评论家，并带来更高的样本效率和最终回报。总之，这些结果既从理论上证明了其合理性，也从实证上建议在 N 智能体临时团队合作的集中式评论家中纳入不受控智能体的历史。

    SPARTA：面向长上下文边缘推理的稀疏三值 LLM 加速器，采用自适应注意力和统一数据通路

    Yanzhen Zhou, Zhengyu Han, Qunyou Liu, Zheyu Yan, Weihong Xu, Cheng Zhuo

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    SPARTA contributes a specialized accelerator architecture combining sparse dataflows, shared compute, and adaptive attention to improve long-context edge inference. Its hardware and computation design provides substantial systems insight, while the attention pruning results do not study model internals, compositional generalization, or reasoning capabilities.

    SPARTA 提出了一种专用加速器架构，将稀疏数据流、共享计算和自适应注意力结合起来，以提升长上下文边缘推理效率。其硬件与计算设计提供了重要的系统层面见解，而注意力剪枝结果并未研究模型内部机制、组合泛化或推理能力。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    LLMs on edge devices are constrained by limited memory and bandwidth. Although 1.58-bit ternary weights greatly reduce model storage, long-context inference is increasingly bottlenecked by KV-cache traffic and attention. Existing accelerators also use separate datapaths for ternary linear layers and attention, incurring hardware and execution overhead. We present SPARTA, a sparse ternary LLM accelerator for efficient long-context edge inference. SPARTA integrates: (1) a phase-aware sparse dataflow exploiting heterogeneous sparsity across compute-bound prefill and memory-bound decode; (2) a unified compute fabric mapping ternary SpMM/SpMV and bit-serial attention onto shared processing elements to exploit zero-weight and zero-bit sparsity; and (3) an adaptive two-stage attention engine combining page-level Top-k selection to reduce K-cache accesses with token-level Top-p pruning to reduce V-cache traffic. SPARTA reduces KV traffic by 4.1-4.8x over full attention and 1.3-1.5x over a state-of-the-art sparse-attention scheme, with task-dependent quality loss. Compared with NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin, SPARTA achieves 3.9x higher generation throughput and 8.3x higher end-to-end energy efficiency on average; versus AMD Ryzen 7 9700X, the gains are 5.0x and 81.7x. It also delivers 1.6-12.0x higher throughput, 2.0-4.2x higher energy efficiency, and 1.3-51.4x higher area efficiency than FIGLUT, TeLLMe, and MCBP.

    中文

    边缘设备上的 LLM 受限于内存和带宽。尽管 1.58 位三值权重大幅减少了模型存储占用，长上下文推理越来越受到 KV 缓存流量和注意力计算的瓶颈限制。现有加速器还为三值线性层和注意力使用不同的数据通路，造成硬件和执行开销。我们提出 SPARTA，这是一种用于高效长上下文边缘推理的稀疏三值 LLM 加速器。SPARTA 集成了：（1）一种感知阶段的稀疏数据流，利用计算受限的预填充阶段与内存受限的解码阶段之间的异构稀疏性；（2）一种统一计算结构，将三值 SpMM/SpMV 和位串行注意力映射到共享处理单元，以利用零权重和零比特稀疏性；（3）一种自适应两阶段注意力引擎，将页级 Top-k 选择与令牌级 Top-p 剪枝相结合，前者减少 K 缓存访问，后者减少 V 缓存流量。与完整注意力相比，SPARTA 将 KV 流量降低了 4.1-4.8 倍；与最先进的稀疏注意力方案相比，则降低了 1.3-1.5 倍，但质量损失因任务而异。与 NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin 相比，SPARTA 的生成吞吐量平均提高 3.9 倍，端到端能效提高 8.3 倍；与 AMD Ryzen 7 9700X 相比，这两项提升分别为 5.0 倍和 81.7 倍。与 FIGLUT、TeLLMe 和 MCBP 相比，其吞吐量提高 1.6-12.0 倍，能效提高 2.0-4.2 倍，面积效率提高 1.3-51.4 倍。
