    ENGLISH

    We address a fundamental question: How far should kernel fusion extend and which boundaries are worth preserving? Unlike the general convention of using one monolith megakernel at lower batch sizes or supporting only a selective model component as megakernel and rest of the model as conventional graph, we show that the best configuration is a composition of multiple megakernels with no overlapping conventional graph component, or a fully conventional graph. We present a framework that selects megakernel regions in a streaming inference model from conventional-graph profiles and standalone kernel benchmarks, without running any candidate design end to end. It simulates each candidate's tile and event graphs to predict time to first output and selects the measured best design in all 13 combinations of model and batch size we tested. Across NH-TTS, Qwen3-TTS and Llama-1B, the best composition ranges from two to four megakernels to fully conventional execution and none is a single megakernel. We introduce four model categories (megakernel-stable/ receding/ advancing/ averse) that capture how a model's best megakernel composition changes with batch size. Using NH-TTS model on H100 NVL GPU, we demonstrate that preserving three specialized megakernels can improve both latency and throughput despite introducing additional kernel boundaries. At batch size 32, this design delivers 21.4% lower mean batch-p95 time to first audio (TTFA) and 28% higher throughput than the evaluated monolith megakernel. Against conventional TensorRT graph execution, it reduces engine-level mean batch TTFA p95 by 4.05x and increases throughput by 19.7%.

    我们要回答一个基本问题：内核融合应延伸到什么程度，又有哪些边界值得保留？通常的做法是在较小批次下使用单个整体式 megakernel，或者只将模型的某个特定组件用作 megakernel，其余部分则采用常规计算图。与此不同，我们表明，最佳配置是由多个 megakernel 组成且不与常规计算图组件重叠，或者完全采用常规计算图。我们提出一种框架，从常规计算图的性能剖析和独立内核基准测试中，为流式推理模型选择 megakernel 区域，无须端到端运行任何候选设计。该框架模拟每个候选方案的 tile 图和事件图，以预测首次输出时间，并在我们测试的全部 13 种模型与批次大小组合中选出了实测表现最佳的设计。在 NH-TTS、Qwen3-TTS 和 Llama-1B 上，最佳组合从两个到四个 megakernel 不等，也可能是完全采用常规执行方式；没有一种是单个 megakernel。我们提出了四种模型类别（megakernel-stable/ receding/ advancing/ averse），用于描述模型的最佳 megakernel 组合如何随批次大小变化。我们在 H100 NVL GPU 上使用 NH-TTS 模型证明，即使引入额外的内核边界，保留三个专用 megakernel 也能同时改善延迟和吞吐量。在批次大小为 32 时，与经过评测的整体式 megakernel 相比，该设计的平均批次 p95 首次音频时间（TTFA）降低 21.4%，吞吐量提高 28%。与常规 TensorRT 计算图执行相比，它将引擎级平均批次 TTFA p95 降低至原来的 1/4.05，并将吞吐量提高 19.7%。

Context management is therefore essential, yet existing systems have either neglected it or treated it as a supporting mechanism rather than a subject of study. This paper presents MarkovSim, an LLM agent harness for long-horizon computational simulation, whose core is a context management scheme built into the workflow. Linear maps refit on cleaned embedding-table vectors recover every held-out emotion at rank 1 in all thirty ordered pairs. Second, scale spreads the geometry's variance across more directions without weakening its tie to valence. The leading component's share of variance falls from 31.6 percent (2B) to 29.8 (9B) to 26.7 (27B) in the base models and from 31.9 (2B) to 29.2 (9B) to 27.3 (27B) in the tuned ones, while its correlation with human valence ratings stays between .71 and .78 in all six models. Third, we project each emotion vector onto the output vocabulary and ask at what depth the vector's own emotion word enters the top 10,000 of the 256,000 tokens. In the 2B and 9B models the median emotion word is there from layer 0, while in the 27B models it begins near chance, stays outside the top 10,000 for half the network, and enters at layer 23 in one step. Fourth, tuning leaves every registered analysis-layer measure within its floor. At every size, valence correlation rises and arousal correlation falls by amounts within their floors, the latter against prediction. PC2's variance share also falls, with a pooled decrease significant after correction. Mid-late layer stability exceeds its floor and traces to base 27B's final layer. Code, data, and audit reports are released.

    中文

    我们测量了六个 LLM 的情绪几何结构，这些模型涵盖 Google 的 Gemma 2 系列。我们采用 Sofroniew et al. (2026) 在 Claude Sonnet 4.5 上建立、并由 Hollowell (2026) 在 Gemma 2 27B base 上复现的提取流程，比较 Gemma 2 2B、9B 和 27B 的基础版与指令微调版模型中的情绪几何结构。第一，六个模型单元都呈现出核心情绪几何结构。在两个单元之间拟合线性映射后，目标模型中留出的情绪最接近其对应向量。在全部十五对模型中（每对仅拟合一个方向），这一方法仅失败一次，而且每对模型的中位排名都是 1。在清理后的嵌入表向量上重新拟合线性映射后，全部三十个有序模型对中的每个留出情绪都以排名 1 被找回。第二，随着模型规模增大，几何结构的方差分散到更多方向上，但其与效价的联系并未减弱。基础模型中，主成分的方差占比从 31.6 percent（2B）降至 29.8（9B）、再降至 26.7（27B）；微调模型中则从 31.9（2B）降至 29.2（9B）、再降至 27.3（27B），而该成分与六个模型的人类效价评分之间的相关性始终处于 .71 至 .78 之间。第三，我们将每个情绪向量投影到输出词表上，考察该向量对应的情绪词在第几层进入 256,000 个 token 中的前 10,000 名。在 2B 和 9B 模型中，中位情绪词从第 0 层起就位于其中；而在 27B 模型中，该词起初接近随机水平，在网络一半深度内都处于前 10,000 名之外，随后在第 23 层一步进入。第四，微调后，每项预先登记的分析层指标都仍处于其底限范围内。在每种模型规模下，效价相关性有所上升，唤醒度相关性有所下降，变化幅度均处于各自底限范围内；后者与预测相反。PC2 的方差占比也有所下降，合并后的降幅在校正后仍显著。中后层稳定性超过其底限，该结果可追溯至基础版 27B 的最后一层。代码、数据和审计报告均已公开。

This paper investigates the phonetic representations in the first codebook (CB0) of the Mimi codec. ABX style evaluation is poorly suited to Mimi fixed 80 ms tokenization window, which often spans multiple phonemes; we instead use forced alignment, entropy analysis, and Phone-Normalized Mutual Information (PNMI).     Wangcheng Tao, Zhanglu Yan, Han Wu, Weng-Fai Wong

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Skill$^{\infty}$ presents a reusable meta-skill that recursively improves task skills and its own optimization procedure, evaluated across diverse agent tasks. This advances agent organization and optimization, with partial relevance to compositional reuse and task execution, but the abstract does not establish a focused contribution to compositional generalization or reasoning mechanisms.

    Skill$^{\infty}$提出了一种可复用的元技能，能够递归地改进任务技能及其自身的优化流程，并在多种智能体任务上进行了评估。这推进了智能体组织和优化，与组合式复用及任务执行有一定关联，但摘要没有证明其对组合泛化或推理机制作出了明确贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Recursive self-improvement (RSI), in which a system also improves the way it improves, is a long-standing aspiration on the path to AGI. Language agents increasingly store procedural knowledge in reusable skills. Optimizing skills offers a direct way to achieve RSI, because the optimization procedure itself can be encoded as a skill. Existing skill optimizers, however, follow a hand-designed procedure. Even methods that evolve a meta-skill confine it to a fixed pipeline and relearn it for each task. We present Skill$^{\infty}$, which makes skill optimization recursively self-improving: a meta agent follows a meta-skill to optimize task skills and optimizes the meta-skill itself using the same procedure. The optimization is agent-led. The meta agent diagnoses execution traces, proposes candidates, requests independent reviews, and allocates the search budget. The meta-skill defines these steps, allowing self-improvement to rewrite them. This meta-skill is also decoupled from task skills, refined on multiple skill optimization tasks and then reused to optimize task skills across diverse domains. As in deployment, skills at both levels are standard packages loaded through native skill discovery. On 83 SkillsBench tasks, Skill$^{\infty}$ reaches a pass rate of 60.7%, compared with 56.4% for human-curated skills and 54.5% for SkillEvolver.

    中文

    递归式自我改进（RSI）指系统还能够改进自身的改进方式，这是迈向 AGI 长期以来的目标。语言智能体越来越多地将程序性知识存储在可复用的技能中。优化技能是实现 RSI 的直接途径，因为优化过程本身也可以编码为一种技能。然而，现有技能优化器遵循人工设计的流程。即使是能够演化元技能的方法，也将其限制在固定流程中，并针对每项任务重新学习。我们提出 Skill$^{\infty}$，它能使技能优化实现递归式自我改进：元智能体遵循元技能来优化任务技能，并使用同一流程优化元技能本身。这种优化由智能体主导。元智能体诊断执行轨迹、提出候选方案、征求独立评审，并分配搜索预算。元技能定义了这些步骤，使自我改进能够重写这些步骤。该元技能还与任务技能解耦，在多项技能优化任务上得到完善，随后复用于优化多个不同领域中的任务技能。与部署场景一致，两个层级的技能都是通过原生技能发现机制加载的标准软件包。在 SkillsBench 的 83 项任务上，Skill$^{\infty}$ 的通过率达到 60.7%，而人工整理的技能为 56.4%，SkillEvolver 为 54.5%。

    Yinsong Yan, Ling Wang, Yuxuan Wang, Yifan Yang, Ruiyang Xu, Junming Lin, Qi Chen, Meng Gao, Minghao Han, Yunfei Chu, Qize Yang, Xize Cheng, Jin Xu, Jibin Wu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper contributes a benchmark measuring timely, sustained agent interaction with continuous audiovisual streams, and reports gaps in tool invocation, reminders, and sequence coverage. Its agent behavior and tool-use evaluation strongly support Systems; the benchmark does not investigate internal mechanisms or substantive reasoning or compositional generalization.

    本文提出一个基准，用于衡量智能体与连续视听流进行及时、持续交互的能力，并报告了工具调用、提醒和序列覆盖方面的不足。其对智能体行为和工具使用的评估有力地支持了系统方向；该基准没有研究内部机制，也没有探讨实质性的推理或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Omnimodal large language models (Omni-LLMs) are increasingly expected to assist users while observing continuous audiovisual streams. However, existing evaluations provide limited insight into how reliably these models connect stream evidence and user needs to timely, sustained interventions. We introduce \textbf{Omni-InteractScope}, a benchmark of 1,479 human-annotated, cross-reviewed interactions with 1,790 temporal targets across eight task groups. It links input modalities, event triggers, intervention types, and user needs, covering event-timed tool invocation and query-free assistance alongside notifications, warnings, state tracking, and continuous responses. Our experimental results on the proposed benchmark reveal three critical limitations of current Omni-LLMs: (1) \textbf{Timely tool invocation remains unreliable}: all 12 evaluated models produce an on-time first response for at most 40\% of tool-invocation targets, and joint timing-and-tool accuracy reaches at most 32.0\%. (2) \textbf{Query-free reminders remain poorly covered}: all evaluated models achieve lower timely reference-target recall on query-free reminders than on explicit questions, measured on their respective target sets. Reminder recall never exceeds 23.0\%. (3) \textbf{End-to-end guidance coverage remains limited}: nine models cover none of the 26 guidance sequences in full, and the remaining three cover only one to three sequences each. Targeted controls further show that tool-invocation scores alone do not establish event grounding and that reminder coverage depends on response history and frequency. These findings motivate developing and evaluating streaming assistants for timely action, initiative under general user needs, and coverage of entire response sequences.

    中文

    全模态大型语言模型（Omni-LLM）越来越需要在观察连续视听流的同时为用户提供帮助。然而，现有评估难以充分揭示这些模型能否可靠地将流中的证据和用户需求联系起来，并及时、持续地采取干预。我们推出 \textbf{Omni-InteractScope}，这是一个基准，包含 1,479 条经人工标注和交叉审核的交互，涵盖八个任务组中的 1,790 个时间目标。它将输入模态、事件触发条件、干预类型和用户需求联系起来，覆盖按事件时机调用工具和无需查询的辅助，以及通知、警告、状态跟踪和连续响应。我们在所提出的基准上开展实验，发现当前 Omni-LLM 存在三项关键局限：（1）\textbf{工具调用的时机仍不可靠}：所有 12 个接受评估的模型中，对于工具调用目标，按时给出首次响应的比例均不超过 40\%，而时机与工具联合准确率最高仅达 32.0\%。（2）\textbf{无需查询的提醒覆盖仍然不足}：对于各自对应的目标集，所有接受评估的模型在无需查询提醒上的及时参考目标召回率都低于显式提问任务。提醒召回率从未超过 23.0\%。（3）\textbf{端到端指导覆盖仍然有限}：九个模型无法完整覆盖 26 个指导序列中的任何一个，其余三个模型各自仅完整覆盖一到三个序列。针对性控制实验进一步表明，仅凭工具调用得分无法证明模型理解了事件依据，而且提醒覆盖率取决于响应历史和频率。这些发现促使我们进一步开发和评估流式助手，使其能够及时采取行动、根据一般用户需求主动提供帮助，并覆盖完整的响应序列。

    This perspective proposes decentralized agents that share structured clinical reasoning trajectories, including observations, hypotheses, tool use, and outcomes, to aggregate experience across institutions.     这篇观点文章提出由去中心化智能体共享结构化临床推理轨迹（包括观察、假设、工具使用和结果），以便在不同机构间汇聚经验。智能体组织和类似记忆的经验交换与系统方向相关；推理是重要但仍属提议中的应用场景，文章没有提供关于内部机制或组合泛化的直接证据。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Clinical expertise is inherently distributed: it resides not in any single dataset or institution but in the accumulated reasoning experiences of thousands of clinicians navigating diverse patient populations, resource constraints, and evolving treatment protocols. Yet current approaches to scaling medical AI, from centralized large language models to federated learning, remain anchored to a data-centric paradigm that treats knowledge as static parameters to be aggregated. In this Perspective, we argue for a fundamental shift from data aggregation to experience aggregation. We propose Decentralized Agentic Systems (DAS), a framework in which distributed AI agents operating across healthcare institutions synthesize collective clinical intelligence by sharing abstracted reasoning trajectories rather than raw data or model parameters. Unlike federated learning, which averages numerical gradients across homogeneous model architectures, DAS exchanges structured records of clinical reasoning, specifically the sequence of observations, hypotheses, tool invocations, and outcome feedback that constitute diagnostic experience. We examine the architectural principles, deployment considerations, governance requirements, and critical open challenges of this framework, laying the groundwork for a collaborative medical AI ecosystem where distributed expertise autonomously adapts to the complexities of longitudinal patient care.

    临床专业知识本质上是分布式的：它不属于任何单一数据集或机构，而是积累在数千名临床医生的推理经验中；他们服务于不同的患者群体，面临各异的资源约束和不断变化的治疗方案。然而，从集中式大型语言模型到联邦学习，当前扩展医疗 AI 的方法仍植根于以数据为中心的范式，将知识视为可聚合的静态参数。在这篇观点文章中，我们主张应从聚合数据根本转向聚合经验。我们提出去中心化智能体系统（DAS）框架：医疗机构中运行的分布式 AI 智能体通过共享抽象后的推理轨迹，而非原始数据或模型参数，综合形成集体临床智能。联邦学习会在同构模型架构之间对数值梯度取平均；与之不同，DAS 交换结构化的临床推理记录，具体包括构成诊断经验的一系列观察、假设、工具调用和结果反馈。我们探讨这一框架的架构原则、部署考量、治理要求和关键开放挑战，为构建协作式医疗 AI 生态系统奠定基础，使分布式专业知识能够自主适应纵向患者护理的复杂需求。

    面向物理信息探索的多时域未来发现

    Shuwei Wang, Qiang Guan, Brian Qiu, Haoxiang Huang, Haoxi Wang, Chenyu Li, Bo Xu, Sen Cui

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    HTC² combines multi-horizon representation learning and Hamiltonian structure to shape intrinsic rewards for exploration, with evaluations and ablations across control tasks. It offers a substantive algorithmic contribution to exploration and capability development (Reasoning 4); representation learning is relevant but not an investigation of internal model mechanisms (MechInterp 3), while composition and agent-system organization are incidental.

    HTC² 将多时域表征学习与哈密顿结构相结合，以塑造探索的内在奖励，并在多项控制任务上进行评估和消融。它对探索和能力发展作出了实质性的算法贡献（推理 4）；表征学习与模型内部机制相关，但本文并未研究内部模型机制（机制可解释性 3），而系统组合与智能体系统组织只是附带内容。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Exploration in physical control environments requires agents to identify actions whose consequences reveal previously unexplored aspects of the underlying dynamics. However, many intrinsic motivation methods rely on immediate prediction errors, state novelty, or local physical changes, which may overlook informative outcomes that emerge across extended temporal horizons. We investigate whether learning structured representations of reachable futures can provide a more effective basis for exploration. To this end, we introduce Hamiltonian Temporal Contrastive Curiosity (HTC$^2$), a framework that combines multi-horizon temporal representation learning with Hamiltonian phase-space structure. A horizon-conditioned contrastive critic learns temporal relationships from future-state pairs sampled within the same episode. The distance between positive-pair representations is then used as an intrinsic reward, encouraging the agent to explore futures that remain insufficiently organized in the learned representation. To incorporate information about physical dynamics, we additionally modulate this reward using bounded multi-step Hamiltonian variation, rather than directly rewarding changes in the Hamiltonian itself. We integrate HTC$^2$ with both Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) and Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), and evaluate it across six DeepMind Control Suite tasks. Comparisons with ICM, RIDE, E3B, Plan2Explore, and a single-step Hamiltonian curiosity baseline are complemented by state-coverage evaluations, component ablations, and phase-space diagnostics to characterize the contributions of temporal learning and physical structure to exploratory behavior.

    中文

    在物理控制环境中进行探索，要求智能体识别出其后果能够揭示底层动力学此前未被探索方面的动作。然而，许多内在动机方法依赖即时预测误差、状态新颖性或局部物理变化，可能会忽略那些在较长时间跨度内才显现的信息性结果。我们研究学习可达未来的结构化表征能否为探索提供更有效的基础。为此，我们提出哈密顿时间对比好奇心（HTC$^2$），这是一个将多时域时间表征学习与哈密顿相空间结构相结合的框架。一个以时域为条件的对比评论器，从同一回合中采样的未来状态对里学习时间关系。随后，将正样本对表征之间的距离用作内在奖励，鼓励智能体探索在所学表征中仍未得到充分组织的未来。为了纳入物理动力学的信息，我们还使用有界的多步哈密顿变化来调节该奖励，而不是直接奖励哈密顿量本身的变化。我们将 HTC$^2$与软演员-评论家（SAC）和近端策略优化（PPO）结合，并在六项 DeepMind Control Suite 任务上进行评估。我们将其与 ICM、RIDE、E3B、Plan2Explore 以及单步哈密顿好奇心基线进行比较，并结合状态覆盖评估、组件消融和相空间诊断，刻画时间学习与物理结构对探索行为的贡献。

    The Hidden Costs of Forgetting: A Study of Trajectory Deletion in Software Engineering Agents

    遗忘的隐性代价：软件工程智能体轨迹删除研究

    Fernando Vallecillos-Ruiz, Islem Bouzenia, Michael Pradel, Leon Moonen

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The study measures how deleting agent trajectory content affects task effectiveness, compensatory behavior, and costs, showing that delayed deletion and cache-aware pricing change the tradeoffs. This provides empirical insight into agent memory management, while reasoning text is only a target of deletion and the paper does not investigate reasoning mechanisms.

    这项研究衡量了删除智能体轨迹内容对任务效能、补偿行为和成本的影响，并显示延迟删除与考虑缓存的定价会改变其中的权衡。这为智能体记忆管理提供了实证见解；推理文本只是删除对象，论文并未研究推理机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Software engineering agents resend their entire trajectory to an LLM at every turn, motivating online trajectory reduction. Prior work shows that randomly deleting 75% of tokens in old turns may preserve agent effectiveness, but it remains unclear why, how agents compensate for missing content, and whether it actually reduces costs. This paper presents an empirical study of 42 trajectory-reduction configurations, focusing on effectiveness, agent behavior, and cost. We systematically explore deleting content from old turns by varying the scope, granularity, amount, and timing of deletion across 9,400 runs with two state-of-the-art agents on SWE-bench Verified. We find deleting large amounts of trajectory content (e.g., up to 100% of reasoning text) can preserve overall effectiveness. Importantly, such deletion must be applied with a delay, as immediate deletion tends to significantly degrade effectiveness. Agents often compensate for deleted content by re-fetching it, increasing both the number of turns taken and the input/output tokens. Whether trajectory reduction reduces costs depends on the pricing model: Under a flat pricing model, estimated costs fall in 26 of 42 evaluations. Surprisingly, under a caching-aware pricing model, zero evaluations yield lower costs, since reducing the trajectory breaks the cached prefix billed at a lower rate. Our findings have three implications: First, token counts alone are misleading; trajectory reduction techniques must consider overall costs under a realistic pricing model. Second, analyzing trajectories is crucial to understand agent behavior, as end-to-end effectiveness hides differences such as excessive re-fetching. Finally, these results highlight the need for future work on memory management to reduce costs without sacrificing effectiveness.

    中文

    软件工程智能体每轮都会将完整轨迹重新发送给 LLM，因此需要在线缩减轨迹。先前研究表明，随机删除较早轮次中 75% 的词元可能仍能保持智能体效能，但其原因、智能体如何弥补缺失内容，以及这是否真的能降低成本，仍不清楚。本文对 42 种轨迹缩减配置进行了实证研究，重点考察效能、智能体行为和成本。我们在 SWE-bench Verified 上使用两种最先进的智能体进行了 9,400 次运行，系统地探索通过改变删除范围、粒度、数量和时机来删除较早轮次中的内容。我们发现，删除大量轨迹内容（例如，最多删除 100% 的推理文本）仍可能保持整体效能。值得注意的是，此类删除必须延迟实施，因为立即删除往往会显著降低效能。智能体经常通过重新获取已删除内容来弥补，这会增加交互轮数以及输入/输出词元数。轨迹缩减能否降低成本取决于定价模式：在固定价格模式下，42 项评估中有 26 项的预估成本下降。令人意外的是，在考虑缓存的定价模式下，没有任何评估能降低成本，因为缩减轨迹会破坏以较低费率计费的缓存前缀。我们的发现有三点启示：第一，仅看词元数量会产生误导；轨迹缩减技术必须在现实的定价模式下考虑总体成本。第二，分析轨迹对于理解智能体行为至关重要，因为端到端效能会掩盖过度重新获取等差异。最后，这些结果凸显了未来开展记忆管理研究的必要性，以便在不牺牲效能的前提下降低成本。

    细粒度信用分配何时有益、何时有害：通过视频剪辑进行多模态智能体强化学习

    Lei Zhao, Zongheng Cao, Xinyu Hu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper studies when process-level credit assignment helps multimodal agents learn long-horizon editing, and compares reward schedules and self-distillation empirically. Its main contribution advances reasoning training and problem-solving; tool use and workflow composition are part of the testbed, without a substantive contribution to interpretability or compositional generalization.

    本文研究过程级信用分配何时有助于多模态智能体学习长时程剪辑任务，并通过实证比较奖励调度和自蒸馏。其主要贡献在于推进推理训练和问题求解；工具使用与工作流组合属于试验平台内容，对可解释性或组合泛化没有实质贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Reinforcement learning (RL) has shown promise for training multimodal agents to reason and use tools. However, it remains unclear when fine-grained credit assignment improves learning and when it fails to improve task performance. Video editing provides a useful testbed for this question, combining multimodal perception, long-horizon planning, and tool use with delayed outcome feedback. We construct four movie-trailer editing task types---Content Selection, Narrative Sequencing, Rough Cut, and Fine Cut---that reflect real-world editing workflows and span different levels of task complexity and interaction horizon. Decaying process rewards provides the largest benefit on Fine Cut, with a 45.4% relative gain over outcome-only GRPO on tasks averaging more than 60 turns under outcome-only GRPO. On the three shorter-horizon task types averaging 30--40 turns under the same baseline, outcome-only GRPO remains competitive, with decaying process rewards yielding at most a 10.4% relative gain. Process rewards from an LLM judge initially improve tool use and encourage visual inspection. As training progresses, however, GRPO+PRM with a fixed process-reward weight increasingly exhibits excessive reasoning and redundant tool calls: process rewards continue to rise while task completion rates and outcome scores decline. Decaying the process-reward weight to zero mitigates this reward-hacking behavior while preserving the early gains. Despite dense token-level supervision, on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) yields little improvement or substantial degradation and is highly sensitive to the choice of privileged information. Our analysis reveals differences in teacher--student disagreement and gradient magnitudes, and suggests possible dilution of informative signals over long trajectories.

    中文

    强化学习（RL）在训练能够推理并使用工具的多模态智能体方面展现出潜力。然而，细粒度信用分配何时能改善学习、何时无法提升任务表现，仍不清楚。视频剪辑为研究这一问题提供了一个有用的试验平台，它结合了多模态感知、长时程规划和工具使用，并具有延迟的结果反馈。我们构建了四种电影预告片剪辑任务类型——内容选择、叙事排序、粗剪和精剪——以反映现实世界的剪辑流程，并涵盖不同的任务复杂度和交互时长。衰减过程奖励在精剪任务上带来的收益最大：在仅使用结果奖励的 GRPO 基线上，任务平均超过 60 轮时，相对提升为 45.4%。在同一基线下，平均为 30–40 轮的三种较短时程任务类型中，仅使用结果奖励的 GRPO 仍具竞争力，衰减过程奖励带来的相对提升最高为 10.4%。由 LLM 评判器给出的过程奖励起初能改善工具使用并鼓励视觉检查。然而，随着训练推进，采用固定过程奖励权重的 GRPO+PRM 越来越多地表现出过度推理和冗余工具调用：过程奖励持续上升，而任务完成率和结果分数却在下降。将过程奖励权重逐渐衰减至零，能够缓解这种奖励劫持行为，同时保留早期收益。尽管获得了密集的词元级监督，在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）带来的提升仍然很小，或会造成显著退化，并且对特权信息的选择高度敏感。我们的分析揭示了教师与学生之间分歧以及梯度幅度的差异，并指出有用信号可能会在长轨迹中被稀释。

    Yucheng Wu, Chengyi Xie, Chenpeng Wang, Liangming Pan

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    CANS introduces a closed-form, neuron-wise activation steering method designed to control behavior while preserving general capabilities, supported by evaluations across several domains. Its intervention on internal neurons gives it a substantial connection to model mechanisms, though the abstract does not analyze representations or circuits; capability benchmarks are evaluation context rather than a reasoning contribution.

    CANS 提出了一种逐神经元的闭式激活引导方法，旨在控制行为的同时保持通用能力，并通过多个领域的评估提供支持。它对内部神经元进行干预，因此与模型机制有实质联系，但摘要并未分析表征或电路；能力基准测试只是评估背景，并非推理方面的贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Activation steering offers training-free and dynamic control of target behaviors in large language models, but existing methods can impair general capabilities and require domain-specific intervention designs. We introduce Capability-Preserving Neuron Steering (CANS), a unified framework that balances target-behavior control with capability preservation. To make target-behavior improvement and general-capability preservation tractable, we introduce two proxies: log-probabilities of target tokens in model generated responses, and output-distribution KL divergence on general-purpose inputs. Combining the local approximation of the two proxies yields a closed-form solution, enabling lightweight steering without iterative model training or additional inference-time computation. The resulting neuron-wise scaling coefficients achieve effective steering while limiting general-capability loss. A shared data-construction and intervention procedure supports adaptation across domains using sampled responses with target-behavior filtering and target-span annotations. Across safety, toxicity, and hallucination control on Qwen and Llama models, CANS achieves comparable or better steering while better preserving MMLU, BBH, and IFEval performance than SFT, CAA, and neuron-level baselines. On Qwen3-4B, CANS reduces HarmBench attack success from $15.50\%$ to $1.75\%$ with a $1.11$-point decrease in average capability. These results support CANS as a practical approach to behavioral control across domains.

    中文

    激活引导能够在无需训练的情况下动态控制大型语言模型的目标行为，但现有方法可能损害通用能力，且需要针对特定领域设计干预方案。我们提出能力保持型神经元引导（CANS），这是一个统一框架，旨在兼顾目标行为控制与能力保持。为了使目标行为改善和通用能力保持易于处理，我们引入了两个代理指标：模型生成响应中目标词元的对数概率，以及通用输入上的输出分布 KL 散度。结合这两个代理指标的局部近似可得到闭式解，从而实现轻量级引导，无需迭代训练模型或增加推理时计算。由此得到的逐神经元缩放系数能够有效引导行为，同时将通用能力损失控制在较低水平。一套共享的数据构建和干预流程支持跨领域适配，使用经过目标行为筛选并带有目标片段标注的采样响应。在 Qwen 和 Llama 模型的安全、毒性和幻觉控制任务中，与 SFT、CAA 及神经元级基线相比，CANS 实现了相当或更好的引导效果，同时更好地保留了 MMLU、BBH 和 IFEval 表现。在 Qwen3-4B 上，CANS 将 HarmBench 攻击成功率从 $15.50\%$ 降至 $1.75\%$，平均能力下降 $1.11$ 个百分点。这些结果表明，CANS 是一种实用的跨领域行为控制方法。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    ADA proposes and tests an algorithmic account in which amortized feature knowledge shapes representations used for few-shot concept induction, offering a transferable hypothesis about contextualization mechanisms. The task involves identifying commonalities across examples and latent concept inference, but the abstract does not establish broader compositional generalization or multi-step reasoning.

    ADA 提出并检验了一种算法解释：摊销特征知识会塑造用于少样本概念归纳的表征，并为情境化机制提供了一种可迁移的假说。该任务涉及识别示例间的共同点以及推断潜在概念，但摘要并未证明更广泛的组合泛化或多步推理能力。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Both models and minds not only encode features that describe an entity, but can specifically represent which features of that entity are relevant for a given context. This core capability underlies in-context learning in language models and a variety of cognitive phenomena in minds, yet it is unclear how intelligent systems identify and promote relevant features. In this work, we propose Amortized Direction Accentuation (ADA), an algorithmic hypothesis that provides an explanation for how relevance is determined in the context of few-shot concept induction --- the ability to infer a latent concept from a small number of positive examples. Under ADA, concept induction proceeds by forming a summary representation of the examples in a feature space that is shaped by amortized knowledge about which features tend to be useful for finding commonalities between items. We investigate and validate ADA in language models using a few-shot concept induction task. This work provides a novel perspective on the mechanisms supporting contextualization in language models and a promising hypothesis for a core aspect of cognition.

    模型和心智不仅会编码描述实体的特征，还能具体表示在给定情境下该实体的哪些特征是相关的。这种核心能力支撑着语言模型的上下文学习以及心智中的各种认知现象，但智能系统如何识别并突出相关特征仍不清楚。在这项工作中，我们提出摊销方向凸显（ADA），这是一种算法假说，用于解释在少样本概念归纳情境下如何确定相关性；少样本概念归纳是指从少量正例中推断潜在概念的能力。根据 ADA，概念归纳通过在特征空间中形成示例的摘要表征来进行，而该特征空间受到摊销知识的塑造，这些知识说明哪些特征通常有助于发现项目之间的共同点。我们使用少样本概念归纳任务，在语言模型中研究并验证 ADA。这项工作为语言模型中支持情境化的机制提供了新视角，并为认知的一个核心方面提出了有前景的假说。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    StateLoop adds a gated persistent per-token state to retain information across repeated Transformer computation, improving language-model and task performance. This is a substantial memory and computation design contribution, while the abstract does not present it as a reasoning method or investigate internal representations.

    StateLoop 增加了一个带门控的逐词元持久状态，以便在重复的 Transformer 计算中保留信息，并改善语言模型和任务表现。这是一项实质性的记忆与计算设计贡献，但摘要没有将其作为推理方法提出，也未研究内部表征。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Looped Transformers offer a parameter-efficient approach to language modeling by repeatedly applying a shared backbone. Vanilla looped Transformers use each backbone output directly as the input to the next iteration. These outputs may contain information useful several iterations later, but retaining it across the loop depends entirely on the single hidden state. We introduce StateLoop, which maintains one additional persistent state per token to retain information across iterations. At each iteration, a learned gate controls how much of the previous state is retained and how much information from the backbone output is incorporated. The updated state is projected back and added to the backbone output for subsequent iterations and final prediction. This design reduces Pile perplexity and improves average accuracy across eight zero-shot tasks over Vanilla Looped. Its perplexity advantage over Vanilla Looped grows with trained loop depth, consistent with persistent state becoming increasingly useful as recurrent computation deepens.

    中文

    循环 Transformer 通过反复应用共享骨干网络，为语言建模提供了一种参数高效的方法。普通循环 Transformer 直接将每次骨干网络的输出用作下一次迭代的输入。这些输出可能包含在后续若干次迭代中有用的信息，但在循环过程中保留这些信息完全依赖单一隐藏状态。我们提出 StateLoop，为每个词元维护一个额外的持久状态，以便在迭代间保留信息。在每次迭代中，一个学习得到的门控会控制保留多少先前状态，以及从骨干网络输出中纳入多少信息。更新后的状态会被投影回去，并与骨干网络输出相加，供后续迭代和最终预测使用。与 Vanilla Looped 相比，该设计降低了 Pile 困惑度，并提高了八项零样本任务的平均准确率。随着训练时循环深度增加，StateLoop 相对于 Vanilla Looped 的困惑度优势也随之增大，这与循环计算加深时持久状态越来越有用的情况相符。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    LoopFold’s main contribution is a predictor-corrector method that parallelizes recurrent computation to reduce decoding latency while retaining accuracy gains. This advances model computation and allocation, but the abstract does not study internal representations, compositional generalization, or reasoning mechanisms.

    LoopFold 的主要贡献是一种预测器-校正器方法，它通过并行化循环计算来降低解码延迟，同时保留准确率增益。这推动了模型计算与资源分配的发展，但摘要并未研究内部表征、组合泛化或推理机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Looped Transformers increase computation per token by repeatedly applying a shared backbone, offering a way to improve language modeling and downstream task performance at a fixed backbone parameter count. However, each loop depends on the preceding loop, so increasing recurrent depth also increases decoding latency. Existing approaches include Parallel Loop Transformers, which reduce latency by overlapping loop computation across token positions, but yield rapidly diminishing marginal accuracy gains at larger depths. To address this challenge, we introduce LoopFold, which folds computation at multiple recurrent depths into parallel batches for the same token prefix. A lightweight predictor estimates inputs to later loops so they can start before earlier loops finish. A corrector then refines the outputs of these later loops using newly available results from earlier loops. All components are trained jointly using only the final next-token prediction loss. In experiments with 1.4B models, deeper LoopFold configurations achieve progressively higher average zero-shot accuracy across eight tasks, rising from 53.41% to 56.38%. Vanilla looped models and PLT show limited gains over the same depth range. Compared with a nine-loop vanilla model, LoopFold uses five sequential stages and additional parallel computation to reduce decoding latency by 46%.

    中文

    循环 Transformer 通过反复应用共享骨干网络来增加每个词元的计算量，在骨干网络参数量固定时，为提升语言建模和下游任务表现提供了一种途径。然而，每次循环都依赖前一次循环，因此增加循环深度也会提高解码延迟。现有方法包括并行循环 Transformer（PLT），它通过在词元位置之间重叠循环计算来降低延迟，但在较大深度下准确率的边际增益会迅速递减。为应对这一挑战，我们提出 LoopFold，将多个循环深度上的计算折叠为针对同一词元前缀的并行批次。一个轻量级预测器估计后续循环的输入，使其能够在前序循环完成之前启动。随后，校正器利用前序循环新近产生的结果来细化这些后续循环的输出。所有组件仅使用最终的下一词元预测损失进行联合训练。在 1.4B 模型实验中，更深的 LoopFold 配置在八项任务上的平均零样本准确率逐步提高，从 53.41% 上升至 56.38%。在相同深度范围内，普通循环模型和 PLT 的收益有限。与九循环的普通模型相比，LoopFold 使用五个顺序阶段和额外的并行计算，将解码延迟降低了 46%。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    EXCISE identifies distracting sentences using hidden-state signals and selectively blocks their influence, offering a substantial mechanistic account and intervention for model behavior; its medical QA setting is the application context. It also improves chain-of-thought QA performance, but reasoning is secondary, and the inference-time intervention alone provides only an incidental systems connection.

    EXCISE 利用隐藏状态信号识别干扰句，并有选择地阻断其影响，为模型行为提供了实质性的机制解释与干预；医学问答是其应用场景。它也提升了思维链问答表现，但推理只是次要内容，而单靠推理时干预与系统方面的联系只是附带的。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Language models are increasingly considered for clinical decision support, where their answers should be grounded in clinical evidence and remain robust to irrelevant information. Prior work shows that a single irrelevant sentence can lower the accuracy of medical models, but not where inside the model its effect can be removed, or how to do so without knowing which sentence it is. We find that blocking attention to a known distractor restores the answer, whereas head masking can suppress correct answers. We also show that the model's hidden states mark the distractor as the sentence that least fits the case even when the model follows it. To remove a distractor's effect without knowing which sentence it is, we propose EXCISE, an inference-time method that blocks the sentence most influencing the answer, but only if the model's hidden states mark it as inconsistent with the case. On MedQA-TD (MedQA with Targeted Distractors), a benchmark we construct in which each distractor targets a specific wrong option, EXCISE gains 16.7-22.8 accuracy points at a 1.5-2.1-point cost on the same questions without distractors, outperforming prompting, rewriting, and steering baselines for all three models. Its gains extend to MedDistractQA and BiasMedQA, as well as chain-of-thought generation.

    人们越来越多地考虑将语言模型用于临床决策支持；在这种场景下，模型回答应以临床证据为依据，并能抵御无关信息的干扰。先前研究表明，一句无关文本就可能降低医学模型的准确率，但尚未指出这种影响可以在模型内部的何处消除，也未说明在不知道是哪句话的情况下该如何处理。我们发现，对已知干扰句屏蔽注意力可以恢复正确答案，而屏蔽注意力头则可能抑制正确答案。我们还发现，即使模型跟随了干扰句，其隐藏状态仍会将该句标记为与病例最不契合的句子。为了在不知道具体哪句话是干扰句的情况下消除其影响，我们提出 EXCISE，这是一种推理时方法：它会屏蔽对答案影响最大的句子，但前提是模型隐藏状态将该句标记为与病例不一致。在 MedQA-TD（带定向干扰项的 MedQA）上，EXCISE 的准确率提高了 16.7–22.8 个百分点，而在不含干扰项的同一批问题上仅损失 1.5–2.1 个百分点；在所有三种模型上，它都优于提示、改写和引导基线。其收益还扩展到 MedDistractQA 和 BiasMedQA，以及思维链生成。

    The paper presents an autonomous research agent whose editable harness, gated evaluation, and verification workflow produced several reported results, while also documenting failures and operator involvement. This substantially advances agent-system design; solving research problems is a secondary reasoning connection, and the abstract does not establish compositional generalization or model interpretability.

    本文介绍了一种自主研究智能体，其可编辑运行框架、门控评估和验证流程产出了若干报告结果，同时也记录了失败和操作人员的参与。这对智能体系统设计有实质性推进；解决研究问题与推理有关，但属于次要联系，而摘要并未证明组合泛化或模型可解释性方面的贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    We present the Infinity Machine, a self-improving AI agent that we use for research on problems whose answers aprogram or data can check. Each candidate solution is produced by a full tool-using agent that works for up to an hour in a fresh sandbox; proposers see only a public score, and a private split decides what counts. The harness itself(prompts, tools, skills, playbook, meta agent) is an editable genome, changed only through a kernel-enforced gate with held-out and cost checks. An autonomous mode goes from a plain-text goal to a verified report with no human step: an agent picks an open problem and writes its verifier, the kernel calibrates it, an adversarial agent audits it, and an agent that never sees the verifier re-checks the result. Across fourteen problems in six days, for about $180 of model usage, the system produced four results beyond the published state of the art on catalogued open problems in quantum information: a certified depolarizing-channel threshold point p = 0.064966, a qutrit positivity frontier of 0.2910672, a 44-gate depth-6 Golay state preparation, and a stabilizer-rank bound chi(T^7) <= 10. It also cut SABRE qubit-routing overhead from 68,559 to 12,087 added gates. In hardware, it cut the energy per MAC of an open 8x8 INT8 systolic tile by 77.7% through a full open RTL-to-GDS flow, bit-exact. Three fully autonomous runs ended in honestties with public records; one audit caught a stale record, and one agent-written score pointing the wrong way went unnoticed. We report the failures as carefully: the one self-derived harness generation was rejected on cost, proposers gamed lenient scorers four times, and operator changes were decisive for several results.

    中文

    我们介绍 Infinity Machine，这是一种自我改进的 AI 智能体，我们用它研究答案可由程序或数据检验的问题。每个候选解都由一个完整的工具使用型智能体生成；它在全新的沙箱中运行最长一小时。提案智能体只能看到公开分数，而结果是否有效则由私有数据划分决定。运行框架本身（提示、工具、技能、操作手册、元智能体）是一个可编辑的基因组，但只有通过内核强制执行的门控，并通过留出数据和成本检查后，才能对其进行修改。自主模式能够从纯文本目标出发，无需人工介入即可生成经过验证的报告：一个智能体选取开放问题并编写验证器，内核对其校准，一个对抗性智能体进行审计，而一个从未看过验证器的智能体则重新检查结果。在六天内针对十四个问题运行、模型使用成本约为 180 美元后，该系统在已编目的量子信息开放问题上取得了四项超越已发表最先进水平的结果：一个经过认证的去极化信道阈值点 p = 0.064966，一个 qutrit 正性前沿 0.2910672，一个 44 门、深度为 6 的 Golay 态制备结果，以及一个稳定子秩界 χ(T^7) <= 10。它还将 SABRE 量子比特路由的开销从 68,559 个新增门降至 12,087 个。在硬件方面，它通过完整开放的 RTL 到 GDS 流程，将一个开放的 8×8 INT8 脉动阵列单元每次 MAC 的能耗降低了 77.7%，且结果逐位精确。三次完全自主运行最终得到了与公开记录相符的结果；一次审计发现了过时记录，还有一个由智能体编写、方向错误的评分结果未被发现。我们同样认真报告失败：一次自我推导的运行框架迭代因成本过高而被拒绝，提案智能体四次利用宽松的评分器，而操作人员的修改对若干结果起到了决定性作用。

    ENGLISH

    Linear probes, classifiers that read a language model's internal activations, are widely used to detect harmful requests. They are cheap to train and run, and an auditor who has trained one would like to reuse it when the model is replaced by a successor rather than retrain it for every release. We test how well probes can be reused. For four base models (Qwen2.5-Math-7B, Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen2.5-14B, Qwen2.5-32B) we train a probe on the base model with the XSTest prompt set and apply it, unchanged, to two successors of that base: the DeepSeek-R1 distilled reasoning model and the developer's instruction-tuned chat model. We find that the successors rotate the direction separating unsafe from safe prompts by 17$^\circ$ to 35$^\circ$, yet on XSTest the transferred probe's AUC changes by only $-0.011$ to $+0.027$, and on an independent OR-Bench evaluation, never used for training, by $-0.015$ to $+0.053$. On XSTest, whose safe prompts deliberately contain alarming words, the probes beat a classifier that sees only the prompt text by 0.15 to 0.20 AUC. On the OR-Bench prompts that margin shrinks to 0.03 to 0.20, and the probes flag 29\% to 42\% of prompts that sound harmful but are benign, so part of what they read is the appearance of harm rather than harm itself. A probe trained on a base model can thus be reused, in these families, after distillation and after instruction tuning; how much it reads beyond textual cues depends on the test set.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    EoG develops self-play and a capability-aware curriculum to improve multi-hop logical reasoning over knowledge graphs without QA annotations, a substantial algorithmic contribution to reasoning.     EoG 通过自博弈和感知能力的课程机制，在知识图谱上改进多跳逻辑推理，无需 QA 标注，是对推理方法的重要算法贡献。其图拓扑涉及结构化组合，但摘要并未表明组合泛化是核心贡献；智能体设置与系统的联系则较为有限。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Knowledge graphs (KGs) provide reliable external knowledge for multi-hop factual reasoning with large language models (LLMs), yet most KGs in real-world domains such as finance and industry lack question--answer (QA) annotations. Without such annotations, existing methods struggle to improve LLM graph reasoning: training-free agents cannot improve their exploration through interaction; reinforcement learning (RL) agents depend on QA data annotated by humans or synthesized by closed-source models; and training data is typically built offline, so its topology mix is fixed and cannot follow the agent's ability. We propose Evolve on Graph (EoG), a framework that lets an LLM self-evolve its graph reasoning without any QA annotations. Through Graph Self-Play, a single LLM alternates between a Proposer that poses questions and a Solver that answers them. To make questions verifiable, Symbolically Verifiable Topology Synthesis (SVTS) samples reasoning topologies on the KG and executes the corresponding first-order logic queries, yielding topology skeletons with correct and complete answer sets; guided by a skeleton, the Proposer explores the graph to pose a multi-hop question. To let task topologies follow the Solver, a Boundary-Aware Graph Curriculum rewards the Proposer by the Solver's score variance, keeping questions at the Solver's capability boundary so that complex topologies enter training as the Solver improves. On six benchmarks over Freebase, Wikidata, and an industrial KG, EoG consistently outperforms prompting-, retrieval-, and agent-based methods, showing that LLM graph reasoning can improve through self-play without QA annotations. Our code is available at https://github.com/Szy5/EoG

    中文

    知识图谱（KG）为大型语言模型（LLM）的多跳事实推理提供可靠的外部知识，但金融和工业等现实领域中的大多数 KG 缺少问答（QA）标注。没有这类标注，现有方法难以提升 LLM 的图推理能力：免训练智能体无法通过交互改进探索；强化学习（RL）智能体依赖人工标注或闭源模型合成的 QA 数据；训练数据通常离线构建，因此其拓扑构成固定，无法随智能体能力变化。我们提出 Evolve on Graph（EoG），一个无需任何 QA 标注即可让 LLM 自我进化图推理能力的框架。通过图自博弈（Graph Self-Play），单个 LLM 在提出问题的 Proposer 和回答问题的 Solver 之间交替切换。为使问题可验证，符号可验证拓扑合成（SVTS）在 KG 上采样推理拓扑，并执行相应的一阶逻辑查询，从而生成具有正确且完整答案集的拓扑骨架；在骨架引导下，Proposer 探索图并提出多跳问题。为使任务拓扑随 Solver 的能力变化，边界感知图课程（Boundary-Aware Graph Curriculum）根据 Solver 的分数方差奖励 Proposer，将问题维持在 Solver 的能力边界，使复杂拓扑随着 Solver 能力提升而进入训练。在 Freebase、Wikidata 和一个工业 KG 上的六个基准测试中，EoG 持续优于基于提示、检索和智能体的方法，表明 LLM 图推理无需 QA 标注也可通过自博弈得到提升。我们的代码见 https://github.com/Szy5/EoG

    HSE 从智能体轨迹中分层提炼可复用的编码流程，并展示了技能可在代码库、基准、模型和工具框架之间迁移。这显著推进了智能体记忆和技能复用，与组合泛化有部分关联，但摘要并未表明组合是其核心贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Skills provide agents with reusable experience to guide future decisions without modifying the underlying model. However, coding trajectories are often entangled with task- and repository-specific contexts, making it challenging to distill procedural skills that generalize across diverse coding environments. To address this challenge, we present Hierarchical Skill Evolution (HSE), which progressively distills procedural knowledge from coding trajectories through hierarchical evidence aggregation. HSE first extracts task-level evidence from individual trajectories, then aggregates recurring evidence within the same repository to form repository-specific skill candidates, and finally consolidates consistent patterns across repositories into transferable skills across repositories. The evolution is driven by an external writer-evaluator loop that generates and assesses skills while keeping the underlying coding model frozen. The loop externally updates the writer and evaluator policies to improve subsequent skill generation and assessment. This hierarchy progressively filters task-specific details while preserving procedures that generalize across diverse coding environments. Successful trajectories yield reusable guidance for future tasks, while failed trajectories reveal recurring failure modes that guide avoidance and recovery. We evaluate HSE on SWE-bench Verified and DeepSWE, using GLM-5.2 across Pi and Claude Code harnesses and GPT-5.5 and Opus 4.8 with Pi. Across both benchmarks, 10 skills evolved solely from SWE-Gym improve coding performance across all evaluated settings, demonstrating transfer across benchmarks, coding models, and agent harnesses. We further evolve the skill library from target-benchmark trajectories without verifier feedback, relying solely on the learned evaluator for candidate assessment and achieving additional gains through benchmark-tailored skills.

    中文

    技能为智能体提供可复用经验，以指导未来决策，而无需修改底层模型。然而，编码轨迹往往与特定任务和代码库的上下文交织在一起，因此很难提炼出能在多样编码环境中泛化的程序性技能。为应对这一挑战，我们提出层级技能进化（HSE），通过分层证据聚合，逐步从编码轨迹中提炼程序性知识。HSE 首先从单条轨迹中提取任务层面的证据，然后聚合同一代码库中的重复证据，形成特定于代码库的技能候选项，最后将不同代码库间一致的模式整合为可跨代码库迁移的技能。进化过程由外部的编写者—评估者循环驱动，该循环生成并评估技能，同时保持底层编码模型冻结。该循环在外部更新编写者和评估者策略，以改进后续技能生成和评估。这种分层机制逐步过滤特定于任务的细节，同时保留能在多样编码环境中泛化的流程。成功轨迹为未来任务提供可复用指导，而失败轨迹则揭示反复出现的失败模式，为规避和恢复提供参考。我们在 SWE-bench Verified 和 DeepSWE 上评估 HSE，使用 GLM-5.2 搭配 Pi 和 Claude Code 工具框架，以及 GPT-5.5 和 Opus 4.8 搭配 Pi。在两个基准上，仅从 SWE-Gym 演化出的 10 项技能提升了所有评估设置下的编码表现，展示了跨基准、编码模型和智能体工具框架的迁移能力。我们还在没有验证器反馈的情况下，利用目标基准上的轨迹进一步演化技能库，仅依靠学得的评估器评估候选技能，并通过针对基准定制的技能取得额外提升。

    Akshay Mete, Dileep Kalathil, P. R. Kumar

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    OpTTA adds a goal-reaching objective to test-time world-model adaptation and evaluates its effect on planning under distribution shift. This substantially advances planning and reasoning methods; adaptation of a model at deployment is a secondary systems connection, while the abstract does not address internal representations or compositional generalization.

    OpTTA 在世界模型测试时适应中加入到达目标的目标项，并评估其对分布偏移下规划的影响。这显著推进了规划和推理方法；模型在部署时的适应是次要的系统联系，而摘要没有涉及内部表征或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Latent world models are typically pre-trained offline and kept frozen at test time, so planning with them can degrade under distribution shift. Test-time adaptation (TTA) can mitigate this degradation by updating the model during deployment. Unlike pre-training on fixed data, TTA for planning is closed-loop: the planner uses model rollouts to select actions, and the resulting transitions drive the next update. This raises the question: which objective should guide TTA for planning? Under a prediction-only objective, the model is fit only to the outcomes of its own actions, so it can remain wrong about the actions that would reach the goal, and low prediction error need not translate into better planning. Inspired by reward-biased maximum likelihood from adaptive control, we introduce Optimistic Test-Time Adaptation (OpTTA). Its objective has two terms, the prediction loss on observed transitions and the planner's goal-reaching cost on its candidate rollouts, both minimized over the model parameters. The planning term biases adaptation toward models that are optimistic about reaching the goal, without any additional environment interaction. Across visual and environment shifts on manipulation, reaching and navigation tasks, OpTTA raises final planning success over the frozen model by 13.5 percentage points on average, compared with 6.9 for the prediction-only objective (AdaJEPA), when only the predictor is adapted. When the encoder is adapted as well, the gains are 13.5 and 7.5 points. These experiments span three JEPA world models with different encoders and training objectives and, for temporal straightening, both CEM and gradient-based planners. Our results suggest that test-time adaptation of world models for planning benefits from an optimistic, task-aware term in addition to the prediction loss.

    中文

    潜在世界模型通常在线下预训练，并在测试时保持冻结，因此在分布偏移下，基于它们进行规划的效果可能下降。测试时适应（TTA）可通过在部署期间更新模型来缓解这种性能下降。不同于基于固定数据的预训练，面向规划的 TTA 是闭环的：规划器使用模型展开来选择动作，而由此产生的转移则驱动下一次更新。这引出了一个问题：什么目标应当指导面向规划的 TTA？在仅预测目标下，模型只针对自身动作的结果进行拟合，因此它可能仍然无法正确预测哪些动作能够到达目标；较低的预测误差未必能转化为更好的规划。受自适应控制中奖励偏置最大似然方法的启发，我们提出乐观测试时适应（OpTTA）。其目标包含两项：对观测到的转移计算预测损失，以及对候选展开计算规划器的到达目标代价；两项都针对模型参数进行最小化。规划项使适应偏向于对到达目标持乐观态度的模型，无需与环境进行额外交互。在操控、抵达和导航任务中的视觉与环境偏移下，仅适应预测器时，OpTTA 的最终规划成功率比冻结模型平均提高 13.5 个百分点，而仅预测目标（AdaJEPA）提高 6.9 个百分点。若编码器也同时适应，增幅分别为 13.5 和 7.5 个百分点。这些实验涵盖了三个编码器和训练目标各异的 JEPA 世界模型；在时间拉直任务中，还使用了 CEM 和基于梯度的规划器。我们的结果表明，面向规划的世界模型测试时适应，除了预测损失之外，还受益于乐观且任务感知的目标项。

    Yao Huang, Zhiyuan Zeng, Yu Wang, Zhitong Zhu, Dingcheng Duan, Hao Li, Shangzhi Xu, Yifan Wang, Jinzhe Tu, Shukun Xiong, Yihe Zang, Han Yan, Hongchang Yang, Fuyu Gu, Wei Xu, Yinpeng Dong, Xiaojian Li

    本文通过多个基准比较了一个前沿模型的安全性，并建议在过程层面监控推理轨迹和动作日志。这为智能体行为和评估提供了有用证据，但没有研究推理机制，因此与推理的联系有限。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    As frontier language models grow increasingly capable and autonomous, independent third-party evaluations are critical for characterizing their systemic safety risks. While closed-source releases are routinely accompanied by comprehensive system cards, open-weight models receive less scrutiny regarding frontier risks. To address this gap, we present an independent safety evaluation of DeepSeek V4.1 Flash-1017, the latest version of V4.1 Flash that departs from V4 with a new architecture, scaled-up training, and strong agentic capabilities. Drawing on the EU General-Purpose AI Code of Practice, we evaluate the model across 34 benchmarks, including 5 in-house suites, spanning evaluation integrity, loss of control, and harmful manipulation. Conforming to the AEF-1 standard, we compare V4.1 Flash-1017 against V4.1 Flash, earlier DeepSeek V4 models, and leading closed-source systems (GPT-6 Astra, GPT-5.6 Sol, and Gemini 3.8 Flash). Overall, V4.1 Flash-1017 shows substantial safety improvements over the V4 generation and approaches or matches leading closed-source baselines on several dimensions, while still exhibiting notable behaviors that warrant continued attention. Building on our findings, we highlight three key observations and recommendations. First, because safety can shift and even regress across minor updates, developers should integrate safety evaluation into incremental releases. Second, as final-turn outputs and end-state checks alone cannot reliably detect loss-of-control behaviors, deployments require process-level observability across both reasoning traces and action logs. Third, because public benchmarks elicit strong evaluation awareness and face data contamination risks, developing private benchmarks is essential for trustworthy frontier evaluation.

    随着前沿语言模型的能力和自主性不断增强，独立第三方评估对于刻画其系统性安全风险至关重要。闭源模型发布时通常会附带全面的系统卡，而开源权重模型在前沿风险方面受到的审查较少。为弥补这一缺口，我们对 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash-1017 开展独立安全评估。它是 V4.1 Flash 的最新版本，与 V4 相比采用了新架构、扩大了训练规模，并具备强大的智能体能力。我们参考欧盟《通用人工智能行为准则》，在 34 个基准上评估该模型，其中包括 5 套内部评测，覆盖评估完整性、失控和有害操纵。按照 AEF-1 标准，我们将 V4.1 Flash-1017 与 V4.1 Flash、早期 DeepSeek V4 模型以及领先的闭源系统（GPT-6 Astra、GPT-5.6 Sol 和 Gemini 3.8 Flash）进行比较。总体而言，V4.1 Flash-1017 的安全性相比 V4 代际有显著提升，在多个方面接近或达到领先闭源基线的水平，但仍表现出值得持续关注的行为。基于我们的发现，我们提出三项重要观察和建议。第一，由于安全性可能随小版本更新而变化甚至退化，开发者应将安全评估纳入增量发布流程。第二，仅依靠最终轮输出和终态检查无法可靠地检测失控行为，因此部署时需要对推理轨迹和动作日志进行过程级可观测性监控。第三，由于公开基准会引发较强的评估意识，并面临数据污染风险，开发私有基准对于可信的前沿评估至关重要。

    Runchu Tian, Zaid Khan, Zun Wang, Justin Chih-Yao Chen, Mohit Bansal

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    MiRL profiles recurring terminal-agent errors and uses targeted RL rollouts to reduce them, improving long-horizon task performance with fewer rollouts. This substantially advances agent training and task execution, while its recurring error categories do not establish compositional learning or internal model mechanisms.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Error-targeted learning gives a legible way to improve a model: identify specific weaknesses of the model, train the model to fix these weaknesses, and check whether the weaknesses are fixed. We study how to apply error-targeted learning to terminal agents, which solve long-horizon tasks specified in natural language by interacting with a command shell. Existing error-targeted methods are designed for single-turn tasks, and existing analyses of agent failures are used to evaluate and debug agents rather than to train them. We propose Misbehavior-driven RL (MiRL), which first profiles the errors of a policy to find generalizable misbehaviors: kinds of wrong steps that recur across many environments. MiRL then trains the policy with RL, starting rollouts at the steps where these misbehaviors occur and rewarding a rollout only if it passes the tests and avoids the misbehavior. On Qwen3.5-4B, eight misbehaviors account for 52.1% of wrong steps. After training with MiRL, the policy repeats the measured misbehaviors 43% to 57% less often on average on unseen prefixes. MiRL outperforms TMax-4B on Terminal-Bench Lite (51.8% vs. 47.4%) and matches it on Terminal-Bench 2.1 (21.3% vs. 20.6%), while using 35% of its rollouts. These results show that error-targeted learning can be applied to realistic, long-horizon terminal tasks.

    针对错误的学习提供了一种清晰易懂的模型改进方式：识别模型的具体弱点，训练模型修正这些弱点，并检查弱点是否已得到修正。我们研究如何将针对错误的学习应用于终端智能体；这类智能体通过与命令 shell 交互，解决以自然语言指定的长时程任务。现有针对错误的方法是为单轮任务设计的，而现有对智能体失败的分析用于评估和调试智能体，而非训练智能体。我们提出行为失当驱动的 RL（MiRL），首先对策略的错误进行剖析，以找出可泛化的不当行为，即在多个环境中反复出现的错误步骤类型。随后，MiRL 通过 RL 训练策略，从出现这些不当行为的步骤开始进行展开，并且只有当展开通过测试且避免了该不当行为时才给予奖励。在 Qwen3.5-4B 上，八种不当行为占错误步骤的 52.1%。使用 MiRL 训练后，在未见过的前缀上，策略平均重复这些已测量不当行为的频率降低了 43% 至 57%。在 Terminal-Bench Lite 上，MiRL 优于 TMax-4B（51.8% 对 47.4%）；在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上则与之相当（21.3% 对 20.6%），同时使用的展开次数仅为其 35%。这些结果表明，针对错误的学习可以应用于现实的长时程终端任务。

    审计漏洞获利之处：针对 GRPO 奖励投机的预算受限强验证器审计

    Shurun Li, Michael Hua Wang, Haibo Zeng, Long Wang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper analyzes and tests how budgeted strong-verifier audits and correction randomness affect reward hacking and held-out accuracy during GRPO training. This provides substantial algorithmic insight into training problem-solving behavior; verifier use is incidental to Systems because the contribution does not develop agent or model-system organization.

    本文分析并测试了预算受限的强验证器审计及纠正随机性如何影响 GRPO 训练中的奖励投机和留出准确率。这为训练问题求解行为提供了重要算法见解；验证器的使用与系统领域的联系只是附带的，因为本文并未发展智能体或模型系统组织方法。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards trains on cheap checks, such as unit tests, that a policy can learn to game, while a stronger check is too expensive to run on every rollout. We study how to spend a limited strong-verifier budget in GRPO, separating which weakly passing rollouts to audit from what reward a caught hack receives. At a fixed policy state with centered advantages, the expected update depends on a design only through each rollout's marginal audit probability and correction; reflecting a caught hack's reward about the failure reward negates the advantages of an all-hack group; and auditing whole groups with the fewest weak passes first (low-pass budgeted audits, LB) minimizes the advantage mass left on hacks among pass-count designs with a fixed correction when a label's value falls with the pass count. We tested this analysis in actual LLM training: from each run's starting state, the sign of this mass on a frozen panel predicted whether hacking would be suppressed in 33 of 39 runs, including 13 of 16 preregistered ones. In LeetCode (Wong et al., 2026) and Countdown-Code (Khalifa et al., 2026), LB drives hacking to near zero, while random audits with the same penalty and budget do not and use more labels. We also find that the randomness of the update affects training: in Countdown-Code, two unbiased corrections, per-item reward-level IPW and a group-level advantage correction, bring hacking down too but end 6.1-11.8 and 8.0-11.5 points lower in held-out accuracy than LB at the same budget. A full audit, which the group-level correction reproduces in expectation, stays within about two points of LB in three seeds, while LB uses 28% of its labels, and allocating the same correction by pass count recovers most of the loss (one seed). Training outcomes thus depend not only on the expected update but also on the randomness of its estimate.

    中文

    使用可验证奖励的强化学习依靠单元测试等低成本检查进行训练，而策略可能学会钻这些检查的空子；更强的检查则成本过高，无法在每次展开时运行。我们研究如何在 GRPO 中使用有限的强验证器预算，将选择哪些弱检查通过的展开进行审计，与被发现投机时给予什么奖励区分开来。在优势居中的固定策略状态下，设计对期望更新的影响仅取决于每个展开的边际审计概率和纠正幅度；将被发现投机时的奖励围绕失败奖励进行镜像变换，会抵消全由投机行为构成的组的优势；当标签价值随通过数量下降时，在纠正幅度固定的按通过数量划分的设计中，优先审计弱检查通过数量最少的整组（低通过数预算审计，LB），可最大限度减少留在投机行为上的优势总量。我们在实际 LLM 训练中检验了这一分析：从每次运行的起始状态出发，在冻结面板上测得的该总量符号，能在 39 次运行中的 33 次预测投机是否会被抑制，其中包括 16 次预注册运行中的 13 次。在 LeetCode（Wong et al., 2026）和 Countdown-Code（Khalifa et al., 2026）中，LB 将投机行为降至接近零，而使用相同惩罚和预算的随机审计做不到这一点，且需要更多标签。我们还发现，更新中的随机性会影响训练：在 Countdown-Code 上，两种无偏纠正方法——逐项奖励层级的 IPW 和组级优势纠正——也能减少投机行为，但在预算相同的情况下，其留出准确率分别比 LB 低 6.1 至 11.8 和 8.0 至 11.5 个百分点。全量审计在期望上等同于组级纠正，在三个随机种子下的表现与 LB 相差不超过约两个百分点，而 LB 只使用其 28% 的标签；按通过数量分配相同纠正幅度可弥补大部分性能损失（一个随机种子）。因此，训练结果不仅取决于期望更新，也取决于其估计的随机性。

    Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning Using Routed Ensembles and Trajectory Attribution

    使用路由集成与轨迹归因的多目标强化学习

    Zhenshuo Zhang, Ruoxuan Xiong, and Hongyang R. Zhang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper contributes regret analysis for objective conflict, routed policy ensembles, and trajectory attribution to improve multi-objective reinforcement learning. This advances learning and optimization for decision-making, but it does not study internal model mechanisms; routing and trajectory interactions are algorithmic tools rather than substantive composition or system-architecture contributions.

    本文提出目标冲突的遗憾分析、路由策略集成和轨迹归因方法，以改进多目标强化学习。这推进了面向决策的学习与优化，但没有研究模型内部机制；路由和轨迹交互是算法工具，不构成实质性的组合或系统架构贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Multi-objective reinforcement learning is a fundamental problem for modern AI, with applications spanning post-training, reasoning models, and robotic control. A central challenge is to learn policies that balance competing objectives, such as helpfulness versus honesty in safety and alignment, or speed versus energy in robotics. The optimal policy can vary sharply with objective-weighting combinations, and the extent of this variation depends crucially on the degree of conflict among objectives, making per-preference policy learning sample-inefficient. In this paper, we introduce objective-conflict coefficients and derive near-optimal regret bounds for online settings using this measure, thereby quantifying the impact of misalignment on learning efficiency. Then, we design routed ensemble policy learning, an algorithm that maintains a small set of basis policies and dynamically routes trajectories to the policy with the highest potential reward. Finally, we consider trajectory selection as another approach to mitigate objective conflict, and design a kernel surrogate trajectory attribution algorithm that estimates how feedback signals from a set of trajectories influence policy learning on other trajectories. The kernel can capture nonlinear interactions such as synergy and antagonism between trajectories. We evaluate our approach across diverse environments and benchmarks: routed ensembles improve average performance by 4.3% over baselines for online environments from Meta-World and MO-Gymnasium, and kernel surrogate attribution improves correlation with leave-one-out analysis over existing baselines by 50%. When applied to trajectory selection, kernel-based attribution yields a 27% improvement in reward over baseline attribution methods.

    中文

    多目标强化学习是现代 AI 的基础问题，应用涵盖后训练、推理模型和机器人控制。核心挑战在于学习能够平衡相互竞争目标的策略，例如安全与对齐中的有用性和诚实性，或机器人领域中的速度和能耗。最优策略可能随目标权重组合而显著变化，而这种变化程度关键取决于目标之间的冲突程度，因此针对每种偏好分别学习策略会造成样本效率低下。本文引入目标冲突系数，并利用该指标推导在线场景下近乎最优的遗憾界，从而量化目标不一致对学习效率的影响。随后，我们设计了路由集成策略学习算法，它维护一小组基策略，并动态将轨迹路由至潜在奖励最高的策略。最后，我们将轨迹选择视为缓解目标冲突的另一种方法，并设计一种基于核的代理轨迹归因算法，用于估计一组轨迹上的反馈信号如何影响其他轨迹上的策略学习。该核能够捕捉轨迹间协同和对抗等非线性交互。我们在多种环境和基准上评估了该方法：在 Meta-World 和 MO-Gymnasium 的在线环境中，路由集成的平均表现比基线高 4.3%；基于核的代理归因与留一法分析的相关性比现有基线高 50%。将其用于轨迹选择时，基于核的归因相较于基线归因方法使奖励提升了 27%。

    ENGLISH

    Multi-objective multi-agent reinforcement learning (MOMARL) addresses agent coordination and objective trade-offs simultaneously while optimising overall system performance. Existing work tends to treat multi-agent cooperation and multi-objective optimisation as largely independent components of a learning problem, which amounts to an exorbitant complexity except in trivial cases. We study here whether the structure provided by multiple objectives can itself be exploited to facilitate cooperation, rather than being treated as an additional optimisation challenge. We formulate MOMARL at both the team and individual levels and introduce objective-wise counterfactual credit assignment to evaluate each agent's contribution across the team objectives. We propose Meta-Gradient Informed Multi-Objective Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MIRL), with static (MIRL-S) and dynamic (MIRL-D) variants. By incorporating meta-gradient information, MIRL enables agents to learn how to prioritise objectives individually while collectively optimising the system-level objective, allowing the multi-objective structure to directly guide cooperation. Experiments on a multi-objective multiple particle environment show that our methods improve Pareto-front quality over baselines, with the dynamic variant achieving the strongest performance.

    噪声线性循环神经网络学习动力学理论

    John J. Vastola, Kanaka Rajan

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper analytically studies how intrinsic noise changes weight alignment and solution degeneracy during representation learning in linear RNNs, including a noise-driven phase transition. This gives transferable insight into representation formation, though it does not directly identify model features or circuits.

    本文通过解析研究噪声如何改变线性RNN表征学习过程中的权重对齐和解简并性，其中包括由噪声驱动的相变。这为表征形成提供了可迁移的见解，不过并未直接识别模型特征或回路。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Biological neural networks are noisy: their dynamics involve difficult-to-predict fluctuations which are likely due not just to chaos, but also to a variety of low-level biophysical processes. Despite the omnipresence of intrinsic noise, its theoretical consequences are incompletely understood, especially in the context of learning. For example, does noise meaningfully shape representation learning, or is it better viewed as a nuisance factor whose presence or absence changes little about what solution is found and when? Here, we argue that intrinsic noise can significantly modulate representation learning in recurrent neural networks (RNNs), since it can strongly break solution-space degeneracies and in some cases control whether a non-degenerate solution exists at all. We show that this is true for an analytically tractable model of noisy RNN learning with a linear activation function and white noise inputs. We find that, in the so-called rich regime (where weights are initialized with small values), noise strongly modulates the directions in which the read-in, readout, and recurrent weights align. Moreover, we find that noise produces a kind of phase transition: for sufficiently high noise, a non-degenerate solution is not even optimal if parameter scales are limited (e.g., via regularization). These results extend recent analytic work on RNN representation learning and show that noise can act as a fundamental determinant of representations.

    中文

    生物神经网络具有噪声：其动力学涉及难以预测的波动，这些波动很可能不仅源于混沌，也源于各种低层次的生物物理过程。尽管内在噪声无处不在，我们对其理论后果仍知之甚少，尤其是在学习情境下。例如，噪声是否会实质性地塑造表征学习，还是更适合将其视为一种无关因素，其存在与否对最终找到何种解以及何时找到影响甚微？在此，我们认为，内在噪声能够显著调节循环神经网络（RNN）中的表征学习，因为它可以强烈打破解空间中的简并性，并且在某些情况下决定是否存在非简并解。我们证明，这一结论适用于一个解析上易于处理的噪声RNN学习模型，该模型采用线性激活函数和白噪声输入。我们发现，在所谓的富集区间（权重以较小值初始化）中，噪声会强烈调节输入权重、读出权重和循环权重彼此对齐的方向。此外，我们发现噪声会产生一种相变：当噪声足够高时，如果参数尺度受到限制（例如通过正则化），非简并解甚至不是最优解。这些结果拓展了近期关于RNN表征学习的解析研究，并表明噪声可以成为表征的根本决定因素。

    Aidar Myrzakhan, Zhiqiang Shen

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper distills token-unmasking schedules to reduce diffusion language model decoding rounds while preserving task performance. Mathematical reasoning is an evaluation setting, while the main contribution is adaptive generation computation rather than a reasoning method.

    该论文通过蒸馏词元反掩码调度，减少扩散语言模型的解码轮次，同时保持任务表现。数学推理是其评估场景之一，而其主要贡献是自适应生成计算，而非一种推理方法。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) can generate multiple tokens in parallel, but often require many decoding rounds to complete a response. Efficient generation depends not only on which tokens are easy to predict, but also on how committing to them helps predict the remaining positions. A highly predictable token may provide little useful context, while revealing a less predictable token can help several other positions become predictable sooner. We propose dSpark, a new schedule distillation-based framework for learning when to commit tokens for faster diffusion language generation. To achieve this, we construct unmasking schedules that prioritize tokens whose reveal makes other positions easier to predict, reducing uncertainty earlier in decoding. We then distill these schedules into the model to enable faster parallel sampling, with a KL-divergence regularizer to help preserve generation quality. We extensively evaluate our approach across mathematical reasoning and code generation tasks. On GSM8K, our method achieves remarkable 10.12$\times$ and 5.12$\times$ speedups over the various baselines on LLaDA-8B-Instruct and Dream-7B-Instruct, respectively, while maintaining superior task performance. Our code is available at https://github.com/VILA-Lab/dSpark.

    中文

    扩散大语言模型（dLLMs）可以并行生成多个词元，但通常需要许多解码轮次才能完成响应。高效生成不仅取决于哪些词元容易预测，也取决于提交这些词元如何帮助预测剩余位置。高度可预测的词元可能几乎不能提供有用上下文，而揭示一个较难预测的词元则可能使其他多个位置更快变得可预测。我们提出 dSpark，这是一种基于调度蒸馏的新框架，用于学习何时提交词元，从而加快扩散语言生成。为此，我们构建了揭示调度，优先处理那些能够让其他位置更易预测的词元，从而在解码早期降低不确定性。随后，我们将这些调度蒸馏到模型中，以实现更快的并行采样，并使用 KL 散度正则项帮助保持生成质量。我们在数学推理和代码生成任务上对该方法进行了广泛评估。在 GSM8K 上，我们的方法在 LLaDA-8B-Instruct 和 Dream-7B-Instruct 上分别相较于各类基线实现了显著的 10.12$\times$ 和 5.12$\times$ 倍加速，同时保持了更优的任务表现。我们的代码见 https://github.com/VILA-Lab/dSpark.

    Does VGGT Know What It Does Not Know?

    VGGT知道自己不知道什么吗？

    Adityan Thirumani Srinivasan, David Nordstr\"om

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper shows that intermediate cross-view features encode information about reconstruction failures that the model’s reported confidence misses, using probes and transfer tests. This provides substantial evidence about where failure awareness is represented, while downstream abstention is a limited systems application.

    本文通过探针和迁移测试表明，中间的跨视图特征编码了关于重建失败的信息，而模型报告的置信度未能反映这些信息。这为失败意识在模型中的表征位置提供了有力证据，而下游弃权只是有限的系统应用。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models such as VGGT regress cameras and geometry in a single forward pass, but they report no uncertainty for the camera poses they predict: an incorrect relative pose looks no different from a correct one. We ask whether the frozen model nonetheless knows when its pose is wrong. On HardMatch, a benchmark of 1,000 deliberately difficult image pairs on which VGGT fails on 35% of pairs, a linear probe on VGGT's frozen features predicts pose failure on held-out categories with ROC-AUC 93.5%, compared with 79.7% for VGGT's own point-map confidence and 77.7% for a classifier trained on all of VGGT's outputs. The probe catches failures VGGT is confident about, lets a downstream system abstain on the pairs it distrusts, and transfers without retraining to rotation failures on PhotoTourism and ScanNet-1500, beyond what co-visibility explains. This knowledge is absent from the per-image encoder: it is computed partway through the layers that fuse the two views, and the same holds for a second model, $\pi^3$. In essence, we find that VGGT knows more about its own failures than it reports.

    中文

    VGGT等前馈式3D重建模型会在一次前向传播中回归相机参数和几何信息，但它们不会报告所预测相机位姿的不确定性：错误的相对位姿看起来与正确的没有区别。我们探究冻结模型是否仍然知道自己的位姿何时出错。在HardMatch上，这是一个包含1,000对刻意设置为困难样例的图像对基准，VGGT在其中35%的图像对上失败；在VGGT冻结特征上训练的线性探针能够预测未见类别中的位姿失败，ROC-AUC为93.5%，相比之下，VGGT自身的点图置信度为79.7%，基于VGGT全部输出训练的分类器为77.7%。该探针能发现VGGT虽然自信却仍然失败的情况，使下游系统能够对其不信任的图像对弃权；无需重新训练，它还能迁移到PhotoTourism和ScanNet-1500中的旋转失败案例，其效果超出了共可见性所能解释的范围。逐图像编码器中并不存在这种知识：它是在融合两个视图的网络层中途计算出来的，第二个模型$\pi^3$也呈现相同情况。从本质上说，我们发现VGGT对自身失败的了解超过了它所报告的内容。

    Reva: Real-Time Vulnerability Detection through Contextual Probing of Large Language Models

    Reva：通过对大语言模型进行上下文探测实现实时漏洞检测

    Amine Lbath, Massih-Reza Amini

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    REVA uses a trained probe to read internal LLM representations for vulnerability detection, and its results indicate those representations encode context relevant to agentic analysis. This is a substantial, transferable contribution to representation probing, while agentic reasoning and systems are mainly comparison points rather than contributions.

    REVA使用经过训练的探针读取LLM内部表征以检测漏洞，其结果表明，这些表征编码了与智能体分析相关的上下文信息。这是对表征探测的一项重要且可迁移的贡献，而智能体推理和系统主要是比较对象，并非本文贡献的重点。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    A vulnerability costs more to fix the later it is discovered. As coding agents generate code faster than developers can review it, software needs a first line of defense screening each new function in real time. LLM agents have recently become capable of finding real-world vulnerabilities by working as a security expert would: they run analysis tools, explore the surrounding code, test hypotheses and weigh the evidence before forming their own judgement. This reasoning, however, spans many model calls, so that each verdict takes minutes of compute, far too long for real-time screening. Faster detectors, which fine-tune deep learning models or prompt an LLM for a direct verdict, are less accurate: they judge a function without the context an agent gathers, and an LLM's generated verdict is unreliable even when given some of it. We present REVA (REal-time Vulnerability Analysis), an AI vulnerability detector that brings the security context and code understanding components behind agentic detectors into a single forward pass of an LLM. For each new function, REVA gives the LLM a pre-computed threat model of its module, lightweight static analysis findings and call-graph information. REVA leverages a trained probe to read the LLM's internal representations of the new function in this context. On PrimeVul's held-out test set, REVA on GLM-5.3-Flash reaches 60.0% accuracy in about one second per function. This matches VulTriage (59.2%), the state-of-the-art agentic detector, run on the same LLM, while being over 250 times faster and less than a tenth as costly. On the same prompt, the probe is 14% to 17% more accurate than the LLM's own direct verdict. Across three open LLMs, REVA is at least as accurate as VulTriage, and about 10% more accurate on two of them. An LLM's internal representations thus encode much of what agentic detectors obtain through reasoning.

    中文

    漏洞发现得越晚，修复成本就越高。随着编码智能体生成代码的速度快于开发者审查代码的速度，软件需要一道第一道防线，实时筛查每个新函数。近期，LLM智能体已经能够像安全专家那样发现现实世界中的漏洞：它们运行分析工具、探索周边代码、检验假设并权衡证据，然后形成自己的判断。然而，这种推理涉及多次模型调用，因此每次判定都需要耗费数分钟的计算时间，远远无法满足实时筛查的要求。更快的检测器——包括微调深度学习模型或提示LLM直接给出判定的方案——准确性较低：它们在缺少智能体收集的上下文时判断函数；即使给LLM提供部分上下文，它生成的判定也不可靠。我们提出REVA（REal-time Vulnerability Analysis，实时漏洞分析），这是一种AI漏洞检测器，它将智能体检测器所依赖的安全上下文和代码理解组件整合进LLM的一次前向传播。对于每个新函数，REVA都会向LLM提供预先计算的模块威胁模型、轻量级静态分析结果和调用图信息。REVA利用一个经过训练的探针，读取LLM在此上下文中对新函数形成的内部表征。在PrimeVul的留出测试集上，REVA搭配GLM-5.3-Flash达到60.0%的准确率，每个函数约耗时一秒。这与使用同一LLM运行的当前最先进智能体检测器VulTriage（59.2%）表现相当，同时速度快250倍以上，成本不到其十分之一。在相同提示下，该探针的准确率比LLM自身直接给出的判定高14%至17%。在三个开放式LLM上，REVA的准确率至少与VulTriage相当，并且在其中两个模型上高出约10%。因此，LLM的内部表征编码了智能体检测器通过推理获得的大量信息。

    Profiling a Frontier Agent with EBench: From Direct Control to Harness with Policy

    使用EBench剖析前沿智能体：从直接控制到带策略的框架

    Yifei Yao, Yude Zou, Guanbo Jiao, Xing Gao, Ning Gao, Yukai Wang, Jiantong Chen, Zihou Zhu, Xinyu Li, Ningyu Yan, Shuai Wang, Jianming Ma, Haoyu Guo, Weinan Zhang, Chunhua Shen

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The report evaluates direct robot control by a frontier MLLM and a harness that invokes post-trained policies, showing how their capabilities combine and where orchestration falls short. This provides substantial empirical insight into agent system design; generalization dimensions and task execution do not by themselves establish contributions to compositionality or reasoning mechanisms.

    该报告评估了前沿MLLM的直接机器人控制能力，以及能够调用后训练策略的框架，展示了它们如何结合各自能力，以及协调过程存在哪些不足。这为智能体系统设计提供了重要的实证见解；泛化维度和任务执行本身并不能证明其对组合能力或推理机制有所贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Frontier multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can control robots without robot-specific training, but how their capabilities compare and interact with post-trained vision-language-action (VLA) and world action model (WAM) policies across manipulation demands remains to be thoroughly evaluated. In this report, we evaluate GPT-6-Astra on EBench as the core of an agent that controls a robot through an agent harness under the same visual and proprioceptive observation protocol as post-trained policies. We study two agent configurations: direct control, in which the agent generates waypoint commands directly, and harness with policy, in which it can also invoke a post-trained VLA or WAM policy for action execution. Under direct control, the agent achieves competitive overall performance relative to post-trained policies. It leads on short-horizon tasks and exhibits the least performance variation across generalization dimensions, whereas it underperforms post-trained policies on long-horizon tasks, tabletop manipulation, and high-precision contact-rich tasks. In the harness with policy, invoking a post-trained VLA or WAM combines the complementary strengths of both components, raising overall task success to the level of the strongest compared post-trained policies while substantially reducing token cost. However, performance remains below the per-task upper bound of the standalone components due to suboptimal policy invocation, fixed-instruction execution without subgoals, and grasp disruption when the agent resumes control. Overall, our study characterizes the capability boundary of a frontier MLLM agent and suggests directions for improving future agent harness design. Project page: https://internrobotics.github.io/EBench-Astra-Tech-Report/

    中文

    前沿多模态大语言模型（MLLM）无需针对机器人进行专门训练便能控制机器人，但对于它们在各种操作任务中的能力如何与经过后训练的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略和世界动作模型（WAM）策略比较及交互，目前仍缺乏充分评估。在本报告中，我们在EBench上评估GPT-6-Astra，将其作为智能体核心，通过智能体框架控制机器人，并采用与后训练策略相同的视觉和本体感知观测协议。我们研究两种智能体配置：直接控制，即智能体直接生成航点指令；以及带策略的框架，即智能体还能调用经过后训练的VLA或WAM策略来执行动作。在直接控制模式下，相较后训练策略，该智能体总体表现具有竞争力。它在短时程任务上领先，并且在不同泛化维度上的表现变化最小；但在长时程任务、桌面操作任务以及高精度接触丰富型任务上，其表现逊于后训练策略。在带策略的框架中，调用经过后训练的VLA或WAM能够结合两种组件的互补优势，使整体任务成功率达到最强对比后训练策略的水平，同时显著降低词元成本。然而，由于策略调用欠佳、执行固定指令时没有子目标，以及智能体恢复控制时会干扰抓握，其表现仍低于独立组件在各任务上的上限。总体而言，我们的研究刻画了前沿MLLM智能体的能力边界，并为改进未来的智能体框架设计提出了方向。项目页面：https://internrobotics.github.io/EBench-Astra-Tech-Report/

    Work Agents: Systems, Capabilities, and Optimization

    工作智能体：系统、能力与优化

    Zishan Xu, Enjun Du, Mingqi Gao, Cheng Yang, Junhao Shen, Zirong Chen, Zhiyuan Yao, Yifu Guo, Yuquan Lu, Jinyang Huang, Zhengxi Lu, Siyi Liu, Ziyu Zheng, Yongqi Zhang, Difan Zou, Weiwen Liu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper proposes a system-level framework for characterizing, optimizing, and evaluating agents that execute delegated work across tools and stateful workspaces. This strongly advances agent systems; its discussion of capabilities and task organization touches reasoning and composition, but the abstract does not present focused contributions to either.

    本文提出了一个系统级框架，用于刻画、优化和评估那些借助工具并在有状态工作空间中执行委派工作的智能体。这对智能体系统的发展具有重要推动作用；对能力和任务组织方式的讨论涉及推理和组合能力，但摘要没有提出针对这两者的专门贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    As foundation models evolve from information generation to digital work execution, agents are increasingly capable of completing complex tasks across tools, applications, and workflows. However, existing research lacks a unified perspective on how agents reliably accomplish delegated work. To address this gap, we present a work-centric, system-level perspective that views work agents as systems combining foundation models and runtime harnesses to execute tasks in stateful workspaces and deliver verifiable outcomes. We introduce two complementary dimensions, work persistence and work openness, to characterize working conditions, and classify digital work into five forms according to task scope and organization. Building on this framework, we identify five core capability families required for reliable work execution and examine approaches to model optimization, harness optimization, and their joint optimization. We further analyze existing evaluation methods and metrics from the perspective of work outcomes. Finally, we discuss future research directions, including sustained work delegation, adaptation to open environments, and the interaction between work execution and capability improvement. This paper provides a unified framework for understanding, optimizing, and evaluating work agents, supporting the development of systems capable of delivering reliable, verifiable, and practically valuable work outcomes.

    中文

    随着基础模型从信息生成发展到数字工作执行，智能体日益能够借助工具、应用程序和工作流完成复杂任务。然而，现有研究缺少一个统一视角，来说明智能体如何可靠地完成委派工作。为弥补这一缺口，我们提出一种以工作为中心的系统级视角，将工作智能体视为结合基础模型与运行时框架的系统，用于在有状态的工作空间中执行任务并交付可验证的结果。我们提出两个互补维度——工作持久性和工作开放性——以刻画工作条件，并根据任务范围和组织方式将数字工作划分为五种形式。基于这一框架，我们确定了可靠执行工作所需的五类核心能力，并考察模型优化、框架优化及两者联合优化的方法。我们还从工作成果的角度分析现有评估方法和指标。最后，我们讨论未来研究方向，包括持续委派工作、适应开放环境，以及工作执行与能力提升之间的相互作用。本文提供了一个统一框架，用于理解、优化和评估工作智能体，支持开发能够交付可靠、可验证且具有实际价值的工作成果的系统。
